items.title: Puntland Suspends Aid Agencies, Accuses NGOs of Political Interference
items.description: Garowe (WDN) – Puntland has suspended the operations of several humanitarian organizations working within its territory, accusing them of abandoning their humanitarian mandates and becoming entangled in Somalia’s political affairs. The announcement marks a significant escalation in Puntland’s increasingly strained relationship with both the Federal Government of Somalia and sections of the international aid community. Puntland’s Minister of Humanitarian Affairs and Disaster Management, Abdinasir Haji Yusuf, said organizations implementing projects that do not reflect Puntland’s development priorities or address the region’s humanitarian needs will no longer be permitted to operate. “We are informing humanitarian organizations, particularly those implementing development projects, that any project which does not serve Puntland’s interests has been halted in our territory,” the minister said. He described the decision as a necessary step to safeguard Puntland’s interests and ensure that international assistance benefits the region’s population rather than advancing political agendas. Puntland also renewed longstanding complaints over what it describes as an inequitable allocation of international aid to Somalia. According to Puntland officials, the state receives only about one percent of the international assistance allocated to Somalia, while the overwhelming majority is directed toward southern regions of the country. The administration accused the Federal Government and some international organizations of allowing political considerations to influence the distribution of humanitarian and development assistance, rather than allocating resources based on objective assessments of humanitarian need. Puntland officials argued that aid should be distributed transparently and equitably, ensuring that all Somali communities receive assistance according to need rather than political affiliation or geographic preference. Calls for Reform The regional government called for a comprehensive review of Somalia’s aid allocation mechanisms, urging international donors and humanitarian agencies to adopt a transparent, needs-based system that guarantees fair access to assistance across all regions. The decision comes amid an ongoing political standoff between Puntland and the Federal Government over constitutional reforms, power-sharing, and the broader federal governance model. As of publication, neither the Federal Government of Somalia nor the humanitarian organizations affected by Puntland’s decision had issued an official response to the allegations or the suspension order. items.title: Daawo: Soomaaliya oo war  culus kasoo saartay xaaladda dalka Yemen
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ka hadashay xaaladda kasoo cusboonaatay gudaha dalka Yemen, kadib markii dowladda caalamku aqoonsan yahay dakaas ee uu taageero Sacuudiga, ay qaaday weerarro ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta. Danjire Maxamed Rabiic, oo ka tirsan Ergada Soomaaliya ee Qaramada Midoobay, ayaa jeediyay khudbad xasaasi ah oo uu kaga hadlay dagaalka Yemen, isaga oo ku tilmaamay wax aan la aqbali karin in dagaal dibadda laga soo abaabulo dalkaas oo muddo dheer wajahayay xasilooni-darro gudaha ah. Sidoo kale, wuxuu soo jeediyay in xaaladda dalka Yemen iyo xalkeeda looga dambeeyo shacabka dalkaasi, fursadna loo siiyo in iyagu ay gaaraan go’aanka kama dambeysta ah. “In Yemen loo soo waarido dagaal dibadda ah ma ahan wax la aqbali karo, waxaan ku baaqeynaa in xalka xaaladda dalkaasi looga dambeeyo dadka reer Yemen, iyagoo kaashanaya Qaramada Midoobay,” ayuu yiri Maxamed Rabiic. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas ku daray in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ka xun tahay xaaladaha kasii darayo ee Yemen, gaar ahaan dhibaatada ay wajahayaan shaqaalaha gargaarka e u xiran kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee dalkaasi. Ugu dambeyn, Danjire Maxamed Rabiic ayaa ku baaqay in la ilaaliyo madaxbannaanida dalkaasi, sidoo kalena ay miiska wada-hadalka isugu yimaadaan dhinacyada is haya, si loo gaaro xal waaro. “Waxaan sidoo kale ka xunahay shaqaalaha arrimaha Binu Aadanimada ee u xiran Xuuttiyiinta, waxaan ku baaqeynaa in dhinacyada is haya ay iskugu yimaadaan Miiska wada hadalka” ayuu sii raaciyay Danjiruhu Hadalka DFS ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo weerarkii ugu weynaa shalay lagu qaaday garoonka diyaaradaha ee Sanca, xilli diyaarad ay leedahay shirkadda Mahan Air ee laga leeyahay Iiraan ay isku dayaysay inay halkaas ka dejiso wafdi ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta oo ka soo laabtay aaska hoggaamiye sare oo Iiraan ah. Dowladda Yemen ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay inay ka hortagtay diyaaradda, iyadoo ku doodday inay ka jawaabayso xad-gudub ay Iiraan ku hayso hawada dalka. Kadib weerarkii Sanca, afhayeenka garabka militariga Xuutiyiinta, Yaxye Sariic ayaa isna sheegay in weerarkaas uu “soo afjaray marxaladdii xabbad-joojinta,” isagoo ku hanjabay inay qaadi doonaan jawaab militari oo ka dhan ah dowladda Yemen iyo Sacuudiga. Saacado uun kadib, Xuutiyiintu waxay dhankooda bilaabeen weerarro gantaallo ah oo ay ku beegsadeen gudaha Sacuudiga. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in gantaallo lagu weeraray saldhigga ciidamada cirka ee Boqor Khaalid, halkaas oo qiiq laga arkay, waxaana sidoo kale la beegsaday garoonka diyaaradaha Abha oo ku yaalla koonfur-galbeed Sacuudiga, meel qiyaastii 120KM u jirta xadka Yemen. The post Daawo: Soomaaliya oo war culus kasoo saartay xaaladda dalka Yemen appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Clan Tensions Rise Again in Lower Shabelle as Somalia’s Internal Conflicts Continue to Shift
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Fresh clan tensions are escalating in Somalia’s Lower Shabelle region, raising fears of another round of intercommunal violence in a country where local clan conflicts have increasingly become a recurring feature of the security landscape—even as areas under Al-Shabaab control remain largely free from comparable internal clan warfare. Reports from Lower Shabelle indicate growing tensions in the areas of Janaale, Baqal, Xawaaloow, and Lambar 60, where members of the Biyomaal clan are at odds with sections of the Hiraab clan family, particularly the Abgaal and Habar Gidir communities. The dispute reportedly centers on competing claims over local administration, land ownership, and control of territories recently recovered from Al-Shabaab. Both sides are said to be mobilizing armed supporters, stockpiling weapons, and convening clan meetings as they prepare for a possible confrontation, each insisting it is defending its legitimate rights and interests. The Biyomaal community has announced a campaign to reclaim areas it says were taken from it and has unveiled plans to establish a new local administrative entity it calls “Koonfur Bari.” Meanwhile, elders from the  Hawiye (Abgaal and Habar Gidir) communities have vowed to defend what they describe as their ancestral territories against any attempts to alter the current balance of control. The tensions have already begun to inflict economic damage. Local reports say a commercial farm in Janaale was deliberately set ablaze last week, causing losses estimated at more than $200,000. The farm’s owner has appealed to both the Federal Government of Somalia and the South West State administration to intervene urgently before the dispute erupts into full-scale armed conflict. Neither the Federal Government nor the South West State administration has issued an official statement on the latest developments, despite the region remaining a key theater in ongoing military operations against Al-Shabaab. The latest crisis highlights a troubling pattern that has become increasingly common across Somalia. Only recently, Middle Shabelle witnessed deadly clan clashes. Before that, similar violence erupted in other regions as local communities fought over land, political representation, grazing rights, and control of territory. Observers note a striking paradox: while government-controlled and recently liberated areas repeatedly descend into clan-based violence, comparable inter-clan fighting is rarely reported in territories that remain under Al-Shabaab’s rule. Security analysts argue that the militant group maintains strict centralized control over the areas it governs, suppressing local disputes through coercion and fear. Others suggest that the absence of open clan conflict in Al-Shabaab-held territory underscores the group’s ability to impose order—albeit through intimidation and violence—while exposing the Somali state’s continuing struggle to establish effective governance and dispute-resolution mechanisms in areas it controls. The recurring cycle presents a significant challenge for Somalia’s stabilization efforts. Military victories against Al-Shabaab risk proving temporary if liberated areas quickly become engulfed in clan rivalries, undermining efforts to establish lasting peace and functioning local administrations. As Somalia continues its campaign to recover territory from Al-Shabaab, many analysts argue that preventing clan conflict may prove just as important as defeating the insurgency itself. Without effective reconciliation, inclusive governance, and credible local institutions, newly liberated communities risk exchanging one form of insecurity for another. items.title: Isbeddelka Al-Shabaab: Ma Istaraatiijiyad Baa Mise Waa Lagu Qasbay? (Cilmibaarista Saldhig Institute)
items.description: Machadka cilmibaarista ee Saldhig Institute oo fadhigiisu yahay magaalada Muqdisho ayaa soo saaray warbixin cusub oo si weyn u falanqaynaysa isbeddellada dhanka istaraatiijiyadda, hawlgallada milateri, iyo hannaanka maamul ee kooxda Al-Shabaab ee sannadihii u dambeeyay. Warbixintan oo baxday bishan Luulyo 2026, ayaa ka kooban 40 bog. Waxay si gaar ah u dhuuxaysaa in isbeddellada ka muuqda kooxda ay yihiin kuwo ay iyagu qorshaysteen (istaraatiijiyad) iyo inay yihiin kuwo ku yimid culaysyo kaga imaanaya hawlgallada ciidan iyo isbeddelka siyaasadeed ee dalka ka jira (kuwa lagu qasbay). Beddelka Tabaha Milateri iyo Adeegsiga Sirdoonka Warbixinta ayaa lagu xusay in dhanka hawlgallada milateri ay kooxdu bilowday dhisidda ciidamo gaar ah oo fuliya weeraro qorshaysan, iyadoo si weyn ugu tiirsan xog-ururin sirdoon oo aad u xooggan. Waxay, sidoo kale, adeegsadaan tabaha kediska ah iyo u kuurgalidda daldaloolada amni ee ka jira goobaha ay beegsanayaan, si ay u gaaraan guulo ciidan iyadoo aanay khasaare ballaaran soo gaarin. Ilaha Dhaqaalaha iyo Maamulka Dhinaca maaliyadda, cilmibaaristu waxay muujisay in kooxdu ay si weyn ugu tiirsan tahay ilo dhaqaale oo isugu jira canshuuraha baadda ah, khidmadaha ay ka qaadaan waddooyinka ganacsiga, iyo adeegsiga lacagaha moobilka (mobile money) si ay u maamulaan ugana gudbiyaan dhaqaalahooda qaybaha dalka, taas oo u sahlaysa inay sii joogteeyaan hawlgalladooda. Haddaba, lifaaqan hoose ka sii akhriso cilmibaarista oo dhammaystiran: Qeybta af Soomaaliga ah: https://saldhig.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Isbeddelka-Al-Shabaab-1.pdf Qeybta af Ingiriisiga ah: https://saldhig.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Al-Shabaabs-evolution.pdf

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo gaaray dalka Qatar + Ujeedka
items.description: Doha (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta gaaray magaalada Doha ee caasimada dalka Qatar, halkaas oo ay kusoo dhaweeyeen mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda Qatar iyo safiirka Soomaaliya ee dalkaasi. Ujeedka safarka Madaxweynaha ayaa la xiriira ka qayb-galka aaska Amiirkii hore ee dalkaas, Sheekh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Thani oo Axaddii geeriyooday. Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa la filayaa inuu kulan la yeesho madaxda Qatar oo uu ugu horreeyo Amiirka dalka, Sheekh Tamiim Bin Xamad Aal Thaani oo uu uga tacsiyeyn doono geerida Amiirkii hore. Doha waxaa sidoo kale gaaray madax iyo wafuud kala duwan oo ka kala socda waddamo badan, oo ay ka mid yihiin Sacuudi Carabiya, Isutegga Imaaraadka Carabta, Baxrayn, Kuwait, Cumaan, Ciraaq, Suuriya, Pakistan, Itoobiya, Kazakhstan, Maldives, Rwanda, Lubnaan, Marooko iyo Liibiya. Dhammaan wafuudan caalamiga ah ayaa dowladda iyo shacabka Qatar uga tacsiyeeyay geerida Amiirkoodii hore. Sheekh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Thani ayaa Qatar hoggaaminayay intii u dhexeysay 1995 illaa 2013. Intii uu talada hayay, wuxuu hormuud ka noqday isbeddello waaweyn oo dalkaas ka hirgalay, kuwaas oo sare u qaaday doorka Qatar ee gobolka iyo caalamkaba. Sannadkii 2013 ayuu Sheekh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Than si iskiis ah xilka ugu wareejiyay wiilkiisa, Amiir Tamim Bin Hamad Al Thani. Dhanka kale, dowladda Qatar ayaa ku dhawaaqday 4 maalmood oo baroordiiq qaran ah oo ka bilaabatay shalay, iyadoo calanka dalka hoos loo dhigay. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale hadda wada qaban-qaabada aaska rasmiga ah ee loo sameynayo Amiirkii hore. Si kastaba, Qatar ayaa kamid ah dalalka Carbeed ee taageerada kala duwan siiya Dowladda Federaalka, taas oo keentay in Soomaaliya ay hoos u dhigto calankeeda muddo saddex cisho ah, kadib amar kasoo baxay Madaxweynaha. The post Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo gaaray dalka Qatar + Ujeedka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ciidamada Mareykanka oo dhaqangeliyay go’doominta cusub ee Dekedaha Iran
items.description: Ciidamada Mareykanka ee ku sugan Gacanka Cumaan ayaa Talaadadan dhaqangeliyay xayiraadaha dhanka badda ee Mareykanka uu dib ugu soo rogay Dekedaha Iran. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Isniintii sheegay in Mareykanka uu soo celinayo xayiraadihii Dekedaha Iran ee la qaaday bishii hore ee June, ka dib markii uu ciidamada dalkaasi ku eedeeyay inay weerareen maraakiib ganacsi oo ku sugnaa Marinka Hormuz. Go’doomintan ayaa saamayn doonta maraakiibta ganacsiga ee ku sii jeeda ama ka imanaya Dekedaha Iran, isla-markaana adeegsanaya marin biyoodka Hormuz. Tallaabadan oo uu fulinayo Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Mareykanka (CENTCOM) ayaa lagu horjoogsanaya dhammaan maraakiibta iyo shirkadaha la macaamila Dowladda Iran inay taggaan xeebaha dalkaasi amaba ay ka baxaan. Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa laga soo xigtay in si isku mid ah ay Ciidanka Badda Mareykanka u beegsan doonaan maraakiibta booyadaha shidaalka iyo kuwa kale ee sida shixnadaha ganacsiga. Madaxweyne Trump ayaa qoraal uu ku daabacay bartiisa xiriirka bulshada ku sheegay in dhammaan maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamiga ah ay mari karaan Hormuz, marka laga soo tago buu yiri kuwa Iran. items.title: Trump oo bahdilay dalalka Khaliijka, kana dalbaday lacag xilli uu kasii darayo dagaalka Iran
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Xiisadda u dhexeysa Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa gashay marxalad cusub oo aad u halis badan, kadib markii labada dal ay is dhaafsadeen weerarro militari, halka hadallo adag oo kasoo baxay Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump ay sii kordhiyeen walaaca laga qabo in colaaddu ku fido guud ahaan gobolka Khaliijka. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Iran ay billowday weerarro ay ku beegsaneyso saldhigyada ciidamada Mareykanka ku leeyihiin dalalka Khaliijka, iyadoo tallaabadaas lagu sheegay jawaab ay ka bixineyso duqeymihii ugu dambeeyay ee ciidamada Mareykanku ka fuliyeen gudaha Iran. Madaxweyne Donald Trump oo warbaahinta kula hadlay Aqalka Cad ayaa sheegay in Mareykanku uu sii wadi doono difaaca dalalka Khaliijka, balse wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in dowladahaasi ay bixiyaan kharashka ku baxaya sugidda amnigooda. “Waxaan rabaa in nala siiyo lacag, sababtoo ah waxaan ilaalinaynaa qayb aad u hodan ah oo dunida ka mid ah. Lacag badan ayaan ku bixinnaa arrintan,” ayuu yiri Trump. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Mareykanku dhaqaale ka heli doono dalalka uu difaacayo, sida Sacuudiga, Imaaraadka Carabta, Qatar, Baxrayn, Kuweyt iyo dalal kale. Trump ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Mareykanku uusan ku tiirsanayn shidaalka Khaliijka, maadaama uu leeyahay keyd shidaal oo ballaaran. Dhanka kale, Trump ayaa ku dhawaaqay qorsheyaal cusub oo cadaadis dhaqaale lagu saarayo Iran, taas oo kamid tahay go’doominta dekedaha Iran. Wuxuu kaloo sheegay in canshuur dhan 20% lagu soo rogi doono dhammaan maraakiibta xamuulka ee isticmaasha marin-biyoodka Hormuz oo ka mid ah marinnada ganacsiga ee ugu muhiimsan dunida. Isla waqtigaas, guddoomiyaha gobolka Bushehr ee Iran, Maxamed Mozaffari ayaa xaqiijiyay in ciidamada Mareykanku ay xalay duqeeyeen laba goobood oo ku yaalla degmooyinka Bushehr iyo Chaghadaq. Wuxuu sheegay in goobihii la bartilmaameedsaday ay ahaayeen goobo gaar ah, balse baaritaannadii ugu horreeyay ay muujiyeen in aysan jirin wax dhimasho ama dhaawac ah oo ka dhashay weerarradaas. Dhankiisa, Taliska dhexe ee ciidamada Mareykanka (CENTCOM) ayaa sheegay in weerarradu ay ku beegsadeen goobo militari oo ku yaalla Bushehr, Chabahar, Jask, Konarak, Abu Muusa iyo Bandar Cabbaas. CENTCOM ayaa xusay in ujeeddada howlgalka ay ahayd in la wiiqo awoodda Iran ee lagu weerari karo ama lagu carqaladeyn karo maraakiibta ganacsiga ee isticmaasha marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Subaxnimadii Talaadada, ciidanka ilaalada kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iran (IRGC) ayaa soo saaray bayaankoodii toddobaad, iyagoo ku dhawaaqay inay si rasmi ah uga jawaabeen weerarradii Mareykanka. IRGC ayaa sheegtay inay gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku weerareen xarunta isgaarsiinta dayax-gacmeedka iyo dhismaha ay deggan yihiin ciidamada Mareykanka ee saldhigga Juffair ee dalka Baxrayn. Wararka ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in isla saaka uu dhacay mid ka mid ah weerarradii ugu waaweynaa ee ay IRGC qaaday tan iyo markii ay colaaddu cirka isku shareertay, iyadoo laba markab oo shidaal sida lagu beegsaday Marinka Hormuz. Weerarkaas ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo amniga maraakiibta caalamiga ah iyo saameynta uu ku yeelan karo suuqyada tamarta. Dowladaha Isu-tagga Imaaraadka Carabta iyo Baxrayn ayaa sheegay in ugu yaraan hal qof uu ku dhintay weerarrada, halka siddeed kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen. Dhanka kale, wakaaladda wararka ee Tasnim, oo ku dhow IRGC ayaa werisay in weerarro kale laga fuliyay gudaha Kuwait, isla markaana “mowjado qiiq ah” laga arkay magaalada Manama ee caasimadda Baxrayn. Tan ayaa muujinaya in xiisadda u dhexeysa Mareykanka iyo Iran ay sii ballaaraneyso, iyadoo laga cabsi qabo inay isu beddesho dagaal saameeya gobolka oo dhan. items.title: Kumaandooska Danab oo galay goobo gabaad u ahaa Shabaab
items.description: Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab ee Xoogga Dalka ayaa bishii labaad si xiriir ah hawlgalo ka dhan ah maleeshiyada Al Shabaab uga wada Gobolka Jubbada Hoose. Taliska Kumaandooska Danab ayaa maanta sheegay in ciidamadu ay hawlgal burburin ah ka sameeyeen deegaanada Lafa-gari iyo Xabala Afwaax ee gobolkaasi. “Hawlgaladan oo si qorsheysan loo fuliyay ayaa lagu bartilmaameedsaday fariisimo iyo goobo ay ku dhuumaaleysanayeen maleeshiyaadka Khawaarijta.” Ayuu talisku ku sheegay war qoraal ah. Warka ayaa lagu yiri “Ciidanka Kumaandooska Danab ayaa gudaha u galay goobihii ay kooxdaasi gabaadka ka dhigan jirtay, iyagoo burburiyay xarumo iyo saldhigyo ay u adeegsanayeen abaabulka iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyadooda.” Taliska Danab ayaa sheegay in hawlgalada lagu wiiqayo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ay yihiin kuwo lagu xaqiijinayo amniga, difaaca shacabka iyo xasilloonida dalka. Ciidanka Ururka 162aad ee Kumaandooska Danab ayaa hoggaaminaya gulufka Al Shabaab lagaga saarayo deegaanada dhaca dhulka hawdka ee Gobolka Jubbada Hoose. Kumaandooska Danab ayaa tan iyo bishii June hoggaaminaya hawlgalada ay Ciidanka Guutada 11aad, Qaybta 43aad ee Xoogga Dalka iyo Daraawiishta Jubbaland ka wadaan deegaanada qaar ee Gobolka Jubbada Hoose iyo meelo ku dhow xadka uu gobolkaasi la wadaago Gobolka Jubbada Dhexe.

items.title: Somalia seeks to expand partnership with Brazil
items.description: Somalia’s new ambassador to Brazil, Omar Mohamed, said on Tuesday (14) that he intends to expand trade and cooperation with Brazil. He visited the Arab-Brazilian Chamber of Commerce ( ABCC ) in São Paulo before continuing on to Canada, where he lives. Mohamed is a non-resident ambassador and will oversee relations with Brazil from Somalia’s embassy in Havana, Cuba, where he will also operate as an ambassador to South and Central America countries. Mohamed told Mohamad Orra Mourad, the ABCC’s Vice President of International Relations and Secretary-General, that he intends to work toward expanding trade between the two countries and making the exchange of goods more frequent and direct. Somalia, a country of 20.3 million people, currently relies on intermediaries in other countries for its imports. “As a result, trade becomes slower and dependent on middlemen, but it can become much more effective,” he told ANBA. To make trade more efficient, Mohamed proposed a meeting between the ABCC, the Somali Chamber of Commerce and Industry and business leaders. “All the chicken we consume comes from Brazil. But we are buying it through other companies rather than directly from Brazilian ones,” he said. Market Intelligence Manager Marcus Vinícius presented data on bilateral trade. In 2025, Brazil exported USD 126 million worth of goods to Somalia, down 18.2% from 2024. Somalia, in turn, exported USD 7,000 to Brazil, a decline of 31.7% over the same period. Brazil’s main exports were sugar and chicken meat, while Somalia’s leading exports were ornamental fish and essential oils. During the meeting, Mourad also invited Mohamed and Somali business leaders to attend the Brazil & Arab Countries Economic Forum, describing it as an opportunity to establish contacts and explore business opportunities. Organized by the ABCC, the forum will be held on August 25 in São Paulo. The diplomat presented his credentials to Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva last Wednesday (8), alongside 13 other ambassadors who officially began representing their countries in Brazil. Anba.

items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo jebisay xabbad joojin 4 sano ah kadib weerarkii Abha
items.description: Kooxda Xuutiyiinta, oo ay taageerto Iran, ayaa markii ugu horreysay muddo afar sano ah Gantaallo iyo Diyaarado aan duuliyaha lahayn (drones) ku weerartay Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Abha ee koonfur-galbeed Soomaaliya. Weerarkan ayaa kabulo Xiisaddii ugu weyneyd tan iyo xabbad-joojintii aan rasmiga ahayn ee 2022, kaas oo yimid kadib markii Sacuudi Carabiya lagu eedeeyay inay weerartay garoonka diyaaradaha ee Sanaa, Yemen. Weerarkan ayaa muhiim u ah, sababtoo ah waxa uu jebiyay xasiloonidii ku yaraa xadka koonfurta Sacuudiga tan iyo 2022, kaddib markii ay Xiisaddu sii kordhay heerkii ugu sareeyey tan iyo dagaalkii 2015. Waxaa ka daba dhacay xiisad ku saabsan diyaarad Iranian ah oo soo raacday wafti Xuutiyiinta ka soo laabtay aaskii Khameini, taasoo Dowladda Yemen ay ku sheegtay inay tahay ku xadgudub. Sacuudiga oo lagu eedeeyay weerarkii Sanaa ma waxay taasi keeni doontaa xiisad cusub? Xuutiyiinta ayaa ku hanjabay inay weerarkan ku jawaabi doonaan, isagoo todobaadkii hore ku tilmaamay in ay “dhammaatay xilligii xasilinta”. Afhayeenka ciidamada Xuutiyiinta, S/ Gaas Yahya Saree, ayaa sheegay in ay ku weerareen Abha si ay “uga jawaabaan gardarrada Sacuudiga”. Wuxuu intaa ku daray inuu uga digay shirkadaha diyaaradaha inay ka dhaafaan hawada Sacuudiga ilaa la qaado “xannibaadda” garoonka Sanaa. Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa ku yeedhay kulan degdeg ah oo laga hadlay sidii looga hortagi lahaa in xiisadda ay sii kordho. Ku-xigeenka Xoghayaha Guud, Khaled Khiari, ayaa yidhi: “Yemen iyo gobolka weyn ma awoodaan inay mar kale soo maraan wareeg kale oo xiisad ah.” Dhanka kale, Dowladda Yemen, oo ay taageerto Sacuudiga, ayaa sheegtay inay weerartay garoonka Sanaa si ay uga hortagto diyaarad Iranian ah inay ku soo degto. Waxay ku xustay war-saxaafadeed in “Xuutiyiinta ay diideen inay oggolaadaan diyaaradaha Yemen, balse ay ku adkaysteen diyaarad Iranian ah oo ku xadgudubtay hawada Yemen”. Weerarkan Gantaallada iyo Diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ayaa ku soo aaday xilli ay taariikhdu tahay 13 Luulyo 2026, waxaana la sheegay in ciidamada Sacuudiga ay ka hortageen qaar ka mid ah, iyada oo aan la soo sheegin khasaare. items.title: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo Howlgal Qorsheysan ka Fuliyay Deegaanno Hoostaga Degmada Sablaale
items.description: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa howlgal qorsheysan oo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab ka fuliyay deegaanno dhowr ah oo hoostaga magaalada Sablaale ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Howlgalkan oo ahaa mid ballaran ayaa si gaar ah uga dhacay tuulooyinka kala ah: Faytaan, Sadex, Aqab, Wabi Goof, Buula Doon, Baroodooy, Xaliima iyo Yaalo, kuwaas oo dhammaantood hoos yimaada degmada Sablaale. Taliyaha Ururka 61-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Dhamme Jamaal Cilmi Aadan oo hoggaaminayay howlgalka, ayaa warbaahinta u sheegay in ujeedka howlgalkan uu ahaa mid lagu burburinayay fariisimo iyo goobo ay ku dhuumaaleysan jireen kooxda Al-Shabaab. Taliyaha ayaa xusay in goobahaas ay kooxdu u adeegsan jirtay dhibaataynta, baaddada iyo cabsi-gelinta dadka shacabka ah ee ku nool deegaannadaas. Saraakiisha ciidanka ayaa xaqiijiyay inay ku guuleysteen burburinta dhowr fariisin oo ay kooxdu ku lahayd deegaannada la baaray, waxayna wacad ku mareen inay sii wadayaan howlgallada ilaa inta deegaannadaas si buuxda looga nadiifinayo haraadiga kooxda Al-Shabaab si dadka deegaanka ay u helaan nabadgelyo iyo xasillooni.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Spain oo kala saxiixday heshiis deyn loogu beddelayo mashaariic horumarineed
items.description: Soomaaliya iyo Spain ayaa magaalada Madrid ku kala saxiixday heshiis deyn loogu beddelayo mashaariic horumarineed, kaas oo dowladda Soomaaliya ay sheegtay inuu u oggolaanayo in lacagihii lagu bixin lahaa deymaha loo weeciyo maalgelinta mashaariic horumarineed oo mudnaan leh. Sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Maaliyadda Soomaaliya, heshiiska ayaa lagu saxiixay Isniintii magaalada Madrid, waxaana looga golleeyahay in deyn cafinta Soomaaliya loo beddelo maalgelinta mashaariic lagu horumarinayo adeegyada bulshada, lagu dhiirrigelinayo kobaca dhaqaalaha, isla markaana gacan ka geysanaya gaaritaanka yoolalka horumar waara ee dalka. Dowladda Soomaaliya waxaa munaasabadda saxiixa ku matalay Agaasimaha Guud ee Wasaaradda Maaliyadda, Suleymaan Sheekh Cumar, kaas oo uga mahadceliyay dowladda Spain iyo saaxiibbada horumarinta taageerada ay u fidiyeen hirgelinta heshiiskan. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in heshiiskani uu suuragelinayo in lacagihii loogu talagalay bixinta deymaha loo weeciyo maalgelinta mashaariic horumarineed oo mudnaan leh, gaar ahaan kuwa diiradda saaraya adeegyada bulshada iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha ee muddada dheer. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dowladda ma shaacin qiimaha deymaha uu heshiisku daboolayo, mashaariicda maalgelinta heli doonta iyo jadwalka rasmiga ah ee hirgelinta. Heshiiskan ayaa imanaya kaddib markii Soomaaliya ay sannadkii 2023 si guul leh u dhammaystirtay Hindisaha Dalalka Saboolka ah ee Deymaha Badan (HIPC), kaas oo si weyn u dhimay culayskii deynta dibadda isla markaana dib ugu soo celiyay awoodda dalka ee helitaanka maalgelinta caalamiga ah. Spain ayaa ka mid ah dalalka caalamka ku dhiirrigeliya heshiisyada deynta loogu beddelo horumarinta, iyadoo la kaashanaysa Bangiga Adduunka si loo sameeyo hannaan u oggolaanaya dowladaha inay lacagaha deymaha u weeciyaan barnaamijyada horumarineed. Mas’uuliyiin ayaa sheegay in heshiiskan cusub la filayo inuu sii xoojiyo iskaashiga dhaqaale ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Spain, isla markaana dhaqaalaha loo weecin doono mashaariic lagu horumarinayo adeegyada bulshada iyo kor u qaadidda heerka nololeed ee shacabka Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: Maxay yihiin kulamada ay DF Soomaaliya ka wado Pakistan? + Sawirro
items.description: Islamabad (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka ee Soomaaliya, Amb. Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi ayaa kulan doceedyo la yeelatay madax iyo mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka kala socday hay’adaha iyo dowladaha xubnaha ka ah ururka iskaashiga Islaamka (OIC) intii uu ka socday magaalada Islamabad shirka haweenka Islaamka. Wasiirka ayaa kulan doceedyada la qaadatay agaasimaha fulinta Guddiga Madaxbannaan ee Joogtada ah ee Xuquuqda Aadanaha ee OIC (IPHRC), wasiirka shaqada iyo amniga bulshada ee Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga Waqooyiga Qubrus (TRNC) iyo agaasimaha guud ee xarunta cilmi-baarista iyo tababarka dhaqaalaha, bulshada iyo tirakoobka ee dalalka Islaamka (SESRIC). Sidoo kale, kulamadan waxaa qeyb ka ahaa wasiirka arrimaha haweenka, carruurta iyo daryeelka bulshada ee Bangladesh, guddoomiyaha golaha qaranka haweenka ee Masar iyo xoghayaha guud ee golaha arrimaha qoyska ee Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya. Intii ay socdeen kulamadu, waxaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dalalka xubnaha ka ah (OIC), gaar ahaan dhinacyada horumarinta qoyska, ilaalinta xuquuqul insaanka, awood-siinta haweenka, daryeelka carruurta, horumarinta bulshada iyo is-dhaafsiga khibradaha iyo aqoonta. Kulamadu waxay ku soo dhammaadeen is-afgarad ku saabsan sii ballaarinta iskaashiga iyo kor u qaadidda wada-shaqeyn miro-dhal ah oo wax ka tari doonta horumarinta adeegyada bulshada iyo hirgelinta barnaamijyada mudnaanta u leh Soomaaliya. Wasiir Khadiija ayaa sidoo kale ka qeyb gashay kulamo kale oo lagu xoojinayay xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo dalalka xubnaha ka ah Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka (OIC), iyadoo xoogga lagu saaray sidii loo horumarin lahaa barnaamijyada bulshada iyo adeegyada la xiriira qoyska. Wasiir Khadiijo waxaa kulamada ku weheliyey Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya u fadhiya Pakistan, Danjire Sheekh Nuur Maxamed Xasan. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan oo ku Heshiiyay inay Xoojiyaan Iskaashiga Waxbarashada Loo Dhan Yahay
items.description: Dawladaha Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan ayaa ku heshiiyay inay xoojiyaan iskaashigooda dhanka waxbarashada loo dhan yahay, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ballanqaadeen inay ballaarin doonaan fursadaha waxbarasho ee gabdhaha iyo dadka baahiyaha gaarka ah qaba, taas oo qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu horumarinayo helitaanka waxbarashada tayada leh. Heshiiskan ayaa lagu gaaray wadahadallo ka dhacay magaalada Islamabad oo ay yeesheen mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Wasaaradda Horumarinta Qoyska iyo Xuquuqul Insaanka ee Soomaaliya iyo Wasaaradda Waxbarashada Federaalka iyo Tababarka Xirfadaha ee Pakistan. Wadahadallada ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray sidii loo kordhin lahaa iskaashiga dhanka waxbarashada baahiyaha gaarka ah, kor loogu qaadi lahaa helitaanka waxbarashada ee carruurta naafada ah, iyo dhiirangelinta barashada luuqadda astaamaha si waxbarashada loogu fududeeyo dadka qaba dhibaatooyinka maqalka. Labada dhinac ayaa adkeeyay in waxbarashada loo dhan yahay ay lagama maarmaan u tahay horumarka waara, dhexgalka bulshada, iyo ka qeybgalka dhaqaalaha. Waxay sidoo kale isku raaceen inay sahmiyaan goobaha wax ku oolka ah ee iskaashiga labada dhinac, oo ay ku jiraan wadaagista aqoonta, dhisidda awoodaha hay’adaha, iyo isweydaarsiga khibradaha aqooneed. Kulankan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli ay Soomaaliya sii waddo dadaallada ay dib ugu dhiseyso nidaamkeeda waxbarasho ka dib tobanaan sano oo colaado ah kuwaas oo malaayiin carruur ah ka reebay helitaanka waxbarashada. Intii ay ku sugnayd magaalada Islamabad, Wasiirka Horumarinta Qoyska iyo Xuquuqul Insaanka ee Soomaaliya, Khadiijo Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi, waxay sidoo kale saxiixday buugga tacsida ee loo furay safaaradda Qatar ee dalka Pakistan ka dib geeridii Amiirkii hore ee dalka Qatar, Sheekh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani, iyadoo gaarsiisay tacsida dowladda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Wadahadalladan dhanka waxbarashada ah ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada ballaran ee ay Soomaaliya ku doonayso inay ku xoojiso xiriirka caalamiga ah, si loo helo iskaashi ku aaddan qeybaha waxbarashada, caafimaadka, maamulka, iyo horumarinta dadka, kuwaas oo fure u ah dib-u-soo-kabashada iyo koritaanka dhaqaalaha dalka.

items.title: Heshiiska aqoonsigu inaga ayay dani inoogu jirtaa waliba inta badan
items.description: Beri aan Madaxtooyada tagay bal si aan indhahayga ugu soo arko heshiiskii ay Madaxweyne Cabdiraxman iyo Raysalwasare Netanyahu dhawaan ku kala sexeexden Tel Aviv. Markaan akhriyay heshiiska waxa ii soo baxday in uu 70% dan yahay dalka iyo dadka Reer Somaliland 30% uu dan u yahay nimanka Reer Binu Israel. Berigii ay Xumada kursigu na haysay ayaa habeen anagoo rag badan oo Garxajis ah ayaanu ku wada hadalay Conference phone dabadeed nin ka mida ragii khadka ku jiray ayaa yidhi “Habar Jeclo way Ina khiyaamaynayaan ee yaynaan aaminin”.!!!! items.title: Soomaaliya oo ECOSOC ku soo bandhigtay horumarkeeda
items.description: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Qorsheynta, Maalgashiga iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Maxamuud C. Sheekh Faarax (Beenebeene), ayaa khudbad rasmi ah ka jeediyay Shirka Heer Wasiir ee Golaha Dhaqaalaha iyo Arrimaha Bulshada ee Qaramada Midoobay (ECOSOC), isagoo weheliya Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Istaatistikada Qaranka, Dr. Cabdisalaam Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed. Wasiirku waxa uu iftiimiyay guulaha taariikhiga ah ee dalka ka gaaray dib-u-habeynta dhaqaalaha, dowlad-dhiska iyo dimuqraadiyeynta . Khudbaddan ayaa muhiim u ah, sababtoo ah waxay ka dhigan tahay Soomaaliya oo horumar xasaasi ah ka sameysay heer caalami ah, iyadoo ECOSOC uu yahay mid ka mid ah golaha ugu muhiimsan ee Qaramada Midoobay oo diiradda saaraya horumarinta dhaqaalaha iyo arrimaha bulshada . Soomaaliya waxay ka mid tahay dalalka xubnaha ka ah ECOSOC tan iyo 1971 . Wasiirku waxa uu xusay guulo muhiim ah oo dalka ka gaaray, oo ay ka mid yihiin dhammaystirka Barnaamijka Deyn Cafinta (HIPC Completion Point), qaadista cunaqabateyntii hubka ee Qaramada Midoobay, hirgelinta doorashooyinka qof iyo cod ee ugu horreeyay muddo ka badan 50 sano, iyo doorashada Soomaaliya ee Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay. Wuxuu yidhi: “Qorshaha Isbeddelka Qaranka (NTP 2025–2029) wuxuu yahay tubta hagaysa horumarka dalka, isla markaana uu saldhig u yahay u-guurista horumar waara oo ku dhisan kobac dhaqaale, maalgashi iyo hoggaan qaran.” Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in dalka si tartiib tartiib ah looga gudbayo ku-tiirsanaanta gargaarka bani’aadannimo . Waxaa intaas dheer, Wasiirku waxa uu xusay in Soomaaliya ay horumar muuqda ka sameysay qorsheynta ku saleysan xogta, xoojinta nidaamka tirakoobka qaranka iyo horumarinta go’aan-qaadashada ku dhisan caddeymo, kuwaas oo sare u qaaday dabagalka iyo qiimeynta horumarka laga gaarayo Yoolalka Horumarka Waara (SDGs). Doodaha ECOSOC waxay diiradda saareen “Transformative, equitable, innovative and coordinated actions for the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and its Sustainable Development Goals for a sustainable future for all” . Soomaaliya waxay ku soo bandhigtay qorshaheeda iyo hiigsigeeda horumarineed goobtan caalamiga ah. Gabagabadii, Wasiirku wuxuu ugu baaqay saaxiibbada horumarinta inay sii xoojiyaan iskaashiga, isla markaana ballanqaadyadooda u beddelaan ficil muuqda oo lagu taageerayo mudnaanta horumarineed ee dalka. Wuxuu xusay in iskaashi dhab ah iyo maalgashi joogto ahi ay muhiim u yihiin dardargelinta hirgelinta Yoolalka Horumarka Waara iyo dhismaha Soomaaliya nabdoon, barwaaqo leh, isla markaana waarta . The post Soomaaliya oo ECOSOC ku soo bandhigtay horumarkeeda first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: The Houthi-Saudi truce is unravelling and that has implications for the wider Horn.
items.description: File picture: Saudi Defence Minister meets Houthi delegation in Riyadh (September 20, 2023 – SPA) Four years of a fragile truce shattered this week following rapid escalation in tit-for-tat strikes between KSA and the Houthi movement in Yemen. First, Saudi Air Force struck San’a airport runway to block a senior Houthi delegation returning from Tehran from landing. The delegation included men deemed by Saudis to have been working against their interests. The Houthis struck back targeting an airport in Abha, Saudi Arabia. The truce is still reparable. Likely both sides prefer the status quo than a return to full-scale conflict. A flare-up in its southern flank when it also facing missile barrages from Iran, is an outcome Riyadh will work to avoid. The Saudis struggled for years to defeat the Houthis without success. KSA cannot contain the Houthis on its own and certainly not via airstrikes alone. Another ground invasion is out of the question for a variety reasons. The big question now is whether Israel and KSA might cooperate tactically to degrade the Houthis since both have an interest in seeing the Iran-backed group crippled. A difficult proposition, a remote prospect for now, but still impossible to rule out. If that happens, Somaliland could be the unlikely beneficiary. Israel’s recognition of Somaliland was partly linked to its need for a regional outpost to monitor and fight the Houthis more effectively. A Saudi-Israel cooperation to degrade the Houthis – as fanciful/unlikely as it may sound – can only work if Houthis are squeezed from all flanks in a systematic and sustained way, especially from the southern flank. If that happens, would Saudi Arabia dial down the anti-Somaliland recognition rhetoric and campaign? From a purely national security and military strategic point of view, Saudia Arabia needs Somaliland more than it needs Mogadishu. Rashid Abdi @RAbdianalyst

items.title: Blanche oo jidka ugu jira Sanduuqa $1.8 bilyan oo la tirtiray
items.description: Washington – Todd Blanche, oo ah agaasimaha hawlgalka ee Wasaaradda Caddaaladda Maraykanka, ayaa la filayaa inuu si fudud uga gudbo dhageysiga xaqiijinta (confirmation hearing) ee Golaha Guurtida, inkastoo uu wehliyo culeysyo kala duwan oo ay ku jiraan shaqadiisii hore ee uu u ahaa qareenka gaarka ah ee Madaxweyne Donald Trump . Dhageysigan ayaa muhiim u ah, sababtoo ah waxa uu go’aaminayaa cidda uu hoggaamin doono Wasaaradda Caddaaladda xilli ay sii socoto dabagallada ka dhanka ah kuwa loo arko inay yihiin cadawga Trump, iyadoo ay jirto su’aal ku saabsan madax-banaanida wasaaradda. Xisbiga Jamhuuriga ayaa ku kalsoon in Blanche uu heli doono codadka ku filan si loo xaqiijiyo . Saraakiisha Jamhuuriga waxay sheegeen in Blanche uu ku socdo “waddo siman” (glide path) si loo xaqiijiyo, iyadoo uu yahay mid ka mid ah musharraxiinta ugu khilaafaanta badan tan iyo wakhti . Waxaa soo ifbaxay in uu lahaa khilaaf weyn oo ku saabsan sanduuqa lacagta “anti-weaponization” oo dhan $1.8 bilyan, kaas oo ay Jamhuuriyiinta ku tilmaameen mid “aan caqli gal ahayn”, balse uu ka laabtay qorshahaas kadib markii uu la kulmay Senatarada . Senator Thom Tillis, oo ka mid ah xubnaha muhiimka ah ee Guddiga Cadaaladda, ayaa sheegay inuu leeyahay “dareen wanaagsan” oo ku aaddan Blanche, laakiin waxa uu cadeeyay inuu raadin doono inuu hubiyo madax-banaanida Blanche inta lagu jiro dhageysiga . Tillis ayaa hore u sheegay in sanduuqa lacagta uu ahaa “mid doqonnimo ah” . Dhanka kale, Dadweynaha Dimuqraadiga ayaa diyaar u ah inay si adag u su’aalaan Blanche oo ay ku eedeeyaan inuu ku mashquulsan yahay hawlo siyaasadeed oo loogu talagalay Trump, halkii uu ka shaqayn lahaa cadaaladda. Waxaana la filayaa in la weydiiyo sida uu u maareeyay sii-daynta faylalka Jeffrey Epstein iyo sida uu ugu hawlan yahay dabagallada ka dhanka ah cadawga Trump . Inkastoo ay jiraan cabashooyin kala duwan oo ka soo jeeda dhinacyada kala duwan, haddana xubnaha Jamhuuriga waxay aad ugu kalsoon yihiin inuu si guul leh uga gudbi doono dhageysiga, iyadoo la filayo in la xaqiijiyo kahor fasaxa Sebtembar The post Blanche oo jidka ugu jira Sanduuqa $1.8 bilyan oo la tirtiray first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: DF iyo inta badan mucaaradka oo isku raacay doorasho dadweyne – Maxaa kale oo la isku haya?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo garabyada mucaaradka ayaa haatan ku mideysan doorasho qof iyo cod kadib wada-hadallo xasaasi ah oo garwadeen ka tahay beesha caalamka oo yeesheen dhinacyadu. Dowladda Federaalka iyo laba garab oo mucaaradka ayaa isku raacay in Soomaaliya ay u gudubto doorasho toos ah oo ku saleysan nidaamka axsaabta siyaasadeed, taas oo lagu beddelayo hannaankii doorashooyinka dadban ee dalka looga dhaqmi jiray sanadihii lasoo dhaafay. Dhinacyadan ayaa la sheegay inay isla qaateen in guddiga madaxa-bannaan ee doorashooyinka uu noqdo hay’adda mas’uulka ka ah maamulka iyo qabashada doorashada, iyadoo la raacayo hannaan sharciyeed oo waafaqsan doorashada qof iyo cod. Hase yeeshee, Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa weli qaba aragti ka duwan tan ay isla qaateen Dowladda Federaalka iyo labada garab ee mucaaradka, inkastoo uu taageersan yahay doorasho dadweyne. Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa soo jeediyay in la qabto waxa uu ugu yeeray “doorasho qofaysan”, isla markaana la dhiso guddi doorasho oo laba heer ah, kaas oo ay si wadajir ah uga qayb qaadanayaan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dowlad-goboleedyada xubnaha ka ah federaalka. Ilo ku dhow wada-hadallada ayaa sheegay in qodobada kale ee weli laga doodayo ay ka mid yihiin tirada goobaha laga qabanayo doorashada, qaabka loo ilaalinayo nidaamka awood-qaybsiga ee 4.5 inta lagu jiro marxaladda kala-guurka, iyo arrimo kale oo farsamo oo la xiriira hirgelinta doorashada, balse si guud dood kama taagna in doorashadu noqoto mid dadweyne. Sida ay xoguhu muujinayaan, qodobadaasi looma arko kuwo caqabad weyn ku noqon kara heshiiska guud, waxaana la filayaa in dhinacyadu ay si fudud uga gaaraan is-afgarad marka la soo gaba-gabeeyo wada-hadallada socda. Wada-hadalladan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu doonayo in lagu gaaro heshiis siyaasadeed oo ballaaran, kaas oo saldhig u noqda hannaanka doorashooyinka dalka. Tani waxay ku soo aadaysaa xilli Soomaaliya ay isu diyaarinayso go’aanno muhiim u ah geeddi-socodka dimuqraadiyeynta, dhismaha hay’adaha dowliga ah iyo qabashada doorashooyin toos ah. Inkastoo weli ay jiraan kala aragti duwanaansho ku saabsan qaabka loo dhisayo guddiga doorashada iyo habraacyada lagu maamulayo doorashada, haddana xogaha la helayo waxay muujinayaan in inta badan dhinacyada siyaasadeed ay isku raacsan yihiin muhiimadda ay leedahay in Soomaaliya ay u gudubto doorasho qof iyo cod ah. The post DF iyo inta badan mucaaradka oo isku raacay doorasho dadweyne – Maxaa kale oo la isku haya? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Cirro oo kulan mihiim ah la yeeshay safiirka UK u jooga Somaliland
items.description: 𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐱𝐰𝐞𝐲𝐧𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐡𝐮𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐨 𝐤𝐮𝐥𝐚𝐧 𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐢𝐣𝐢 𝐚𝐡 𝐥𝐚 𝐲𝐞𝐞𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐲 𝐒𝐚𝐟𝐢𝐢𝐫𝐤𝐚 𝐁𝐨𝐪𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐨𝐨𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐈𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐢𝐬𝐤𝐚 Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa maanta Qasriga Madaxtooyada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland kulan istaraatiiji ah kula yeeshay Safiirka Boqortooyada Ingiriiska (UK), Mudane Charles King, oo booqasho rasmi ah ku yimid Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland si loo sii xoojiyo iskaashiga iyo xidhiidhka labada dhinac. Safiirka waxa kulanka ku weheliyey Marwo Louise Hancock, oo ah Wakiilka Guud ee Xafiiska Boqortooyada Ingiriiska ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa Safiirka uga mahadnaqay xidhiidhka taariikhiga ah, isfahamka soo jireenka ah iyo iskaashiga dhow ee ka dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo Boqortooyada Ingiriiska. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay taageerada ay Boqortooyada Ingiriisku siiso Somaliland, gaar ahaan dhinacyada horumarinta iyo tayeynta hay’adaha amniga, kobcinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, iyo xoojinta hannaanka dimuqraadiyadda. Madaxweynaha ayaa xusay in xidhiidhka istaraatiijiga ah ee labada dhinac uu ku dhisan yahay kalsooni taariikhi ah, is-qaddarin, iskaashi waara iyo dano wadaag ay labada dhinacba ka faa’iidaystaan. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu Safiirka la wadaagay mudnaanta horumarineed ee Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, isaga oo tilmaamay in labada dhinac ay sii xoojin karaan iskaashiga dhinacyada biyaha iyo la qabsiga isbeddelka cimilada, horumarinta tamarta, amniga, waxbarashada, caafimaadka, ganacsiga, maalgashiga, dimuqraadiyadda iyo tayeynta hay’adaha dawladda. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu caddeeyey in Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay ka go’an tahay sii xoojinta xidhiidhka iyo wada-shaqaynta ay la leedahay Boqortooyada Ingiriiska, isaga oo xusay in UK ay tahay saaxiib istaraatiiji ah oo muddo dheer garab taagnaa Somaliland dhinacyada horumarinta, nabadgelyada iyo kobcinta hay’adaha dawliga ah. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa mar kale adkeeyey in geeddi-socodka aqoonsi-raadiska Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland uu yahay mid aan laga noqon karin, maadaama uu ku salaysan yahay xaq sharci, sooyaal taariikheed iyo rabitaanka shacabka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Madaxweynaha ayaa Boqortooyada Ingiriiska ugu baaqay inay door wax-ku-ool ah ka qaadato arrinta aqoonsiga Somaliland. Dhankiisa, Safiirka Boqortooyada Ingiriiska, Mudane Charles King, ayaa Madaxweynaha u sheegay in Dawladdiisu ay si weyn u qiimaynayso xidhiidhka taariikhiga ah iyo iskaashiga adag ee ka dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Safiirku waxa uu Somaliland ku bogaadiyey amniga, xasilloonida, dimuqraadiyadda iyo horumarka ay ku tallaabsatay, isaga oo ku tilmaamay Somaliland tusaale wanaagsan oo ku dayasho mudan marka la eego nabadda, xasilloonida siyaasadeed, dhismaha hay’adaha dawliga ah, dimuqraadiyadda iyo qabsoomidda doorashooyin xor iyo xalaal ah. Safiirka Boqortooyada Ingiriiska ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijiyey in Dawladdiisu ay sii wadi doonto xoojinta iskaashiga iyo taageerada ay siiso Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Kulanka ayaa ku soo dhammaaday is-afgarad iyo ballanqaad ay labada dhinac ku adkeeyeen sii xoojinta wada-shaqaynta iyo iskaashiga istaraatiijiga ah ee u dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo Boqortooyada Ingiriiska. https://qarannews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/deb69ec931b74bdfdb7d410e056e8dbd_1784032874231.mp4

items.title: Maxaa xalay ka dhacay gobolka Hiiraan?
items.description: Beledweyne (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa faah-faahin ka bixisay duqeyn dhinaca cirka ah oo xalay ka dhacday deegaanka Goobo oo qiyaastii 10 KM dhanka waqooyi kaga beegan degmada Maxaas ee gobolka Hiiraan, halkaas oo la sheegay inay isku uruursanayeen maleeshiyaad ka tirsan Al-Shabaab. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa lagu sheegay in duqeynta lagu dilay 42 xubnood oo ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab, halka 12 kalena lagu dhaawacay. Dowladda ayaa sheegtay in bartilmaameedku ahaa dagaalyahanno ka firxaday howl-gallo iyo dagaallo hore uga dhacay deegaannada Sullaay iyo Waab-weyn. Wasaaraddu waxay intaas ku dartay in duqeynta lagu burburiyay gaari nooca ciidamada ah, fariisimo iyo difaacyo ay Al-Shabaab ka sameysteen deegaanka Goobo, kuwaas oo, sida ay sheegtay dowladda, loo adeegsanayay abaabulka iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa kooxda. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeedka, howl-galka waxaa si wadajir ah u fuliyay ciidanka xoogga dalka iyo saaxiibada caalamka ee taageera dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Dowladda ayaa xustay in weerarku uu qayb ka yahay howl-gallada joogtada ah ee lagu baacsanayo maleeshiyaadka kooxda ee ku sugan gobolka Hiiraan. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa sheegtay in howl-gallada isdaba joogga ah ee ka socda gobolka Hiiraan ay si weyn u wiiqeen awoodda Al-Shabaab, iyadoo xustay in kooxda ay bilihii la soo dhaafay lumisay dagaalyahanno iyo horjoogayaal lagu dilay howl-gallo ka dhacay gobollo kala duwan oo dalka ah. Dhanka kale, dowladda ayaa bogaadisay ciidanka xoogga dalka iyo ciidamada Macawiisleyda ee garabka ka siinaya howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Waxay sheegtay in iskaashiga labada dhinac uu horseeday guulo militari oo lagu wiiqay awoodda kooxda. Ugu dambeyn, Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa caddeysay in howl-gallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab ay sii socon doonaan ilaa laga ciribtiro khatarta ay kooxda ku hayso dalka, iyadoo weli gacanta ku haysa deegaanno ka tirsan Soomaaliya. The post Maxaa xalay ka dhacay gobolka Hiiraan? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Dhowr qarax ayaa laga maqlay meel ku dhow magaalada dekedda ee Bandar Abbas. items.title: Over 40 Al-Shabaab Fighters Killed in Goobo, Hiiraan
items.description: The Somali National Armed Forces, supported by international partners, killed more than 40 Al-Shabaab militants and wounded 12 others during a coordinated airstrike in the village of Goobo, Hiiraan region, late Monday night. The strike targeted a regrouping point 10 kilometers north of the Mahaas District, where militants had retreated following earlier combat engagements in Sullaay and Waab-weyn. By neutralizing this concentration of fighters, federal forces aim to prevent the insurgent group from reorganizing for counter-offensives in the strategically vital central region. The military operation marks a significant intensification of the federal government’s campaign to dismantle militant networks in the Hiiraan area. Officials confirmed the destruction of a tactical vehicle and multiple defensive fortifications that the group had established in anticipation of government advances. While the government continues to report successes in the field, independent verification of battlefield casualties remains difficult in remote areas of the country. Nonetheless, analysts observe that consistent pressure on Al-Shabaab’s logistics and command structures in central Somalia is increasingly straining the group’s ability to maintain territorial control. The Ministry of Defense has reaffirmed its commitment to the current military strategy, signaling that offensive operations will continue until the militant presence is eliminated. For the residents of Hiiraan, the outcome of these frequent security operations is critical to restoring local governance and ensuring the safe delivery of humanitarian aid. items.title: Wasiir Beenebeene oo Golaha ECOSOC ee Qaramada Midoobay u soo Bandhigay Horumarka iyo Tubta Cusub ee Soomaaliya
items.description: Wasiirka Qorsheynta, Maalgashiga iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Maxamuud Cabdiraxmaan Faarax (Beenebeene), ayaa khudbad rasmi ah oo uu ka jeediyay shirka Heer Wasiir ee Golaha Dhaqaalaha iyo Arrimaha Bulshada ee Qaramada Midoobay (ECOSOC) ku soo bandhigay guulaha waawayn ee ay Soomaaliya ka gaartay dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, amniga, iyo dhismaha dowladnimada. Wasiirka ayaa beesha caalamka horteeda ku iftiimiyay isbeddellada taariikhiga ah ee dalka ka dhacay muddooyinkii u dambeeyay, isagoo xusay guusha weyn ee laga gaaray dhammaystirka Barnaamijka Deyn Cafinta ee (HIPC), qaadista cunaqabateyntii hubka ee Qaramada Midoobay, iyo guulaha laga gaaray dib-u-xoreynta deegaannada dalka looga saaray Khawaarijta. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay diyaargarowga doorashooyinka qof iyo cod ah oo dalka ka dhaca markii ugu horreysay muddo ka badan nus qarni iyo guusha diblamaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya ay ku guuleysatay kursiga ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay. Wasiir Beenebeene ayaa sheegay in Qorshaha Isbeddelka Qaranka (NTP 2025–2029) uu yahay tubta rasmiga ah ee hagaysa masiirka horumarineed ee dalka, isagoo saldhig u noqon doona u-guurista horumar waara oo ku dhisan kobac dhaqaale, soo jiidashada maalgashiga, iyo xoojinta hoggaanka qaranka si tartiib-tartiib ah looga guuro ku-tiirsanaanta gargaarka bini’aadannimo. Waxaa intaas dheer in Soomaaliya ay horumar weyn ka samaysay qorsheynta ku dhisan xogta dhabta ah iyo xoojinta nidaamka tirakoobka qaranka, taas oo sahashay in go’aannada lagu saleeyo caddeymo cad si loola socdo Yoolalka Horumarka Waara (SDGs). Ugu dambayntii, Wasiirka Qorsheynta Soomaaliya ayaa ugu baaqay saaxiibbada caalamiga ah inay sii xoojiyaan iskaashiga ay la leeyihiin Soomaaliya, isagoo ka codsaday inay ballan-qaadyadooda u beddelaan ficil iyo mashaariic muuqda oo si toos ah u taageeraya mudnaanta qorshaha horumarineed ee dalka.

Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay diyaargarowga doorashooyinka qof iyo cod ah oo dalka ka dhaca markii ugu horreysay muddo ka badan nus qarni iyo guusha diblamaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya ay ku guuleysatay kursiga ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay. Wasiir Beenebeene ayaa sheegay in Qorshaha Isbeddelka Qaranka (NTP 2025–2029) uu yahay tubta rasmiga ah ee hagaysa masiirka horumarineed ee dalka, isagoo saldhig u noqon doona u-guurista horumar waara oo ku dhisan kobac dhaqaale, soo jiidashada maalgashiga, iyo xoojinta hoggaanka qaranka si tartiib-tartiib ah looga guuro ku-tiirsanaanta gargaarka bini’aadannimo. Waxaa intaas dheer in Soomaaliya ay horumar weyn ka samaysay qorsheynta ku dhisan xogta dhabta ah iyo xoojinta nidaamka tirakoobka qaranka, taas oo sahashay in go’aannada lagu saleeyo caddeymo cad si loola socdo Yoolalka Horumarka Waara (SDGs). Ugu dambayntii, Wasiirka Qorsheynta Soomaaliya ayaa ugu baaqay saaxiibbada caalamiga ah inay sii xoojiyaan iskaashiga ay la leeyihiin Soomaaliya, isagoo ka codsaday inay ballan-qaadyadooda u beddelaan ficil iyo mashaariic muuqda oo si toos ah u taageeraya mudnaanta qorshaha horumarineed ee dalka.

items.title: Puntland oo sabab yaab leh hay’adaha gargaarka uga joojisay deegaanadeeda
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka Puntland ayaa ku dhawaaqay inuu joojiyay qaar ka mid ah hay’adaha gargaarka ee ka howlgala deegaannadiisa, isagoo ku eedeeyay inay ka weecdeen doorkoodii bani’aadannimo, isla markaana ay ku milmeen arrimaha siyaasadda Soomaaliya. Wasiirka Gargaarka iyo Maareynta Masiibooyinka Puntland, Cabdinaasir Xaaji Yuusuf ayaa sheegay in hay’adaha gargaarka, gaar ahaan kuwa fuliya mashaariicda horumarineed ee aan waafaqsanayn baahiyaha Puntland, aan loo oggolaan doonin inay ka sii shaqeeyaan deegaannada maamulka. Wasiirka aya wuxuu xusay in go’aankaasi uu salka ku hayo ilaalinta danaha iyo mudnaanta shacabka Puntland. “Hay’adaha gargaarka ka shaqeeya, gaar ahaan kuwa fuliya mashaariicda horumarineed, waxaan u sheegaynaa in mashaariicda aanan ka arkin danaheenna inaan ka joojinay deegaannadayada,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Cabdinaasir Xaaji Yuusuf. Puntland ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in saamiga ay ka hesho gargaarka caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya loo qoondeeyo uu aad u yar yahay, iyadoo ku doodday inay hesho wax u dhigma boqolkiiba hal keliya, halka inta badan gargaarkaas loo leexiyo gobollada Koonfurta Soomaaliya. Maamulka Puntland ayaa ku eedeeyay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo qaar ka mid ah hay’adaha caalamiga ah inay qaybinta gargaarka ku saleeyaan arrimo siyaasadeed, halkii ay ku saleyn lahaayeen heerka baahida bani’aadannimo ee ka jirta deegaannada kala duwan ee dalka. Mas’uuliyiinta Puntland ayaa ku baaqay in dib u eegis lagu sameeyo habka loo qaybiyo gargaarka caalamiga ah, iyagoo dalbaday in lagu saleeyo qiimeyn hufan oo ku salaysan baahida dhabta ah, si dhammaan bulshada Soomaaliyeed ay u helaan kaalmo siman oo caddaalad ku dhisan. Go’aankan ayaa imanaya xilli uu weli taagan yahay khilaafka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Ilaa iyo hadda, Dowladda Federaalka iyo hay’adaha gargaarka ee ka joojisay deegaannadeeda kama aysan hadlin eedeymaha iyo go’aanka uu ku dhawaaqay maamulka. The post Puntland oo sabab yaab leh hay’adaha gargaarka uga joojisay deegaanadeeda appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo sheegtay in ay duqeyn ku dishay 42 xubnood oo katirsan kooxda AS
items.description: Maxaas ( Raxanreeb Online) Ciidanka xoogga dalka ayaa duqeyn ka fuliyay tuulada Goobo oo 10KM dhanka waqooyi kaga beegan degmada Maxaas ee gobolka Hiiraan. Qoraal kasoo baxay wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, ayaa lagu sheegay in duqeynta lagu beegsaday xubno katirsan Al-shabaab oo isku uruursanayay tuulada, kuwaasi oo doonayay in ay weerar fuliyaan balse xogtooda la helay. “Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, oo kaashanaya saaxiibada caalamka, ayaa xalay fiidkii duqeymo ka fuliyay tuulada Goobo, oo qiyaastii 10 KM dhanka waqooyi kaga beegan degmada Maxaas, waxaana lagu dilay 42 dhagarqabe oo ka tirsanaa Khawaarijta Al-Shabaab, halka 12 kale lagu dhaawacay. Sidoo kale, waxaa lagu burburiyay gaari ciidan oo Cabdibile ah, fariisimo iyo difaacyo ay Khawaarijtu ka sameysteen deegaanka”ayaa lagu yir qoraalka kasoo baxay wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in xubnaha la duqeeyay ay shalay kasoo baxsadeen dagaalkii ciidanka xoogga ku qadeen deegaannada Sullaay iyo Waab-weyn ee gobolka Hiiraan. Sikastaba, maalmihii lasoo dhaafay deegaanada hoostaga degmada Maxaas waxaa ka dhacayay dagaalo u dhaxeeyay ciidanka dowladda iyo maleeshiyaadka Al-shabaab. The post Dowladda Soomaaliya oo sheegtay in ay duqeyn ku dishay 42 xubnood oo katirsan kooxda AS appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Qaramada Midoobay oo dalbatay in la kordhiyo gargaarka bani’aadannimo ee la gaarsiinayo Soomaaliya
items.description: Qaramada Midoobay ayaa ku baaqday in si degdeg ah loo kordhiyo gargaarka bani’aadannimo ee la gaarsiinayo Soomaaliya, iyadoo ka digtay in boqolaal kun oo qof ay wajahayaan xaalado nololeed oo aad u adag, gaar ahaan gobollada waqooyi ee dalka oo ay si ba’an u saameeyeen abaaraha. Warbixintii ugu dambeysay ee ay soo saartay Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee Isku-dubaridka Arrimaha Bani’aadannimada (OCHA) ayaa lagu sheegay in dhibaatooyin is biirsaday oo ay ka mid yihiin abaaro daran, fatahaado, hoos u dhaca maalgelinta gargaarka iyo colaadaha daba dheeraaday ay wiiqeen awoodda malaayiin qoys oo Soomaaliyeed ay ugu adkeysan lahaayeen xaaladaha adag. Warbixintu waxay sheegtay in ku dhowaad 250,000 oo qof ay si toos ah u saameeyeen abaaraha, iyadoo bulshooyinka ku nool deegaannada xeebaha iyo meelaha fogfog ay yihiin kuwa ugu daran ee ay dhibaatadu haleeshay. OCHA ayaa xustay in mas’uuliyiinta Soomaaliya ay codsanayaan gargaar degdeg ah, maadaama in ka badan 570,000 oo qof ay u baahan yihiin biyo nadiif ah, halka ku dhowaad 1.5 milyan oo qof ay u baahan yihiin gargaar cunto. Dhanka kale, Sanduuqa Gargaarka Bani’aadannimada Soomaaliya (Somalia Humanitarian Fund) ayaa kordhiyay taageerada uu siiyo degmada Buurhakaba ee gobolka Baay, oo ka mid ah meelaha ay ka jirto halista macluusha. Sanduuqu wuxuu halkaas ku bixiyay 4.7 milyan oo doollar, oo ay ku jirto 2 milyan oo doollar oo dhowaan loo qoondeeyay xaaladda degdegga ah. Sidoo kale, warbixintu waxay muujisay in nafaqo-darradu ay sii kordhayso, iyadoo in ka badan 400,730 carruur ah ay la ildaran yihiin nafaqo-darro ba’an. Tiradaas waxaa ka mid ah 97,150 carruur ah oo xaaladdoodu aad u daran tahay iyo 303,580 carruur ah oo qaba nafaqo-darro dhexdhexaad ah. OCHA ayaa sidoo kale ka digtay in adeegyada caafimaadka, gaar ahaan daryeelka hooyada iyo adeegyada degdegga ah ee dhalmada, ay weli aad u xaddidan yihiin, gaar ahaan bulshada reer guuraaga ah. Intaa waxaa dheer, abaaraha ayaa saameyn ku yeeshay waxbarashada, iyadoo la sheegay in in ka badan 820 dugsi ay albaabada u xirmeen sababo la xiriira xaaladda abaarta. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa ugu dambeyn ugu baaqday deeq-bixiyeyaasha caalamiga ah iyo hay’adaha samafalka inay dedejiyaan taageerada loo fidinayo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, si looga hortago in xaaladda bani’aadannimo ay uga sii darto bilaha soo socda.

items.title: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya oo gaaray Doha si uu uga qayb gal tacsida Amiirkii hore ee Qatar
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta gaaray magaalada Doha ee dalka Qatar, si uu uga qayb galo tacsida Amiirkii hore ee Qatar, Sheekh Xamad Bin Khaliifa Aala Thaani, oo dowladda Qatar ku tilmaantay tiir weyn oo qaranka ka baxay. Madaxweynaha iyo wafdigiisa waxaa garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee Xamad International Airport ku soo dhaweeyay Wasiirka Gaadiidka Qatar, Sheekh Maxamed Bin Cabdullaahi Bin Maxamed Aala Thaani, iyo Safiirka Soomaaliya u fadhiya Qatar, Maxamed Axmed Sheekh Cali. Socdaalka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa qeyb ka ah booqashooyinka ay madaxda caalamka ku tagayaan Doha si ay tacsi ugu diraan dowladda iyo shacabka Qatar geerida Amiirkii hore, oo door weyn ku lahaa horumarka iyo diblomaasiyadda dalkaas. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa hore u muujisay sida ay uga murugootay geerida Amiirkii hore ee Qatar, iyadoo sidoo kale hoos u dhigtay calanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya si loogu muujiyo baroordiiq qaran. Magaalada Doha ayaa maalmahan martigelinaysa madax badan oo ka kala socda dalal kala duwan, kuwaas oo u tegaya inay tacsi u diraan Dowladda Qatar iyo qoyska boqortooyada geerida Amiirkii hore.

items.title: Yaa diiday in Farmaajo ka mid noqdo Golaha Mustaqbalka?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xisbiga Nabad iyo Nolol ee uu hoggaamiyo madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo ayaa faahfaahin ka bixiyay sababta uu uga mid noqon waayay Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed, oo ay ku mideysan yihiin siyaasiyiin mucaarad ah iyo qaar ka mid ah madaxda dowlad-goboleedyada. Maxamed Cabdirisaaq Maxamuud, wasiirkii hore ee arrimaha dibadda, oo hoggaaminayay guddiga Nabad iyo Nolol ku matalayay wada-hadallada siyaasadeed, ayaa sheegay in Farmaajo uusan isagu diidin ku biirista golaha, balse ay arrintaas kasoo horjeesteen xubno awood ku dhex leh isbaheysiga mucaaradka. Hadalkan ayaa markii ugu horreysay si cad u muujinaya khilaafkii gudaha ee ka jiray isku daygii lagu doonayay in Farmaajo lagu daro Golaha Mustaqbalka. Diidmo gudaha ah “Waxaa jiray xubno ka mid ah Golaha Mustaqbalka oo yiri, ‘Madaxweyne Farmaajo nagama mid noqon karo; haddii uu soo galana annaga ayaa baxeyna,’” ayuu Maxamed Cabdirisaaq ku sheegay wareysi uu bixiyay. Wuxuu sheegay in Farmaajo uu ka gaabsaday tallaabo keeni karta kala-jab ku yimaada mucaaradka, inkastoo kooxdiisu ay daneyneysay inay qayb ka noqoto kulamadii siyaasadeed ee xilligaas lagu qorsheynayay magaalada Kismaayo. “Isaguna wax badan ayuu xeerinayay. Ma uusan rabin in dadkii isu yimid ay kala baxaan. Markii la yiri Kismaayo ayaa la isugu tegayaa, waa laga qeyliyay. Marka diidmada dhinacayaga kama imaan,” ayuu yiri. Golaha Mustaqbalka waxaa ku jira madaxweynihii hore Shariif Sheekh Axmed, ra’iisul wasaareyaal hore, siyaasiyiin mucaarad ah iyo madaxda Puntland iyo Jubbaland. Golaha ayaa si weyn uga soo horjeeday wax-ka-beddellada dastuurka iyo hannaanka doorasho ee ay waddo dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. ‘Shahaadada mucaaradnimada’ Maxamed Cabdirisaaq ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in xubno ka tirsan Golaha Mustaqbalka ay ku doodeen in Farmaajo iyo Nabad iyo Nolol aan loo aqoonsan karin mucaarad dhab ah, maadaama ay mowqifyadooda qaar ka duwan yihiin kuwa ay qaateen kooxaha kale. Wuxuu su’aal geliyay cidda awoodda u leh inay siyaasiyiinta siiso ama ka qaaddo magaca mucaaradnimo. “Dowladdii ma nihin, haddana mucaarad kale ayaa leh mucaarad ma tihidin ama nagama mid noqon kartaan. U adeegidda shacabka cidna marti ugama nihin,” ayuu yiri. “Fariinteena waan dhiibaneynaa. Ciddii nagala doodeysa waan la doodeynaa. Haddii aan isku dhow nahay iyo haddii kaleba, waddadeena waan wadeynaa, natiijadeedana waa la arki doonaa.” Wuxuu sheegay in go’aannadii Golaha Mustaqbalka ay ugu dambeyn Nabad iyo Nolol u sahleen inay isu muujiso awood siyaasadeed oo madax-bannaan, halkii ay qayb ka ahaan lahayd isbaheysi ballaaran oo mowqifyadiisu kala duwan yihiin. Nabad iyo Nolol ayaa toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay si gaar ah uga qaybgalaysay wada-hadallada dowladda federaalka iyo dhinacyada siyaasadda ee lagu doonayo in xal looga gaaro khilaafka doorashada. Mowqif gaar ah Maxamed Cabdirisaaq ayaa sheegay in farqiga u dhexeeya Nabad iyo Nolol iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka uu ka weyn yahay kan u dhexeeya kooxdiisa iyo dowladda federaalka marka laga hadlayo qodobada qaarkood ee hannaanka doorashada. Wuxuu tilmaamay in dowladda hadda jirta ay qorshaheeda ku dartay qodobo la mid ah kuwii uu diyaariyay guddigii doorashooyinka ee xilligii maamulka Farmaajo, gaar ahaan in shacabka si toos ah u doortaan wakiilladooda. Dowladda federaalka ayaa ku adkeysaneysa in Soomaaliya laga gudbiyo nidaamka doorashada dadban ee ku dhisan awood-qeybsiga beelaha, iyadoo isbeddelladii dastuurka ee la ansixiyay ay dhigayaan in xubnaha baarlamaanka lagu soo doorto cod dadweyne. Mucaaradka ayaa aqbalaya mabda’a doorasho qof iyo cod ah, balse wuxuu dowladda ku eedeeyaa inay qorshaha u waddo si aan heshiis siyaasadeed loo dhan yahay lagu gaarin. Maamulka Farmaajo ayaa isaguna markii uu talada hayay ku dhawaaqay qorshe doorasho qof iyo cod ah, laakiin khilaaf siyaasadeed, amni-darro iyo diyaar-garow la’aan ayaa sababay in doorashadii 2022 lagu qabto hannaan dadban kadib dib-u-dhac dheer. Isku soo dhowaansho kooban Mowqifka Nabad iyo Nolol wuxuu muujinayaa in dowladda iyo kooxda Farmaajo ay isku aragti ka noqon karaan mabda’a ah in laga gudbo nidaamka 4.5, inkastoo ay weli ku kala duwan yihiin qaabka, waqtiga iyo heshiiska siyaasadeed ee lagu hirgelinayo doorashooyinka tooska ah. Isku soo dhowaanshahaas macnaheedu ma aha inuu jiro heshiis siyaasadeed oo rasmi ah oo dhex maray Villa Somalia iyo Farmaajo. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu cadaadis dheeraad ah saari karaa Golaha Mustaqbalka iyo garabyada kale ee mucaaradka, kuwaas oo isku dayaya inay dowladda ku qasbaan hannaan doorasho oo wadatashi iyo heshiis ballaaran ku dhisan. Khilaafka doorashada ayaa bilihii lasoo dhaafay sababay xiisad siyaasadeed iyo isku dhacyo hubeysan oo ka dhacay Muqdisho, iyadoo beesha caalamku ay dhinacyada ku boorrisay inay khilaafkooda ku xalliyaan wadahadal nabadeed. Dhaqdhaqaaqyada cusub waxay muujinayaan in mucaaradka Soomaaliya uusan hadda lahayn hal aragti oo mideysan, halka dowladda federaalkuna ay isku dayeyso inay taageero ka hesho dhinacyada oggol in laga guuro nidaamka doorashada dadban ee dalka ka jiray muddo ka badan labaatan sano. items.title: Wasiir Al-Makhzoumi oo kulamo muhiim ah la qaadatay mas’uuliyiin sare oo…
items.description: Islamabad ( Raxanreeb Online) Wasiirka Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka ee Soomaaliya, Amb. Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi, ayaa kulan doceedyo la yeelatay madax iyo masuuliyiin sare oo ka kala socday hay’adaha iyo dowladaha xubnaha ka ah Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka (OIC), intii uu ka socday magaalada Islamabad Shirka Haweenka Islaamka. Wasiirka ayaa kulan doceedyada la qaadatay Agaasimaha Fulinta Guddiga Madaxbannaan ee Joogtada ah ee Xuquuqda Aadanaha ee OIC (IPHRC), Wasiirka Shaqada iyo Amniga Bulshada ee Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga Waqooyiga Qubrus (TRNC), Agaasimaha Guud ee Xarunta Cilmi-baarista iyo Tababarka Dhaqaalaha, Bulshada iyo Tirakoobka ee Dalalka Islaamka (SESRIC), Wasiirka Arrimaha Haweenka, Carruurta iyo Daryeelka Bulshada ee Bangladesh, Guddoomiyaha Golaha Qaranka Haweenka ee Masar, iyo Xoghayaha Guud ee Golaha Arrimaha Qoyska ee Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya. Intii ay socdeen kulamadu, waxaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga u dhaxeeya Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dalalka xubnaha ka ah (OIC), gaar ahaan dhinacyada horumarinta qoyska, ilaalinta xuquuqul insaanka, awood-siinta haweenka, daryeelka carruurta, horumarinta bulshada iyo is-dhaafsiga khibradaha iyo aqoonta. Kulamadu waxay ku soo dhamaadeen is-afgarad ku saabsan sii ballaarinta iskaashiga iyo kor u qaadidda wada-shaqeyn miro dhal ah oo wax ka tari doonta horumarinta adeegyada bulshada iyo hirgelinta barnaamijyada mudnaanta u leh Soomaaliya. Ugu dambeyn kulamada ay wasiir Khadiijo la yeelatay mas’uuliyiintan waxaa ku wehlinayay Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya u fadhiya Pakistan, Danjire Sheekh Nuur Maxamed Xasan. items.title: UN Warns Famine Risk Looms for 6M Somalis
items.description: The United Nations has issued an urgent appeal for humanitarian assistance as an estimated 6 million people across Somalia face critical levels of food insecurity, with one district now at credible risk of famine. The UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) warns that 570,000 people require immediate water assistance, while 1.5 million are in need of food aid. The crisis has been compounded by severe drought, rising food prices, and disruptions to global supply chains linked to conflict in the Middle East. Children are bearing the heaviest toll. According to UN agencies, over 400,000 children are suffering from acute malnutrition, with nearly 100,000 cases classified as severe. “The humanitarian context in Somalia is worsening faster than we originally projected,” said George Conway, the UN’s Humanitarian Coordinator for Somalia. “Children are paying the highest price.” He warned that nearly two million young children are acutely malnourished, placing them at high risk of illness or death. More than 500 health and nutrition facilities have closed across the country due to funding shortfalls, leaving vulnerable populations without access to critical care. The UN has confirmed a “real and credible risk of famine” in Burhakaba district, located in the Bay region of southwest Somalia. The Somalia Humanitarian Fund has stepped up support to the area, providing US$4.7 million, including a recent US$2 million reserve allocation. “Without immediate and sustained support from donors, the diaspora and the private sector, we risk a preventable catastrophe unfolding before our eyes,” Conway stated. “We must act now, at scale and without delay.” The current emergency is driven by a convergence of severe drought following failed rains, conflict and insecurity, and the ripple effects of the Middle East conflict, which has pushed up fuel and food prices. Water trucking costs have more than doubled in some locations, and the price of basic commodities has increased by up to 20 per cent. Humanitarian assistance remains critically underfunded. The 2026 Somalia Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan is currently only 15.2 per cent funded, and nearly 90 per cent of people in need are receiving little or no support. items.fullContent: The United Nations has issued an urgent appeal for humanitarian assistance as an estimated 6 million people across Somalia face critical levels of food insecurity, with one district now at credible risk of famine. The UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) warns that 570,000 people require immediate water assistance, while 1.5 million are in need of food aid. The crisis has been compounded by severe drought, rising food prices, and disruptions to global supply chains linked to conflict in the Middle East. Children are bearing the heaviest toll. According to UN agencies, over 400,000 children are suffering from acute malnutrition, with nearly 100,000 cases classified as severe. “The humanitarian context in Somalia is worsening faster than we originally projected,” said George Conway, the UN’s Humanitarian Coordinator for Somalia. “Children are paying the highest price.” He warned that nearly two million young children are acutely malnourished, placing them at high risk of illness or death. More than 500 health and nutrition facilities have closed across the country due to funding shortfalls, leaving vulnerable populations without access to critical care. The UN has confirmed a “real and credible risk of famine” in Burhakaba district, located in the Bay region of southwest Somalia. The Somalia Humanitarian Fund has stepped up support to the area, providing US$4.7 million, including a recent US$2 million reserve allocation. “Without immediate and sustained support from donors, the diaspora and the private sector, we risk a preventable catastrophe unfolding before our eyes,” Conway stated. “We must act now, at scale and without delay.” The current emergency is driven by a convergence of severe drought following failed rains, conflict and insecurity, and the ripple effects of the Middle East conflict, which has pushed up fuel and food prices. Water trucking costs have more than doubled in some locations, and the price of basic commodities has increased by up to 20 per cent. Humanitarian assistance remains critically underfunded. The 2026 Somalia Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan is currently only 15.2 per cent funded, and nearly 90 per cent of people in need are receiving little or no support. items.title: Government, Opposition Reach Election Consensus
items.description: Political talks underway in Mogadishu have made significant progress, with the Federal Government of Somalia and two opposition factions reportedly agreeing on the introduction of direct elections based on a multiparty political system. According to sources familiar with the negotiations, the parties have also agreed that the National Federal Electoral Commission should oversee the electoral process under a legal framework designed to facilitate one-person, one-vote elections. However, the Future Forum has maintained a different position from that adopted by the Federal Government and the two opposition groups. The forum has proposed what it describes as a “personalized election” model and called for the establishment of a two-tier electoral commission jointly managed by the Federal Government and the Federal Member States. Sources close to the talks said the remaining issues under discussion—including the number of polling stations, mechanisms for safeguarding the 4.5 power-sharing formula, and other technical aspects of the electoral process—are not expected to pose major obstacles to reaching a final agreement. They said consensus on these matters could be achieved relatively easily. The ongoing negotiations are part of broader efforts to establish an electoral framework that commands broad political support as Somalia prepares to make key decisions on the future of its democratic transition and electoral system. Although differences remain over the composition of the electoral commission and the administration of the polls, information emerging from the talks suggests that most political stakeholders agree on the importance of transitioning to direct elections conducted under a multiparty system. items.title: Ciidamada Mareykanka oo Weerar ku Qaaday Xarun Dayactirka Maraakiibta iyo Gujisyada Iiraan
items.description: Ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa weerar loo adeegsaday diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku qaaday xarun lagu dayactiro gujisyada iyo maraakiibta dagaalka ee dalka Iiraan, sida uu shaaciyay Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Mareykanka (CENTCOM). Qoraal lagu baahiyay barta X, CENTCOM ayaa sheegay in weerarka dhacay habeenkii Axadda uu si weyn u wiiqay awoodda Iiraan ee ay ku weerari karto maraakiibta ganacsiga ee maraya marin-biyoodka gobolka. Taliska ayaa xusay in hawlgalkan uu qeyb ka yahay dadaallada Mareykanka ee lagu ilaalinayo amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo xorriyadda isu-socodka badda, xilli ay sare u kaceen xiisadaha ka taagan Bariga Dhexe. Warku ma bixin faahfaahin ku saabsan khasaaraha ka dhashay weerarka, mana jirto jawaab rasmi ah oo dowladda Iran ay ka bixisay dhacdadan illaa hadda. Weerarkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo ay sii kordhayaan iska horimaadyada u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iiraan, kuwaas oo saameyn ku yeeshay amniga marin-biyoodka Hormuz iyo isu-socodka maraakiibta caalamiga ah.

items.title: Khatarta Isbeddelka Cimilada iyo Soomaaliya oo Halis ugu Jirta Fatahaado Baaxad Leh iyo Barakac Cusub
items.description: Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ayaa ka digaya in ifafaalaha cimilada ee El Niño, oo si xawli ah u xoogeysanaya, uu sababi karo fatahaado waaweyn, cudurro faafa iyo cunto yari ka dhacda dalal badan oo ku yaalla Bariga Afrika iyo Aasiya, iyadoo Soomaaliya lagu daray waddamada ugu halista badan. Sida warbixinta  dhowaan soo baxday ayaa lagu sheegay in dalalka ay khatartu sida weyn u saameyn karto ay ka mid yihiin Soomaaliya, Kenya, Uganda, Bangladesh, Pakistan iyo Afghanistan, kuwaas oo intooda badan hore ula tacaalayay abaaro, colaado iyo dhibaatooyin bani’aadamnimo. Mas’uul sare oo ka tirsan Hay’adda IRC, Bob Kitchen, ayaa sheegay in dalalka ugu nugul ay wajahayaan dhibaatooyin is biirsaday, isla markaana aysan haysan awood ay ku xamili karaan masiibo kale oo ka dhalata isbeddelka cimilada. Xarunta Saadaasha Cimilada ee Mareykanka (Climate Prediction Center) ayaa sheegtay in El Niño ay si degdeg ah u xoogeysanayso, isla markaana ay jirto 81% fursad ay ku noqon karto mid ka mid ah kuwii ugu xoogga badnaa tan iyo sanadkii 1950, iyadoo la filayo inuu gaaro heerkiisa ugu sarreeya inta u dhexeysa Oktoobar iyo Diseembar. Hay’adda Cimilada Adduunka (WMO) ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijisay in xaaladda El Niño ay durba bilaabatay, isla markaana la filayo inay sii xoogeysato bilaha Luulyo ilaa Sebteembar. Warbixintu waxay xustay in qaybo ka mid ah magaalada Muqdisho ay sanadkan marar badan la kulmeen fatahaado ka dhashay roobab culus. Hay’adda digniinta hore ee macluusha ee FEWS NET ayaa qiimeysay in koonfurta Soomaaliya ay wajahayso halis macluul haddii fatahaadaha la filayo dabayaaqada sanadkan ay la mid noqdaan kuwii dhacay 1997 iyo 2023, kuwaas oo sababay in dhul beereed badan uu biyo galo isla markaana boqolaal kun oo qof ay barakacaan. Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in Bangladesh ay daadad iyo dhul-go’yo ku dileen ugu yaraan 15 qof oo Rohingya ah, halka in ka badan 10,000 oo qof ay ku barakaceen xeryaha Cox’s Bazar. Pakistan ayaa iyaduna la filayaa inay wajahdo xaalad isugu jirta abaaro iyo fatahaado ka dhasha dhalaalka degdegga ah ee barafka buuraha waqooyiga. Dhanka kale, Bangiga Adduunka ayaa ka digay in haddii El Niño ay si buuxda u xoogaysto, wax-soo-saarka bariiska uu hoos u dhici karo 20% ilaa 50% qaybo ka mid ah Koonfurta Aasiya iyo Bariga Afrika, taasoo sii xumeyn karta cunto yarida iyo kororka qiimaha cunnada. Hay’adaha gargaarka ayaa ugu baaqay deeq-bixiyeyaasha caalamka inay si degdeg ah u maalgeliyan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga masiibooyinka, halkii la sugi lahaa inta ay dhibaatooyinku dhacayaan.

items.title: Maxkamad dil ku xukuntay hoggaamiyaha kooxda RSF iyo saraakiil kale oo sare
items.description: Khartoum (Caasimada Online) – Maxkamad ku taalla magaalada Port Sudan ee ay maamusho dowladda Suudaan ayaa dil ku xukuntay hoggaamiyaha ciidamada gurmadka degdegga ah (RSF), Maxamed Xamdaan Dagalo (Hemedti) kadib markii lagu helay dambiyo dagaal oo ka dhan ah aadanaha iyo xasuuq la xiriira tacaddiyo ka dhacay gobolka Galbeedka Daarfuur. Xukunka ayaa lagu riday Hemedti isagoo maqan, maadaama uu weli hoggaaminayo ciidamada RSF ee dagaalka kula jira ciidamada dowladda Suudaan. Maxkamaddu waxay sidoo kale isla xukunka dilka ah ku ridday 15 xubnood oo kale oo ka tirsan hoggaanka sare ee RSF, kuwaas oo lagu eedeeyay inay door ku lahaayeen falalka lagu soo oogay. Sida ay maxkamaddu sheegtay, dacwaddu waxay salka ku haysaa xad-gudubyo culus oo ka dhacay magaalada El Geneina bishii Juun 2023, xilli gobolka Galbeedka Daarfuur uu martigelinayay dagaallo xooggan oo sababay dhimasho iyo barakac ballaaran. Go’aanka maxkamadda ayaa lagu sheegay in eedeysanayaashu ay qorsheeyeen isla markaana fuliyeen weerarro si ula kac ah loogu beegsaday shacabka rayidka ah, kuwaas oo ay ku jireen dilal, burbur hantiyeed iyo bililiqo baahsan. Waxa kale oo lagu eedeeyay inay bartilmaameedsadeen iskuullo, goobaha cibaadada iyo xaafado ay dad rayid ahi degganaayeen. Hay’adaha caalamiga ah ee xuquuqda aadanaha iyo Qaramada Midoobay ayaa hore u diiwaangeliyay eedeymo la xiriira tacaddiyo ka dhacay Daarfuur tan iyo markii uu dagaalka Suudaan billowday bishii Abriil 2023, iyadoo labada dhinac ee dagaallamaya lagu eedeeyay xadgudubyo ka dhan ah shacabka rayidka ah. Dhanka kale, ciidamada RSF ayaan weli wax war ah kasoo saarin xukunkan ay ridday maxkamadda ku taalla Port Sudan. Si kastaba, kooxda ayaa marar badan hore u beenisay eedeymaha la xiriira dambiyada dagaalka iyo dambiyada ka dhanka ah aadanaha ee loo jeediyay. Xukunka dilka ah ee lagu riday Hemedti iyo saraakiisha kale ee RSF ayaa imanaya xilli dagaalka u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda Suudaan iyo RSF uu weli ka socdo qaybo badan oo dalkaas ah, iyadoo colaaddaasi sababtay mid ka mid ah dhibaatooyinka bani’aadannimo ee ugu waaweyn dunida, sida ay sheegeen hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay. The post Maxkamad dil ku xukuntay hoggaamiyaha kooxda RSF iyo saraakiil kale oo sare appeared first on Caasimada Online .
