items.title: Trump oo ka walaacsan inay disho Iran iyo waxa dhici kara
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump oo ka walaacsan inay disho Iran ayaa sheegay in Mareykanku si degdeg ah ugu weerari doono kumannaan gantaal haddii ay isku daydo inay disho isaga. Trump ayaa saaka ku qoray bartiisa bulshada ee Truth Social: “Haddii dowladda Iran ay fuliso hanjabaadaha ay marar badan ka jeedisay meelo kala duwan oo dunida ah ee ku aaddan inay disho ama isku daydo inay khaarijiso madaxweynaha hadda ee Mareykanka, markaas Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iran waxaa isla markiiba lagu garaaci doonaa in ka badan 1,000 gantaal, waxaana xigi doona kumannaan kale.” Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in amarada arrintaas hore loo bixiyay, isla markaana “ciidamada Mareykanku ay diyaar yihiin, go’aan adagnaay leeyihiin, ayna si buuxda u awoodaan inay gebi ahaanba burburiyaan dhammaan goobaha la bartilmaameedsado ee Iran muddo hal sano ah, muddadaasna la kordhin karo haddii loo baahdo.” Hadalka Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa yimid kadib markii wargeyska Wall Street Journal uu Khamiistii qoray in Israa’iil ay Mareykanka la wadaagtay xog sirdoon oo cusub, taas oo ay sheegtay inay muujinayso qorshe ay Iran ku doonayso inay ku khaarijiso Madaxweyne Trump. Hanjabaadda ayaa sidoo kale soo baxday kadib warar laga helay sirdoonka Israa’iil oo ay ku sheegeen qorshe cusub oo la sheegay in Iran ay ku doonayso inay ku disho Trump, iyo sidoo kale sawirro iyo halku-dhegyo lagu soo bandhigay intii lagu jiray aaska Ayatollah Cali Khamenei. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, warbixintu ma caddeynayso goorta xogta sirdoonka la gudbiyay iyo halka ay ka timid. Mas’uuliyiinta Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iran ayaa hore u beeniyay eedeymaha sheegaya inay qorsheynayeen in la khaarijiyo Donald Trump. Trump ayaa saaka ku qoray bartiisa bulshada ee Truth Social: “Haddii dowladda Iran ay fuliso hanjabaadaha ay marar badan ka jeedisay meelo kala duwan oo dunida ah ee ku aaddan inay disho ama isku daydo inay khaarijiso madaxweynaha hadda ee Mareykanka, markaas Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iran waxaa isla markiiba lagu garaaci doonaa in ka badan 1,000 gantaal, waxaana xigi doona kumannaan kale.” Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in amarada arrintaas hore loo bixiyay, isla markaana “ciidamada Mareykanku ay diyaar yihiin, go’aan adagnaay leeyihiin, ayna si buuxda u awoodaan inay gebi ahaanba burburiyaan dhammaan goobaha la bartilmaameedsado ee Iran muddo hal sano ah, muddadaasna la kordhin karo haddii loo baahdo.” Hadalka Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa yimid kadib markii wargeyska Wall Street Journal uu Khamiistii qoray in Israa’iil ay Mareykanka la wadaagtay xog sirdoon oo cusub, taas oo ay sheegtay inay muujinayso qorshe ay Iran ku doonayso inay ku khaarijiso Madaxweyne Trump. Hanjabaadda ayaa sidoo kale soo baxday kadib warar laga helay sirdoonka Israa’iil oo ay ku sheegeen qorshe cusub oo la sheegay in Iran ay ku doonayso inay ku disho Trump, iyo sidoo kale sawirro iyo halku-dhegyo lagu soo bandhigay intii lagu jiray aaska Ayatollah Cali Khamenei. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, warbixintu ma caddeynayso goorta xogta sirdoonka la gudbiyay iyo halka ay ka timid. Mas’uuliyiinta Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iran ayaa hore u beeniyay eedeymaha sheegaya inay qorsheynayeen in la khaarijiyo Donald Trump. items.title: Iran oo qiratay in weerarrada Maraakiibta Marinka Hormuz ay tahay tallaabo “khalad ah”
items.description: CBS News ayaa, iyadoo soo xiganaysa mas’uuliyiin sare oo Maraykan ah, sheegtay in mas’uuliyiin Iranian ah ay si gaar ah ugu sheegeen la-taliyeyaasha Madaxweyne Donald Trump in weerarradii lagu qaaday maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Marinka Hormuz ay ahaayeen “khalad”, isla markaana ay fuliyeen xubno ka tirsan garabka mayalka adag ee Iran, kuwaas oo doonayay inay carqaladeeyaan wadaxaajoodyada. Sida ay mas’uuliyiintu sheegeen, Iran waxay doonaysaa in wadaxaajoodyadu sii socdaan, balse Aqalka Cad wuxuu ka dalbanayaa Tehran inay si cad u qirato mas’uuliyadda weerarradaas, kuwaas oo maamulka Trump u arko inay jebiyeen heshiiskii xabbad-joojinta. Warbixintu waxay intaas ku dartay in Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu faray kooxdiisa wadaxaajoodka, oo ay ka mid yihiin J.D. Vance, Jared Kushner, Steve Witkoff, iyo Marco Rubio, inay sii wadaan wadaxaajoodyada. Wareegga xiga ee wada-hadallada ayaa la qorsheeyay inuu maanta uu ka dhaco Urdun. items.title: Ciidamada PUNTLAND oo hub iyo saanad kasoo furtay Daacish
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Difaaca Puntlad oo weli howlgallo kasii wada aagga buuraha Calmiskaad ayaa mar kale weeraray fariimso ay kooxda Daacish ku lahayd halkaasi, iyaga oo jab culus gaarsiiyay. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Puntland ayaa lagu sheegtay in howlgalka oo guuleystay laga fuliyay deegaanno kala duwan oo ku yaalla dhulka buuraleyda ah, isla markaana lagu beegsaday goobo gabaad u ahaa kooxda Daacish. Sidoo kale, ciidanka ayaa intii ay howlgallada fulinayeen ku guuleystay inay bartilmaameedsadaan kooxo ka tirsan Daacish, iyaga oo goobta ku dilay tiro dagaalyahanno ah iyo horjogayaal ka tirsanaa kooxda. Ciidamada Puntlad ayaa sidoo kale ku guuleystay in ay gacanta kusoo dhigaan saanad ciidan oo isugu jirtay hub, rasaas iyo agabyo kale oo ay kooxda adeegsanaysay, sida lagu caddeeyay warsaxaafadeedka. Xaaladda ayaa weli kacsan, waxaana lagu soo warramayaa in ciidamada ay sii baacsanayaan firxadka maleeshiyaadka kooxda argagixisada Daacish, kuwaas oo ku dhuumaleysanaaya meelo kooban oo ka tirsan buuraleyda Calmiskaad. Ujeedka howlgalladan ayaa ah kuwa lagu xaqiijinayo amniga, laguna ciribtirayo haraadiga kooxda Daacish oo muddo dheer ay la dagaalameyso Puntland. Buuraleyda Calmiskaad, oo ka tirsan silsiladda buuraha Golis ee gobolka Bari, ayaa muddooyinkii dambe noqotay fariisinka ugu weyn ee Daacish-ta Soomaaliya. Dhulkaas oo ah buuro dhaadheer, godad iyo marinno adag ayaa kooxda u noqday gabbaad ay ku dhuumato, ku tababarto, kuna qorsheyso weerarrada ay ka fuliso Puntland. Kooxda ayaa halkaas ka dhistay saldhigyo iyo godad difaac ah, iyadoo mararka qaar isku dayda inay maamusho dhaqdhaqaaqa dadka iyo adeegyada muhiimka ah ee deegaanada ku dhow. Si kastaba, Puntland ayaa dhowrkii sano ee lasoo dhaafay kordhisay howlgallada ka dhanka ah Daacish, gaar ahaan tan iyo markii kooxda ay isku dayday inay ballaariso saameynteeda buuraha gobolka Bari. items.title: Ruto oo Shaaciyay Heshiis Weyn oo Kenya Looga Dhisayo Warshadda Sifaynta Shidaalka ee Dangote
items.description: Madaxweynaha Kenya, William Ruto, ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la guda galayo wejiga fulinta mashruuc ballaaran oo lagu dhisayo warshadda ugu weyn ee sifaynta shidaalka Bariga Afrika, kaddib wada-hadallo miro-dhal ah oo uu la yeeshay maalqabeenka reer Nigeria, Aliko Dangote. Madaxweyne Ruto ayaa sheegay in warshaddan laga hirgelin doono magaalada xeebta ku taalla ee Lamu, taas oo qiyaastii 470 kiiloomitir dhinaca koonfur-bari kaga beegan caasimadda Nairobi. Isagoo ka hadlayay munaasabadda daah-furka wejiga labaad ee barnaamijka shaqo-abuurka dhallinyarada ee Nyota, Ruto wuxuu sheegay in mashruucan uu abuuri doono fursado shaqo oo ballaaran. “Kenya waxay hadda dhisaysaa warshaddii ugu weynayd ee sifaynta shidaalka Bariga Afrika, waxaana Lamu looga baahan doonaa ku dhowaad 60,000 oo dhallinyaro ah inay ka shaqeeyaan,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Ruto. Madaxweynaha ayaa xusay in warshaddu aysan adeeg u noqon doonin Kenya oo keliya, balse shidaalka laga sifeynayo loo dhoofin doono dalalka deriska ah ee Itoobiya, Koonfurta Suudaan, Uganda, Tansaaniya, Ruwanda, Burundi iyo Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Kongo. Mashruucan oo la filayo inuu sifeeyo boqolaal kun oo foosto oo shidaal ah maalintii, ayaa soo afjaraya hadal-heyn muddo bilo ah socotay oo ku saabsan halka laga hirgelinayo warshaddan, iyadoo ugu dambeyn shirkadda Dangote Industries ay dooratay Lamu. Go’aanka lagu doortay Lamu ayaa lagu saleeyay istiraatiijiyadda goobta ay ku taallo oo ku dhow Badweynta Hindiya, dekeddeeda qoto-dheer iyo isku xirnaanta ay la leedahay marinnada ganacsiga ee dalalka aan lahayn xeebaha Bariga iyo Bartamaha Afrika. Madaxweyne Ruto ayaa sheegay in mashruucan uu Kenya u beddeli doono xarunta ugu weyn ee tamarta gobolka, isla markaana uu yareyn doono ku-tiirsanaanta Bariga Afrika ee shidaalka dibadda laga soo dejiyo, waxa uuna intaa ku daray in dhismaha warshadda la filayo inuu ku dhammaado muddo 30 bilood gudahood ah marka si rasmi ah loo bilaabo.

items.title: Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed oo ku dhawaaqay golihiisa wasiirrada
items.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), ayaa magacaabay Golihiisa cusub ee wasiirrada oo ka kooban wasiirro, ku xegeenno, iyo wasiir dowleyaal. Golahan ayaa ka kooban 26 wasiir, 26 wasiir ku xegeen, iyo 3 wasiir dowle, ayadoo Wasaaradaha loo magacaabay xubnahan ay  ka mid yihiin Amniga Gudaha, Maaliyadda, Arrimaha Gudaha, Beeraha, Caafimaadka, Waxbarashada, Garsoorka, Dekedaha, Hawlaha Guud, Haweenka iyo Xuquuqda Aadanaha, Dastuurka, Qorsheynta, iyo wasaarado kale oo muhiim u ah horumarinta maamulka. Hoggaamiye Aadan Madoobe ayaa faray golahan cusub inay si hufan uga shaqeeyaan horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, amniga, dib-u-heshiisiinta, kobcinta dhaqaalaha, iyo fulinta qorshayaasha horumarineed ee Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Magacaabista xubnaha golaha Wasiirrada ayaa u baahan in golaha wakiillada maamulkaasi ay ansixiyaan, ayadoo la filayo in dhowaan la horgeeyo si ay u meelmariyaan.

items.title: From Parliament to Academia: Dr. Mohamed Mursal Earns PhD with Highest Honors in Law and Political Science
items.description: By Abdikarim Haji Abdi Buh Former Speaker’s groundbreaking research on Somalia’s political system offers fresh insights into constitutional reform, state-building, and democratic governance. Somalia marked a significant academic milestone on July 8, 2026, as former Speaker of the House of the People of the Federal Parliament of Somalia, Dr. Mohamed Mursal Sheikh Abdirahman, successfully defended his Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) dissertation in Law and Political Science at International Astrolabe University (IAU), earning the highest academic distinction of “Mumtaaz” (Excellent). The achievement represents more than a personal academic triumph. It is widely regarded as a valuable contribution to Somalia’s growing body of scholarly research on governance, constitutional development, and democratic transformation at a time when the country continues to navigate complex political and institutional reforms. Following several hours of rigorous academic examination, the dissertation committee unanimously approved the research and awarded it the highest possible evaluation, praising the depth of analysis, originality, methodology, and relevance of its findings. Research Focused on Somalia’s Political Future Dr. Mursal’s dissertation, titled “The Somali Political System in Light of Regional and International Changes: An Analytical Study of Challenges and Opportunities ,” examines how regional geopolitical shifts and international developments have shaped Somalia’s evolving political system. The research offers a comprehensive assessment of the challenges confronting Somalia’s state-building process while identifying opportunities to strengthen constitutional governance, democratic institutions, and long-term political stability. Drawing upon both legal scholarship and political science, the dissertation explores constitutional reform, institutional reconstruction, federal governance, electoral development, and the influence of regional and international actors on Somalia’s political trajectory. It also presents practical recommendations aimed at improving governance, strengthening democratic accountability, and reinforcing the rule of law. A Timely Contribution to National Debate The successful defense comes at a pivotal moment for Somalia, where discussions surrounding constitutional review, federal-state relations, electoral frameworks, and institutional reform remain central to the country’s political future. Dr. Mursal’s research provides evidence-based analysis that may prove valuable to policymakers, constitutional experts, researchers, development partners, and students studying governance and public administration. The dissertation is expected to serve as an important reference for universities, research centers, government institutions, constitutional review bodies, and international organizations engaged in Somalia’s governance and state-building agenda. Before pursuing his doctoral studies, Dr. Mohamed Mursal Sheikh Abdirahman served as Speaker of Somalia’s House of the People, one of the country’s highest constitutional offices. His transition from legislative leadership to advanced academic research reflects a continued commitment to public service through scholarship and intellectual inquiry. By combining years of practical political experience with rigorous academic research, he brings a unique perspective to one of Somalia’s most consequential policy debates. His accomplishment also highlights the growing importance of higher education and research in shaping effective public policy and strengthening democratic institutions. About International Astrolabe University Dr. Mursal earned his doctorate from International Astrolabe University (IAU), also known as International Arees University, an international higher education institution specializing in distance learning, open online education, and traditional academic programs. The university is designed to serve a diverse international student community through flexible learning pathways, including on-campus instruction, independent external study, and digital learning platforms. Its academic programs span several disciplines, including Administrative Sciences and Economics, Sharia and Islamic Studies, Information Engineering, Education and Psychology, International Law and Political Science, and Arabic Language and Literature. IAU supports its academic activities through a network of educational and administrative centers across Turkey, Lebanon, Qatar, Iraq, Libya, Austria, Nigeria, and Burkina Faso, enabling students from different regions to participate in graduate studies, dissertation defenses, research conferences, and academic programs. Inspiring the Next Generation of Somali Scholars Dr. Mursal’s achievement extends beyond personal success. It represents an investment in Somalia’s intellectual capital and serves as an inspiration to aspiring Somali scholars who seek to contribute to their country’s future through education and research. At a time when Somalia requires highly qualified experts in constitutional law, governance, diplomacy, and public administration, achievements such as this demonstrate the transformative power of higher education in advancing national development. His doctoral research reinforces the idea that sustainable progress depends not only on political leadership but also on rigorous scholarship capable of informing policy and strengthening public institutions. A National Achievement Worth Celebrating The conferral of the title Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Law and Political Science marks the culmination of years of disciplined research, critical thinking, and academic excellence. While this milestone belongs to Dr. Mohamed Mursal Sheikh Abdirahman, it also represents a proud moment for Somalia’s academic community and for all those who believe education is essential to nation-building. As Somalia continues its journey toward constitutional consolidation, democratic governance, and institutional resilience, scholarly contributions such as Dr. Mursal’s will remain indispensable in enriching public discourse and guiding evidence-based reforms. His successful doctoral defense stands as a testament to the enduring value of knowledge, research, and lifelong learning. It is not only a celebration of personal excellence but also a powerful reminder that Somalia’s future will be shaped by leaders who combine practical experience with academic insight in the service of their nation. His transition from legislative leadership to advanced academic research reflects a continued commitment to public service through scholarship and intellectual inquiry. By combining years of practical political experience with rigorous academic research, he brings a unique perspective to one of Somalia’s most consequential policy debates. His accomplishment also highlights the growing importance of higher education and research in shaping effective public policy and strengthening democratic institutions. About International Astrolabe University Dr. Mursal earned his doctorate from International Astrolabe University (IAU), also known as International Arees University, an international higher education institution specializing in distance learning, open online education, and traditional academic programs. The university is designed to serve a diverse international student community through flexible learning pathways, including on-campus instruction, independent external study, and digital learning platforms. Its academic programs span several disciplines, including Administrative Sciences and Economics, Sharia and Islamic Studies, Information Engineering, Education and Psychology, International Law and Political Science, and Arabic Language and Literature. IAU supports its academic activities through a network of educational and administrative centers across Turkey, Lebanon, Qatar, Iraq, Libya, Austria, Nigeria, and Burkina Faso, enabling students from different regions to participate in graduate studies, dissertation defenses, research conferences, and academic programs. It represents an investment in Somalia’s intellectual capital and serves as an inspiration to aspiring Somali scholars who seek to contribute to their country’s future through education and research. At a time when Somalia requires highly qualified experts in constitutional law, governance, diplomacy, and public administration, achievements such as this demonstrate the transformative power of higher education in advancing national development. While this milestone belongs to Dr. Mohamed Mursal Sheikh Abdirahman, it also represents a proud moment for Somalia’s academic community and for all those who believe education is essential to nation-building. As Somalia continues its journey toward constitutional consolidation, democratic governance, and institutional resilience, scholarly contributions such as Dr. Mursal’s will remain indispensable in enriching public discourse and guiding evidence-based reforms. His successful doctoral defense stands as a testament to the enduring value of knowledge, research, and lifelong learning. It is not only a celebration of personal excellence but also a powerful reminder that Somalia’s future will be shaped by leaders who combine practical experience with academic insight in the service of their nation. items.title: Maqnaanshaha Hoggaamiyaha Cusub ee Iiraan oo Dhaliyay hadal-heyn iyo Su’aalo Badan
items.description: Maqnaanshaha hoggaamiyaha cusub ee Iiraan, Mojtaba Khamenei, ayaa sii kordhiyay hadal-haynta gudaha iyo dibadda dalkaas, iyadoo weli aan si rasmi ah loo arkin ama aan laga maqal wax cod ah tan iyo markii loo magacaabay xilka hoggaamiyaha sare bishii Maarso. Mojtaba Khamenei ayaa si buuxda uga maqnaa aaska aabihii, hoggaamiyihii hore Ayatullah Cali Khamenei, mana uusan soo saarin farriin qoraal ama muuqaal ah, arrintaas oo dhalisay su’aalo badan oo ku saabsan xaaladdiisa caafimaad iyo awooddiisa hoggaamineed. Sida ay qortay Reuters, ilo sare oo Iiraani ah ayaa sheegay in Mojtaba uu dhaawacyo culus kasoo gaaray weerarkii lagu dilay aabihii dabayaaqadii Febraayo, ayadoo Ilo-wareedyadu ay sheegeen inuu weli go’aannada dalka ka qayb qaato, balse uusan awoodin inuu si fagaare ah uga soo muuqdo sababo la xiriira caafimaadkiisa iyo ammaankiisa. Dhanka kale, warbaahinta bulshada iyo falanqeeyayaal qaar ayaa faafiyay xogo sheegaya in Mojtaba Khamenei laga yaabo inuu geeriyooday, islamarkaana xogtiisa la qarinayo. Waxaa kale oo jira dood kale oo aan la xaqiijin oo oranaysa in wadaad kale uu si dhab ah u hoggaamiyo dalka, halka magaca Mojtaba loo adeegsanayo sababo amni awgood, balse ma jiro wax caddeyn rasmi ah oo taageeraysa sheegashooyinkaas. Dowladda Iiraan weli ma shaacin wax war ah oo muujinaya inuu dhintay ama xilka laga qaaday, sidoo kale Reuters waxay sheegtay in sababta maqnaanshihiisa ay ilo rasmi ah ku tilmaameen dhaawacyo iyo walaac dhanka ammaanka ah. Madaxweyne Masoud Pezeshkian ayaa bishii May sheegay inuu la kulmay hoggaamiyaha cusub, isagoo xusay in xaaladdiisa caafimaad ay soo hagaagayso. Khubarada ayaa sheegaya in maqnaanshaha hoggaamiye aan shacabka arkin ama codkiisa maqlin uu caqabad ku noqon karo maamulka Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah, gaar ahaan xilli dalka uu wajahayo xiisado amni, dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed. Falanqeeyaha taariikhda casriga ah ee Jaamacadda St Andrews, Ali Ansari, ayaa sheegay in ay adkaan karto in hoggaamiye cusub uu helo kalsoonida shacabka haddii uu muddo dheer ka maqnaado fagaarayaasha, isagoo xusay in xaaladdan aysan sii socon karin muddo dheer. Ilaa iyo hadda, xogaha la xaqiijiyay waa in Mojtaba Khamenei aan lagu arkin meel fagaare ah tan iyo magacaabistiisii, balse wararka sheegaya inuu geeriyooday ama in qof kale si qarsoodi ah u hoggaaminayo Iiraan lama hayo wax caddeyn rasmi ah oo xaqiijinaysa.

items.title: Somalia’s Election Talks Advance, but Deep Divisions Persist Over Rules of the Game
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Political negotiations between Somalia’s Federal Government and opposition leaders have produced agreement on several core electoral principles, but significant differences remain over the legal framework and administration of the country’s next elections, exposing a persistent divide over whether the process should be shaped through broad consensus or government-led directives. A comparison of the positions presented during the talks shows that both sides have reached common ground on several fundamental issues, raising hopes for progress toward an inclusive political settlement. However, negotiations remain deadlocked over key questions that will ultimately determine the credibility and legitimacy of the electoral process. Areas of Agreement According to information emerging from the negotiations, both the Federal Government and the opposition have agreed in principle that: Somalia should hold one-person, one-vote elections, allowing citizens to directly elect their leaders. The country should adopt a multi-party political system to replace the long-standing clan-based 4.5 electoral model. Eligible voters should undergo official voter registration to establish a credible national voter register. The consensus on these principles is widely viewed as an important step toward establishing a democratic electoral framework. Where the Talks Remain Stuck Despite agreement on the broad principles, negotiators remain sharply divided over how those principles should be implemented. Federal Government’s Position The Federal Government, led by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, is advocating: Basing the elections on the 2026 Constitution. Allowing the Federal Government to appoint the National Electoral Commission. Limiting the political landscape to three national political parties. Conducting voting electronically and counting ballots through a computerized digital system. Opposition’s Position The opposition albeit to varying degrees, with former President Farmaajo’s team presenting their position—has proposed the following: Holding the elections under Somalia’s 2012 Provisional Federal Constitution rather than the newly unilaterally adopted constitutional framework. Establishing an independent Electoral Commission appointed through a consultative process involving multiple stakeholders to ensure neutrality. Conducting voter registration at both the regional and district levels, with political parties participating in monitoring the process. Counting ballots manually instead of relying on a fully digital tabulation system. Consensus or Dictation? While the negotiations have demonstrated growing agreement on the principle of direct elections, the remaining disputes underscore a broader political struggle over who controls the electoral process. A workable transitional period will be required to reach consensus on the electoral model and establish the legal, institutional, and operational infrastructure needed to implement the agreed path forward. Opposition figures argue that an election can only gain national legitimacy if its governing rules are negotiated through consensus rather than determined unilaterally by the incumbent administration. They have expressed concern that proposals allowing the Federal Government to appoint the electoral commission, rely on a contested constitutional framework, and define the structure of the party system without broad political agreement risk undermining confidence in the process. The Federal Government, meanwhile, maintains that its proposals are intended to establish a workable framework for implementing Somalia’s long-delayed transition to universal suffrage. Negotiators are expected to continue discussions on the constitutional basis of the elections, the composition of the Electoral Commission, voter registration procedures, and the method of vote counting. The outcome of these talks is expected to play a decisive role in determining whether Somalia can deliver a broadly accepted one-person, one-vote election or whether political disagreements over the rules of the contest will continue to delay the country’s democratic transition. items.title: Shakhsiga aan aaminsanahay inuu hoggaamin karo Golaha Guurtida waa Cabdulqaadir Jirde.
items.description: Haddii ay rumoowdo in Saleebaan Maxamuud Aadan baneeyo xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Guurtidda, shakhsiga aan aaminsanahay inuu hoggaamin karo Golaha waa Cabdulqaadir Jirde. Nasiib darro, xubin kama aha Golaha Guurtidda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxa suurtogal ah inuu xubin ka noqdo haddii uu helo xildhibaan uga tanaasula xubinnimada. Sababta aan u taageerayo waa inaan aqaan kartidiisa iyo waayo-aragnimadiisa, sidoo kalena uu yahay qof ay dad badani ku kalsoon yihiin. Waxaan rumaysanahay in hoggaankiisu uu Golaha Guurtidda ka dhigi lahaa gole ka duwan sida uu maanta yahay. Tani waa aragtidayda shakhsiga ah, mana metelayso cid kale. Mujaahid Cali Gurey.

items.title: Horjooge Mayow Cali Muuse oo usoo gacan galay ciidanka DF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Horjooge Mayow Cali Muuse ayaa maanta isku soo dhiibay ciidanka xoogga dalka ee ku sugan deegaanka Mubaarak ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, sida ay baahisay warbaahinta ciidamada qalabka sida. Mayow ayaa muddo ka tirsanaa kooxda Al-Shabaab, wuxuuna u qaabilsanaa ururinta waxa ay kooxdu ugu yeerto sakawaadka, kuwaas oo uu ka qaadi jiray shacabka ku nool deegaanka Mubaarak iyo deegaannada hoos yimaada. Sida ay dowladda sheegtay, horjoogahan oo muddo ku dhuumaaleysanayay deegaannada miyiga ah ayaa u adkeysan waayay cadaadiska joogtada ah ee ciidanka xoogga dalka, ugu dambeyntiina wuxuu isku soo dhiibay ururka 203-aad ee guutada 20-aad kumaandooska Gor-Gor. Cutubkan uu isku dhiibay ayaa ka howlgala deegaanka Mubaarak ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, halkaas oo ciidamada ay ka wadaan howlgallo ka dhan ah kooxda Al-Shabaab. Dhanka kale, waxaa isla maanta isna isa soo dhiibay Maxamed Jaylaani Dayib, oo gudaha Al-Shabaab looga yaqaanay magaca Deeqow. Waxa uu isku dhiibay ururka 62-aad ee guutada 6-aad, qeybta 60-aad ee ciidanka xoogga dalka, kuwaas oo saldhiggoodu yahay magaalada Buulo-mareer ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Maxamed Jaylaani ayaa ku biiray Al-Shabaab sanadkii 2015, wuxuuna soo noqday wakiilka kooxda u qaabilsanaa deegaanka Jilib Marko ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Ninkan ayaa sida uu sheegay waxaa xilkaas laga qaaday sanadkii 2024. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay xoojisay dadaallada lagu dhiirrigelinayo xubnaha Al-Shabaab inay ka soo goostaan kooxda oo ay isu soo dhiibaan ciidamada dowladda. items.title: Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga oo Baaritaan ku Bilowday Askar Ku Xadgudbay Calanka Mareykanka
items.description: MUQDISHO, Soomaaliya — Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si adag uga gashay muuqaal dhowaan ku baahay baraha bulshada, kaasi oo muujinayay shakhsiyaad ku labisan dareeska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed oo ku kacaya falal aan la aqbali karin oo ka dhanka ah calanka dalka Mareykanka. Qoraal rasmi ah oo ka soo baxay wasaaradda ayaa lagu caddeeyay in falkaasi uu yahay mid gabi ahaanba ka horimaanaya qiyamka, anshaxa, iyo xirfad-nimo ee laga filayo Ciidanka Qaranka, isla markaana uusan marnaba ka tarjumaynin aragtida Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ama tan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Wasaaradda ayaa shaaca ka qaadday in xilligan gacanta lagu dhigay shakhsiyaadkii ku lugta lahaa falkan, isla markaana uu hadda socdo baaritaan qoto dheer oo lagu ogaanayo duruufihii ku gedaannaa dhacdadan, si loo mariyo ciqaab adag oo isugu jirta mid anshaxeed iyo mid sharci. Dhanka kale, qoraalka wasaaradda ayaa lagu nuux-nuux saday in Soomaaliya ay aad u qiimeyso iskaashiga fog ee dhanka amniga ee kala dhexeeya dowladda Mareykanka, iyadoo la xusay in wadashaqaynta labada dhinac ay door muhiim ah ka qaadatay dagaalka lagula jiro kooxaha Al-Shabaab iyo ISIS, iyo waliba xoojinta hay’adaha amniga ee dalka. Ugu dambeyntii, Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya waxay dib u xaqiijisay ixtiraamka weyn ee ay u heyso shacabka iyo calanka dalka Mareykanka, iyadoo ballan-qaadday inay sii jiri doonto iskaashiga istiraatiijiyadeed ee u dhexeeya labada qaran.

items.title: Iran oo hanjabaadii u cusleyd u dirtay Imaaraadka xilli Trump iyo Netanyahu ay…
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) — Dowladda Iiraan ayaa hanjabaad culus u dirtay Isutagga Imaaraadka Carabta, iyadoo ku eedeysay inuu door ku lahaa weerarradii dhowaan uu Mareykanku ku qaaday dalkeeda. Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan ayaa sheegtay inay qaadi doonto tallaabooyin militari oo ka dhan ah Imaaraadka, iyadoo si cad u sheegtay in jawaab kasta oo ay bixiso ay noqon doonto mid culus oo aan si fudud loo illoobi doonin. Ismaaciil Kowsari, oo xubin ka ah Guddiga Amniga Qaranka iyo Siyaasadda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Baarlamaanka Iiraan, ayaa sheegay in Tehran ay si toos ah u beegsan doonto Imaaraadka, kaas oo ay ku eedeysay inuu garab istaagay weerarrada lagu qaaday dalkeeda. Bartilmaameedyada ciidamada Iiraan ayaa waxaa ka mid noqon kara kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo gaadiidka ee Imaaraadka, sida waddooyinka tareennada, garoomada diyaaradaha, dekedaha, xarumaha ganacsiga, goobaha saliidda iyo gaaska, iyo xarumaha kale ee muhiimka u ah dhaqaalaha dalkaas. Hanjabaaddan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli ay sii kordhayaan xiisadaha u dhexeeya Iiraan, Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil, iyadoo dalalka gobolka ay si dhow ula socdaan xaaladda. Ilaa iyo hadda, dowladda Isutagga Imaaraadka Carabta kama aysan jawaabin eedeymaha iyo hanjabaadaha cusub ee ka soo baxay Tehran. Sidoo kale waxay imaanaysa xilli Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu ay u tashanayaan Iiraan. Labada mas’uul ayaa ka wada-hadlay arrimo la xiriira amniga Bariga Dhexe iyo tallaabooyinka suurtagalka ah ee laga qaadi karo Tehran. Trump ayaa Khamiistii khadka taleefanka kula hadlay hoggaamiyaha Israa’iil, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay ee la xiriiray Iiraan iyo tallaabooyinka la qorsheynayo. War-saxaafadeed ka soo baxay xafiiska Netanyahu ayaa lagu sheegay in labada hoggaamiye ay isla soo qaadeen “tallaabooyin la isku dubbariday oo laga fulinayo jihooyin kala duwan,” halka Trump uu Netanyahu uga warbixiyay tallaabooyinka uu Mareykanku ka qaaday Iiraan iyo qorshayaasha la xiriira xaaladda gobolka. items.title: Faah-faahinta dil ka dhacay magaalada Gaalkacyo
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wiil dhallinyaro ah oo lagu magacaabo Maxamed Diiriye Catoosh ayaa xalay lagu dilay magaalada Gaalkacyo ee xarunta gobolka Mudug kadib weerar la sheegay inuu la xiriiray dhac ay geysteen kooxo hubeysan. Dilka ayaa ka dhacay xaafadda Garsoor, halkaas oo la sheegay in koox burcad ah isku dayeen inay ka dhacaan taleefanka gacanta ee marxuumka, taasoo ugu dambeyn sababtay in rasaas lagu furo. Marxuum Maxamed Diiriye Catoosh ayaa la sheegay inuu ka mid ahaa ardaydii sannadkan dhammaysatay dugsiyada sare ee Puntland, iyadoo geeridiisa si weyn uga naxeen ehelladiisa, saaxiibbadiis iyo bulshada ku nool magaalada Gaalkacyo. Ciidanka booliska gobolka Mudug ayaa xaqiijiyey inay bilaabeen baaritaan ku saabsan dilka, iyagoo sheegay inay ku raad-joogaan koox lagu tuhunsan yahay inay ka dambeysay falka. Taliyaha saldhigga booliska warshad Galay, Mahad Siciid Axmed ayaa sheegay in laamaha ammaanku ay si dhow ula socdaan baaritaanka iyo raadraaca eedeysanayaasha, isla markaana ay socdaan howlgallo lagu soo qabanayo dadka looga shakisan yahay kiiskan. Waxa uu taliyuhu ugu baaqay shacabka inay laamaha ammaanka la wadaagaan xog kasta oo gacan ka geysan karta soo qabashada dambiilayaasha, isagoo xusay in cid kasta oo ku lug yeelata falalkan sharciga la horkeeni doono. Magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa waxaa mararka qaar ka dhaca falal amni-darro iyo dhac hubeysan, kuwaas oo walaac ku haya shacabka, iyadoo laamaha ammaankuna ay wadaan dadaallo lagu xoojinayo sugidda amniga magaalada. The post Faah-faahinta dil ka dhacay magaalada Gaalkacyo appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan oo tababar usoo xiray saraakiil uu tababaray Turkiga + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Dr. Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta tababar u soo xiray saraakiil iyo saraakiil-xigeenno si guul leh u dhammaystay sanadkii waxbarashada ciidan ee dugsiga tababarka ee TURKSOM. Madaxweynaha ayaa munaasabadda ku daawaday dhoolatus ciidan oo ay si wadajir ah u soo bandhigeen saraakiisha, saraakiil-xigeennada iyo cutubyadii ay hoggaamin doonaan, isagoo ku ammaanay dadaalka, adkaysiga iyo hufnaanta ay muujiyeen muddadii uu tababarkoodu socday. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in saraakiishan ay yihiin hoggaamiyeyaasha mustaqbalka ee ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed, lagana filayo inay qarankooda ugu adeegaan daacadnimo, aqoon iyo waddaniyad. Madaxweynaha ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyey in dowladdu ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso dib-u-dhiska, casriyeynta iyo tayeynta ciidanka xoogga dalka, si loo helo ciidan leh awood iyo xirfad buuxda oo xaqiijiya amniga dalka iyo difaaca qarannimada. Waxa uu sidoo kale xusay in tayeynta ciidamada ay laf-dhabar u tahay qorshaha dowladda ee lagu xoojinayo la-dagaallanka kooxaha argagixisada iyo sugidda xasilloonida dalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa ku dhiirrigeliyey saraakiisha qalin-jabisay inay si hufan u gutaan waajibaadka loo igmaday, isla markaana ay tusaale wanaagsan u noqdaan askarta ay hoggaamin doonaan. Gabagabadii, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa uga mahadceliyey dowladda aan walaalaha nahay ee Turkiga taageerada joogtada ah ee ay siiso Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada tababarka iyo tayeynta ciidamada, taas oo door weyn ka qaadatay dhismaha ciidan qaran oo xirfad iyo karti leh. The post Madaxweyne Xasan oo tababar usoo xiray saraakiil uu tababaray Turkiga + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Saraakiil ku biiraya Ciidamada Qalabka Sida oo tababar loogu soo xiray TURKSOM (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta Saraakiil ku biiraya Ciidamada Dhulka, Cirka iyo Badda tababar ugu soo xiray Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee TURKSOM ee duleedka Magaalada Muqdisho. Munaasabadda qalin jebinta ayaa waxaa ka qaybgalay Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga, Axmed Macalin Fiqi, Wasiirka Dekedaha & Gaadiidka Badda, Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar, Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka Turkiga, General Metin Tokel, Saraakiisha Dugsiga TURKSOM, diblomaasiyiin iyo xubno kale. Saraakiishan oo isugu jira Saraakiil iyo Saraakiil Xigeeno ayaa la filayaa in ay door weyn ka qaadan doonaan horumarinta Ciidanka Qaranka Somaliya iyo la dagaalanka maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee TURKSOM ayaa waxaa si joogta ah tababar loogu soo xiraa Saraakiil, Saraakiil Xigeeno iyo Ciidanka Kumaandooska Gorgor ee Militariga Somaliya. Xerada TURKSOM ayaa ah saldhigga ugu weyn ee Turkigu uu ku leeyahay meel ka baxsan dalkiisa, wuxuuna diiradda saaraa tababarka ciidamada, waxbarashada iyo dhisidda awoodda difaaca. Turkiga ayaa gacan weyn ka gaysta taageerada dib-u-dhiska Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Somaliya iyo casriyayntooda, iyadoo loo marayo iskaashi ku dhisan heshiisyada labada dal. Doorka Turkiga ee Somaliya waa mid muuqdo oo udub dhexaad u ah dhismaha ciidamada iyo in Somaliya mar kale ay cagaheeda isku taagto.

items.title: Journalists union raps Puntland authorities over arrest of reporter
items.description: The National Union of Somali Journalists (NUSOJ) has mounted a fresh challenge against the Puntland administration, calling for the immediate release of independent reporter Suways Ga’ayte and the withdrawal of all criminal charges filed against her. In a formal statement released on Friday, the union decried what it describes as an “intensifying pattern of intimidation” in the regional state, accusing local judicial authorities of weaponizing the law to silence critical reporting. Ga’ayte’s case has become a flashpoint for a growing standoff between the government and the media, which the union claims is being stifled by politically motivated prosecutions. NUSOJ Secretary-General Omar Faruk Osman warned that the continued detention of journalists signals a dangerous shift in the region’s governance. “The criminal justice system must never be used as a tool to punish journalists for independent reporting,” Osman said. “We call upon the Puntland judicial authorities to discontinue the proceedings against Suways Ga’ayte and withdraw all charges arising from her legitimate journalistic work.” The union is now demanding that Puntland’s leadership honor constitutional protections for press freedom, arguing that current practices have fostered a climate of fear. By targeting those who act as the public’s “watchdogs,” the union warns, the state is effectively eroding government accountability. For observers across the Horn of Africa, the crackdown in Puntland is a familiar, albeit troubling, trend. Somalia remains one of the world’s most precarious environments for media workers, who frequently operate at the intersection of clan politics, militant threats, and state-led legal harassment. In Somalia, media stakeholders and regional human rights bodies often monitor such developments closely, as the erosion of press freedom creates a “chilling effect” on the country’s information flow. NUSOJ has committed to escalating the case through national and international legal and human rights channels, vowing to remain involved until the charges are dropped and those behind the prosecution are held accountable. As of Friday the Puntland judicial authorities had not issued a formal response to the union’s demands. items.title: Colaadda Iiraan iyo Mareykanka oo hoos u dhigtay rajadii laga qabay suuqa shidaalk caalamka
items.description: Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Tamarta (IEA) ayaa sheegtay in sii xoogaysashada colaadda u dhexeysa Maraykanka iyo Iran toddobaadkan ay mugdi gelisay rajadii laga qabay suuqa shidaalka ee caalamka. IEA ayaa hore u saadaalisay in heshiiskii ay Washington iyo Tehran gaareen bishii hore, kaas oo lagu soo afjarayay colaadda isla markaana si buuxda dib loogu furayay Marinka Hormuz, uu horseedi doono koror weyn oo ku yimaadda sahayda shidaalka bilaha soo socda. Hase yeeshee, hay’addu waxay hadda ka digaysaa in dib u soo cusboonaanshaha dagaalladu uu burburin karo saadaashaas. Inkastoo aanay jirin weerarro cusub oo dhacay habeenkii xalay, haddana xaaladdu weli waa mid kacsan oo aan degganayn.

items.description: Madaxweyne Xasan oo tababar u soo xiray saraakiil ka qalin jebiyay Dugsiga TURKSOM Muqdisho – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta tababar u soo xiray Saraakiil iyo Saraakiil-xigeenno si guul leh u dhammeystay sanad waxbarashadooda ciidan ee Dugsiga Tababarka ee TURKSOM. Madaxweynaha ayaa daawaday dhoolatus ciidan oo ay wadajir u sameeyeen Saraakiisha, Saraakiil-xigeenada iyo colalkii ay hoggaamin lahaayeen. Tababarkan ayaa muhiim u ah xilligan, sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay tallaabo cusub oo ay Dowladda Soomaaliya uga sii dhowaanayso dib-u-dhiska iyo casriyeynta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, iyadoo la xoojinayo awoodda iyo xirfadaha ciidamada si ay uga jawaabaan caqabadaha amni ee dalka ka jira. Madaxweynaha oo hadal ka jeediyay xafladda qalin-jabinta ayaa ku bogaadiyay dadaalka, adkaysiga iyo hufnaanta ay muujiyeen saraakiishu muddadii uu tababarkoodu socday. Wuxuu yidhi: “Waxaad tihiin hoggaamiyeyaasha berri ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, lagana sugayo inaad si daacadnimo, aqoon iyo waddaniyad ku dheehan tahay ugu adeegtaan qarankooda.” Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso dib-u-dhiska, casriyeynta iyo tayeynta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, si ay u yeeshaan awood iyo xirfad ay ku xaqiijiyaan amniga dalka, difaaca qarannimada iyo ciribtirka kooxaha Khawaarijta. Waxaa intaas dheer, Madaxweynuhu wuxuu uga mahadceliyay Dowladda Turkiga taageerada joogtada ah ee ay ku bixiso horumarinta iyo tayeynta ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, taasi oo door muuqda ka qaadatay dhismaha ciidan qaran oo leh xirfad iyo karti. Saraakiisha qalin jabisay ayaa lagu tilmaamay inay yihiin kuwa lagu tababaray qaabab casri ah oo ku saleysan taageerada Turkiga, iyagoo diyaar u ah inay qabtaan waajibaadkooda ciidan ee dalka. Tababarkan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada socda ee Dowladda Soomaaliya ay ku xoojinayso awoodda ciidamada si ay uga hortagaan khataraha amni. items.title: DF Soomaaliya oo maanta heshiisyo muhiim ah la saxiixatay dalka…
items.description: Nouakchott (Caasimada Online) – Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Cali Balcad ayaa maanta kulan rasmi ah la yeeshay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Mauritania, Maxamed Saalim Marzuuq, kaas oo ka dhacay xarunta Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Mauritania. Kulanka ayaa waxaa goob-joog ka ahaa Danjiraha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya u fadhiya Aljeeriya, ahna Danjiraha aan degganeyn ee Mauritania, Danjire Yuusuf Axmed Xasan (Yuusuf Jeego) iyo mas’uuliyiin kale oo ka socday labada dal. Intii uu kulanku socday, labada dhinac ayaa ka wada-hadlay xoojinta xiriirka laba geesoodka ah, iskaashiga diblomaasiyadeed iyo sidii loo ballaarin lahaa wada-shaqeynta ka dhexeysa Soomaaliya iyo Mauritania. Mas’uuliyiinta labada dal ayaa sidoo kale kala saxiixday saddex heshiis is-afgarad (MoU), kuwaas oo lagu tilmaamay kuwo muhiim u ah horumarinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya labada dowladood. Heshiisyada ayaa diiradda saaraya iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, la-dagaallanka argagixisada, kalluumeysiga, batroolka iyo waxbarashada, kuwaas oo la filayo inay sare u qaadaan xiriirka labada dal. Wasiiru-dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Cali Maxamed Cumar ayaa sheegay in booqashadiisa Mauritania ay qeyb ka tahay dadaallada dowladda Soomaaliya ay ku xoojineyso xiriirka ay la leedahay dalalka Afrika, gaar ahaan kuwa gobolka. Booqashadan ayaa la filayaa inay sii xoojiso iskaashiga siyaasadeed, amniga iyo dhaqaalaha ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Mauritania, iyadoo labada dhinac ay muujiyeen sida ay uga go’an tahay hirgelinta heshiisyada ay kala saxiixdeen. The post DF Soomaaliya oo maanta heshiisyo muhiim ah la saxiixatay dalka… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dowladda iyo Mucaaradka oo isku afgartay wadahadal
items.description: Dowladda iyo Mucaaradka oo isku afgartay in la sii wado wadahallada doorashooyinka Muqdisho – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo xubno ka socda dhinacyada mucaaradka ayaa sheegay inay horumar ka gaareen wadahalladii uga socday magaalada Muqdisho, kuwaas oo diiradda lagu saaray hannaanka doorashooyinka, dimuqraadiyadda iyo dib-u-habeynta nidaamka siyaasadeed ee dalka. Labada dhinac ayaa isku raacey in wadahallada la sii wado si loo gaaro is-afgarad dhammaystiran. Wadahalladan ayaa muhiim u ah xilligan, sababtoo ah waxay ka dhigan yihiin tallaabo cusub oo ay Soomaaliya uga sii dhowaanayso nidaam dimuqraadi ah, iyadoo dowladda iyo mucaaradku ay wada ogaadeen in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay helaan fursad ay si toos ah uga qayb qaataan doorashooyinka. Tani waxay muujinaysaa is-beddel ku yimaada dhaqanka siyaasadeed ee dalka. Mas’uuliyiin ka hadlay kulanka ayaa sheegay in labada dhinac ay isku raaceen muhiimadda ay leedahay in geeddi-socodka siyaasadeed uu noqdo mid ku dhisan wada-tashi, is-afgarad iyo ilaalinta dastuurka. Waxay sidoo kale isla qaatay in wadahadalku yahay waddada ugu habboon ee lagu xallin karo arrimaha la xiriira hannaanka doorashooyinka. Dowladda ayaa soo bandhigtay qorshaheeda ku aaddan hirgelinta doorashooyin ku saleysan dimuqraadiyadda iyo nidaamka xisbiyada badan, iyadoo tilmaantay in qorshahaasi u baahan yahay wada-shaqeyn iyo taageero ay ka helaan dhammaan dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo bulshada. Wasiirka arrimaha gudaha ayaa sheegay in dowladda ay hiigsanayso in Soomaaliya ay u gudubto nidaam dimuqraadi ah oo shacabka siinaya fursad ay si xor iyo xalaal ah ugu doortaan hoggaankooda. Wuxuu yidhi: “Wadahalladaani waxay caddeyn u yihiin in Soomaaliya ay diyaar u tahay in ay qaaddo tallaabooyin muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo dimuqraadiyadda iyo ka qaybgalka siyaasadeed.” War-saxaafadeedka ka soo baxay kulanka ayaa lagu sheegay in wadahallada la sii wadi doono, si loo gaaro is-afgarad dhammaystiran oo ku saabsan arrimaha doorashooyinka iyo ka qaybgalka siyaasadeed ee muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed. Kulanka ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada socda ee lagu doonayo in la helo hannaan siyaasadeed oo ay isku waafaqsan yihiin dowladda, mucaaradka iyo dhinacyada kale ee ay khuseyso arrinta doorashooyinka. Dowladda ayaa sheegtay inay tixgelinayso duruufaha amni iyo xaaladaha gaarka ah ee ka jira dalka, iyadoo la raadinayo sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa doorashooyin xor ah oo qof walba ka qayb qaadan karo. The post Dowladda iyo Mucaaradka oo isku afgartay wadahadal first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Turkish Army Chief Arrives in Somalia Amid Sensitive Government-Opposition Talks
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – The arrival of Turkey’s Land Forces Commander, General Metin Tokel, in Mogadishu on an official military visit has drawn renewed political attention as Somalia’s Federal Government and opposition leaders remain engaged in Turkish-facilitated negotiations over the country’s electoral future. General Tokel and his high-level delegation were received at Aden Adde International Airport by the Commander of the Somali National Army’s Land Forces, Major General Sahal Abdullahi Omar. The visiting delegation was accorded full military honors, underscoring the close defense partnership between Somalia and Turkey. The visit comes at a particularly sensitive moment, with Ankara serving as a mediator in political talks aimed at reaching a consensus on Somalia’s electoral framework. While Turkish officials have presented themselves as facilitators of dialogue, some opposition figures and political observers have questioned whether the timing of the senior military delegation’s arrival could complicate perceptions of Turkey’s impartiality. Turkey has long been one of Somalia’s closest security partners, providing military training, equipment, strategic advice, and institutional support to the Somali National Army. Thousands of Somali soldiers have received training under Turkish programs, and the partnership has expanded to include defense planning, military modernization, and counterterrorism cooperation. However, Ankara’s growing military and political influence has also attracted criticism from sections of the opposition. Some government critics argue that Turkey appeared to side with the Federal Government during previous political disputes, including the controversial federal intervention in Southwest State, which opponents described as an illegitimate effort to consolidate Mogadishu’s control over the regional administration. Those allegations have fueled lingering doubts among some opposition groups about whether Turkey can serve as a fully neutral mediator in the current political negotiations. Although neither the Somali Federal Government nor Turkish officials have publicly linked General Tokel’s visit to the ongoing political dialogue, analysts note that the optics of a high-profile military engagement during delicate mediation efforts are likely to intensify scrutiny from opposition stakeholders who have repeatedly called for an even-handed facilitation process. During the visit, military officials from both countries are expected to discuss expanding defense cooperation, increasing training programs, strengthening joint military planning, and enhancing the operational capabilities of the Somali National Army as it continues operations against Al-Shabaab. The visit also reflects the deep strategic partnership between Mogadishu and Ankara, a relationship that has grown steadily over the past decade and encompasses security, defense, infrastructure, and economic cooperation. Whether the visit is viewed solely as part of routine military cooperation or becomes another point of political contention may depend on the progress of the ongoing government-opposition negotiations, where confidence in the neutrality of mediators remains a critical factor in building a broadly accepted electoral agreement. items.title: Wasiir Soomaali oo kulan la yeeshay Bangiga Adduunka
items.description: Geneva, Switzerland – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Isgaarsiinta iyo Tiknoolajiyadda ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Maxamed Aadam Macallim Soomaali, ayaa kulan gaar ah la yeeshay Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka Bangiga Adduunka ee Isbeddelka Dijitaalka, Mudane Sangbu Kim, xilli uu ka qayb galayo Shirka Heerka Sare ee WSIS+20 ee ka dhacaya magaalada Geneva. Kulankan ayaa diiradda lagu saaray jihada cusub ee iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Bangiga Adduunka. Kulankan ayaa muhiim u ah xilligan, sababtoo ah waxa uu ka dhigan yahay tallaabo cusub oo ay Soomaaliya uga sii dhowaanayso midowga caalamiga ah ee dhanka tiknoolajiyadda, iyadoo la isla qaatay mudnaanta la siinayo hirgelinta Qorshaha Qaran ee Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI). Qorshahan ayaa la filayaa inuu saldhig u noqdo isku xirka adeegyada dowladda, fududeynta adeeg bixinta, iyo kobcinta dhaqaalaha ku dhisan tiknoolajiyadda. Intii uu kulanku socday, labada dhinac waxay is dhaafsadeen aragtiyo ku saabsan sidii taageerada Bangiga Adduunka ay ula jaanqaadi lahayd qorshayaasha dib-u-habeynta ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhismaha adeegyo dijitaal oo gaara muwaadiniinta iyo ganacsiyada dalka. Wasiir Soomaali ayaa xusay in iskaashiga caalamiga ahi uu yahay tiirka ugu muhiimsan ee lagu dardargelin karo isbeddelka dhijitaalka ah. Wuxuu yidhi: “Dalalka waxaa muhiim ah inay iska bartaan waaya-aragnimada, is-weydaarsadaan aqoonta iyo hababka ugu wanaagsan ee lagu hirgelin karo isbeddelka dhijitaalka ah, si loo xaqiijiyo mustaqbal dhijitaal ah oo loo dhan yahay.” Waxaa intaas dheer, Wasiirku wuxuu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay gaartay dib-u-habaynta nidaamka sharciyeed ee ICT-ga, iyo horumarinta Kaabeyaasha Dadweynaha ee Dhijitaalka ah (Digital Public Infrastructure – DPI), taas oo ah dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee lagu dhisayo adeegyo dowladeed oo casri ah. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah kulammada dhinacyada badan ee ay wafdiga Soomaaliya ka wadaan magaalada Geneva, kuwaas oo lagu ballaarinayo iskaashiyada caalamiga ah isla markaana lagu soo jiidanayo taageero dheeraad ah oo lagu hirgelinayo himilooyinka isbeddelka dijitaalka ee dalka. Shirka Heer Wasiir ee WSIS Forum 2026 ayaa isku keenay Wasiirrada iyo madaxda sare ee dalalka xubnaha ka ah Qaramada Midoobay si ay uga wada hadlaan hirgelinta natiijooyinka WSIS+20, horumarinta isbeddelka dhijitaalka ah, iyo xoojinta iskaashiga caalamiga ah. The post Wasiir Soomaali oo kulan la yeeshay Bangiga Adduunka first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Kenyan Police Foil Alleged Attack Plot, Arrest Somali Suspect in Major Illegal Arms Bust
items.description: Nairobi (WDN) – Kenyan security forces have disrupted what authorities describe as a suspected plot to carry out attacks in Nairobi and Garissa, arresting several armed suspects, including a Somali national allegedly involved in an illegal weapons trafficking network. The arrests followed a targeted security operation in which police intercepted a vehicle at a checkpoint and detained a suspect accused of transporting firearms intended for Nairobi. Authorities believe the weapons were being moved as part of a broader illicit arms operation. According to police, the Somali suspect is under investigation for alleged involvement in the illegal arms trade and for attempting to smuggle weapons into the Kenyan capital. Officers recovered multiple firearms during the operation and later displayed the seized weapons as evidence. Images of the suspect in handcuffs quickly circulated across Kenyan media and social media, drawing widespread attention to the high-profile operation. Investigators said the suspect remains in custody and will be arraigned in court after further questioning. Police disclosed that preliminary investigations uncovered additional intelligence regarding his alleged role in illegal arms trafficking, with authorities now pursuing further leads to determine whether he was acting alone or as part of a larger criminal network. The operation comes as Kenyan security agencies intensify efforts to dismantle arms smuggling routes and prevent militant attacks, particularly in Nairobi and the northeastern region bordering Somalia, where authorities have long warned that illegal weapons trafficking continues to pose a significant threat to national security. The investigation remains ongoing, and police have indicated that additional arrests could follow as detectives pursue new leads uncovered during the operation. items.title: Shariif oo markii u horreysay ka hadlay nooca xiriirka kala dhaxeeya Imaaraadka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya Shariif Sheekh Axmed ayaa beeniyay eedeymaha sheegaya in isaga iyo siyaasiyiin kale oo mucaaradka ah ay taageero dhaqaale ama mid siyaasadeed ka helaan dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta. Shariif, oo wareysi bixiyay toddobaadkan, ayaa sheegay in xiriirka kala dhexeeya Imaaraadka uu yahay mid shakhsi ah, isla markaana uusan wax xiriir siyaasadeed ah la lahayn dowladda Abu Dhabi. Waxa uu sheegay inuu qoyskiisa kula noolaa Imaaraadka muddo ku dhow toban sano, halkaasna si wanaagsan loogu soo dhaweeyay. “Aniga iyo qoyskayga waa nala soo dhaweeyay, waana uga mahadcelinayaa, laakiin wax xiriir siyaasadeed ah ma lihin,” ayuu yiri Shariif Sheekh Axmed. Hadalkiisa ayaa yimid xilli dowladda federaalka ay marar kala duwan ku eedeysay dalal shisheeye, oo Imaaraadku ka mid yahay, inay faragelin ku hayaan arrimaha gudaha Soomaaliya, isla markaana ay taageero siiyaan qaar ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka iyo maamul-goboleedyada. Shariif ayaa ku dooday in Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud laftiisu uu xiriir dhow la lahaa Imaaraadka, isla markaana dowladda federaalka ay sannadihii dambe Abu Dhabi ka heshay taageero dhaqaale iyo mid amni. Waxa uu Imaaraadka ku tilmaamay mid ka mid ah dalalka Carabta ee muddada dheer taageerayay Soomaaliya, isaga oo xusay mashaariic horumarineed, tababarrada ciidamada iyo kaalmooyin dhaqaale oo ay ka faa’iideysteen dowlado kala duwan oo Soomaaliya soo maray. Madaxweynihii hore ayaa dhaliilay isbeddelka ku yimid hadallada dowladda federaalka ee ku wajahan Imaaraadka, isaga oo sheegay in aysan dani ugu jirin Soomaaliya inay si joogto ah eedeymo ugu jeediso dal horay taageero u siin jiray. “Soomaaliya waa inay fahamtaa sida xiriirrada caalamiga ahi u shaqeeyaan iyo sida khilaafaadka loo maareeyo, halkii mar walba eedeyn laga adeegsan lahaa,” ayuu yiri. Bishii Janaayo 2026, dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay joojisay dhammaan heshiisyadii ay la lahayd Imaaraadka Carabta, oo ay ku jireen heshiisyo la xiriiray maareynta dekedaha, iskaashiga amniga iyo difaaca. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa xilligaas sheegay in go’aanka lagu saleeyay warbixinno iyo caddeymo lagu kalsoon yahay oo muujinaya tallaabooyin uu Imaaraadku qaaday, kuwaas oo sida uu sheegay dhaawacayay madaxbannaanida, midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. Ilo ku dhow dowladda ayaa sheegay in Muqdisho ay ka carootay saameynta sii kordheysa ee Imaaraadku ku leeyahay deegaannada ka baxsan gacanta tooska ah ee dowladda federaalka, gaar ahaan Somaliland iyo qaar ka mid ah maamul-goboleedyada. Imaaraadka ayaa tobankii sano ee la soo dhaafay maalgashi ganacsi iyo mid amni ku sameeyay Somaliland. Shirkadda DP World ee laga leeyahay Imaaraadka ayaa heshiis muddo 30 sano ah ku maamusha dekedda Berbera, taas oo noqotay mid ka mid ah xarumaha ugu muhiimsan ee ganacsiga iyo istaraatiijiyadda gobolka. Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya waxay ku adkeysaneysaa in Somaliland ay weli qayb ka tahay Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, halka maamulka Hargeysa uu leeyahay hay’ado u gaar ah, balse aanu weli helin aqoonsi caalami ah oo ballaaran. Hadalka Shariif Sheekh Axmed ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Imaaraadka uu wajahayo xiisad xooggan, isla markaana arrinta xiriirka mucaaradka, maamul-goboleedyada iyo dowladaha shisheeye ay noqotay mid ka mid ah qodobbada ugu waaweyn ee muranka siyaasadeed ee dalka. items.title: Somalia: Puntland President Warns Opposition Politicians and Armed Groups
items.description: Garowe — Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni has issued a strong warning to opposition politicians and armed forces that he says are being mobilized by Somalia's Federal Government in parts of Puntland.

items.title: UNTMIS Welcomes Progress in Somalia’s Government-Opposition Election Talks
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – The United Nations Transition Mission in Somalia (UNTMIS) has welcomed the progress made in the ongoing political dialogue between Somalia’s Federal Government and opposition leaders, describing the talks as a positive step toward reaching a broad-based agreement on the country’s electoral process. In a statement, UNTMIS commended the efforts of all parties involved in convening the negotiations, emphasizing the importance of sustained dialogue in achieving a political consensus on Somalia’s future elections. The UN mission noted that the latest round of discussions, held  in Mogadishu, took place in a cordial and constructive atmosphere, with participants focusing on building common ground and advancing mutual understanding on key electoral issues. The negotiations, which have been underway in the Somali capital in recent days, are aimed at bridging differences over the electoral framework and securing an inclusive political agreement acceptable to all major stakeholders. According to sources familiar with the talks, the discussions have made encouraging progress, although several key issues remain under negotiation. The dialogue is being facilitated by UNTMIS, with support from diplomats representing the European Union, as well as the embassies of the Turkey, United Kingdom and the United States, all of whom are working alongside Somali stakeholders to help foster consensus and support a peaceful, Somali-led political process. items.title: Soomaaliya, Turkiga iyo UK oo yeeshay wada-hadal cusub
items.description: London (Caasimada Online) – Iskaashi dhow oo u dhexeeya Soomaaliya, Turkiga iyo Boqortooyada Midowday (UK) ayaa lagu sheegay inuu gacan ka geysan karo xoojinta xasilloonida Soomaaliya iyo guud ahaan Geeska Afrika, kadib kulan ay mas’uuliyiin ka kala socday saddexda dal ku yeesheen Aqalka Baarlamaanka UK. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray doorka iskaashiga istaraatiijiga ah ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya, Turkiga iyo UK, iyadoo lagu sheegay in xiriirka muddada dheer ee Ankara iyo Muqdisho uu noqon karo saldhig lagu ballaarinayo wada-shaqeyn ay London qayb ka noqoto. Mas’uuliyiintii ka hadlay kulanka ayaa sheegay in iskaashigan saddex geesoodka ah uu muhiim u noqon karo taageerada amniga, horumarinta iyo koboca dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan xilli uu dalku ku jiro marxalad dib-u-dhis iyo horumar. Danjiraha Turkiga ee Boqortooyada Midowday, Cismaan Koray Ertaş ayaa sheegay in xiriirka dalkiisa iyo Soomaaliya uusan ku koobnayn gargaarka bini’aadantinimo, balse uu isu beddelay iskaashi ballaaran oo dhinacyada horumarinta, amniga iyo maalgashiga ah. Ertaş ayaa xusay in Turkigu tan iyo sanadkii 2011 uu Soomaaliya ka hirgeliyay mashaariic horumarineed oo ka badan hal bilyan oo doollar, isla markaana uu tababarro siiyay in ka badan 20,000 oo askari oo ka tirsan ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliya. Danjiraha Turkiga ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay sameysay horumar muuqda, inkastoo ay weli wajahayso caqabado kala duwan. Wuxuu tilmaamay in Ankara ay soo dhoweynayso taageerada caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan doorka UK, isagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay in Turkigu uu doorbidayo iskaashi halkii uu ka jiri lahaa tartan. Dhankiisa, Danjiraha Soomaaliya ee UK, Cabdulqaadir Xaashi ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ka gudbeyso marxalad ku tiirsanaanta gargaarka dibadda una gudbeyso hannaan ku saleysan horumar, maalgashi iyo iskaashi dhaqaale. Xaashi ayaa soo dhoweeyay warbixin ay diyaarisay xarunta xiriirka Anglo-Turkiga (CATR), isagoo sheegay inay ka tarjumeyso isbeddellada ka socda Soomaaliya iyo dadaallada dalka loogu beddelayo meel fursado maalgashi leh. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in ku biirista UK ee iskaashiga dhow ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ay abuuri karto iskaashi saddex geesood ah oo faa’iido u leh dhammaan dhinacyada, isla markaana gacan ka geysan kara xoojinta nabadda iyo horumarka Geeska Afrika. “Soomaaliya iyo Turkigu waa laba saaxiib oo muhiim u ah UK,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaanka Baarlamaanka UK ee xisbiga Labour-ka, Afzal Khan oo guddoomiyay kulanka. Sidoo kale wuxuu ku baaqay in laga gudbo ku tiirsanaanta gargaarka loona gudbo maalgashi, kobac dhaqaale iyo iskaashi waara, isagoo sheegay in xasilloonida Soomaaliya ay dan u tahay Afrika iyo caalamkaba. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray doorka iskaashiga istaraatiijiga ah ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya, Turkiga iyo UK, iyadoo lagu sheegay in xiriirka muddada dheer ee Ankara iyo Muqdisho uu noqon karo saldhig lagu ballaarinayo wada-shaqeyn ay London qayb ka noqoto. Mas’uuliyiintii ka hadlay kulanka ayaa sheegay in iskaashigan saddex geesoodka ah uu muhiim u noqon karo taageerada amniga, horumarinta iyo koboca dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan xilli uu dalku ku jiro marxalad dib-u-dhis iyo horumar. Danjiraha Turkiga ee Boqortooyada Midowday, Cismaan Koray Ertaş ayaa sheegay in xiriirka dalkiisa iyo Soomaaliya uusan ku koobnayn gargaarka bini’aadantinimo, balse uu isu beddelay iskaashi ballaaran oo dhinacyada horumarinta, amniga iyo maalgashiga ah. Ertaş ayaa xusay in Turkigu tan iyo sanadkii 2011 uu Soomaaliya ka hirgeliyay mashaariic horumarineed oo ka badan hal bilyan oo doollar, isla markaana uu tababarro siiyay in ka badan 20,000 oo askari oo ka tirsan ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliya. Danjiraha Turkiga ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay sameysay horumar muuqda, inkastoo ay weli wajahayso caqabado kala duwan. Wuxuu tilmaamay in Ankara ay soo dhoweynayso taageerada caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan doorka UK, isagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay in Turkigu uu doorbidayo iskaashi halkii uu ka jiri lahaa tartan. Dhankiisa, Danjiraha Soomaaliya ee UK, Cabdulqaadir Xaashi ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ka gudbeyso marxalad ku tiirsanaanta gargaarka dibadda una gudbeyso hannaan ku saleysan horumar, maalgashi iyo iskaashi dhaqaale. Xaashi ayaa soo dhoweeyay warbixin ay diyaarisay xarunta xiriirka Anglo-Turkiga (CATR), isagoo sheegay inay ka tarjumeyso isbeddellada ka socda Soomaaliya iyo dadaallada dalka loogu beddelayo meel fursado maalgashi leh. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in ku biirista UK ee iskaashiga dhow ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ay abuuri karto iskaashi saddex geesood ah oo faa’iido u leh dhammaan dhinacyada, isla markaana gacan ka geysan kara xoojinta nabadda iyo horumarka Geeska Afrika. “Soomaaliya iyo Turkigu waa laba saaxiib oo muhiim u ah UK,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaanka Baarlamaanka UK ee xisbiga Labour-ka, Afzal Khan oo guddoomiyay kulanka. Sidoo kale wuxuu ku baaqay in laga gudbo ku tiirsanaanta gargaarka loona gudbo maalgashi, kobac dhaqaale iyo iskaashi waara, isagoo sheegay in xasilloonida Soomaaliya ay dan u tahay Afrika iyo caalamkaba. items.title: Nin fursad ganacsi u beddelay fikrad uu ka helay dhageysiga Radio Ergo
items.description: (ERGO) – Axmed Cabdullaahi Bocoreey oo ah 47 jir deggan magaalada Muqdisho ayaa nolosha qoyskiisa isbeddel weyn ku sameeyay. Dhegeysiga barnaamijka deegaanka ee Raadiyow Ergo ayuu ka dhex helay aragti ganacsi oo u horseeday inuu abuurto ilo cusub oo kordhiyay daqligiisa. Ninkan ayaa ka ganacsada dhir noocyo kala duwan ah, isagoo adeegsanaya hab hal-abuur leh oo uu ku badbaadinayo deegaanka. Wuxuu tilmaamay in ganacsigan uu kaafiyay nolosha qoyskiisa iyo ehelkiisa. Ninkan oo ku guulaystay inuu ballaariyo shaqadiisa, ayaa sheegay in aqoonta uu ka qaatay raadiyaha ay u sahashay inuu badiyo dhaqaalaha qoyskiisa. Wuxuu markii hore la tacaalayay daboolista baahiyaha asaasiga ah. Isbeddelkan ayaa Axmed ka caawiyay inuu ka baxo hubanti-la’aan dhanka dakhliga ah, taas oo keentay in toddobaadkii uu ku tashto lacag u dhaxeeya 80 illaa 100 dollar. “Nolosheenna oo keliya ma ahan asxaabo ayaa jirto. Waalid ayaa jira oo si maalin walba ah u qaato masaariif, mar mar abti ayaa soo boodaayo mar mar eedaa soo boodayso mar walbo waxbaa soo boodaayo.” Guri labo qol ka kooban ayuu ku deggan yahay bishii 100 dollar oo ku yaalla degmada Wadajir ee magaalada Muqdisho. Ninkan ayaa sidoo kale awooday bixinta waxbarashada labo carruurtiisa kamid ah oo dhigta fasalka 11 naad ee dugsiga sare. Wuxuu sheegay in bille uu uga bixiyo min 15 dollar. “Shaqada waxbadan ayay iga kaafisay inaan qof hoos tagin oo  qof wax aan tuugsan, wax keen maanta inaan qof dhihin oo aaniga aan isku filnaado oo  aan shaqeesto bil caksi aniga aan wax bixiyo.” Ninkan ayaa dakhli iyo nolol cusub ka dhex abuuray miraha la tuuro; wuxuu tagaa goobaha qashinka si uu uga soo dhex xulo miraha khudaarta iyo dhirta ay bulshadu reebtay, kuwaas oo uu dib u abuuro, daryeel weynna galiyo. waxay hadda u noqdeen il-dhaqaale oo uu si joogto ah u gurto miraheeda. In kasta oo dadka qaar ay la yaabaan marka ay ku arkaan goobaha qashinka isagoo baaraya, haddana isaga waxaa bidhaamaysa ujeeddo weyn oo ganacsi. Ma ahan oo kaliya miraha waxa uu raadsado; haraaga cuntada iyo qolofka khudaarta ee dadku daadiyeen ayuu u beddelaa digada nafaqaysa carrada uu ku dhex beerayo dhirta cusub. “Caleentaas dad baa iskasoo xaaqay waan soo aruusaday caleenta caraa u beddelaa. geedkaan moxoga laleeyahay waxaa laga sameeyaa buraa canbuulaa lagu karsadaa.” Axmed Cabdullaahi Bocoreey oo gacmaha ku haya beeshin ama weel uu ku abuuray miraha uu soo uruursado/Maxamed Khadar/Ergo Horumarka iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa xooggan ee ganacsigiisa, Axmed wuxuu guusheeda gabi ahaanba u tiirinayaa talooyinkii uu ka bartay Raadiyow Ergo. Wuxuu rumeysan yahay in la’aanta codkaas hagayay, ay adkaan lahayd inuu maanta sawirto halka uu ku dambayn lahaa mustaqbalka masruufka qoyskiisa iyo noloshiisaba. Axmed ayaa tilmaamay in uu kala socdo idaacadaha Muqdisho ee soo daaya Radio Ergo, taas oo u noqotay mid uu ku tixan yahay galab kasta. Bishii  March, 2025 oo Radio Ergo lagu daabacay halgankiisa nololeed ayaa u horseeday inuu helo macaamiil badan, kuwaas oo ka soo dalbada dhirta. Axmed ayaa sheegay in wax-soo saarka shaqadiisa ay hooseysay. Noloshiisa ayaa isbedeshay markii uu la saaxiibay idaacadda, taas oo siisay fursad ah inuu ganacsigiisa ku soo daro hal abuur maanta ku simay inuu noqdo mid bullaalay oo wax ka beddelay hab nololeedka qoyskiisa. Tan iyo markaas waxay u noqotay shaqadiisa mid ka duwan intii aan la baahin, Axmed oo si gaar ah u xiiseeya arrimaha deegaanka ayaa sheegay inuu ku tixan yahay cinwaannada la xariira dhireynta deegaanka. “Barnaamijka deegaanka oo Ergo ayaan ku xiranahay wax badan ayaan ka faa’iiday marwalba cilmiga inaan sii kordhiyo ayaan jeclahay. Shaqadeyda marka meel sare ayaad gaarsiiseen aad ayaan idinkaga mahadcelinaa.” Ninkan ayaa shaqadan si rasmi ah u xoojiyay bilowgii sannadkan 2026, isaga oo xogihii uu kala baxay baahinta ergo oo uu joogteeyay kaddibna u beddel ficil, wuxuuna ku guuleystay inuu ka miro dhalliyo kana macaasho. Axmed ayaa xusay in shaqadu aysan aheyn wax laga xishoodo balse ay tahay sharaf mudnaan gaar ah siineysa cidda ku dhiirrata lana aqoon iyo xirfad. Wuxuu aaminsan yahay in aragti ka maqan ay aheyd xoojinta iibinta dhirta miraha la dheefsado leh, taas u kabtay xirfaddiisa samaynta agab dhirta lagu rido oo uu ka farsameeyo shamiindo, carro gaduud iyo rinji midabo kala jaad ah ka kooban. Yoolka ugu weyn ee Axmed hadda ma ahan oo kaliya inuu qoyskiisa kaafiyo, balse wuxuu rabaa in xirfaddiisa farshaxanka iyo beerista dhirta uu u adeegsado la-dagaallanka shaqo-la’aanta haysata dhallinyarada. Wuxuu bilaabay inuu mid-mid u fuliyo qorsheyaal u deggan oo ah inuu aqoontiisa gaarsiiyo bulshada, si loo helo qoysas badan oo isku filan. Illaa iyo hadda. Wuxuu xirfaddan si bilaash ah ugu tababaray in ka badan 10 dhallinyaro ah, kuwaas oo maanta ku shaqaysta, kuna maareeya nolosha qoysaskooda. Axmed nolosha maanta uma muuqato sidii hore; wuxuu noqday tusaale nool oo muujinaya sida macluumaadka Raadiyow Ergo uu qofka iyo bulshada uga caawin karo inay qaataan go’aan u sahla inay dhistaan mustaqbalka wanaagsan iyo wacyi. Ninkan oo wehel ka dhigtay dhegeysiga barnaamijyada maalinlaha ah ee idaacadda, wuxuu ka dhex helay aqoon iyo dhiirrigelin gabi ahaanba beddeshay jihada noloshiisa iyo midda dadka uu gacan qabtay. items.title: Fiqi oo ciidamada xoogga faray inay u diyaar garoobaan…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa ciidamada xoogga dalka iyo kuwa deegaanka ee ku sugan xarumaha tababarrada ee gobolka Shabeellada Dhexe ku amray inay galaan heegan buuxa, iyadoo dowladda ay waddo abaabulka howlgallo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa ciidanka ku booriyay inay dardar geliyaan howl-gallada lagu ciribtirayo kooxda Al-Shabaab, isagoo sheegay in loo baahan yahay diyaar-garow buuxa si loo soo afjaro haraadiga kooxda. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa wadday abaabulka ugu dambeeyay ee lagu xoojinayo dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, iyadoo la diyaarinayo ciidamo fulin doona howlgallo qorsheysan oo ka dhacaya deegaanno ka tirsan Galmudug, HirShabeelle iyo Koonfur Galbeed. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga ayaa booqday degmada Raaga Ceelle ee gobolka Shabeellada Dhexe, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay ciidamada iyo saraakiisha kumaandooska Gorgor, kuwaas oo qeyb ka ah qorshaha howlgalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa ciidamada ku adkeeyay inay u diyaar garoobaan gulufka colaadeed ee lagu doonayo in lagu xoreeyo deegaannada ay weli ku sugan yihiin Al-Shabaab, isagoo bogaadiyay dadaallada ay ciidamada ka wadaan furimaha dagaalka. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale ciidamada ku ammaanay difaaca ay ka sameeyeen weerarrada Al-Shabaab, wuxuuna sheegay in dowladda ay sii xoojin doonto taageerada iyo howlaha lagu wiiqayo awoodda kooxda. Fiqi ayaa shacabka ugu baaqay inay ciidamada la wadaagaan xogaha muhiimka ah ee la xiriira dhaqdhaqaaqyada Al-Shabaab iyo sahayda ay helaan, isagoo sheegay in iskaashiga shacabka iyo ciidamada uu muhiim u yahay guusha howlgalka. Ugu dambeyntiina, wasiirka ayaa sheegay in ciidamada ay sameeyeen howl-gallo lagu joojiyay sahayda Al-Shabaab, isagoo tusaale u soo qaatay in la qabtay xoolo ay kooxdu dadka kaga qaadday canshuur ay ugu yeerto “sako”, taasoo uu ku tilmaamay dhaqaale ay ku maalgeliso howlaheeda. items.title: Midowga Afrika oo ku baaqay in howlgalka AUSSOM lagu maalgeliyo dhaqaale ay xubnuhu ay bixiyaan
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika, Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf, ayaa ku baaqay in la dardargeliyo maalgelinta gudaha ee howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, kadib markii Mareykanku uu ku dhawaaqay inuu joojinayo taageeradii saadka ee uu siin jiray howlgalka. Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf ayaa sheegay in la joogo xilligii dalalka xubnaha ka ah Midowga Afrika ay kordhin lahaayeen kaalintooda dhaqaale, isla markaana si degdeg ah loo dhaqan-gelin lahaa Sanduuqa Nabadda ee Midowga Afrika (African Peace Fund), si loo xaqiijiyo joogtaynta howlgalada nabad ilaalinta ee qaaradda. Guddoomiyuhu wuxuu xusay in ku-tiirsanaanta deeq-bixiyeyaasha dibadda ay caqabad ku tahay sii socoshada howlgalada amniga, isagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay in Afrika ay u baahan tahay awood ay ku maalgeliso nabaddeeda iyo amnigeeda. Baaqan ayaa imanaya xilli Soomaaliya ay wajahaysa caqabado amni oo ay ka mid yihiin dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda ay si tartiib tartiib ah ula wareegayaan mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka, kadib dhimista doorka howlgalka Midowga Afrika. Go’aanka Mareykanka ee lagu joojiyay taageerada saadka ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo mustaqbalka howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, taasoo keentay in madaxda ururku ay xoojiyaan baaqyada ku aaddan in la helo ilo dhaqaale oo waara oo ay iska kaashadaan dalalka xubnaha ka ah Midowga Afrika. items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo Sheegtay inay Sii Wadi Doonto Wadahadallada Doorashooyinka
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay tacab iyo dadaal badan gelisay sidii dalka ay uga dhici lahayd doorasho qof iyo cod ah, iyadoo arrintaas kala tashatay daneeyeyaasha kala duwan ee siyaasadda iyo bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Dowladdu waxay tilmaantay in hirgelinta nidaam doorasho oo dimuqraadi ah ay muhiim u tahay xoojinta dowladnimada, matalaadda shacabka iyo ka gudubka nidaamka awood-qaybsiga ee ku saleysan qabiilka. Sidoo kale, Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto wada-hadallada iyo la-tashiyada ay la yeelanayso dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo daneeyeyaasha kale, si loo gaaro is-afgarad ku saabsan hannaanka doorasho ee dalka iyo sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa doorashooyin loo dhan yahay, hufan isla markaana lagu kalsoonaan karo. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay socdaan dadaallo lagu doonayo in Soomaaliya ay u gudubto nidaamka doorashooyinka qof iyo codka ah iyo dimuqraadiyad ku dhisan xisbiyo badan.

items.title: Turkiga oo ciidamo cusub u tababaraya Dowladda Somaliya
items.description: Dowladda Turkiga oo xulafo muhiim ah la ah Somaliya ayaa rasmi ah u ballaarineysa howlaheeda tababarka iyo dhismaha Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee lagu tababaro gudaha dalka. Saraakiisha Turkiga ayaa ciidamo cusub u tababaraya Dowladda Federaalka, si kor loogu qaado tayada iyo diyaargarowga Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Somaliya. Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka Turkiga, General Metin Tokel ayaa maanta Magaalada Muqdisho u yimid hirgelinta heshiisyada difaaca ee labada dal ee lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga militari iyo wada-shaqaynta hawlgalada Somaliya iyo Turkiga. Somaliya iyo Turkiga ayaa 8-dii bishii February ee sanadkii 2024 kala saxiixday heshiis ku qotoma iskaashiga difaaca iyo dhaqaalaha. Heshiiskan oo Turkiga uu kaga caawinayo Somaliya ilaalinta xeebaheeda ayaa waxaa qayb ka ah dib-u-dhiska Ciidanka Badda. Heshiiska badda ee labada dal ay galeen ayaa u ogolanaya Turkiga inuu tababaro, isla-markaana uu qalabeeyo Ciidanka Badda Somaliya, muddo toban sano ah. Saraakiisha Turkiga ayaa markii hore Ciidamada Dowladda Somaliya ku tababarayay Xerada TURKSOM ee duleedka Muqdisho, waxaana la filayaa in sidoo kale ay askarta ku tababaraan Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Qorilow ee Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe. Saraakiisha Turkiga ayaa horey Xerada TURKSOM ugu tababaray kumanaan askari oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, gaar ahaan Kumaandooska Gorgor iyo Booliska Sida Gaarka ah u tababaran ee Haramcad. Tallaabooyinka uu hadda Turkigu u qaadayo dardargelinta dib-u-dhiska iyo tayaynta ciidamada ayaa lagu xoojinayaa awooddooda difaaca. Turkiga ayaa ah saaxiibka ugu dhow ee Dowladda Federaalka kala shaqeeya arrimaha amniga, dhismaha Ciidamada Qalabka Sida iyo xoojinta xirfadahooda. Turkiga oo dhanka kale Somaliya ka taageera kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha ayaa ah dalka ugu weyn ee maalgashiga ku sameysta Somaliya, wuxuuna ku howlan yahay, sidii uu shidaal qodis uga bilaabi lahaa xeebaha dalka.

items.title: Sawirro: Taliyaha ciidanka dhulka Turkiga oo soo gaaray Muqdisho + Ujeedka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar ayaa maanta Garoonka Diyaaradaha Aadan Cadde ku soo dhaweeyey Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga, Jeneraal Metin Tokel oo booqasho rasmi ah ku yimid Soomaaliya. Soo dhaweynta taliyaha iyo wafdigiisa ayaa loo sameeyey hab-maamuus ciidan oo heer sare ah, iyadoo la muujiyey muhiimadda booqashada iyo xiriirka dhow ee labada dal. Booqashadan ayaa ka tarjumeysa xiriirka qotada dheer ee walaaltinimo iyo iskaashiga istaraatiijiga ah ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, kaas oo saldhig u ah wada-shaqeyn ballaaran oo dhinacyada amniga iyo difaaca ah. Turkiga ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyey door muuqda ka qaatay dib-u-dhiska iyo tayeynta ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo gacan ka geystay tababarrada ciidamada, kor u qaadista awooddooda iyo horumarinta hay’adaha difaaca. Sidoo kale, labada dal ayaa si joogto ah u xoojinaya iskaashigooda dhinacyada amniga, iyagoo ka wada shaqeynaya la dagaallanka khataraha amni ee gobolka iyo xoojinta awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Inta lagu guda jiro booqashadan, waxaa la filayaa in mas’uuliyiinta labada dhinac ay yeeshaan kulamo looga arrinsanayo ballaarinta iskaashiga difaaca, tababarrada ciidamada iyo is-dhaafsiga khibradaha ciidan. Booqashadan ayaa la filayaa inay sii adkeyso xiriirka u dhexeeya ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, isla markaana ay gacan ka geysato xoojinta amniga, xasilloonida iyo horumarka dalka. items.title: Maxay daarrantahay booqashada Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka Turkiga uu ku yimid Soomaaliya ?
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Turkiga, Jeneraal Metin Tokel, ayaa maanta oo Jimce ah booqasho rasmi ah ku yimid magaalada Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu kula kulmi doono saraakiisha ugu sarreysa ciidamada Soomaaliya si loo xoojiyo iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca iyo horumarinta awoodda ciidamada.
