The African Union Commission on Thursday informed members of its Peace and Security Council of Washington’s decision, warning that it would have “significant implications for the logistical sustainment, operational posture and financing of the Mission,” according to a letter seen by Somaliguardian. A spokesperson for the U.S. State Department confirmed that the United States would no longer support UNSOS operations. “The United States has provided nearly $2 billion in assessed contributions to UNSOS and its predecessor,” the spokesperson said. “Despite this investment, Somalia has been unable to independently sustain progress that AUSSOM and its predecessor missions have made to degrade and contain al-Shabaab or take ownership of most of its own security functions.” The spokesperson said the United States should not continue funding a mission that “has not met core objectives” and argued that resources should instead be directed toward security priorities with more immediate and direct implications for U.S. interests. Ahmed Koshin, a former director general at Somalia’s Ministry of Defence and now a member of the federal parliament, said the U.S. decision could have far-reaching consequences for Somalia’s security. “This will have huge ramifications for Somalia,” Koshin told Reuters. “The peacekeeping mission is in danger because ultimately you need to be able to support and sustain these forces,” he added. Two diplomats with direct knowledge of the African Union mission also told Reuters news agency that AUSSOM would be unable to continue unless another organization stepped in to replace the logistical support currently provided through the United Nations. U.N. spokesperson Stephane Dujarric said the organization was aware of the U.S. decision and had begun consultations with key stakeholders. “At this stage, we are discussing this internally and engaging with the African Union, Federal Government of Somalia and other partners,” Dujarric said. In its diplomatic note, Washington also delivered a sharp assessment of Somalia’s political leadership, arguing that internal divisions continue to undermine security gains. “Internal rivalries and political infighting continue to undermine the fight against al-Shabaab and ISIS, and the benefits of international support will remain limited until Somalia’s leaders unite to address the country’s security and governance challenges,” the note said. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo wacad ku maray in Israa’iil aysan joogi doonin Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa si adag uga hadlay xiriirka sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhaxeeya maamulka Somaliland iyo Israel, isagoo sheegay in dhaqanka, diinta iyo taariikhda Soomaalida midna uusan ogoleyn in dhul Soomaaliyeed lagu xiro Israel. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, oo ka hadlayay munaasabadda Kowda Luulyo, ayaa sheegay in Soomaalida ay ab ka ab iska ilaalin jirtay xiriir ay la yeelato Israel, wuxuuna si gaar ah uga digay qorshe kasta oo Israel loogu ogolaanayo inay saldhig ama saameyn ku yeelato dhul Soomaaliyeed. “Annaga iyo Israel waxba nagama dhexeeyaan. Israel laguma aqoon geyiga Soomaaliyeed, mana joogeyso haddii Alle yiraahdo,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Madaxweynaha ayaa hadalkiisa si toos ah ugu jeediyay Somaliland, oo muddooyinkii dambe qaaday tallaabooyin diblomaasiyadeed oo ay ku xoojinayso xiriirka ay la leedahay Israel, waxaana ugu dambeysay furitaanka xafiis diblomaasiyadeed oo Somaliland ay ka sameysatay magaalada Qudus. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in dowladda federaalka aysan aqbali doonin in Israel ay cag soo dhigato dhul Soomaaliyeed, isagoo ku celiyay in arrintaas ay ka hor imaaneyso dareenka shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo mowqifka guud ee dunida Islaamka. “Walaalayaal, xoogaa is-qabasho ah ayaa dhankiinna naga jirta. Wallaahi wax aysan Israel idinkaga dhexeyn ayaa naga dhexeeya. Waxa Israel jira wax ka fiican ayaan haysannaa,” ayuu yiri madaxweynaha. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in dadka Somaliland aysan ahayn dad ka duwan Soomaalida kale, balse ay yihiin walaalo ay tahay in la wada hadlo oo xal siyaasadeed lagu dhameeyo khilaafka muddada dheer taagan. “Walaalahey waxaan leeyahay, carada iyo caadifadda soo gaabiya wax yar, aan is-wareysanno. Walaalaheen meel aan ku kala tagno ha na soo gaarsiinina. Idinka ayaa ahaa dadkii xigmadda laga yaqaanay,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Hadalka madaxweynaha ayaa imanaya xilli maamulka Somaliland uu ku adkeysanayo go’aankiisa ku aaddan xiriirka uu la yeelanayo Israel, inkastoo tallaabooyinkaasi ay dhalinayaan dood xooggan oo gudaha Soomaalida iyo dalalka Islaamka ah. Somaliland ayaa dhowaan xafiis diblomaasiyadeed ka furatay magaalada Qudus, tallaabadaas oo ay cambaareeyeen dunisa Islaamka iyo dad badan oo Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo ku tilmaamay mid dhaawaceysa midnimada ummadda Soomaaliyeed iyo mowqifka soo jireenka ah ee Soomaalida ee ku aaddan qadiyadda Falastiin. Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa horey u caddeysay in aysan aqoonsaneyn wax xiriir diblomaasiyadeed ah oo Somaliland la gasho dal kale, maadaama ay u aragto Somaliland qeyb ka mid ah Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Hadalkan cusub ee Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa muujinaya in Muqdisho ay si dhow ula socoto dhaq-dhaqaaqyada Somaliland ee ku wajahan Israel, isla markaana aysan aqbali doonin tallaabo kasta oo ay u aragto mid dhaawaceysa madaxbannaanida, midnimada iyo mowqifka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. items.title: DF oo garab istaag wayn u muujisay Suuriya kadib markii…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si kulul u cambaareysay qarax argagixiso oo ka dhacay gudaha dalka Suuriya, kaas oo lala beegsaday maqaaxi ku taalla magaalada caasimadda ah ee Dimishiq oo ay ku sugnaayeen dad badan oo shacab ah. Qaraxa oo ka dhashay bambo la dhigay gudaha maqaayadda ayaa waxaa la xaqiijiyay inay ku dhinteen ugu yaraan 4 qof, ayna ku dhaawacmeen 11 kale, sida ay sheegtay Wakaaladda Wararka Dowladda Suuriya ee SNA. Bayaan kasoo baxay xafiiska Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali (Dhaay) ayaa lagu sheegay in dowladdu ay ka xun tahay weerarkaas oo ay ku dhinteen dad rayid ah, kuna dhaawacmeen kuwa kale oo aan waxba galabsan. Soomaaliya ayaa tacsi tiraanyo leh u dirtay dowladda Suuriya iyo shacabkeeda, gaar ahaan qoysaska ay dadkoodii ku dhinteen qaraxa, iyada oo kuwa dhaawaca ah u rajeysay caafimaad deg-deg ah. “Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay si kulul u cambaareyneysaa qaraxii argagixisanimo ee lala beegsaday maqaaxi ku taalla magaalada Dimishiq ee Jamhuuriyadda Carabta Suuriya, kaas oo sababay dhimashada dad rayid ah oo aan waxba galabsan iyo dhaawaca tiro kale oo badan,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Sidoo kale wuxuu bayaanka intaas ku daray “Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay tacsi tiiraanyo leh la wadaagaysaa Dowladda iyo shacabka Jamhuuriyadda Carabta Suuriya, gaar ahaan qoysaska iyo ehelada dadkii ku geeriyooday weerarkaas, waxayna u rajaynaysaa dhammaan dadka dhaawacmay in uu Alle siiyo caafimaad degdeg ah”. Dhanka kale Dowladda Federaalka ayaa shaacisay in xilligan adag ay garab taagan tahay dowladda Suuriya, iyada oo mar kale xaqiijisay taageeradeeda ku aadan amniga iyo xasiloonida dalkaasi. “Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay garab istaag buuxa la garab taagan tahay Jamhuuriyadda Carabta Suuriya xilligaan adag, waxayna mar kale xaqiijinaysaa taageeradeeda ku aaddan amniga, xasilloonida iyo badbaadada shacabka Suuriya,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri bayaanka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda. Ma jirto illaa iyo hadda cid sheegatay mas’uuliyadda qaraxa ka dhacay magaalada Dimishiq ee caasimadda dalka Suuriya, waxaana weli socdo baaritaanno ay wadaan laamaha amniga oo lagu ogaanayo cidda ka dambeysay. Suuriya ayaa tan iyo markii isbeddelka wayn ka dhacay ka caaganayd weerarada noocaan oo kale ah, waxaana amniga si buuxda u sugaya ciidamada amniga ee dalkaasi. The post DF oo garab istaag wayn u muujisay Suuriya kadib markii… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xogta duqeyn culus oo ka dhacay Masaajid Cali Gaduud
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Wararka naga soo gaaraya Gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe ayaa sheegaya in xalay diyaarado dagaal ay duqeymo ka fuliyeen aagga deegaanka Masaajid Cali Gauduud ee gobolkaasi, iyada oo lala eegtay maleeshiyaad ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab oo ku sugan halkaasi. Duqeynta oo bartilmaameed ahayd ayaa lagu garaacay goob ay isku uruursanayeen maleeshiyaad ka tirsan kooxda oo ku sugnaa halka loo yaqaano Quraca Nayle, waxaana lagu gaarsiiyay khasaare culus. Saraakiisha amniga ayaa ku warramay in ay heleen xogta dhaq-dhaqaaqa maleeshiyaadka, kadibna la duqeeyyay, iyada oo cagta la mariyay goobo ay gabaad ka dhigayaeen xubnah khawaarijta, gaar ahaan maleeshiyaad iyo horjoogayaal sar sare, sida ay hadalka u dhigeen. Qaar kamid ah dadka deegaanka ayaa innoo sheegay inay maqlayeen jugta gantaallada, balse aysan caddeyn karin inta uu gaarsiisan yahay khasaaraha. Shabeellaha Dhexe ayaa kamid ah meelaha ay weli ka socdaan howlgallada, waxaana badanaa ka dhaca howlgallo iyo duqeymo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab. Xaaladda ayaa weli kacsan, waxaana haatan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo iska soo horjeedo laga dareemayaa qaybo kamid ah gobolka oo ay ku xoogan tahay kooxda Muddooyinkii ugu dambeeyay dowladda Soomaaliya iyo saaxibada caalamiga ah gaar ahaan Mareykanka iyo Turkiga ayaa kordhiyay duqeymaha ka dhanka ah argagixisada, iyada oo meela kala duwan oo dalka ah lagu beegsaday laguna gaystay khasaare xooggan. The post Xogta duqeyn culus oo ka dhacay Masaajid Cali Gaduud appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Geopolitical Implications of Rapprochement Between Ethiopia and Somaliland
items.description: Geopolitical Implications of Rapprochement Between Ethiopia and Somaliland The Emirates Policy Center published on 1 July 2026 a paper titled “Between Maritime Access and Recognition: Geopolitical Implications of Rapprochement Between Ethiopia and Somaliland.” The prospect of landlocked Ethiopia securing maritime access through Somaliland highlights the intersection of Addis Ababa’s structural need for a maritime outlet and Hargeisa’s ambition to strengthen its legitimacy and bargaining power–without pressing for immediate formal recognition. The most likely scenario in the foreseeable future is the gradual expansion of economic and logistical cooperation between Ethiopia and Somaliland, without sovereign arrangements or formal recognition. While the option of recognition or sovereign maritime privileges remains possible, it is less likely and would require deeper regional and international transformations. Ambassador David H. Shinn

Government of the Republic of Somaliland Officially Endorses and Confirms Hosting of the 11th Annual London Political Summit
items.description: Government of the Republic of Somaliland Officially Endorses and Confirms Hosting of the 11th Annual London Political Summit and Awards (LPSA) 2026 – First Africa Edition, “Beyond London” FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE London, United Kingdom | Hargeisa, Republic of Somaliland The Organising Committee of the London Political Summit and Awards (LPSA), under the leadership of CaterandMerger Consult UK, in strategic collaboration with Africa-Next-Gen, the Africa Institute of Arts and Design, Maandeeq Cafeteria UK, and other international and diaspora partners, is honoured to announce that the Government of the Republic of Somaliland has formally endorsed and confirmed its hosting of the 11th Annual London Political Summit and Awards (LPSA) 2026 – First Africa Edition, “Beyond London.” The Summit is scheduled to take place from 15–18 October 2026 in Hargeisa, the capital of the Republic of Somaliland, under the distinguished patronage and official hosting of the Government of the Republic of Somaliland. This official endorsement marks a significant milestone in the eleven-year history of the London Political Summit and Awards. Since its inception in 2016, the Summit has evolved into an internationally recognised platform for high-level dialogue on democratic governance, diplomacy, peacebuilding, political leadership, trade, investment, and sustainable development, bringing together government leaders, parliamentarians, diplomats, business executives, academics, civil society organisations, and diaspora stakeholders from Africa, the United Kingdom, the Commonwealth, and the wider international community. A Historic Transition: From London to Africa The 2026 edition represents the Summit’s first official African country edition under the theme “Beyond London,” signifying the strategic expansion of the platform from its traditional base in the United Kingdom to the African continent. While the Summit proudly retains its roots in London, where it has been successfully convened for over a decade, the decision to launch the First Africa Edition reflects the Organising Committee’s commitment to bringing international policy dialogue, investment engagement, and Pan-African cooperation directly to Africa. This landmark initiative demonstrates the growing international relevance of the Summit and its vision of creating stronger institutional links between Africa, the United Kingdom, the Commonwealth, and the global African diaspora. Official Host Government The Government of the Republic of Somaliland has graciously accepted the honour of hosting this historic First Africa Edition, reaffirming its commitment to international engagement, democratic governance, regional peace, and economic cooperation. The Summit will be convened with the support of the Presidency, relevant Government Ministries, Parliament, public institutions, the Somaliland business community, diplomatic representatives, and members of the Somaliland diaspora. The official endorsement by the Government provides an important platform for expanding Somaliland’s engagement with international policymakers, investors, development institutions, and strategic partners. A Gathering of Continental and Global Leaders The Summit is expected to attract a distinguished international audience, including invited Heads of State and Government, Ministers, Members of Parliament, diplomats, business executives, traditional rulers, development partners, academics, civil society leaders, youth representatives, women leaders, and members of the African diaspora. Senior representatives of the Government of Somaliland, including Members of Parliament, Cabinet Ministers, local government leaders, and public institutions, are expected to participate alongside international delegations. The official opening ceremony is expected to be presided over by His Excellency the President of the Republic of Somaliland, who will formally welcome international delegates and officially declare the Summit open, subject to the final State programme. The London Edition Continues As part of the Summit’s expanded international programme, the traditional London Political Summit and Awards will continue to be held in the United Kingdom as scheduled. The London programme is planned to take place at the Palace of Westminster, where the Organising Committee anticipates the participation and support of Hon. Oliver Ryan MP, Member of Parliament for Burnley, as host, and Prof. Kishan Devani BEM, FRSA, as Chair of the proceedings, subject to final parliamentary and programme confirmations. Following the London engagements, it is anticipated that a high-level international delegation comprising parliamentarians, diplomats, business leaders, traditional rulers, investors, academics, and development partners will travel to Somaliland to participate in the First Africa Edition, reinforcing collaboration between the United Kingdom and Africa. A Strategic Opportunity for Somaliland Hosting the First Africa Edition of the London Political Summit and Awards presents Somaliland with an exceptional opportunity to showcase its achievements, aspirations, and development potential to a distinguished international audience. The Summit will provide an important platform to highlight Somaliland’s progress in democratic governance, peacebuilding, institution-building, entrepreneurship, education, culture, trade, and investment. It will also create opportunities to strengthen dialogue on regional cooperation within the Horn of Africa while promoting Somaliland as an emerging destination for responsible investment, business partnerships, higher education collaboration, tourism, innovation, and cultural exchange. The programme will include high-level policy dialogues, business and investment forums, diplomatic engagements, parliamentary exchanges, diaspora networking sessions, leadership awards, and cultural diplomacy events designed to foster meaningful international partnerships. items.title: Buffalo vandals steal Somali flag from City Hall pole — days after mayor canceled Fourth of July fireworks show
items.description: A Somalian flag that was raised outside of Buffalo’s City Hall to commemorate Somali Independence Day was stolen in an overnight heist, the city’s leftist mayor decried. “The City of Buffalo’s flagpole in Niagara Square sustained damage after unknown vandals broke the access panel, cut the cable, and removed the Somali flag during the overnight hours of Wednesday, July 1,” Mayor Sean Ryan wrote on Facebook. Ryan said the Buffalo Police Department was investigating the alleged vandalism after the city approved non-profit HEAL International to raise the white star, blue flag on July 1. “The flag had been raised by an organization called Heal International in honor of Somalian Independence Day. Heal International has been raising the Somali flag at Niagara Square for at least the last four years,” Ryan said. The mayor’s office shared that the “public use” flagpoles have flown banners of several countries and territories over the years, including Ukraine, Greece, Ireland, Puerto Rico, Italy and Bangladesh. It was not immediately known how much the vandalism to the city-owned property cost. Two poles sit across the street from the eastern side of City Hall with an American flag flying on one while the secondary pole is reserved for other flags. Somali Bantu refugees have settled in Buffalo’s West Side since 2003, according to the NYS Assembly. “Buffalo is a proud, diverse city, and our administration remains committed to honoring and celebrating the many cultures that make our community stronger,” Ryan wrote. The mayor, who previously served in the NYS Senate, has taken heat for canceling a city-sponsored Fourth of July fireworks display — days before the Somalian flag was raised. Ryan claimed plans to hold a large Independence Day celebration fell through after the hired vendor “raised real questions” about the safety of launching fireworks near City Hall, according to WGRZ. items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo ku Hanjabay inay beegsan doonaan Garoomada diyaaradaha Sacuudiga
items.description: Xiisadda u dhexeysa Xuutiyiinta Yemen iyo Sacuudiga ayaa sii xoogeysatay, kaddib markii Xuutiyiintu ku hanjabeen inay beegsan doonaan garoomada diyaaradaha iyo kaabeyaasha muhiimka ah ee dalkaas. Afhayeenka garabka militariga Xuutiyiinta, Yahya Saree, ayaa sheegay in ciidamadoodu ay ka hortageen waxa uu ku tilmaamay isku day ay diyaarado dagaal oo Sacuudigu leeyahay ku doonayeen inay ka hor istaagaan diyaarad rakaab oo Iiraan leedahay inay ka degto garoonka diyaaradaha ee Sanca. Xuutiyiintu waxay sheegeen in diyaaraddaasi ay sidday in ka badan 200 qof oo isugu jiray bukaano, dhaawacyo iyo rakaab ku xanibnaa Yemen. Kooxda ayaa uga digtay Sacuudiga inuu ku celiyo tallaabooyin noocaas ah, iyagoo sheegay in haddii hawadooda lagu soo xadgudbo ama la beegsado Yemen, ay jawaab ahaan u weerari doonaan garoomada diyaaradaha iyo xarumaha muhiimka ah ee Sacuudiga, dhulka iyo baddaba. Dhanka kale, isbahaysiga uu hoggaamiyo Sacuudiga ayaa si adag uga jawaabay hanjabaaddaas, isagoo sheegay in weerar kasta oo lagu qaado Boqortooyada lagu jawaabi doono si xooggan oo aan hore loo arag. Isbahaysigu wuxuu sidoo kale ku eedeeyay Xuutiyiinta inay ku xadgudbeen madaxbannaanida Yemen isla markaana ay isku dayayaan inay xaaladda sii huriyaan. Xiisaddan cusub ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli gobolka Bariga Dhexe uu wajahayo qalalaase isa soo taraya, iyadoo walaac laga muujinayo in iskahorimaad kasta oo cusub uu sii kordhin karo khatarta amniga gobolka iyo isu socodka hawada.

Aqoonsigu ma aha guusha xisbi siyaasadeed, xukuumad gaar ah, ama qof keliya.
items.description: “Maanta Somaliland waxay taagan tahay marxalad taariikhi ah oo dunidu si dhow ula socoto. Indhaha beesha caalamka waxay ku soo jeedaan dalkeenna, iyadoo ay socdaan dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu xoojinayo xidhiidhka caalamiga ah iyo himilada aqoonsiga. Aqoonsigu ma aha guusha xisbi siyaasadeed, xukuumad gaar ah, ama qof keliya. Waa himilo qaran oo ay wada leeyihiin dhammaan shacabka Somaliland, kana sarreysa kala aragti duwanaanta siyaasadeed. Sidaa darteed, waxaan ugu baaqayaa dhammaan muwaadiniinta, siyaasiyiinta, aqoonyahannada, dhallinyarada, haweenka iyo qurba-joogta inay garab istaagaan dedaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee ay hoggaaminayso Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, isla markaana laga fogaado hadallo ama falal arrintan qaran lagu siyaasadeynayo ama lagu kala qaybsamayo. Marka ummaddu mideysan tahay, codkeeduna mideysan yahay, waxay dunida u diraysaa farriin cad oo muujinaysa bisayl siyaasadeed, kalsooni iyo diyaar-garow dawladnimo. Midnimada shacabka ayaa ah awoodda ugu weyn ee lagu kasban karo saaxiibtinimada iyo kalsoonida caalamka. Aan xusuusnaanno in taariikhdu ay xilliyadan oo kale qorto jiilalka doortay inay qarankooda ka hormariyaan danaha gaarka ah. Aynu noqonno hal cod, hal ujeeddo, iyo hal himilo—taas oo ah in Somaliland hesho aqoonsiga caalamiga ah ee ay mudan tahay. Qaran mideysan ayaa dunida ka dhaadhicin kara xaqa uu leeyahay.” Mohamed Ali (Obama)

items.title: Foreign Delegations Converge on Tehran for Historic State Funeral of Iran’s Supreme Leader
items.description: Tehran (WDN) – Foreign delegations from across Asia and the Middle East continue to arrive in Tehran as Iran prepares for one of the largest state funerals in the history of the Islamic Republic following the death of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. The funeral ceremonies, which form part of a week-long national mourning program, have drawn senior political leaders and government representatives from numerous countries, reflecting Khamenei’s influence across the region during his nearly four decades as Iran’s highest political and religious authority. Among the first high-profile visitors to arrive was Pakistan’s Interior Minister Mohsen Naqvi, accompanied by an official Pakistani delegation. Additional Pakistani leaders, including Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, are also expected to participate in the state funeral. Afghanistan’s Taliban-led government is represented by a delegation headed by Foreign Minister Amir Khan Muttaqi, while China has dispatched a senior delegation led by He Wei, Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People’s Congress. The Chinese delegation was formally received by senior Iranian parliamentary officials upon its arrival in Tehran. ( Reuters ) Delegations from Turkmenistan, Armenia, and several other countries have also reached the Iranian capital, where they are expected to join Iranian leaders, religious scholars, and millions of mourners for the official farewell ceremonies. Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, who died at the age of 86, was killed during the opening phase of the U.S.-Israeli military campaign against Iran in February 2026, according to Iranian authorities and international media reports. His death marked a defining moment in the conflict and ended a 37-year tenure as Iran’s Supreme Leader and Commander-in-Chief of the country’s armed forces. Iranian authorities have described the funeral as a national moment of mourning and unity, with ceremonies scheduled across multiple cities before Khamenei is laid to rest in his hometown of Mashhad. Massive crowds are expected to participate in what is anticipated to be one of the largest public gatherings in the country’s modern history. items.title: Sawirro: Sacuudiga oo si heer sare ah looga maamuusay maalinta qarannimada Somalia
items.description: Riyaad (Caasimada Online) – Safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Boqortooyada Sacuudiga ayaa lagu qabtay munaasabad si heer sare ah loogu maamuusayay 66-guuradii ka soo wareegtay markii gobollada koonfureed ay xornimada ka qaateen gumeystihii Talyaaniga iyo midowgii labada gobol. Munaasabadda waxaa ka soo qeyb-galay Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee Boqortooyada Sacuudiga, Maxamed Amiin Sheekh Cusmaan iyo xubno ka tirsan Safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Riyaad. Sidoo kale, waxaa munaasabadda si rasmi ah ugu soo dhoweeyey Wakiilka Boqortooyada Sacuudiga, ahna Duqa Magaalada Riyaad, Amiir Faysal bin Cabdulcasiis bin Cayaaf. Waxaa sidoo kale ka soo qeyb-galay Agaasimaha Guud ee Waaxda Diblomaasiyiinta ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Boqortooyada Sacuudiga iyo masuuliyiin kale oo ka tirsan dowladda Sacuudiga. items.title: Wasiir Jaamac oo Turkiga ku saxiixay laba heshiis oo taariikhi ah
items.description: Istanbul (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Dekadaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda ee Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u saxiixay laba heshiis oo taariikhi ah, kuwaas oo la xiriira iskaashiga tacliinta sare iyo horumarinta sharciga baddaha. Heshiisyadan ayaa lala galay Jaamacadda caanka ah ee Piri Reis iyo xarunta cilmi-baarista sharciga baddaha ee DEHUKAM oo laga leeyahay dalka Turkiga. Heshiisyadan saameynta weyn leh ayaa u kala baxa laba qaybood oo muhiim u ah mustaqbalka baddaha Soomaaliya: 1. Horumarinta tacliinta iyo tababarrada baddaha (Jaamacadda Piri Reis): Ujeeddada ugu weyn ee heshiiskan iskaashi ayaa ah in la xoojiyo tayada tacliinta sare ee la xiriirta culuumta baddaha Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale heshiiskani wuxuu siinayaa shaqaalaha wasaaradda dekadaha iyo howl-wadeennada kala duwan ee dekadaha dalka fursad ay ku helaan waxbarasho iyo tababarro heer sare ah oo ay bixiso Jaamacadda Piri Reis oo ku xeeldheer arrimaha baddaha. 2. Xoojinta sharciga iyo nidaamka maamulka baddaha (xarunta DEHUKAM): Wasaaradda ayaa sidoo kale heshiis weyn la gashay xarunta qaanuunka baddaha ee DEHUKAM, kaas oo diiradda lagu saarayo dhanka sharciga iyo talo-bixinta oggolaanshaha baddaha. Xarunta DEHUKAM waxay wasaaradda ka taageeri doontaa dib-u-eegista, horumarinta, iyo talo-bixinta dhanka sharciyada khuseeya arrimaha baddaha Soomaaliya. Heshiisyadan maanta la saxiixay ayay wasaaraddu sheegtay inay bud-dhig u yihiin dhisidda aqoonta iyo sharciga baddaha Soomaaliya, isla markaana ay dhabaha u xaarayaan inaan yeelanno shaqaale xirfad leh iyo nidaam sharciyeed oo adag oo ilaalinaya khayraadka iyo maamulka baddayada.” Si kastaba, labada heshiis ee maanta la saxiixay ayaa calaamad u ah xiriirka qotada dheer ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, gaar ahaan dhinaca horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha iyo dhisidda awoodda hay’addaha dowladda. items.title: New Report: Al Shabaab’s narratives of humanitarian aid
items.description: For two decades, Al-Shabaab has defined itself against the international system: its laws, its institutions, and its claim to decide who governs Somali territory. Humanitarian aid sits at the centre of that contest. In the group’s telling, foreign assistance is “empty wind” full of promises, hollow in delivery, and part of a long project of foreign domination. Drawing on a database of more than 50,000 primary Al-Shabaab media sources produced between 2016 and 2026, this report reconstructs — on its own terms, and for the first time at this level of detail — how the movement talks about aid, what it tells its supporters, and why that message resonates well beyond its ideological core. Al-Shabaab’s position rests on three interlocking arguments: A theological claim. Grounded in the doctrines of loyalty and disavowal ( al-wala’ wal-bara’ ) and divine sovereignty ( hakimiyyah ), Al-Shabaab classifies Western humanitarian actors as unbelievers regardless of their conduct, foreclosing neutrality before any specific action is even judged. An empirical indictment. The group marshals real, well-documented failures; diversion, corruption, aid captured by dominant clans, the exclusion of minority communities, many of them acknowledged in the humanitarian system’s own evaluations, and reframes them as proof of a hostile foreign project. A strategic theory. Aid is cast as the opening wave of intervention, folded into a 600-year story of Somali resistance to foreign intrusion. Crucially, Al-Shabaab does not simply reject relief. It has built a parallel humanitarian system: a Zakat Office, drought and flood committees, and the Al-Ihsan Foundation that it presents as a religious obligation and as visible proof of its capacity to govern. Yet in practice it still tolerates outside assistance where its own capacity falls short, an accommodation it frames as strictly transitional and conditional. For humanitarian actors, misreading this narrative carries real operational and human costs. Understanding it is a precondition for reaching populations in areas under Al-Shabaab control, and it points to an underused opening: the group’s framing of relief as a duty of Islamic governance overlaps with the obligations international humanitarian law places on any authority controlling civilians. The report is descriptive, not prescriptive. Reading Al-Shabaab carefully is not the same as agreeing with it but it is the foundation on which any serious engagement must rest. Hiraal Institute.

items.title: Female Vox-Pop Reporter Suweys Gacayte Arrested in Garowe on 2 July 2026
items.description: GAROWE, Puntland – Suweys Gacayte, a reporter with Suweys Media, was arrested in Garowe on 2 July 2026 and transferred to Garowe Central Prison. Suweys Media is a social-media platform known for conducting vox-pop street interviews that capture the concerns, experiences and opinions of ordinary residents in Garowe. Following her detention, journalists in Garowe gathered and called for her immediate release. They expressed concern that no charges, court order or clear legal justification for her detention had been publicly disclosed. In a statement, the Media Association of Puntland (MAP) said it was deeply concerned by the increasing targeting of media professionals. MAP stated that information gathered through its contacts indicated that Gacayte’s detention had not followed proper legal procedures. The association warned against the misuse of state authority to intimidate journalists and urged Puntland institutions to respect the Constitution, the Puntland Media Law and fundamental rights. It demanded Gacayte’s immediate and unconditional release, or, should formal allegations exist, that she be brought before a competent court with all legally guaranteed rights respected. MAP also noted that her detention followed the June arrest of journalist Mohamed Abdinasir in Qardho, describing both cases as part of a concerning pattern. Gacayte had previously faced official pressure. According to media-freedom monitoring records from NUSOJ, she was summoned by the Puntland Attorney General’s Office in September 2025, although she was not detained at that time. Her latest arrest has renewed concerns about press freedom in Puntland, particularly for young women journalists and independent social-media reporters working outside traditional newsrooms. Puntland authorities had not issued a detailed public statement explaining the reasons for her arrest at the time of publication. items.title: Trump: “Somalians are Garbage”
items.description: By Adan Makina Currently, there is a political fracas going on in the United States after P resident Donald Trump described the American Somali community in the US as garbage. While there are millions of illegal immigrants in the US, his hate for the Somali community has reached alarming proportions and it all evolved after Ilhan Omar exchanged verbal political differences in words and not in deeds. A female Somali in the US House of Representatives, Ilhan Omar who is a Democrat, is regarded an outspoken opposition member since she is opposed to the president’s Republican Party that is known for distancing itself from immigrants who are not White, Trump felt it was beyond his dignity to be challenged by a Black, African female Somali Muslim. Even though Somalis in the US have made great leaps and bounds in the transportation industry especially heavy trucks that are responsible for the hauling of vital heavy delivery goods within the US, Canada, and Alaska, and the fastest money remittances across the globe, and also in the housing industry and the operations of malls and shops within Minesota and other states, in the medical and education fields, the taxi industry, and the operations of wholesale goods, Trump’s attempts to alienate the Somali community could have severe ramifications if drastic measures are not made to stabilize the current political stalemate. Somalis’ adherence to Islam enabled them to have mosques across the United States and to as far as Canada and Alaska in the Arctic and since Trump has a great hatred for Islam, he is opposed to Americans reverting to Islam at alarming proportions. Trump’s attempts to distance himself with Islam and Somalis will eventually have severe repercussions because, it contravenes the American constitution that guarantees freedom of religion and speech. It has already been prognosticated by political and religious analysts that by 2050, the global population of Muslims and Christians will be equal and by 2070, Islam will take over as the religion with the largest followers and by 2090, Arabic will be the global language tossing aside English and French that have domineered the world for centuries. Unfortunately, many of us may not live to see it.  Going back to history and benefiting from the adage “we remember the past in order to make the present tolerable and the future worth waiting for” requires thorough historical exegesis for modern leaders especially President Donald Trump who appears to be on the wrong path when it comes to crucial governance that requires global political equality, embracing human rights, and general economic facilitations. From historical perspective, the world had seen the rise and fall of empires including Christian and Muslim empires and others. The Rise and Fall of the Roman Empire is a fascinating magnus opus that was authored by the famous English man Edward Gibbon. Starting as a Republic in c. 509 BCE then transforming into an empire in 27 BCE, in the end, it transformed into a historical empire in 117 CE under emperor Trajan when it crossed Europe, North Africa, and the Middle East. However, since that has a beginning has an end, invasions from the Goths and Vandals who were Germanic, sacked Rome several times until Romulus Augustulus was deposed in 476 CE. Even though the Byzantine Empire survived for a thousand years, in the end, the Roman Empire that rose from scratch as a city/state suddenly collapsed in 1453 CE when the famous city of Constantinople fell to its toes. The names Byzantine or Byzantium arose from a small port on the Sea of Marmara on the northern side that was known as Byzantion in classical antiquity. Currently, it is the City of Istanbul. Instead of looking at the political, social, and economic state of his own country that is already showing signs of societal breakdown, the President of the United States appears not being up to task to restore his nation’s sovereignty internally and globally. While Trump’s comments about Somalis sparked controversies across the globe, even prominent Catholic bishops in the US did not shy away from giving their points of views. Even though he did not name Trump, Bishop Daniel Garcia of Austin, Texas felt it was dehumanizing to pick on specific people, perhaps in reference to Somalis. In his statement, Garcia was reported to have said, “As Catholics, we believe that every person is beloved by God…” He continued by saying “language that denigrates a person or community based on his or her ethnicity or country of origin is incompatible with this truth…” [1] The world reknown Muslim Imam and theologically-driven activist for human rights, Omar Suleiman, writing about Somalis, at first reminded the readers of the online magazine how Trump described African nations as “s-hole countries” and then further exposed how Somalis arrived the United States as refugees to “become the most civically engaged and socially productive Muslim communities in the country.” [2] It is a well-known and documented factor that Somalis contributed immensely to the economy of the United States especially to the State of Minnesota. According to Imam Omar Suleiman “Somali Minnesotans generate some $500 million in income annually and pay close to $67 million in state and local taxes every year, with an estimated $8 billion overall impact on the state’s economy.” While it is legally acceptable as per the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) adopted by the General Assembly of the United Nations on December 10, 1948 to extend a helping hand to refugees, asylees, and immigrants seeking safety in any country, the Republican Party under Trump seems to have negative views about foreigners who are not White. Prior to Trump hurling epithets at Somalis living in the US and those residing in Somalia, Mexicans and Haitians got their share of derogatory insults. His hatred for specific people, their countries, and leaders appear to be emerging by the day. It was during a cabinet meeting on December 2, 2025 when Donald Trump referred to Somalis as “garbage”. Synonymously equivalent in meaning to rubbish waste or garbage, it could also could be translated to mean worthless or meaningless, rubbish, nonsense or balderdash. It also means gobbledygook, hogwash, hooey, malarkey, poppycock and phooey.  In reference to Somalis, Trump was reported to have said “we are going to go the wrong way if we keep taking in garbage into our country.” His use of the “go back” rhetoric was aimed at urging Somalis to “go back from where they came from and fix it.” His remarks have been condemned by civil rights groups, Democratic lawmakers, and community leaders as “racist” and “dangerous”. His “go back’ rhetoric and ‘garbage” remarks appeared apprehensively palpable to most Somalis, especially those living in Cedar-Riverside that is known as Little Mogadishu for its large Somali population. [3] Despite having citizenship for decades, Somalis who get caught up in the cleansing by ICE are those who don’t speak English well. Trump’s disparaging comments about Somalis could be a harbinger for radicalization. The deriding public remarks of Donald Trump has been challenged by Somalis and advocacy groups who have joined hands to overcome the unconstitutional impositions on Somalis by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security’s decision to end providing Temporary Protected Status to Somalis. [4] Another high-profile US-born figure of theological repute who was insulted by President Trump in mid-2026 is Pope Leo XIV. Referring to him as “weak on crime” and “terrible for foreign policy”, Muslims across the world felt perturbed and flabbergasted at such castigations at the head of Catholicism such that, even Somali Congresswoman Ilhan Omar came to the rescue of the Pope in a public address. Skeptical of Trump’s Christian faith, she also castigated Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth “who stated that the Pope had no place to lead the Catholic Church due to his unfitness to serve as its spiritual leader.” [5] Another insult to Somalis by Trump was the US denial to allow Somali international FIFA referee Omar Artan the right to enter the United States–an act that infuriated global lovers of sports. American leaders’ denigration of the Pope has already caused uproar among the followers of Catholicism and Christian sects together with Muslims who consider Christians as the “nearest in friendship to the believers” as stated in the Qur’an even though they are a specific sect of Christianity. What turned the tables upside down for Trump and Hegseth is the Pope’s opposition to the US invasion of Iran and the stringent immigratory measures on Somalis and other people seeking protection against wars ignited by the United States and its allies. Because of national interest, using direct interventions or proxy wars by the United States and her allies in peaceful lands has been the major cause of the flow of refugees and immigrants across the world. Even though Trump perceives Iran as an enemy, there are millions of Americans living in the Middle East and the income they make and the peace they enjoy is far much better than what they would get in their states of origin. Prior to the 1979 Islamic revolution that toppled the Shah, approximately 40,000 Americans lived in Iran and they were mostly composed of oil industry workers, engineers, military advisors, teachers, and missionaries. They were mostly attracted to the country by Iran’s rapid modernization and lucrative petroleum sector. At the present time, known as Iranian-Americans or Persian-Americans, America is home to about 600,000 Diaspora Iranians. The Trump administration has caused immense sufferings to billions in the world and that is because, working in cahoots with corrupt foreign leaders from poor countries help America achieve its major aims and objectives of gaining what it wants most. The Temporary Protected Status for Somalis was expected to end on March 17, 2026. In scholarly and academic studies, the negative utterances of Trump are considered as generalization. Even the use of “third world countries” by some of the press and other media houses appear out of context for the era of “first world”, “second world”, and “third world” have been replaced by Global North and Global South. While Trump’s derogatory remarks have been supported by those close to him, majority of Americans who disagree with him on many political issues, seem to be in support of Somalis. The president appears to be against the massive influx of refugees fleeing civil wars mostly from Africa especially the citizens of Somalia and other countries who have been regarded persona non grata in the US. While the Temporary Protected Status (TPS) has been there for some time under the leaderships of Democratic and Republican leaders of the US, under Trump, it could be completely cancelled for good to dissuade further movement of immigrants to the US. While past leaders have been fearful of immigrants from Latin American countries especially Mexico leading to the construction of a massive wall in the southern US border especially in the State of Texas, the current stalemate between Trump and Ilhan has caused immense fear among the Somali community that is concentrated in the State of Minnesota. A recent and shocking revelation seems to be coming from a group of African leaders who convened to oppose American involvement in their affairs militarily and economically. With America being thrown to the dogs, it appears that China is filling the vacuum. Most of these African leaders oppose loud and clear regarding US interference in all aspects. Trump’s desire to control Africa appears to be breaking down since Africa has chosen to take a different way and that is Africa is not willing to withstand American influence of all sorts regardless of whether it is economic, industrial or military cooperation. African leaders have chosen economic independence, control over their resources, moving away from dependency towards self-sufficiency, overcoming neocolonialism, and systematic policy reforms. Unlike China that is for economic emancipation to develop the African continent, the US under Trump appears to be suffering backlashes from major African societies. African nations like Algeria, Egypt, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa, Senegal, Uganda, Ethiopia, Nigeria, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Morocco, and others have chosen to turn down every American deal that has been defined as a form of neocolonialism. Refusing visas to Africans is another factor that is causing alarm among many African nations. The assumption that only Americans are responsible for moving America to a forward progress are pathological lies. The best students in American colleges and universities are Africans as claimed by an American press recently. Nigerians alone can be found in the colleges and universities of America’s fifty states and one territory. There are five permanently inhabited American territories with Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands located in the Carribean and American Samoa, Guam, and the Northern Mariana Islands considered Pacific Territories. South Africans have voted for their country to be part and parcel of the BRICS nations. With America losing credibility in Africa, what could be expected is economic strangulation for the United States and accelerated economic growth for Africa, China, and Russia together with others like Taiwan, Japan, Indonesia, Singapore, India, Pakistan, Malaysia, and Taiwan. While the world has seen the demise of Pax Romana and Pax Britannica, in the meantime, what is to be expected is the collapse of Pax Americana. Some theological analysts are of the view that President Donald Trump is a God-sent man whose mission is to destroy America’s past greatness militarily, socially, politically, and economically. From general perspective, America is no longer the sole superpower because China has already taken over as the number one leader in political, social, economic, and military global leadership with the US falling to the second slot followed by Russia and Iran that is considered an emerging superpower. With America expected to withdraw from the Persian Gulf especially the Strait of Hormuz, obviously, the entire world will be overtaken by celebratory mood. Abandoned by her NATO allies and other foreign forces that were in support of America for many years, America is no longer a superpower to be counted on. While there are millions of illegal immigrants in the US, his hate for the Somali community has reached alarming proportions and it all evolved after Ilhan Omar exchanged verbal political differences in words and not in deeds. A female Somali in the US House of Representatives, Ilhan Omar who is a Democrat, is regarded an outspoken opposition member since she is opposed to the president’s Republican Party that is known for distancing itself from immigrants who are not White, Trump felt it was beyond his dignity to be challenged by a Black, African female Somali Muslim. Somalis’ adherence to Islam enabled them to have mosques across the United States and to as far as Canada and Alaska in the Arctic and since Trump has a great hatred for Islam, he is opposed to Americans reverting to Islam at alarming proportions. Trump’s attempts to distance himself with Islam and Somalis will eventually have severe repercussions because, it contravenes the American constitution that guarantees freedom of religion and speech. From historical perspective, the world had seen the rise and fall of empires including Christian and Muslim empires and others. The Rise and Fall of the Roman Empire is a fascinating magnus opus that was authored by the famous English man Edward Gibbon. Starting as a Republic in c. 509 BCE then transforming into an empire in 27 BCE, in the end, it transformed into a historical empire in 117 CE under emperor Trajan when it crossed Europe, North Africa, and the Middle East. However, since that has a beginning has an end, invasions from the Goths and Vandals who were Germanic, sacked Rome several times until Romulus Augustulus was deposed in 476 CE. Even though the Byzantine Empire survived for a thousand years, in the end, the Roman Empire that rose from scratch as a city/state suddenly collapsed in 1453 CE when the famous city of Constantinople fell to its toes. The names Byzantine or Byzantium arose from a small port on the Sea of Marmara on the northern side that was known as Byzantion in classical antiquity. Currently, it is the City of Istanbul. items.title: Midowga Afrika oo kulan degdeg ah isugu yeeray kadib go’aanka Mareykanka ee Somalia
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Midowga Afrika ayaa kulan degdeg ah isugu yeeray la-taliyeyaasha militariga iyo difaaca ee dalalka xubnaha ka ah Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka (PSC) kadib markii Mareykanka uu ku dhawaaqay inuu joojinayo kaalmada amni ee Soomaaliya. Qoraal rasmi ah oo kasoo baxay Guddiga Midowga Afrika ayaa lagu sheegay in ergada Mareykanka ee Midowga Afrika ay 1-da Luulyo 2026 gudbisay qoraal diblomaasiyadeed (Note Verbale 118-26), kaas oo lagu caddeeyay go’aanka Washington ee ah in aan la taageeri doonin sii wadista UNSOS wixii ka dambeeya dhammaadka sanadkan. Guddiga Midowga Afrika ayaa sheegay in go’aanka Mareykanka uu yeelanayo saameyn weyn oo ku saabsan saadka, maalgelinta iyo awoodda howlgal ee hawlgalka taageerada iyo xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), maadaama xafiiska taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya (UNSOS) uu door muhiim ah ku leeyahay taageerada ciidamada howlgalka. Sida lagu sheegay warqadda, Midowga Afrika wuxuu bilaabay qorshe-hawleed degdeg ah oo lagu qiimeynayo cawaaqibka ka dhalan kara go’aanka Mareykanka, isla markaana lagu dejinayo tallaabooyin lagu xaqiijinayo sii socoshada howlgalka AUSSOM iyo ka hortagga carqalad kasta oo amni. Kulanka degdegga ah oo ka dhacaya xarunta Julius Nyerere ee magaalada Addis Ababa ayaa looga tashanaya saameynta go’aanka Mareykanka, tallaabooyinka xiga iyo jadwalka fulinta qorshayaasha. Midowga Afrika ayaa sidoo kale farriin u diray safaaradaha dalalka xubnaha ka ah Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka oo ay Soomaaliya ku jirto iyo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Itoobiya, isagoo adkeeyay muhiimadda iskaashi iyo wadatashi degdeg ah oo ku aaddan mustaqbalka howlgalka AUSSOM. Go’aanka Mareykanka ayaa imanaya xilli Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika ay dadaal ugu jiraan sii wadista howlgalka AUSSOM iyo taageerada caalamiga ah ee lagu xoojinayo dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, iyadoo tallaabada Washington ay abuurtay walaac ku saabsan maalgelinta iyo joogteynta howlgalka ciidamada Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya. items.title: An arrest that raised more questions than answers
items.description: Garrowe – (WDN ) – In the early hours of the morning, police in Garowe detained Suweys Jama Mahmoud Gacayte, a well-known Puntland journalist whose reporting has largely focused on public opinion, social issues, and entertainment. According to local sources, officers from the Puntland Police Force arrived at her residence in Garowe and took her into custody. By Wednesday evening, authorities had still not publicly disclosed the reason for her arrest, fueling speculation and concern among journalists and civil society groups across Puntland. Suweys Jama Gacayte’s detention quickly triggered a wave of condemnation from media professionals, many of whom described the arrest as alarming given the absence of any official explanation. Colleagues say she is widely recognized for giving ordinary citizens a platform to express their views and for covering issues that resonate with the public. A Broader Crackdown? The arrest comes amid a broader tightening of political controls in Puntland. In a separate development, the administration of Mudug Region announced a ban on political meetings and gatherings held without prior government authorization. In a directive issued by Mudug Governor Abdiweli Jibril Bayle, security agencies and district authorities were ordered to prevent any unauthorized political meetings from taking place in hotels, conference halls, or other venues. “The regional police commander, the intelligence chief, and district commissioners are instructed that no political meetings may be held in hotels or elsewhere without permission from the Mudug regional administration,” the governor said in the order. Hotel owners and managers of conference facilities were also warned not to host political gatherings unless organizers obtained formal approval from the authorities. The administration said legal action would be taken against anyone who violates the directive. A Pattern Emerging The measures have drawn attention because they follow a similar decision recently imposed in Karkaar Region, where the Puntland government also restricted political meetings that had not been cleared by the authorities. Coming just days after those restrictions, the unexplained arrest of a prominent journalist has intensified debate over whether Puntland is entering a new phase of heightened political control. For now, one question hangs over Garowe: Why was Suweys Gacayte arrested? Until authorities provide an answer, the mystery surrounding her detention is likely to deepen scrutiny of Puntland’s recent security and political measures. items.title: Somalia’s Leaders Trade Sharp Blows as Rift with Puntland Deepens
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Somalia’s political crisis escalated on Wednesday as Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre and President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud launched blistering attacks on Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni, further widening the rift between Mogadishu and the semi-autonomous federal state. Speaking at an event in Mogadishu on Tuesday night, Prime Minister Hamza fired back at remarks made by President Deni on July 1, declaring that he—not Deni—represents the people of Puntland within the Federal Government. Hamza argued that Puntland had long been denied its fair share of representation in Somalia’s national armed forces and vowed to address what he described as a longstanding imbalance. “We are recruiting 30,000 soldiers from Puntland. I represent them. Whether you like it or burst with anger, that’s the reality,” the Prime Minister declared in a direct jab at Deni. He further claimed that under the new recruitment drive, Puntland would receive a significant share of positions in the Somali National Army, saying that for every three soldiers recruited, two would come from Puntland. The Prime Minister’s remarks came in response to Deni’s Independence Day speech, in which the Puntland leader dismissed Hamza as “Hassan’s boy” and accused President Hassan Sheikh of using him to portray Puntland and Jubaland as greater obstacles to Somalia’s unity than Somaliland. Hours later, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud also used his address at the closing ceremony of Somalia’s Independence Week celebrations to reject Deni’s accusations that the Federal Government was attempting to destabilize Puntland. “It is false to claim that the Federal Government is creating unrest in Puntland,” Hassan said. “We have been paying the salaries of some Puntland-registered soldiers for nearly a year. If our intention was to provoke conflict, why didn’t those forces rebel during all that time? These allegations have no basis in fact.” The President also blamed Deni for the complete breakdown in relations between Mogadishu and Puntland. “There is currently no relationship between the Federal Government and Puntland. It was Said Deni who severed Puntland’s ties with Somalia,” Hassan declared. The exchange marks one of the fiercest public confrontations yet between Somalia’s federal leadership and Puntland’s administration, underscoring the growing political polarization ahead of key electoral and constitutional milestones. With both sides hardening their rhetoric and trading accusations in public, prospects for dialogue appear increasingly remote, raising fresh concerns about the future of Somalia’s fragile federal system. items.title: Jubaland President Ahmed Madobe Meets Prominent Traditional Leader to Promote Unity and National Reconciliation
items.description: Nairobi (WDN) – Jubaland President Ahmed Mohamed Islam (Ahmed Madobe) has held a high-level meeting with Sultan Said Mohamed Garaase, one of Somalia’s most respected traditional leaders from Puntland, in a move widely seen as reinforcing the vital role of traditional elders in fostering national unity and reconciliation. Reports about the meeting indicated that, it focused on Somalia’s evolving political landscape and the indispensable contribution of traditional leaders in promoting peace, strengthening social cohesion, and safeguarding the country’s federal system. Recently Puntland and Villa Somalia have drifted further apart politically, and tensions deepened between the two sides. Puntland has faced what it describes as a sustained political offensive by the Federal Government, which it accuses of using Puntland politicians opposed to President Said Abdullahi Deni to undermine the regional administration and expand Mogadishu’s influence. In a statement released by the Jubaland Presidency on Wednesday evening, officials described the discussions between President MAdoobe and Sultan Garaaseas “productive and constructive,” emphasizing the shared commitment of both leaders to advancing peace and preserving Somalia’s unity during a critical period in the nation’s political development. “The President of the Jubaland State, Mr. Ahmed Mohamed Islam, held a fruitful meeting with Sultan Said Mohamed Garaase, one of Somalia’s distinguished traditional leaders,” the statement said. According to the presidency, the discussions centered on the overall situation in Somalia, the historic role of traditional elders in conflict resolution, and strategies to reinforce national solidarity and strengthen bonds among Somali communities. Both sides underscored the enduring importance of Somalia’s traditional leadership institutions, which have long served as trusted mediators during times of political tension and have played a pivotal role in preserving dialogue between communities and government leaders alike. Sultan Garaase is among Somalia’s most influential traditional elders. He was one of the 135 traditional leaders entrusted with endorsing members of Somalia’s Federal Parliament during the country’s indirect electoral process, reflecting the central role elders continue to play in Somalia’s governance and state-building efforts. One of the parliamentary seats he traditionally endorsed is currently allocated to Jubaland. The meeting comes at a time when Somalia is navigating complex political challenges, making engagement between elected leaders and respected traditional authorities increasingly significant. Analysts say such consultations can help build consensus, reduce political tensions, and create space for dialogue at a time when cooperation among Somalia’s political stakeholders is essential. For Jubaland, the engagement also highlights the administration’s continued emphasis on consultation, inclusivity, and the belief that sustainable peace and national stability are best achieved through dialogue that brings together political leaders, traditional elders, and the wider Somali community. items.title: Somaliland waa qaran, ma aha arrin uun lagu gorgortamo
items.description: Shacabkii Imaraadka Carabta oo Somaliland ka difaacaya Carabtii Kale, ​Aqoonyahanka iyo falanqeeyaha reer Imaaraad (UAE), Hind Al-Dhahiri ayaa sheegtay inay Jiraan Dalal adeegsanaya magaca taageerada Falastiin si ay Somaliland ugu hayaan go’doon, kuwaas oo ay dhab ahaantii ujeedadoodu tahay danaysi siyaasadeed iyo diin-ku-ganacsi. ​Al-Dhahiri ayaa hoosta ka xariiqday in isku-dayada lagu cabudhinayo Somaliland ay salka ku hayaan damac ku aaddan xakameynta iyo bililiqaysiga hantida marinnada muhiimka ah ee Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Waxay tidhi Sidan “Kuwa dadka kale ku shaabadeeya ‘Zionist’ (Sahyuuni) waa isla xoogagga quusashada taagan ee doonaya inay Somaliland ku hayaan meel go’doon ah oo xidhan”. “Somaliland waa qaran, ma aha arrin uun lagu gorgortamo” Maalmahan danbe soo kordhaysay taageerada aqoonyahanka iyo dadka saamaynta ku leh dalka Imaaradka Carabta UAE, ay u muujinayaan qaddiyadda madax-bannaanida Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland,

items.title: Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka ee Midowga Afrika oo kulan Degdeg ah ka yeelanaya go’aanka Mareykanka ee AUSSOM
items.description: Guddiga Midowga Afrika (AUC) ayaa isugu yeeray kulan degdeg ah oo ay yeelanayaan la-taliyeyaasha militariga iyo difaaca ee dalalka xubnaha ka ah Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka (PSC), kadib markii Mareykanku si rasmi ah u sheegay inuusan sii taageeri doonin Hawlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM) wixii ka dambeeya 31-ka Diseembar 2026. Warqad rasmi ah oo kasoo baxday Midowga Afrika ayaa sheegtay in Ergada Mareykanka u qaabilsan Midowga Afrika ay 1-dii Luulyo 2026 gudbisay ogeysiis rasmi ah oo lagu caddeeyay in Washington aysan taageeri doonin sii socoshada Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya (UNSOS) ee adeegyada siiya AUSSOM marka uu dhammaado oggolaanshaha hadda jira. Midowga Afrika ayaa ka digay in go’aankan uu saameyn weyn ku yeelan karo joogtaynta saadka, awoodda hawlgallada iyo maalgelinta howlgalka AUSSOM ee Soomaaliya. Si arrintan looga tashado, Guddiga Midowga Afrika ayaa qabanaya kulan degdeg ah oo ka dhacaya xarunta Julius Nyerere Building ee magaalada Addis Ababa, maanta oo Jimce ah, 3-da Luulyo 2026, halkaas oo lagu falanqeyn doono saameynta go’aanka Mareykanka iyo tallaabooyinka xiga ee la qaadi karo. Kulanka waxaa lagu casuumay xubnaha Guddiga Shaqaalaha Militariga (Military Staff Committee) ee dalalka xubnaha ka ah Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka, kuwaas oo ay ku jirto Soomaaliya. Go’aankan Mareykanka ayaa imanaya xilli AUSSOM ay wajahaysay caqabado dhinaca maalgelinta ah, waxaana uu sare u qaadayaa walaaca ku saabsan sida loo sii wadi karo howlgalka taageeraya ciidamada amniga Soomaaliya haddii aan la helin ilo dhaqaale oo beddela taageerada Mareykanka.

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo caddeeyay arrin muhiim ah oo ku saabsan xiriirka Somaliland iyo Israel
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si cad u sheegtay in Dowladda Federaalka ay ka soo horjeedo xiriir kasta oo diblomaasiyadeed oo dhex mara maamulka Somaliland iyo Israa’iil. Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa adkeeyay in arrimaha siyaasadda dibadda ay yihiin awood dastuuri ah oo u gaar ah Dowladda Federaalka, isagoo caddeeyay in Soomaaliya aysan aqbali doonin wax kasta oo uu ku tilmaamay fara-gelin dibadeed oo lagu sameeyo qaranimada iyo midnimadeeda dhuleed. Xasan Sheekh ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ka go’an tahay difaaca midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale wuxuu sheegay in Israa’iil aysan “meel ku lahayn geyiga Soomaaliyeed,” isagoo shacabka Soomaaliyeed ugu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan taageeridda tallaabo kasta oo uu sheegay inay ka hor imaaneyso mowqifka rasmiga ah ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale dib u xaqiijiyay in Somaliland ay weli tahay qayb ka mid ah Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, isagoo xusay in go’aannada la xiriira aqoonsiga dowladaha iyo maamulka xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ay yihiin awood u gaar ah dowladda dhexe. Sidoo kale, Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka ay aaminsan tahay in wada-hadalku yahay waddada ugu habboon ee lagu xallin karo arrimaha u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Hargeysa. Wuxuu ku baaqay in dib loo bilaabo wada-hadallo miro-dhal ah oo lagu xoojinayo midnimada iyo wadajirka shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Madaxweynaha ayaa intaas ku daray in Soomaaliya ay soo martay marxalado adag oo ay ka mid yihiin kala qeybsanaan siyaasadeed iyo amni darro, balse loo baahan yahay aragti mideysan iyo wadajir si looga gudbo caqabadaha horyaalla dalka, loona dardar-geliyo dowlad-dhiska iyo horumarka. Ugu dambeyn, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa shacabka Soomaaliyeed ugu baaqay inay ilaashadaan midnimada iyo wadajirka dalka, isagoo caddeeyay in Dowladda Federaalka ay sii wadi doonto dadaallada lagu xoojinayo hay’adaha dowladda, difaaca madax-bannaanida dalka iyo ilaalinta qaranimada Soomaaliya. Hadalka Madaxweynaha ayaa imanaya xilli ay taagan tahay xiisad xooggan oo ka dhalatay xiriirka Somaliland iyo Israa’iil, taas oo kasii dartay markii maamulka Somaliland uu sheegay inuu safaarad ka furtay Qudus, tallaabadaas oo si adag horyimaadeen dowladda Soomaaliya iyo waddamada Muslimka. items.title: Imaamkii beesha Mudulood oo ku geeriyooday Hindiya iyo madaxweyne Xasan oo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Allaha u naxariistee Imaam Maxamed Yuusuf Cali oo ka mid ahaa dhaqanka Soomaliyeed kuwooda ugu waaweyn ayaa ku geeriyooday dalka Hindiya, halkaas oo muddooyinkii dambe lagu dabiibayay xaaladdiisa caafimaad. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa tacsi tiiraanyo leh u diray qoyska, ehelada iyo guud ahaan ummadda Soomaaliyeed, geerida naxdinta leh ee ku timid Imaam Maxamed Yuusuf Cali oo ahaa Imaamkii beesha Mudulood. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in geerida Imaamka ay tahay mid murugo leh, isla markaana si weyn u taabatay bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, waxa uu ku tilmaamay Imaamka haldoor qaran oo door muuqda ka soo qaatay geeddi-socodkii nabadeynta dalka, isagoo sheegay in Imaamku kaalin muhiim ah ka qaatay dadaalladii dib-u-heshiisiinta bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ayaa xusay in Marxuumku uu si weyn uga shaqeeyay xoojinta midnimada iyo wadajirka shacabka Soomaaliyeed. “Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ayaa Alle SWT uga baryay Marxuumka in uu hoygiisa ka yeelo Jannatul Firdowsa,” ayaa lagu yiri dhambaalka tacsida oo lagu baahiyay bogga Villa Somalia. Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa Eebbe uga baryay in uu siiyo samir iyo iimaan qoyska, ehelada iyo guud ahaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee uu ka baxay Marxuumku. Allaha u naxariistee, Imaam Maxamed Yuusuf oo kamid ahaa dhaqanka Soomaliyeed ayaa muddo ka shaqeynayey nabadeynta bulshada iyo xoojinta midnimada, oo si weyn loogu yaqaanay. items.title: Sawirro Muujinaya Duuliyayaal Soomaaliyeed oo Tababar ka Helaya Bakistaan oo la Faafiyay
items.description: Muqdisho – Sawirro si weyn ugu faafaya baraha bulshada ayaa la sheegay inay muujinayaan saraakiil ka tirsan Ciidanka Cirka ee dalka Bakistaan (PAF) oo tababar siinaya duuliyayaal Soomaaliyeed gudaha magaalada Muqdisho. Haddii sawirradaasi la xaqiijiyo, waxay noqon doonaan astaan kale oo muujinaysa sii ballaarashada iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Bakistaan. Wararka soo baxaya ayaa sidoo kale kusoo beegmaya xilli ay hore u jireen warbixino sheegayay in Soomaaliya iyo Bakistaan ay ka wada hadlayaan suurtagalnimada helitaanka diyaaradaha dagaalka ee JF-17 Thunder, iyo tababarka duuliyeyaasha iyo farsamayaqaannada Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Dawladda Soomaaliya iyo Dawladda Bakistaan weli kama aysan soosaarin war rasmi ah oo xaqiijinaya sawirrada hadda la faafiyay ama heshiis cusub oo arrintan la xiriira. Bakistaan ayaa lagu tiriyaa dalalka leh barnaamijyada ugu horumarsan ee tababarka duuliyayaasha militari. Haddii iskaashigan uu hirgalo, wuxuu kaalin muhiim ah ka qaadan karaa dibudhiska iyo casriyaynta awoodda Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed. Goobjoog ayaa si dhow ula soconaya arrintan, waxayna idiin soo gudbin doontaa wixii war rasmi ah ee ka soo kordha.

items.title: Naadiya Maxamed oo si Heer Sare ah loogu soo Dhoweeyay Magaalada Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho – Naadiya Maxamed, Duqa Magaalada St. Louis Park ee gobolka Minnesota ee dalka Mareykanka, ayaa maanta si heer sare ah loogu soo dhoweeyay magaalada Muqdisho, ka dib safar ay ku timid dalka. Soo dhowaynta Naadiya Maxamed waxaa ka qeybgalay madax iyo mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan dawladda, xildhibaanno, xubno ka tirsan Golaha Wasiirrada, mas’uuliyiin dawladeed, aqoonyahanno, waxgarad, odayaal, dhallinyaro, haween iyo boqollaal qof oo ka mid ah bulshada rayidka ah. Waxaa, sidoo kale, soo dhowaynta qeyb ka ahaa Siihayaha Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, Marwo Sacdiyo Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar, oo ka mid ahayd masuuliyiintii qaabbishay wefdiga. Naadiya Maxamed ayaa diiwaanka taariikhda ku gashay sannadkii 2023, libintii ay ka soo hoyisay carriga Maraykanka, ka dib markii loo doortay Duqa Magaalada St. Louis Park, iyadoo noqotay haweenaydii ugu horraysay oo Soomaali ah ee loo doorto xilka duqmagaalo oo dalka Maraykanka ah, isla markaasna noqotay duqii ugu horreeyay ee Muslin iyo qof madow ah ee hoggaamiya magaaladaas. Guusheeda taariikhiga ah ayaa noqotay astaan muujinaysa kaalinta isa soo taraysa ee Soomaalidu ku leedahay hoggaanka iyo siyaasadda caalamka. Imaanshaheeda Muqdisho ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli ay sii xoogaysanayaan dadaallada lagu xoojinayo xiriirka u dhexeeya Soomaalida qorraxjoogtada ah iyo qurbajoogta Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan kuwa ka dhex muuqda hoggaanka siyaasadda, maamulka iyo adeegga bulshada ee dalalka ay ku nool yihiin. Waxaa la filayaa in Naadiya Maxamed ay inta ay dalka joogto kulamo la yeelato madaxda dawladda, hay’adaha kala duwan iyo bulshada rayidka, iyadoo booqashadeedu diiradda saari doonto xoojinta iskaashiga, isweydaarsiga khibradaha hoggaaminta iyo dhiirrigelinta doorka dhallinyarada iyo haweenka Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: Nolol xumo haysa haween barakac ku ah Doollow kuwaas oo noqday shaqo la’aan
items.description: (ERGO) – Xaalad nolol xumo ah ayaa soo wajahday ku dhawaad 150 habeen ah iyo qoysaskooda oo deggan magaalada Doollow ee gobolka Gedo. Arrintan ayaa timid markii shaqadoodii oo ahayd dhar-dhaqid iyo nadaafadda guryaha ay meesha ka baxeen 6 bil ee la soo dhaafay. Waxaa isku raacday dhaqaale la’aan ku dhacday qoysaskii ay ku shaqaynayeen iyo haween Itoobiyaan ah oo lacag yar ku qabta shaqooyinkii ay hayeen oo deegaanka ku soo batay. Shugri Caraale Cabdi oo waxay cunno ku filan u la’dahay carruurteeda oo toddobo ah. Waxay xaaladdan galeen bishii Abriil ee sanadkan. Qoysas ay shaqo nadaafad ah  maalinle ugu qaban jirtay ayaa u sheegay inay fasax tahay sabab la xiriirta inaysan aqoodin gunadeeda. Haweeneydan ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegtay inay hadda haystaan culeysyo is-biirsay oo ay ugu horreysa quud u helidda carruurteeda oo keliyeed ku tiirsan. Waxay ka fursan wayday inay dewersato si hal waqti dabka ugu shiddo. “Cambuulo shamuureey ayaan saaka sida uu waaga u baryay dabka u saaray ciyaalkeyga. Wax kale oo la siiyo malaha. Hal waqti oo wax la siiyo hadii loo helo caawa sidaas lee ku seexanayaan. “Dukaankii aan daynta ka qaadanaayay isagana waa la iga joojiyay oo wax kale laguguma daraayo ayaa la i dhahay. Hadda waan iska fadhiistay dhawaanahan banaan ma’aadin, shaqana malaha, sidaa ayaana xaafadda ku joogaa.” Shugri oo 42 jir ah ayaa sheegay ka seexan waydo habeennada qaar carruurteeda oo gaajaysan, taas oo ku kordhisa fekerka iyo murugada. Waxay intaas raacisay inay xaaladdooda sii adkaysay in wax gargaar ah aysan ku helin  xerada barakaca Kabaaso ee degmada Doollow oo ay soo miciin biddeen.   Shugri oo shaqooyinka muruq-maalka ku soo jirtay labo sano ayaa sheegtay inay maalinle u heli jirtay lacag u dhaxeeyso saddex ilaa shan doollar, taas oo kaga filnayd cunnada, biyaha iyo waxbarashada carruurteeda. Waxaa ka istaagay bishii Jannaayo raashin ay ka helaysay hay’adaha samafalka. Waxaa u dheeraa daqligii ka soo gali jiray shaqooyinka xoogsiga balse maanta labadiiba ma hayso. “Hadda wax dhaq dhaqaaq ah oo qof kuu wacanaayo maleh. Hadda magaaladi aan ka shaqeysaneynay oo dharka ka dhaqeynay Oromo ayaa la wareegtay. Shaqo la’aan ayaan hadda cidda iskala joognaa.” Marka laga yimaado cunno xumada ay ka dhaxleen iyada carruurteed shaqo la’aanta. Waxaa u wehliya culeys ka haysta dhinaca biyaha markii uu meesha ka baxay dhaqaalihi ka soo gali jiray shaqada oo ay biyaha ka beeqaamin jirtay. Xerada Kabaaso oo ay ku nooshahay biyuhu waa lacag. Fuustadii waxaa lagu shubtaa 300 birr oo u dhiganta $1.5. Shugri ayaa sheegtay in markii ay awoodi weyday bixinta lacagta biyaha ay dantu ku qasabtay in carruurteeda ay wabiga jubba oo u jira hal km ay ka doonaan biyo aan nadiif ahayn. “Hadda gabar tubbo ugu jirto oo walaal ah ayaa u tahay oo aan ku dhahay biyihi lacag ayaa la igu la haaday, lacagtina mahaayo ayaan dhahay ee biyo isii, iyadi ayaan hadda shantoo caag lacag la’aan kaga soo dhaansaday. “Hadii aan weyno oo tubadiina lacagti nagu badatay wabiga oo wasaq ah ayaan iskaga soo dhaansanaa.” Haweeneydan iyo carruurteeda ayaa ku sugan xaalad quus ah. Waxay xustay inay u baahan yihiin samata-bixin si ay uga soo kabtaan xaaladda ay ku jiraan oo aysan awoodin inay keligood ka baxaan. Shugri iyo qoyskeeda ayaa sanadkii 2016 ka soo barakacay abaar ku dhufatay miyiga degmada Diinsoor, halkaas oo ay kaga dhinteen ari 70, xilligaan oo ay ku soo biireen nolosha barakaca. Haweenka shaqo la’aanta ay soo foodsaartay ayaa ah kuwo ka soo jeeda qoysaska barakaca ku ah xeryaha magaalada Doollow. Waana kuwo aan laheyn xirfaddo kale oo ay ku shaqeystaan sidoo kalana ay ka istaagtay deeqda hay’adaha samafalka oo noloshooda kabi jiray. Xaaladdan waxaa haweenkan u raacday hakad ku yimid gargaarkii hay’adaha samafalka ee ka shaqeeya gobolka dhaqaale xumo guud darteed iyo sicir barar ka jira magaalada. Waxaa la diiday shillin Soomaaliga, taas oo keentay in la isticmaalo birta ee Itoobiya iyo kuwa danabaysan ee taleefannada gacanta. Shiniyey Maxamed Cabdi waxay dabooli la’ dahaya baahiyaha nolosheed ee carruurteeda oo lix ah. Waxaa ka istgaatay shaqo nadaafad ah bishii Febraayo ee sanadkan. Waxaa u wehelisay inuu ka go’day isla December 2025 raashin igusu jiray Min 25 kg oo bariis, baasto, bur, 5kg sonkor iyo sadexle saliid ah oo ay bille uga heleysay hay’adaha samafalka. Waxay wajahayaan cunno xumo, daymo lagu yeeshay iyo carruurteeda oo waxbarashada kaga soo eryay. Raadiyow Ergo ayay u sheegtay in hadda carruurteeda ay ugu soo dawarsato qoysaska nolol ahaan dhaamo oo xerada iyo xaafadaha magaalada. Shaqo la’aanta kahor waxa aheyd mid ku filan cuntada iyo maaraynta baahiyaha kale ee qoyskeeda. “Awal hore saddexda doolar labada doolar waan iska heli jirnay, hadda wax aan haysano ma jirto. Ilmihi maanta hadii dabka loo shiddo bari looma shidaayo. Alle ayaa wax nasiiyo maalin waa la heli maalin waa kheyri. Marmar dabkooda lama shido. Ilmihi daris ayaa jiro in kastoo la is dhaamin.” Shiniyey oo 36 jir ah, waxa ay shaqada nadaafadda ka heli jirtay lacag dhan afar doolar taas oo aheyd mid ay joogto kaga soo qaban jirtay xafadaha ay ku nool yihiin dadka ku jira dabaqada dhexe. “Dugsigi waan ka reebay wax la’aanta awgeed. Hungurigooda ayaan u weysanahay oo aan haynin marka bil intee ka keenaa, iska jooga ayaan dhahay.” Waxay sheegtay inaysan wax garab ah ka helin carruurteeda aabbahood oo ay kala tageen. Waxay xustay in xaaladdan hadda ay ku sugan yihiin ay tahay middii ugu adkayd ee soo marta. Shiniyey iyo qoyskiisa ayaa sanadkii 2011 ku cayroobay abaar dhaafisay tiro ariga ah iyo 20 sac oo ay ku dhaqanayeen miyiga Doolow. Waxay galeen xeryo ku yaalla deegaanka Soomaalida. items.fullContent: (ERGO) – Xaalad nolol xumo ah ayaa soo wajahday ku dhawaad 150 habeen ah iyo qoysaskooda oo deggan magaalada Doollow ee gobolka Gedo. Arrintan ayaa timid markii shaqadoodii oo ahayd dhar-dhaqid iyo nadaafadda guryaha ay meesha ka baxeen 6 bil ee la soo dhaafay. Waxaa isku raacday dhaqaale la’aan ku dhacday qoysaskii ay ku shaqaynayeen iyo haween Itoobiyaan ah oo lacag yar ku qabta shaqooyinkii ay hayeen oo deegaanka ku soo batay. Shugri Caraale Cabdi oo waxay cunno ku filan u la’dahay carruurteeda oo toddobo ah. Waxay xaaladdan galeen bishii Abriil ee sanadkan. Qoysas ay shaqo nadaafad ah  maalinle ugu qaban jirtay ayaa u sheegay inay fasax tahay sabab la xiriirta inaysan aqoodin gunadeeda. Haweeneydan ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegtay inay hadda haystaan culeysyo is-biirsay oo ay ugu horreysa quud u helidda carruurteeda oo keliyeed ku tiirsan. Waxay ka fursan wayday inay dewersato si hal waqti dabka ugu shiddo. “Cambuulo shamuureey ayaan saaka sida uu waaga u baryay dabka u saaray ciyaalkeyga. Wax kale oo la siiyo malaha. Hal waqti oo wax la siiyo hadii loo helo caawa sidaas lee ku seexanayaan. “Dukaankii aan daynta ka qaadanaayay isagana waa la iga joojiyay oo wax kale laguguma daraayo ayaa la i dhahay. Hadda waan iska fadhiistay dhawaanahan banaan ma’aadin, shaqana malaha, sidaa ayaana xaafadda ku joogaa.” Shugri oo 42 jir ah ayaa sheegay ka seexan waydo habeennada qaar carruurteeda oo gaajaysan, taas oo ku kordhisa fekerka iyo murugada. Waxay intaas raacisay inay xaaladdooda sii adkaysay in wax gargaar ah aysan ku helin  xerada barakaca Kabaaso ee degmada Doollow oo ay soo miciin biddeen.   Shugri oo shaqooyinka muruq-maalka ku soo jirtay labo sano ayaa sheegtay inay maalinle u heli jirtay lacag u dhaxeeyso saddex ilaa shan doollar, taas oo kaga filnayd cunnada, biyaha iyo waxbarashada carruurteeda. Waxaa ka istaagay bishii Jannaayo raashin ay ka helaysay hay’adaha samafalka. Waxaa u dheeraa daqligii ka soo gali jiray shaqooyinka xoogsiga balse maanta labadiiba ma hayso. “Hadda wax dhaq dhaqaaq ah oo qof kuu wacanaayo maleh. Hadda magaaladi aan ka shaqeysaneynay oo dharka ka dhaqeynay Oromo ayaa la wareegtay. Shaqo la’aan ayaan hadda cidda iskala joognaa.” Marka laga yimaado cunno xumada ay ka dhaxleen iyada carruurteed shaqo la’aanta. Waxaa u wehliya culeys ka haysta dhinaca biyaha markii uu meesha ka baxay dhaqaalihi ka soo gali jiray shaqada oo ay biyaha ka beeqaamin jirtay. Xerada Kabaaso oo ay ku nooshahay biyuhu waa lacag. Fuustadii waxaa lagu shubtaa 300 birr oo u dhiganta $1.5. Shugri ayaa sheegtay in markii ay awoodi weyday bixinta lacagta biyaha ay dantu ku qasabtay in carruurteeda ay wabiga jubba oo u jira hal km ay ka doonaan biyo aan nadiif ahayn. “Hadda gabar tubbo ugu jirto oo walaal ah ayaa u tahay oo aan ku dhahay biyihi lacag ayaa la igu la haaday, lacagtina mahaayo ayaan dhahay ee biyo isii, iyadi ayaan hadda shantoo caag lacag la’aan kaga soo dhaansaday. “Hadii aan weyno oo tubadiina lacagti nagu badatay wabiga oo wasaq ah ayaan iskaga soo dhaansanaa.” Haweeneydan iyo carruurteeda ayaa ku sugan xaalad quus ah. Waxay xustay inay u baahan yihiin samata-bixin si ay uga soo kabtaan xaaladda ay ku jiraan oo aysan awoodin inay keligood ka baxaan. Shugri iyo qoyskeeda ayaa sanadkii 2016 ka soo barakacay abaar ku dhufatay miyiga degmada Diinsoor, halkaas oo ay kaga dhinteen ari 70, xilligaan oo ay ku soo biireen nolosha barakaca. Haweenka shaqo la’aanta ay soo foodsaartay ayaa ah kuwo ka soo jeeda qoysaska barakaca ku ah xeryaha magaalada Doollow. Waana kuwo aan laheyn xirfaddo kale oo ay ku shaqeystaan sidoo kalana ay ka istaagtay deeqda hay’adaha samafalka oo noloshooda kabi jiray. Xaaladdan waxaa haweenkan u raacday hakad ku yimid gargaarkii hay’adaha samafalka ee ka shaqeeya gobolka dhaqaale xumo guud darteed iyo sicir barar ka jira magaalada. Waxaa la diiday shillin Soomaaliga, taas oo keentay in la isticmaalo birta ee Itoobiya iyo kuwa danabaysan ee taleefannada gacanta.
