items.title: Maxaa ka jira in Lafta-gareen uu dib u heshiisin la bilaabay DF?
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, welina ku doodayo inuu yahay Madaxweynaha sharciga ah oo qoraal soo saaray ayaa ka hadlay warar lagu baahiyay baraha bulshada oo sheegayay inuu dib u heshiisiin la bilaabay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, si loo soo afjaro dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ay weli ciidamadiisa ka wadaan aaga Baydhaba. Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen) oo haatan ah dibad-joog ayaa beeniyay weerarkaasi, wuxuuna sheegay in aanu jiri qorshe dib u heshiisiineed oo la filanayo, sida uu ku caddeeyay warsaxaafadeedkiisa. Sidoo kale, wuxuu baaq u diray shacabka Koonfur Galbeed oo uu ka dalbaday in xogta saxda ah ee kala socdaan ilaha rasmiga ah, gaar ahaa xafiiskiisa iyo hay’adaha dowladda. “Waxaan shacabka ugu baaqeynaa inay ka feejignaadaan wararka aan la hubin saxnimadooda, isla markaana ay ku kalsoonaadaan oo kaliya warka iyo ogeysiisyada rasmiga ah ee kasoo baxay xafiiska rasmiga ah ee Madaxweynaha iyo hay’adaha rasmiga ah ee ay khuseyso,” ayuu yiri Lafta-gareen. Waxaa kale oo uu warsaxaafadeedka kusii daray “Faafinta warar aan xaqiiqo ku salaysnayn waxay horseedi karaan jahwareer iyo marin habaabin bulshada dhexdeeda ah. Sidaas darteed, waxaan ku boorrinaynaa dhammaan dadka isticmaala baraha bulshada inay xaqiijitaan xog kasta kahor inta aasan faafinin”. Lafta-gareen oo sidoo kale soo hadal qaaday arrimaha ciidamada iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ka socda duleedka Baydhaba ayaa sheegay in dhankooda ay sii wadi doonaan howlgallada, isla markaana uu jeedka uu yahay inay soo celiyaan nabadda Koonfur Galbeed, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Waxay Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed markale xaqiijinaysaa in ciidamada Booliska gaarka ay si wadi doonaan gudasha waajibaadkooda dastuuriga ah ee ilaalinta amniga iyo difaaca shacabka, sugidda xasilloonida iyo dib usoo celinta nabadda dhammaan deegaannada Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed,” ayaa mar kale yiri bayaanka uu soo saaray Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo dhawana isbeddel uu ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba, kadib markii doorashada Koonfur Galbeed uu kusoo baxay Hoggaamiye Aadan Madoobe. items.title: Houthis warn over Israeli troop deployment to Somaliland
items.description: Sanaa, Yemen — A senior official in Yemen’s Houthi movement has warned that the group would treat any Israeli or US military presence in Somali waters as a “legitimate target”, after reports that Israel deployed forces to Somaliland following its recognition of the breakaway Somali region. Mohammed al-Farah, a member of Ansarullah’s political bureau, said the group viewed the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab Strait as central to Yemen’s national security. “We regard the Red Sea and Bab el-Mandeb Strait as a very important strategic region,” Farah said in remarks reported Monday. “Any movement by the Zionist-American enemy there will be interpreted as an attempt to establish hostile influence, dominate vital waterways, and threaten the security of the entire region, including Saudi Arabia itself,” he added. The Houthis, who control Yemen’s capital Sanaa and much of the country’s north, have repeatedly targeted Israel and shipping they describe as Israeli-linked since the start of the Gaza war, turning the Bab al-Mandab into one of the world’s most volatile maritime chokepoints. The narrow waterway links the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden and sits between Yemen, Djibouti and Eritrea. Any escalation there threatens a route used by commercial shipping, energy supplies and international naval forces. ‘Red line’ Farah said any Israeli presence in Somali territorial waters would directly threaten Yemen. “We in Yemen view such activities as a direct threat to Yemen’s national security and sovereignty,” he said. He added that Houthi leader Abdul-Malik al-Houthi had issued “a clear and stern warning” that the group would “deal forcefully” with any Israeli or American military presence in Somaliland. Farah said the group would treat any such deployment as a “red line” and a “legitimate target”. He also rejected the argument that foreign bases or military deployments were needed to secure the Red Sea, saying regional states, especially countries bordering the waterway, should take responsibility. “The Red Sea is not an open arena for foreign powers,” he said, accusing Israel and the United States of seeking to use the route for “Zionist, aggressive, and American agendas and schemes”. The warning followed a Middle East Eye report , cited by Somalia Today, that Israel sent around 50 soldiers to Somaliland after recognising the breakaway Somali region as an independent state in December. The report, citing a senior Somali government official, said Somali intelligence believed the soldiers arrived after Israel resumed its war with Iran in late February. The official claimed Israel selected soldiers of African heritage, “especially Ethiopians”, to avoid drawing attention. Israel’s military declined to comment directly on the allegation, saying it was “a matter for the political echelon”, according to the report. Israel’s Foreign Ministry later issued a blunt denial through several official accounts, saying: “FAKE NEWS.” Somaliland authorities have not publicly confirmed the alleged deployment. ‘Training, not bases’ Somaliland’s Defence Minister Mohamed Yusuf Ali has denied that Israel has established a military base in the territory, but confirmed Israeli security support. “There is no Israeli military presence or military bases in Somaliland,” he said. “But Israel is helping Somaliland… they are supporting to train some of our police and military.” The denial has not ended speculation about the military dimension of the new relationship. Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz said during talks with Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi in Israel that the two sides had maintained quiet security ties for years. “For many years, we cooperated under the radar in a series of operations that will remain classified,” Katz said. At a Tel Aviv business forum, Abdullahi presented Somaliland as a strategic and commercial partner for Israel. “Somaliland is open for business, and Somaliland is ready for Israeli investment,” he said. Israel became the first country to formally recognise Somaliland on December 26, a move Hargeisa welcomed, but Mogadishu fiercely rejected. Somaliland declared independence from Somalia in 1991 as the Somali state collapsed into civil war. It has since built its own institutions and maintained relative stability, but has not secured broad international recognition. Somalia’s federal government says Somaliland remains an integral part of its sovereign territory and has described Israel’s recognition as unlawful interference and a direct assault on Somali unity. Berbera, Somaliland’s main port, sits on the Gulf of Aden near the approaches to the Bab al-Mandab, making it strategically valuable for foreign powers seeking influence over Red Sea routes. The Houthis this month announced a ban on Israeli maritime navigation in the Red Sea after renewed regional escalation, heightening fears that any Israeli foothold near Yemen could turn Somaliland and Somali waters into a new regional flashpoint. The warning followed a Middle East Eye report , cited by Somalia Today, that Israel sent around 50 soldiers to Somaliland after recognising the breakaway Somali region as an independent state in December. The report, citing a senior Somali government official, said Somali intelligence believed the soldiers arrived after Israel resumed its war with Iran in late February. The official claimed Israel selected soldiers of African heritage, “especially Ethiopians”, to avoid drawing attention. Israel’s military declined to comment directly on the allegation, saying it was “a matter for the political echelon”, according to the report. Israel’s Foreign Ministry later issued a blunt denial through several official accounts, saying: “FAKE NEWS.” Somaliland authorities have not publicly confirmed the alleged deployment. ‘Training, not bases’ Somaliland’s Defence Minister Mohamed Yusuf Ali has denied that Israel has established a military base in the territory, but confirmed Israeli security support. “There is no Israeli military presence or military bases in Somaliland,” he said. “But Israel is helping Somaliland… they are supporting to train some of our police and military.” The denial has not ended speculation about the military dimension of the new relationship. Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz said during talks with Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi in Israel that the two sides had maintained quiet security ties for years. “For many years, we cooperated under the radar in a series of operations that will remain classified,” Katz said. At a Tel Aviv business forum, Abdullahi presented Somaliland as a strategic and commercial partner for Israel. “Somaliland is open for business, and Somaliland is ready for Israeli investment,” he said. Israel became the first country to formally recognise Somaliland on December 26, a move Hargeisa welcomed, but Mogadishu fiercely rejected. Somaliland declared independence from Somalia in 1991 as the Somali state collapsed into civil war. It has since built its own institutions and maintained relative stability, but has not secured broad international recognition. Somalia’s federal government says Somaliland remains an integral part of its sovereign territory and has described Israel’s recognition as unlawful interference and a direct assault on Somali unity. Berbera, Somaliland’s main port, sits on the Gulf of Aden near the approaches to the Bab al-Mandab, making it strategically valuable for foreign powers seeking influence over Red Sea routes. The Houthis this month announced a ban on Israeli maritime navigation in the Red Sea after renewed regional escalation, heightening fears that any Israeli foothold near Yemen could turn Somaliland and Somali waters into a new regional flashpoint. items.title: Somali state cuts ties with federal government
items.description: Somalia’s South West state has suspended all cooperation with the federal government in Mogadishu, accusing it of arming militias and attempting to remove regional president Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen. The diplomatic rupture follows disputes over constitutional amendments pushed by Mogadishu. Following similar recent boycotts by Puntland, Jubbaland, and the long-breakaway Somaliland, Mogadishu’s actual governing authority is rapidly shrinking, leaving the central government increasingly isolated. This situation favors Al-Shabaab insurgents and local militias, providing them with operational breathing room as federal and regional security forces turn their political focus against each other. But for the average Somali citizen, the development has increased uncertainty over the country’s stability. Without credible dialogue, this cascading collapse of federal cooperation threatens to permanently balkanize Somalia, reversing decades of painstaking international state-building and security efforts. Reuters

items.title: Maxay dhigantahay in Aqoonyahanka Soomaaliyeed loo magacaabay xilka Kaaliyaha Xoghayaha Guud Qaramada Midoobay ee arrimaha bani’aadannimada?
items.description: Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, António Guterres, ayaa u magacaabay Mohamed Yahya xilka Kaaliyaha Xoghayaha Guud ee Arrimaha Bani’aadannimada iyo Ku-Xigeenka Isuduwaha Gargaarka Degdegga ah ee Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee Isuduwidda Arrimaha Bani’aadannimada (OCHA). Magacaabistan ayaa Mohamed Yahya ka dhigaysa mid ka mid ah mas’uuliyiinta ugu sarreeya ee hoggaanka arrimaha bani’aadannimada ee Qaramada Midoobay, isaga oo door muhiim ah ka qaadan doona isku dubbaridka gurmadka degdegga ah iyo howlaha gargaarka ee ka socda dalalka ay saameeyeen colaadaha iyo musiibooyinka. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si diirran u soo dhaweysay magacaabistan, iyadoo ku tilmaantay guul qaran iyo aqoonsi muujinaya doorka sii kordhaya ee ay Soomaaliya ku leedahay hoggaanka hay’adaha caalamiga ah. Wasiiru Dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Cali Cumar, ayaa hambalyo u diray Mohamed Yahya, isaga oo sheegay in xilkan uu yahay mid uu mudnaa. “Waxaan hambalyo u dirayaa Mudane Mohamed Yahya magacaabistan muhiimka ah. “Soomaaliya waxay ku faanaysaa in mid ka mid ah muwaadiniinteeda loo doortay xil sare oo hoggaamineed oo Qaramada Midoobay ah. Waxaan u rajaynaynaa guul iyo inuu sii xoojiyo howlaha muhiimka ah ee OCHA ee taageerada dadka u baahan gargaarka adduunka oo dhan,” ayuu yiri Wasiiru Dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda XFS. Magacaabistan ayaa noqanaysa tallaabo  muujinaysa kororka kalsoonida beesha caalamka ay ku qabto khubarada Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka ay muujisay rajo ah in waayo-aragnimada iyo hoggaaminta Mohamed Yahya ay door weyn ka qaadan doonaan horumarinta howlaha bani’aadannimada ee Qaramada Midoobay.

items.title: Madaxweynaha oo furay itixaanka shahaadiga ee dugsiyada sare iyo dhexe
items.description: 𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐱𝐰𝐞𝐲𝐧𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐡𝐮𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐨 𝐦𝐚𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐬𝐢 𝐫𝐚𝐬𝐦𝐢 𝐚𝐡 𝐮 𝐟𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐲 𝐈𝐦𝐭𝐢𝐱𝐚𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐚 𝐒𝐡𝐚𝐡𝐚𝐚𝐝𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐚𝐡 𝐞𝐞 𝐃𝐮𝐠𝐬𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐃𝐡𝐞𝐱𝐞 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐃𝐮𝐠𝐬𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐒𝐚𝐫𝐞 Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa maanta Dugsiga Sare ee Faarax Oomaar ee Caasimadda Hargeysa si rasmi ah uga furay bilowga Imtixaannada Shahaadiga ah ee Dugsiyada Dhexe iyo Dugsiyada Sare ee dalka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, kaas oo sannad kasta lagu qiimeeyo heerka aqooneed ee ardayda dalka, laguna xaqiijiyo hufnaanta iyo tayada nidaamka Waxbarashada Qaranka JSL. Waxa xusid mudan in sannadkan 2026-ka ay ardaydii ugu badnay (𝟒𝟐,𝟓𝟏𝟗) taariikhda Somaliland u fadhiisteen Imtixaannada Shahaadiga ah ee Dugsiyada Dhexe iyo kuwa Sare ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu hambalyo iyo dhiirrigelinba u diray dhammaan ardayda maanta u fadhiisatay Imtixaannada Shahaadiga ah, isaga oo u rajeeyey guul iyo in ay ka gaadhaan natiijooyin wacan oo ka turjumaysa dedaalkoodii, kartidooda iyo aqoonta ay muddada dheer soo baranayeen. Ugu dambayn, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu u mahad naqay Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Barbaarinta iyo Sayniska JSL, Xafiiska Imtixaannada Qaranka, Ciidamada Booliska JSL, Macallimiinta iyo dhammaan cid kasta oo ka qayb qaadatay diyaarinta, sugidda iyo qabsoomidda Imtixaannada Shahaadiga ah ee Qaranka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland.

items.title: Puntland Security Tensions Deepen Amid Rising Political Dispute
items.description: Garow e — Security concerns have resurfaced in Garowe, the capital of Somalia’s Puntland state, following reports of renewed tensions and clashes involving forces affiliated with the Puntland administration. Religious leaders in Garowe have called for a united stance against any actors threatening Puntland’s security, stability and political existence. In a strongly worded appeal, the clerics urged authorities and the public to confront any efforts aimed at destabilising the region. The administration of President Said Abdullahi Deni has accused Somalia’s Federal Government of seeking to undermine Puntland’s state institutions. Puntland officials also alleged that federal authorities were involved in military mobilisation and the movement of weapons in parts of the region. Mudug region is among the areas where Puntland officials say federal-linked military activity has been reported. The Puntland administration has said it will take measures in response to what it describes as threats to its security and stability. The Federal Government of Somalia has not immediately responded to the allegations. The post Puntland Security Tensions Deepen Amid Rising Political Dispute appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Somalia and International Partners Carry Out Fresh Airstrikes on Al-Shabaab Positions
items.description: Mogadishu — The Federal Government of Somalia said its forces, with support from international partners, have conducted a series of airstrikes targeting Al-Shabaab positions in several areas of the Middle Shabelle region. In a statement, the government said the operations were carried out in Gayfo, Ruun Idiris and Cali Gaduud, areas it described as key locations used by Al-Shabaab for fighter mobilisation, training activities, and the storage of weapons, ammunition and military supplies. According to the statement, the first airstrike took place on June 24 in Gayfo, where Somali authorities said an Al-Shabaab mobilisation centre was destroyed. The government said militants and military equipment were present at the site when it was struck. On June 25, three consecutive airstrikes were reportedly carried out against an Al-Shabaab training facility in Ruun Idiris, where the group was allegedly preparing fighters for future operations. The government said another strike on the same day targeted armed Al-Shabaab militants in Cali Gaduud, who were allegedly preparing to launch attacks and carry out terrorist activities. Somali authorities did not provide further details on casualties or the full scale of damage caused by the strikes. Al-Shabaab has not immediately commented on the government’s claims. The post Somalia and International Partners Carry Out Fresh Airstrikes on Al-Shabaab Positions appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Daawo: Fiqi oo u jawaabay Sanbaloolshe: “In uu nool yahay ayaa naxariis ah”
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa si kulul ugu jawaabay Agaasimihii hore ee Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka Cabdullahi Maxamed Cali (Sanbaloolshe) oo xalay weerar afka ah ku qaaday Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Sanbaloolshe oo wareysi gaar ah siiyay Shabelle Tv ayaa weerarkii lagu qaaday isaga iyo Ra’iisul wasaarihii hore Xasan Cali Khayre ku eedeeyay inuu amray Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, isla markaana la rabay in la dilo, sida uu hadaka u dhigay. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ku hanjabay in uu aarsan doono, isla markaana uusan cafin doonin weerarka lagu beegsaday, illaa inta laga bixinayo garowshiyo. “Wallaahi Bilalahi Tallaahi inaanan loo cafineynin 100-ka sano ee soo socda haddii aanan la’isaga garaabin oo aan laga Towbad keenin oo aanan laga heshiin aniga nimaan ahay weligey ma cafinaayo,” ayuu yiri Sanbaloolshe. Waxaa kale oo uu kusii daray “Wuxuu rabay in meesha nagula baaba’sho 100% isaga ayaa amarka baxshay taleefankana waa dansaday”. Intaas kadib waxaa soo jawaabay Wasiir Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo sheegay in Sanbaloolshe iyo nimanka kale ee mucaaradka ay doonayeen in la gubo Muqdisho, balse isku daygoodii laga hortegay, sida uu ku dooday. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga ayaa sidoo kale xusay in nimanka sidaas sameeyay la fasaxay, isla markaana ay weli sii doodayaan, sida in dhib loo gaystay oo kale. “Ninka madfaca kusoo riday Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya ayaa wuxuu leeyahay waa lay soo weeraray ninka haamaha shidaalka dekedda rabay inuu gubo oo 10 mitir u jirsaday hoobihii uu riday haamaha magaalada oo dhan gubi lahaa ayaa wuxuu leeyahay waa lay dili rabay weligey ma cafinayo inuu noolyahay ayaa naxariis ah oo weliba la fasaxay,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Axmed Macallin Fiqi. Si kastaba, Hadalkan ayaa daba socda is weerarka dhanka baraha bulshada ee muxaafadka iyo mucaaradka oo dhawaan dagaal toos ah uu ku dhex-mara xaafado ka tirsan magaalada Muqdisho, kaas oo gaystay khasaare kala duwan. items.title: Wanted Suspect in $5M U.S. Nutrition Fraud Arrested in Mogadishu
items.description: Mogadishu — Somali security authorities have arrested Abdikarim Abdullahi Idle, 42, in Mogadishu, in connection with a major U.S. fraud investigation linked to the Feeding Our Future child nutrition program. According to the U.S. Department of Justice, Idle was arrested on June 25, 2026, after allegedly fleeing the United States to avoid prosecution. U.S. prosecutors accuse him of playing a central role in a large-scale fraud scheme involving federal child nutrition funds. The indictment alleges that Idle, who was involved in the program’s operations, accepted bribes and kickbacks in exchange for approving fraudulent meal sites. These sites allegedly submitted false claims stating that they were providing daily meals to thousands of children under the U.S. federal Child Nutrition Program. Prosecutors further allege that Idle established multiple companies and entities under different names to submit false claims and move fraud proceeds. The U.S. Department of Justice said more than $5 million in alleged proceeds were deposited into bank accounts linked to companies associated with him. U.S. authorities have described the Feeding Our Future case as one of the largest fraud schemes in Minnesota’s history. Officials said Idle’s arrest underscores their commitment to pursuing individuals accused of financial crimes, regardless of where they attempt to evade justice. Idle is expected to face legal proceedings in connection with the charges brought against him in the United States. items.title: Daawo: Somalia oo Record caalami ah jebisey kadib markii…
items.description: London (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya aya maanta jebisey Recordkii cusub oo ku aadan heshiisyada caalamiga ah, kadib markii Hay’adda Baddaha Aduunka IMO ay ka diiwaangelisey 15 heshiis oo caalami ah. Wasiirka Wasaaradda Dekadaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda Mudane, Cabduqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo hadda ku sugan magaalada London ee caasimada dalka Ingiriiska ayaa Xarunta Ururka Badaha Adduunka ee Qaramada Midoobay ka diiwaangeliyay heshiisyadan oo ay horay u meel-mariyeen xubnaa Golaha Wasiirrada Soomaaliya, isla markaana muhiim u ah dalka. Documentiyada la gubdiyay ayaa isugu jiro 15 heshiis, borotokool iyo lifaaqyo sharciyeed oo caalami ah oo la xiriira arrimaha badaha, iyadoo tallaabadan lagu tilmaamay mid lagu casriyeynayo hannaanka sharciyeed ee badaha dalka. Wasiir Jaamac oo faah-faahin ka bixiyay tallaabada ay qaadeen ayaa guul ku tilmaamay, wuxuuna sheegay in tani ay tahay isbeddelkii ugu ballaarnaa ee lagu sameeyo sharciyada badaha Soomaaliya tan iyo markii ay xornimada qaadatay Soomaaliya, isla markaana ay dalka ka caawin doonto inuu la jaanqaado xeerarka caalamiga ah ee khuseeya badqabka maraakiibta, amniga badda, heerarka badmaaxiinta iyo ilaalinta deegaanka badda. “Maanta waa maalin wayn oo taariikhi ah oo dalka iyo dadka Soomaaliyeed qiimo wayn ugu fadhido waa maalin aan soo diiwaangelinay 15 documenti oo dalka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan inta daneysa arrimaha badda aan kusoo diiwaanelinay Hay’adda Badaha Caalamiga ah ee IMO waa maalin aan dhihi karno taariikhda weli kama dhicin in documintiyo heerkan la eeg ay dowladi keento xaruna IMO,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac). Waxaa kale oo uu intaas kusii datay “Shuruucda aan diiwaangelinay waxay u adeegayaan oo ay muhiim u yihiin arrimaha diblumaasiyadda, ganacsiga, difaaca iyo ilaalinta gobonnimada dalka Soomaaliyeed”. In kasta oo Soomaaliya ay leedahay xeeb-barriyeedka ugu dheer Afrika, isla markaana ay ku taallo marinno istiraatiiji ah oo ka mid ah kuwa ugu muhiimsan adduunka, haddana tan iyo 1960-kii waxay ku biirtay oo keliya saddex heshiis oo caalami ah oo la xiriira arrimaha badaha, sida ay shaacisay Wasaaradda Dekadaha iyo Gaadiidka Badda ee Xukuumadda Soomaaliya. Si kastaba, ku biirista heshiisyadan waxay Soomaaliya ka dhigaysaa dal firfircoon oo ka tirsan nidaamka caalamiga ah ee badaha, iyadoo xoojinaysa badqabka iyo amniga badda, ilaalinta deegaanka, iyo hirgelinta heerarka caalamiga ah. Sidoo kale, waxay dhiirrigelinaysaa maalgashiga, kobcinta dhaqaalaha buluugga ah, iyo ballaarinta fursadaha ganacsi iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah, taas oo ka tarjumaysa aragtida Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan horumarinta waarta ee howlaha qaran ee la xiriira badaha. The post Daawo: Somalia oo Record caalami ah jebisey kadib markii… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Muuse Biixi oo uga digay Cabdiraxmaan Ciro in uusan ku il-duufin dalalka kala ah…
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee maamulka Somaliland, Muuse Biixi Cabdi, ayaa sheegay in colaadda Bariga Dhexe ay saamaynteedu soo gaartay Geeska Afrika, taasoo dhalisay isbeddello waaweyn oo jaan-gooynaya isbahaysiyo cusub iyo dalal ku shuraakoobaya ilaalinta danahooda. Muuse Biixi ayaa tilmaamay in isbeddellada dunida ka dhacaya iyo duufaannada siyaasadeed ee jira ay lagama maarmaan ka dhigayaan in si hufan looga fiirsado tallaabo kasta oo la qaadayo, si looga fogaado ilduuf siyaasadeed. Qoraal uu soo saaray munaasabadda 26-ka Juun ayuu Muuse Biixi sidoo kale ku sheegay inay sii kordhayso saamaynta dalalka waaweyn ee Muslimka ah, sida Iiraan, Pakistan, Turkiga, Masar iyo Sacuudiga, kuwaas oo uu sheegay inay sameysteen isbahaysi. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in xiriirka sii xumaanaya ee Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil uu keeni karo in dalalkaas ay isku soo dhowaadaan, taasoo uu ku tilmaamay isbeddel weyn oo u baahan in Somaliland ay si xeeldheer u eegto ka hor inta aysan qaadin tallaabooyin xasaasi ah. Muuse Biixi ayaa sidoo kale hadal qaaday in isbahaysiyadan dalalka Islaamka ay suuragal tahay inay sidii hore ka badan isugu soo dhowaadaan, sababo la xiriira is-maan-dhaafka sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya hoggaanka Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil. Wuxuu uga digay xukuumadda cusub ee Somaliland, ee uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Cirro, inay si dhexdhexaad ah oo taxaddar leh u darsaan saamaynta ballaaran ee ka dhalan karta heshiisyada caalamiga ah. Waxa uu sheegay in colaadda Bariga Dhexe ay saamayn toos ah ku leedahay Geeska Afrika, sidaas darteedna loo baahan yahay in tallaabo kasta oo la qaadayo lagu miisaamo danta guud ee Somaliland. “Sidaas awgeed, waxa la gudboon Dawladda, gaar ahaan Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, inay si xeeldheer u daraasadayso saamaynta ka dhalan karta isbeddelladan caalamiga ah, si looga baaqsado ilduuf siyaasadeed oo wax u dhimi kara danaha Qaranka. Waxa kale oo muhiim ah in tallaabooyinka aynu hore u qaadnay iyo kuwa ina horyaalla la is waafajiyo, iyadoo lagu salaynayo danta Qaranka,” ayuu yiri Muuse Biixi Cabdi. Israa’iil ayaa bishii Diseembar 2025 ku dhawaaqday inay aqoonsatay Somaliland, taasoo dhalisay falcelinno kala duwan oo isugu jiray dabbaaldeg ay muujiyeen taageerayaasha aqoonsiga iyo walaac dhinacyada amniga iyo diinta ah oo ay muujiyeen culimada iyo qaybo ka mid ah bulshada. Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Cirro, ayaa isna dhowaan sheegay in dalkiisu uu danihiisa ka eegayo cid kasta oo aqoonsi rasmi ah siisa. Hadalkaas ayaa yimid kaddib markii uu booqasho maalmo qaadatay ku tegay dhulka ay Israa’iil xoogga ku haysato. items.title: Hay’adda NISA oo FBI-da u gacan gelisay Soomaali ka soo baxsaday Mareykanka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in magaalada Muqdisho lagu qabtay Abdikariim Abdelahi Eidleh, oo ka mid ahaa eedeysanayaasha ugu muhiimsan ee loo haysto fadeexaddii weynayd ee Feeding Our Future, taas oo lagu sheegay mid ka mid ah musuq-maasuqyadii ugu waaweynaa ee dhacay xilligii Covid-19. Eidleh, oo ah Soomaali 42 jir ah, kana soo jeeda magaalada Burnsville ee gobolka Minnesota, ayaa la qabtay 25-kii June, sida ay shaacisay Xafiiska Xeer Ilaaliyaha Mareykanka ee gobolka Minnesota. Dacwad-oogayaasha Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in Eidleh uu ka mid ahaa dadka “hagaha” ka ahaa qorshahan, kaas oo lagu eedeeyey in lagu dhacay boqolaal milyan oo dollar oo loogu talagalay barnaamij federaal ah oo carruurta lagu siin jiray cunto xilligii cudurka Covid-19. Eidleh ayaa markii hore lagu soo oogay dacwad bishii September 2022, waxaana lagu soo eedeeyey 31 qodob oo ay ku jiraan khiyaano dhanka internet-ka ah, laaluush la xiriira barnaamij federaal ah iyo lacag dhaqid. Illaa hadda ma cadda goorta loo gudbin doono Mareykanka si uu u wajaho dacwadaha loo haysto. Doorka NISA Hay’adaha Mareykanka ayaa faahfaahin badan ka bixin sida lagu helay Eidleh iyo qaabkii lagu qabtay, balse waxay sheegeen in howlgalka lagu soo qabtay ay iska kaashadeen FBI-da iyo Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka Soomaaliya ee NISA. Christopher D. Dotson, oo ah madaxa xafiiska FBI-da ee Minneapolis, ayaa sheegay in qabashada Eidleh ay muujineyso awoodda iskaashiga hay’adaha amniga ee Mareykanka iyo kuwa caalamka. “Iskaashiga FBI-da la leedahay hay’adaha amniga ee dunida ayaa mar kale diraya farriin ah in gacanta FBI-da ay gaarto meel fog, isla markaana aan soo qaban doono cid kasta oo baxsad ah, meel kasta oo ay joogto,” ayuu yiri Dotson. Wuxuu sidoo kale si gaar ah ugu mahadceliyey NISA. “FBI-du waxay si dhab ah ugu mahadcelineysaa Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka Soomaaliya dadaalkooda iyo iskaashigooda wanaagsan ee lagu helay laguna qabtay Eidleh, si cadaaladda loo horkeeno,” ayuu yiri. Eedeymo culus Feeding Our Future waxay ahayd hay’ad aan macaash doon ahayn oo fadhigeedu ahaa Minnesota, taas oo maamuli jirtay goobo cunto lagu siinayey carruurta iyada oo ka faa’iideysaneysay barnaamij federaal ah oo la ballaariyey xilligii Covid-19. Dacwad-oogayaasha Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in dad ku xiran hay’addaas ay sameeyeen goobo been abuur ah oo lagu sheegay in maalin kasta lagu quudinayey kumannaan carruur ah, kadibna ay si sharci darro ah ku heleen lacagihii dowladda federaalka. Wasaaradda Cadaaladda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in Feeding Our Future ay furtay in ka badan 250 goobood, isla markaana si khiyaano ah loogu helay loona qaybiyey lacag ka badan 240 milyan oo dollar. Dukumentiyada maxkamadda ayaa sheegaya in Eidleh uu ka shaqeynayey Feeding Our Future, isla markaana uu mas’uul ka ahaa qorista iyo taageeridda qaar ka mid ah goobihii ku hoos shaqeynayey hay’addaas. Dacwad-oogayaasha ayaa sheegay in Eidleh iyo shaqaale kale ay qaadan jireen laaluush iyo lacag celin qarsoodi ah oo ay ka helayeen dad iyo shirkado doonayey in loo oggolaado inay maamulaan goobo cunto oo been abuur ah. Sida ku cad eedeynta, Eidleh ayaa sidoo kale sameystay goobo isaga u gaar ah oo uu ku qariyey magacyo dad kale, wuxuuna sheegtay in goobahaas ay maalin kasta quudinayeen kumannaan carruur ah. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu eedeeyey inuu sameystay shirkado been abuur ah oo loo ekaysiiyey inay cunto ka iibinayeen goobahaas, kadibna uu gudbiyey biilal been abuur ah si uu u helo lacagaha barnaamijka federaalka. Dacwad-oogayaasha ayaa sheegay in Eidleh uu ku shubtay in ka badan 5 milyan oo dollar akoonno ku xirnaa shirkado uu lahaa, si uu u qariyo halka ay lacagtaas ka timid. Fadeexad weyn Kiiskan ayaa ka mid noqday dacwadihii ugu waaweynaa ee musuq-maasuq ee laga furo gobolka Minnesota. Bishii hore, Aimee Bock, oo ahayd aasaasihii iyo agaasimihii Feeding Our Future, ayaa lagu xukumay 500 bilood oo xabsi ah, taas oo u dhiganta in ka badan 41 sano, kadib markii lagu helay doorkeedii hoggaamineed ee fadeexaddan. Waxaa iyada lala xukumay Salim Said, oo horey uga mid ahaa milkiilayaasha maqaayadda Safari Restaurant ee Minnesota. Dacwad-oogayaasha Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in shabakaddan ay si been abuur ah u sheegatay in malaayiin cunto ah la siiyey carruur baahan, balse lacagahaas loo weeciyey dano gaar ah. Wasaaradda Cadaaladda Mareykanka ayaa horey u sheegtay in 78 qof lagu soo oogay dacwado la xiriira baaritaanka Feeding Our Future, halka tobanaan kale lagu helay dambiyo ama ay qirteen. Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa ku tilmaamay kiiskan mid ka mid ah kiisaskii ugu waaweynaa ee la xiriira musuq-maasuqa barnaamijyadii gargaarka Covid-19. Eedeymaha loo haysto Eidleh weli waa dacwad maxkamadeed, waxaana uu sharciga Mareykanka u aqoonsan yahay qof aan dambi lahayn illaa maxkamad ay ku caddeyso. Illaa hadda ma cadda goorta loo gudbin doono Mareykanka si uu u wajaho dacwadaha loo haysto. Doorka NISA Hay’adaha Mareykanka ayaa faahfaahin badan ka bixin sida lagu helay Eidleh iyo qaabkii lagu qabtay, balse waxay sheegeen in howlgalka lagu soo qabtay ay iska kaashadeen FBI-da iyo Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka Soomaaliya ee NISA. Christopher D. Dotson, oo ah madaxa xafiiska FBI-da ee Minneapolis, ayaa sheegay in qabashada Eidleh ay muujineyso awoodda iskaashiga hay’adaha amniga ee Mareykanka iyo kuwa caalamka. “Iskaashiga FBI-da la leedahay hay’adaha amniga ee dunida ayaa mar kale diraya farriin ah in gacanta FBI-da ay gaarto meel fog, isla markaana aan soo qaban doono cid kasta oo baxsad ah, meel kasta oo ay joogto,” ayuu yiri Dotson. Wuxuu sidoo kale si gaar ah ugu mahadceliyey NISA. “FBI-du waxay si dhab ah ugu mahadcelineysaa Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka Soomaaliya dadaalkooda iyo iskaashigooda wanaagsan ee lagu helay laguna qabtay Eidleh, si cadaaladda loo horkeeno,” ayuu yiri. Eedeymo culus Feeding Our Future waxay ahayd hay’ad aan macaash doon ahayn oo fadhigeedu ahaa Minnesota, taas oo maamuli jirtay goobo cunto lagu siinayey carruurta iyada oo ka faa’iideysaneysay barnaamij federaal ah oo la ballaariyey xilligii Covid-19. Dacwad-oogayaasha Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in dad ku xiran hay’addaas ay sameeyeen goobo been abuur ah oo lagu sheegay in maalin kasta lagu quudinayey kumannaan carruur ah, kadibna ay si sharci darro ah ku heleen lacagihii dowladda federaalka. Wasaaradda Cadaaladda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in Feeding Our Future ay furtay in ka badan 250 goobood, isla markaana si khiyaano ah loogu helay loona qaybiyey lacag ka badan 240 milyan oo dollar. Dukumentiyada maxkamadda ayaa sheegaya in Eidleh uu ka shaqeynayey Feeding Our Future, isla markaana uu mas’uul ka ahaa qorista iyo taageeridda qaar ka mid ah goobihii ku hoos shaqeynayey hay’addaas. Dacwad-oogayaasha ayaa sheegay in Eidleh iyo shaqaale kale ay qaadan jireen laaluush iyo lacag celin qarsoodi ah oo ay ka helayeen dad iyo shirkado doonayey in loo oggolaado inay maamulaan goobo cunto oo been abuur ah. Sida ku cad eedeynta, Eidleh ayaa sidoo kale sameystay goobo isaga u gaar ah oo uu ku qariyey magacyo dad kale, wuxuuna sheegtay in goobahaas ay maalin kasta quudinayeen kumannaan carruur ah. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu eedeeyey inuu sameystay shirkado been abuur ah oo loo ekaysiiyey inay cunto ka iibinayeen goobahaas, kadibna uu gudbiyey biilal been abuur ah si uu u helo lacagaha barnaamijka federaalka. Dacwad-oogayaasha ayaa sheegay in Eidleh uu ku shubtay in ka badan 5 milyan oo dollar akoonno ku xirnaa shirkado uu lahaa, si uu u qariyo halka ay lacagtaas ka timid. Fadeexad weyn Kiiskan ayaa ka mid noqday dacwadihii ugu waaweynaa ee musuq-maasuq ee laga furo gobolka Minnesota. Bishii hore, Aimee Bock, oo ahayd aasaasihii iyo agaasimihii Feeding Our Future, ayaa lagu xukumay 500 bilood oo xabsi ah, taas oo u dhiganta in ka badan 41 sano, kadib markii lagu helay doorkeedii hoggaamineed ee fadeexaddan. Waxaa iyada lala xukumay Salim Said, oo horey uga mid ahaa milkiilayaasha maqaayadda Safari Restaurant ee Minnesota. Dacwad-oogayaasha Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in shabakaddan ay si been abuur ah u sheegatay in malaayiin cunto ah la siiyey carruur baahan, balse lacagahaas loo weeciyey dano gaar ah. Wasaaradda Cadaaladda Mareykanka ayaa horey u sheegtay in 78 qof lagu soo oogay dacwado la xiriira baaritaanka Feeding Our Future, halka tobanaan kale lagu helay dambiyo ama ay qirteen. Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa ku tilmaamay kiiskan mid ka mid ah kiisaskii ugu waaweynaa ee la xiriira musuq-maasuqa barnaamijyadii gargaarka Covid-19. Eedeymaha loo haysto Eidleh weli waa dacwad maxkamadeed, waxaana uu sharciga Mareykanka u aqoonsan yahay qof aan dambi lahayn illaa maxkamad ay ku caddeyso. items.title: Xil. Sanbaloolshe oo ku dhaartay inuusan uga hari doonin madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh weerarkii uu ku soo qaaday
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Agaasimihii hore ee hay’adda nabad sugida iyo sirdoonka Qaranka Xildhibaan Cabdullaahi Maxamed Cali ( Sanbaloolshe) ayaa si kulul markale waxa uu uga hadlay weerarkii ciidanka dowladda ku soo qadeen 4-tii bishan Juun, xili uu ku sugnaa guriga xildhibaan Maxamed Abuukar Jacfar ee ku yaalla Muqdisho. Sanbaloolshe ayaa sheegay in guriga ay ku wada sugnaayeen asiga, Ra’iisul wasaarihii hore Xasan Cali Kheyre, Ugaaska beesha Mursade, Ugaaska beesha Abgaal iyo in ka badan 70 Odayaal dhaqan ah, isla markaana ujeedka ay halkaasi u joogeen ay aheyd arrimo ku saabsan xaalada dalka. Sanbaloolshe, ayaa sheegay in haddii diyaarad uu heysan lahaa maalintaas madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu duqeyn lahaa, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Waxa uu tilmaamay in kaliya madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ay ku filneed inuu telefoon u soo diro, isla markaana nagu dhaho meeshan isaga baxa wixii naga dhaxeeya wada-hadalka ayaan ku dhameeyn karnaa, “annaga diyaar ayaan u nahay ayaan dhihi laheyn”. Sidoo kale Sanbalooshe, ayaa ku dhaartay inuusan cafin doonin madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, xitaa haddii ay kasoo wareegto 100 sanno, oo aan laga xalin dhibka loo geystay. Hadalka Agaasimihii hore ee NISA Sanbaloolshe ayaa imaanaya iyada dowladda Soomaaliya ay mucaaradka ku eedeeysay in aysan dooneynin nabada ka jirta magaalada Muqdisho. The post Xil. Sanbaloolshe oo ku dhaartay inuusan uga hari doonin madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh weerarkii uu ku soo qaaday appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Nin ku eedeysan in Mareykanka lacag ka lunsaday oo lagu qabtay Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Dowladda Soomaaliya, ayaa qabatay nin ku eedeeysan in uu malaayin doollar kasoo lunsaday magaalada Minyaabolis ee gobolka Minisoota ee dalka Mareykanka. Madaxa FBI-da ee Minneapolis Christopher D. Dotson ayaa oga mahadceliyay dowladda Soomaaliya soo qabashada Cabdikariim Cabdullaahi Ciidle oo ah muwaadin soomaaliyeed oo khamiista lagu xiray Soomaaliya. “Qabashada Cabdikariim Ciidle waxay fariin u diraysaa dhammaan dadka baxsadka ah: FBI-du waxay awood u leedahay inay raadiso oo ay soo qabato meel kasta oo ay dunida kaga dhuuntaan. Waxaan sidoo kale uga mahadcelineynaa Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabad-sugidda Qaranka Soomaaliya (NISA) wada-shaqeyntii ay ka geysteen soo qabashadiisa.” Ayuu yiri Christopher. Cabdikariim Ciidle ayaa kamid ah Soomaali badan oo lagu soo oogoy dacwado musuq-maasuq oo ka geysteen gudaha Mareykanka. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii dambe la tilmaamay inay ku raad joogtay shaqsigan, iyada oo ugu dambeeyn kusoo qabatay howlgal ay ciidanka nabad sugida ka sameeyeen magaalada Muqdisho. items.title: Xog: Villa Somalia oo xilkii Aadan Madobe u wadda wasiir xiriir xooggan la leh Turkiga
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya ayaa weli isha ku haysa qofka beddeli lahaa guddoomiyihii hore ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, Sheekh Aadan Madoobe, oo waqtigiisii dhammaaday, haatanna noqday madaxweynaha maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Villa Somalia ayaa wajahaysa caqabado ku saabsan qofka ay u dooraneyso guddoomiyaha baarlamaanka ee waqtigiisu dhammaaday, balse sii wadi doona howlaha inta lagu jiro muddada sanad-ku-darsiga ah ee uu oggolaanayo dastuurka cusub ee la meel mariyey. Madaxtooyadu waxay u baahan tahay hoggaan baarlamaan oo fududeeya meel-marinta sharciyada iyo qorshayaasha ay dowladdu damacsan tahay. Waxaa socda olole xooggan oo madaxtooyadu ku dooneyso in uu guuleysto murashaxa ay taageereyso ee loo wado jagadan, kaas oo sidoo kale la sheegay in dowladda Turkiga iyo xulafadeedu ay ku cadaadinayaan Villa Somalia in la hirgeliyo qorshihiisa. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa xubnaha baarlamaanka iyo siyaasiyiinta kasoo jeeda Koonfur Galbeed u bandhigay dalabyo adag oo la xiriira in lagu taageero guddoomiyaha cusub ee baarlamaanka inuu noqdo siyaasiga da’da yar ee xilligan ah wasiirka dekedaha, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Jaamac, oo kursigiisa baarlamaanka si dirqi ah uga soo qaatay deegaan-doorashadiisa. Madaxweynaha cusub ee Koonfur Galbeed iyo guddoomiyaha KMG ah ee Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa la sheegay in culeys lagu saaray sidii loo dhisi lahaa murashaxa Villa Somalia. Taas beddelkeeda, Villa Somalia ayaa ka shaqeyneysa taageerada maamulka cusub ee Koonfur Galbeed. Waxaa soo baxayay warar sheegaya in Sheekh Aadan Madoobe uu markii hore dhaliilsanaa in guddoonka baarlamaanka loo dhiso Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Jaamac, balse markii dambe lagu qanciyey inuu taageero, kadib cadaadis iyo taageero ka timid Turkiga, oo la rumeysan yahay in Wasiir Jaamac uu xiriir adag la leeyahay. Wasiir Jaamac ayaa tan iyo xukuumaddii 2021 ahaa wasiir aan xilkiisa lumin, isagoo xiriir xooggan la lahaa dowladda Turkiga. Hayaankiisa siyaasadeed ayaa kasoo bilowday safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Ankara, kahor inta uusan gaarin heer wasiirnimo. Dadka aadka ugu dhow ee aqoonta u leh Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Jaamac, oo lagu naaneyso “Madaxaa Na-furan”, ayaa aaminsan inuu ka mid yahay shaqsiyaadka ugu dhow dowladda Turkiga, taladana ay ka qaadato. Dadka qaar ayaa ku tilmaama inuu yahay wakiil qarsoon oo Turkigu ku leeyahay Soomaaliya, inkastoo aan arrintaas caddeyn madax-bannaan loo hayn. items.title: Labo Qof oo ku Dhaawacmay Qarax ka Dhacay Magaalada Jowhar
items.description: Ugu yaraan laba qof ayaa ku dhaawacmay qarax miino oo maanta ka dhacay Kontoroolka Koofureed ee magaalada Jowhar, xarunta Dowlad Goboleedka HirShabeelle. Sida ay sheegeen ilo deegaanka ah, qaraxa ayaa ka dhacay agagaarka kontoroolka, waxaana dhaawac soo gaaray laba qof oo ku sugnaa goobta xilliga uu qaraxu dhacay. Ciidamada ammaanka ayaa si degdeg ah u gaaray goobta, iyagoo billaabay howlgallo lagu baarayo sababta qaraxa iyo cidda ka dambeysay. Ilaa iyo hadda ma jiro war rasmi ah oo ka soo baxay laamaha ammaanka ee HirShabeelle oo faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka bixiyay dhacdada. Baaritaannada ayaa weli socda, mana jirto cid si rasmi ah u sheegatay mas’uuliyadda qaraxa.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Ka Jawaabay Eedeymaha Midowga Yurub ee Masaafurinta Soomaalida
items.description: Madaxweynaha dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa gaashaanka ku dhuftay eedeymaha ka yimid dhanka Golaha Midowga Yurub ee la xiriira in dowladda Soomaaliya ay diiddo muwaadiniinteeda laga soo masaafuriyo qaaradda Yurub. Madaxweynaha oo ka hadlayay munaasabaddii xuska Maalinta Xorriyadda ee ka dhacday magaalada Muqdisho, ayaa hoosta ka xariiqay in mowqifka Soomaaliya uu yahay mid cad, isla markaana aan marnaba muwaadin Soomaaliyeed loo diidi karin dalkiisa hooyo. “Waxaa nala yiri Midowga Yurub wuxuu xayiraad dhanka visaha ah ku soo rogay Soomaalida, iyagoo leh Soomaaliya waxay diidday muwaadiniinteeda. Tani ma aha wax jira,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. “Muwaadin Soomaaliyeed laguma diidi karo dalkiisa, annaguna ma diideyno.” Madaxweynaha ayaa caddeeyey in is-maandhaafka rasmiga ah ee u dhaxeeya labada dhinac uusan ahayn diidmo, balse uu yahay mid la xiriira hubinta aqoonsiga dhabta ah (Identity Verification) ee dadka la rabo in dalka lagu soo celiyo. Wuxuu tilmaamay inay jiraan dad badan oo wata dhalashooyin kale ama ka soo jeeda dalal kale laakiin magaca Soomaalida ku qaatay magangalyo, marka dambena la doonayo in dalka lagu soo celiyo. “Waxaan rabnaa inaan marka hore xaqiijinno in dadka la soo masaafuriyey ay dhab ahaantii yihiin muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed. Haddii ay yihiin, waan soo dhoweyneynaa, haddii kalena, waa in lagu celiyo waddankoodii rasmiga ahaa,” ayuu raaciyey Madaxweynuhu. items.title: Wasiirro katirsan XFS oo Baladweyne kaga qeyb galay xuska sannad guuradii 49-aad ee xornimada dalka Jabuuti
items.description: Baladweyne ( Raxanreeb Online) Wafdi uu hoggaaminayo Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Axmed Macalin Fiqi, ayaa magaalada Beledweyne kaga qeyb galay munaasabadda lagu xusay 49-guurada ka soo wareegtay maalintii Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti ay xornimada ka qaadatay gumeysigii Faransiiska. Wafdiga waxaa ka mid ahaa Safiirka Jabuuti u fadhiya Soomaaliya Cismaan Dubad, Wasiirka Wasaaradda Warfaafinta Soomaaliya Cabdifitaax Qaasim Maxamuud, Wasiiru-Dowlaha Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha XFS, Maxamed Cali Xagaa, xildhibaanno ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, masuuliyiin ka socday Dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabeelle, Hobollada Qaranka ee Waaberi iyo masuuliyiin kale. Munaasabadda oo ka dhacday xarunta Ciidamada Jabuuti ee qeybta ka ah Howlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM) ee magaalada Beledweyne, ayaa lagu maamuusay 49-guurada xornimada Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti. Sidoo kale, waxaa lagu xusay doorkii taariikhiga ahaa ee Soomaaliya ka qaadatay halgankii ay Jabuuti uga xoroobaysay gumeysigii Faransiiska iyo xiriirka walaaltinimo iyo iskaashiga soo jireenka ah ee ka dhexeeya labada dal. items.title: DF oo wafdi wasiirro ah u dirtay Beledweyne + Ujeedka
items.description: Beledweyne (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta wafdi wasirro ah oo uu hoggaaminayo Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Axmed Macallin Fiqi u dirtay magaalada Beledweyne ee xarunta gobolka Hiiraan, halkaas oo ay uga qayb-galeen munaasabad lagu xusay 49-guurada ka soo wareegtay maalintii Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti ay xornimada ka qaadatay gumeysigii Faransiiska. Wafdigan oo ka baxay Muqdisho ayaa waxaa qayb ka ahaa Wasiirka Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska XFS Mudane Cabdifitaax Qaasim Maxamuud, Wasiiru-Dowlaha Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha XFS, Mudane Maxamed Cali Xagaa, Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti u fadhiya Soomaaliya Cismaan Dubad, Xildhibaanno ka tirsan Baarlamaanka, masuuliyiin ka socday Dowlad-goboleedka HirShabeelle, Hobollada Waaberi iyo masuuliyiin kale. Xuska dabaal-degga maalintan qaran ayaa lagu qabtay xarunta Ciidamada Jabuuti ee qeybta ka ah Howlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AUSSOM) ee magaalada Beledweyne, iyada oo si gaar ah loo maamuusay 49-guurada xornimada Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti. Sidoo kale, waxaa munaasabadda lagu xusay doorkii taariikhiga ahaa ee Soomaaliya ka qaadatay halgankii ay Jabuuti uga xoroobaysay gumeysigii Faransiiska iyo xiriirka walaaltinimo iyo iskaashiga soo jireenka ah ee ka dhexeeya labada dal. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo isna haatan booqasho ku jooga dalka Jabuuti ayaa lagu casuumay ka qayb-galka munaasabadda qaran ee xuska 49 sano guurada kasoo wareegatay markii dalkaasi xorriyaddiisa ka qaatay gumeystihii Faransiiska, waqtigaasi oo ku beegan 27-kii bishii Juun, sanadkii 1977-dii. Dalka Jabuuti oo ah walaalka dhabta ah ee Soomaaliya ayaa mar kasta hiil la garab taagan DFS iyo shacabkeeda, gaar ahaan dowlad dhiska Soomaaliya. Si kastaba, waxaa todobaadkan lagu jiraa maalmaha qaran ee xorriyadda Soomaaliya, iyada oo habeen hore loo dabaal-dagay 26-ka June oo a markii ay xoreebeen gobollada Waqooyi, waxaa sidoo kale hadda la’isku diyaarinayaa xuska kowda Luulyo oo iyana ku beegan markii ay xoreebeen gobollada Koonfureed, ayna midoobeen gobollada Waqooyi iyo Koonfur ee Soomaaliya. items.title: Mareykanka oo duqeymo bartilmaameed ah ka fuliyay Iran
items.description: Milatariga Mareykanka ayaa duqeymo ku qaaday bartilmaameedyo Iiraan ah ka dib markii Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu ku eedeeyay Iiraan “jabin doqonnimo ah” oo ay kula kacday xabbad-joojintii u dhexaysay, taas oo ka dambaysay weerar lagu qaaday markab xamuul ah oo marayay Marinka Hormuz. Ma jirin wax khasaare ah oo laga soo sheegay markii markabka ay haleeshay diyaarad nooca aan duuliyaha lahayn ee ismiidaamisa ah, dhacdadaas oo keentay qorshe lagu daadgureynayo kumanaan badmaaxayaal ah oo ku xayirmay. Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka (Centcom) ayaa sheegay jawaab celin hawshaas ah in maalintii Jimcaha inay weerareen goobihii lagu kaydinayay gantaalaha iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, iyo weliba saldhigyada raadaarka ee xeebaha. Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan (IRGC) ayaa ku eedeeyay Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil. Waxyar ka hor intaan lagu dhawaaqin duqeymaha, Trump ayaa yiri “waad arki doontaan” markii la weydiiyay in Mareykanku uu ka aarsan doono oo weeraryo Iiraan. Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka – ama Centcom – ayaa ku sifeeyay duqeymahaas “jawaab xooggan” oo laga bixiyay weerarkii diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. “Gardarrada aan sababta lahayn ee ka dhanka ah maraakiibta ganacsiga ee ay geysteen ciidamada Iiraan waxay si cad u jabisay xabbad-joojinta,” ayaa lagu sheegay bayaan ka soo baxay Taliska Mareykanka. Centcom ayaa sheegtay in milatariga Mareykanka ay “sii wadi doonaan bixinta isku-duwidda marinka nabdoon iyo taageerada maraakiibta ganacsiga ee maraya marinka.” The post Mareykanka oo duqeymo bartilmaameed ah ka fuliyay Iran appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Somalia hit with EU visa restrictions as bloc pressures Mogadishu over migrant readmissions
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – The European Union has imposed new visa restrictions on Somali citizens, intensifying a growing dispute with Mogadishu over the return of Somalis living irregularly in Europe. EU member states approved the measures on Thursday after reviewing a European Commission assessment that found Somalia’s cooperation on readmitting nationals whose applications to remain in Europe had been rejected was insufficient. Under the new rules, member states will no longer issue multiple-entry visas to Somali citizens. The visa fee waiver previously available to holders of Somali diplomatic passports has also been removed, while the standard processing time for visa applications has been extended from 15 days to 45 days. The restrictions have no fixed end date and are intended to encourage stronger cooperation on migrant readmissions. Speaking during Somalia’s Independence Day celebrations on Thursday, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud rejected suggestions that Somalia was refusing to accept its own citizens. “We haven’t rejected our people; they own this country. And we cannot reject them,” the president said. Mohamud said Somalia’s concerns relate to the identification of returnees rather than opposition to repatriation itself. He argued that people from across the Horn of Africa often share similar physical characteristics and that some migrants have falsely identified themselves as Somali while seeking asylum in Europe. The president cited previous cases in which individuals returned to Somalia were later found not to be Somali nationals, including some who were unable to speak the Somali language. “If they are Somali, then we’ll take them. If they aren’t, we’ll help you find out where they are from, and you can send them there,” Mohamud said. According to the president, Somali embassies have been instructed to assist nationals returning home, while the prime minister’s office regularly handles repatriation matters. The dispute comes as Somalia continues efforts to recover from decades of conflict and instability following the collapse of the central government in 1991 and the civil war that followed. The security challenges and economic hardships facing many communities have pushed large numbers of Somalis to seek opportunities abroad, with many attempting the dangerous migration route toward Europe through Libya, where migrants have frequently faced detention, exploitation, extortion and violence. EU Migration Commissioner Magnus Brunner defended the bloc’s position, saying countries of origin must fulfill their obligations regarding the return of nationals who no longer have the legal right to remain in Europe. “Otherwise, there can be consequences,” Brunner said. Somalia joins a small group of countries subjected to such visa measures by the European Union. Similar restrictions were imposed on The Gambia in 2021 and Ethiopia in 2024. The EU lifted restrictions on Ethiopia in May after concluding that cooperation on readmissions had improved. The latest decision adds to mounting travel challenges facing Somali citizens. In 2025, the United States implemented a broad travel ban affecting nationals from several countries, including Somalia, after President Donald Trump returned to office. The policy attracted international attention this month when Omar Abdulkadir Artan, Africa’s Referee of the Year for 2025, was denied entry to the United States and was unable to officiate at the World Cup despite holding a valid visa. The standoff between Brussels and Mogadishu comes as the European Union pursues a broader effort to tighten migration controls, including plans for return centers outside EU territory and faster deportation procedures for individuals whose requests to remain in Europe have been denied. items.fullContent: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – The European Union has imposed new visa restrictions on Somali citizens, intensifying a growing dispute with Mogadishu over the return of Somalis living irregularly in Europe. EU member states approved the measures on Thursday after reviewing a European Commission assessment that found Somalia’s cooperation on readmitting nationals whose applications to remain in Europe had been rejected was insufficient. Under the new rules, member states will no longer issue multiple-entry visas to Somali citizens. The visa fee waiver previously available to holders of Somali diplomatic passports has also been removed, while the standard processing time for visa applications has been extended from 15 days to 45 days. The restrictions have no fixed end date and are intended to encourage stronger cooperation on migrant readmissions. Speaking during Somalia’s Independence Day celebrations on Thursday, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud rejected suggestions that Somalia was refusing to accept its own citizens. “We haven’t rejected our people; they own this country. And we cannot reject them,” the president said. Mohamud said Somalia’s concerns relate to the identification of returnees rather than opposition to repatriation itself. He argued that people from across the Horn of Africa often share similar physical characteristics and that some migrants have falsely identified themselves as Somali while seeking asylum in Europe. The president cited previous cases in which individuals returned to Somalia were later found not to be Somali nationals, including some who were unable to speak the Somali language. “If they are Somali, then we’ll take them. If they aren’t, we’ll help you find out where they are from, and you can send them there,” Mohamud said. According to the president, Somali embassies have been instructed to assist nationals returning home, while the prime minister’s office regularly handles repatriation matters. The dispute comes as Somalia continues efforts to recover from decades of conflict and instability following the collapse of the central government in 1991 and the civil war that followed. The security challenges and economic hardships facing many communities have pushed large numbers of Somalis to seek opportunities abroad, with many attempting the dangerous migration route toward Europe through Libya, where migrants have frequently faced detention, exploitation, extortion and violence. EU Migration Commissioner Magnus Brunner defended the bloc’s position, saying countries of origin must fulfill their obligations regarding the return of nationals who no longer have the legal right to remain in Europe. “Otherwise, there can be consequences,” Brunner said. Somalia joins a small group of countries subjected to such visa measures by the European Union. Similar restrictions were imposed on The Gambia in 2021 and Ethiopia in 2024. items.title: Duqeymo culus oo ka dhacay Sh/Dhexe + Khasaaraha
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa faah-faahin dheeraad ah ka bixisay howlgalladii ugu dambeeyay ee lagu beegsaday kooxda Al-Shabaab, gaar ahaan duqeymo is xig-xigay oo ka dhacay deegaanno ka tirsan gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe ee Maamul-Goboleedka HirShabelle. Howlgalladan oo ay iska kaashadeen Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo saaxibada caalamiga ah ayaa si gaar ah uga dhacay deegaannada Gayfo, Ruun Idiris iyo Cali Gaduud, halkaas oo Khawaarijtu ka sameysatay xarumo abaabul, goobo tababar iyo meelo ay ku kaydsanayeen hub, rasaas iyo saanad ciidan. Weerarkii ugu horreeyay oo dhacay 24-kii bishan, ayaa lagu bartilmaameedsaday xarun abaabul oo Khawaarijtu ku lahayd deegaanka Gayfo, halkaas oo lagu beegsaday maleeshiyaadkii ku sugnaa goobta iyo hubkii ay halkaas ku kaydsanaayeen. Sidoo kale, 25-kii bishan ayaa la fuliyay saddex duqeyn oo is xigxigay, kuwaas oo lagu burburiyay xarun tababar oo Khawaarijtu ku lahayd deegaanka Ruun Idiris. Duqeyn kale ayaa sidoo kale lagu bartilmaameedsaday deegaanka Cali Gaduud, halkaas oo ay ku sugnaayeen maleeshiyaad hubeysan oo kooxda u diyaarisay fulinta falal argagixisanimo. Sida ay sheegtay dowladda Soomaaliya duqeymahan ayaa lagu dilay ku dhowaad 30 dhagarqabe oo ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab. Sidoo kale, waxaa lagu burburiyay laba gaari, saddex mooto, hub, rasaas iyo saanad kale oo ay kooxdu u adeegsan jirtay abaabulka iyo fulinta falalka argagixisanimo. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa lagu sheegay in howlgalladan ay sii socon doonaan, iyada oo u mahadcelisay saaxibada caalamiga ah ee ka qayb qaatay dagaalka lagula jiro argagixisada. “Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga iyo Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed waxay mar kale xaqiijinayaan in howlgallada lagu ciribtirayo Khawaarijta ay si joogto ah uga sii socon doonaan dhammaan deegaannada ay ku dhuumaaleysanayaan, si loo xaqiijiyo amniga, xasilloonida iyo nabadda shacabka Soomaaliyeed,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Waxaa kale oo lasii raaciyey “Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga waxay uga mahadcelinaysaa saaxiibada caalamka ee Soomaaliya kala shaqeeya la dagaallanka argagixisada, kuwaas oo door muuqda ka qaatay taageerada howlgalladan”. The post Duqeymo culus oo ka dhacay Sh/Dhexe + Khasaaraha appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo ka qeyb-galaya dabaal-degga 49-guurada Xorriyadda Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa ka qeyb-galaya munaasabad ballaaran oo lagu xusayo 49 sano guuradii ka soo wareegtay markii Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti ay xorriyadda ka qaadatay Faransiiska 27-kii Juun 1977. Munaasabaddan oo ka dhaceysa fagaaraha caanka ah ee Al Houriya Square ee magaalada Jabuuti, ayaa waxaa kasoo qeyb-galaya madax heer qaran iyo marti sharaf caalami ah, iyadoo lagu soo bandhigi doono bandhigyo dhaqameed, madadaalo iyo barnaamijyo muujinaya midnimada iyo waddaniyadda shacabka Jabuuti. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa la filayaa inuu khudbad ka jeediyo munaasabadda, isagoo hambalyo u diraya dowladda iyo shacabka walaalaha ah ee Jabuuti munaasabadda maalinta xorriyadda, isla markaana adkeynaya xiriirka taariikhiga ah iyo iskaashiga dhow ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti. Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti oo ah labo dal oo walaalo ah ayaa leh xariir qoto-dheer oo dhaqan iyo dhalasho wadaag iyo dano istiraatiiji ah, ayadoo Soomaaliya ay kaalin weyn ku lahayd halgankii xoraynta Jabuuti oo markii hore Xeebta Soomaaliyeed lagu magacaabi jirey.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Mareykanka u Gacan-gelisay Eedaysane Loo Heysto Is-daba-marintii “Feeding Our Future”
items.description: Xafiiska Xeer-ilaalinta Federaalka Mareykanka ee gobolka Minnesota ayaa si rasmi ah u shaaciyey in gacanta lagu soo dhigay, isla markaana dalka Mareykanka loo soo gacan-geliyey Cabdikariim Cabdilaahi Iidle, oo 42 jir ah, kaas oo ahaa mid ka mid ah eedeysanayaashii ugu weynaa ee kiiskii is-daba-marinta maaliyadeed ee barnaamijkii nafaqeynta carruurta ee “Feeding Our Future”. Cabdikariin Cabdallaahi iidle ayaa Juun-kii 25, 2026, lagu qabtay magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimadda Soomaaliya, ka dib hawlgal ay iska kaashadeen hay’adda FBI-da Mareykanka iyo Hay’adda Nabadsugidda iyo Sirdoonka Qaranka Soomaaliya ee NISA. Eedaysanaha ayaa muddo ku dhow afar sano ahaa baxsad, isagoo gabbaad ka dhiganayay gudaha dalka Soomaaliya tan iyo markii dacwado rasmi ah lagu soo oogay bishii Sebtembar 2022. Hadda waxaa si toos ah loogu celiyey gobolka Minnesota si uu u wajaho garsoorka. Maxaa loo Heystaa Eedaysanaha? Sida ku cad dukumentiyada maxkamadda, Abdikerm Eidleh wuxuu ahaa shaqaale ka tirsan ururkii Feeding Our Future, wuxuuna mas’uul ka ahaa qoritaanka iyo oggolaanshaha goobaha raashinka laga qeybiyo. Waxaa lagu eedeeyey inuu lacago laaluush iyoaluush ah ka qaatay shirkado raba inay si sharci darro ah ku furaan xarumo raashin, isagoo adeegsanayay shirkado been abuur ah (shell companies) si uu u qariyo lacagtaas. Intaas waxaa dheer, Eidleh ayaa la sheegay inuu isagu shakhsiyan u samaystay goobo been abuur ah oo uu ku andacooday inay maalin kasta raashin siiyaan kumanaan carruur ah. Waxaa la xaqiijiyey inuu akoonnada shirkadihiisa been abuurka ah ku shubtay lacag ka badan $5 milyan oo doollar oo laga xaday barnaamijka nafaqeynta carruurta danyarta ah xilligii COVID-19. Xeer-ilaaliyaha Guud ee Minnesota, Daniel N. Rosen, iyo madaxa xafiiska FBI-da ee Minneapolis, Christopher D. Dotson, ayaa si weyn u bogaadiyey wadashaqeynta hay’adda sirdoonka Soomaaliya (NISA), iyagoo sheegay inay muujisay in caddaaladdu ay gaari karto meel kasta oo ay tuugada shidaalka iyo hantida dadweynaha ku dhuuntaan. Qabashada eedaysanahan ayaa ku soo aadaysa xilli dhowaan Wasaaradda Caddaaladda Mareykanka ay ku dhowaqay dhismaha Qaybta Qaranka ee Fulinta Sharciga Musuqmaasuqa (National Fraud Enforcement Division), taas oo qeyb ka ah dadaalka ballaaran ee dowladda Madaxweyne Trump iyo guddiga uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka J.D. Vance ee lagu ciribtirayo wax-is-daba-marinta hantida dowladda federaalka. Kiiskan “Feeding Our Future” ayaa ah kii ugu weynaa ee musuqmaasuq oo ka dhaca taariikhda Minnesota, iyadoo guud ahaan lagu xaday lacag ka badan $250 milyan oo doollar.

items.title: Maraykanka oo duqaymo ka gaystay goobo Iran ka mid ah kadib….
items.description: Milatariga Mareykanka ayaa duqeymo ku qaaday bartilmaameedyo Iiraan ah ka dib markii Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu ku eedeeyay Iiraan “jabin doqonnimo ah” oo ay kula kacday xabbad-joojintii u dhexaysay, taas oo ka dambaysay weerar lagu qaaday markab xamuul ah oo marayay Marinka Hormuz. Ma jirin wax khasaare ah oo laga soo sheegay markii markabka ay haleeshay diyaarad nooca aan duuliyaha lahayn ee ismiidaamisa ah, dhacdadaas oo keentay qorshe lagu daadgureynayo kumanaan badmaaxayaal ah oo ku xayirmay. Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka (Centcom) ayaa sheegay jawaab celin hawshaas ah in maalintii Jimcaha inay weerareen goobihii lagu kaydinayay gantaalaha iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, iyo weliba saldhigyada raadaarka ee xeebaha. Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan (IRGC) ayaa ku eedeeyay Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil. Waxyar ka hor intaan lagu dhawaaqin duqeymaha, Trump ayaa yiri “waad arki doontaan” markii la weydiiyay in Mareykanku uu ka aarsan doono oo weeraryo Iiraan. Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka – ama Centcom – ayaa ku sifeeyay duqeymahaas “jawaab xooggan” oo laga bixiyay weerarkii diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. “Gardarrada aan sababta lahayn ee ka dhanka ah maraakiibta ganacsiga ee ay geysteen ciidamada Iiraan waxay si cad u jabisay xabbad-joojinta,” ayaa lagu sheegay bayaan ka soo baxay. “Intaas waxaa sii dheer, hab-dhaqanka khatarta ah ee Iiraan wuxuu dhaawacay xorriyadda marinka badda xilli ganacsigu uu si sii kordhaysa u dhexmarayo marinka muhiimka ah ee ganacsiga caalamiga ah.” Centcom ayaa sheegtay in milatariga Mareykanka ay “sii wadi doonaan bixinta isku-duwidda marinka nabdoon iyo taageerada maraakiibta ganacsiga ee maraya marinka.” IRGC ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay dambeeyay Jimcihii ku sheegtay: “Nidaamka Mareykanka ee heshiis-jebiyaha ah ayaa sidii caadada u ahaydba ku xad-gudbay ballamihii uu qaaday, wuxuuna duqeyn dhanka cirka ah ku qaaday xeebaha Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan, isagoo qiil ka dhiganaya marmarsiiyo kala duwan oo ku saabsan markab ku xad-gudbay marin aan la oggolayn oo ku yaalla Marinka Hormuz.” Waxay ku dartay: “Haddii gardarrada lagu soo celiyo, jawaabtayadu waxay noqon doontaa mid ka ballaadhan tan.” IRGC waxay sidoo kale ku eedeysay “nidaamka Sahyuuniyadda” – oo loola jeedo Israa’iil – inay jabisay xabbad-joojinta Lubnaan. Tani waxay ku soo aadday xilli Israa’iil iyo Lubnaan ay Washington ku kala saxiixdeen heshiis ku meelgaadh ah oo ku saabsan qorshe nabadeed maalintii Jimcaha. Dagaal xaddidan ayaa dhowaanahan ka sii socday koonfurta Lubnaan oo ay isku horfadhiyeen ciidamada Israa’iil iyo ururka Xisbullah ee ay Iiraan taageerto, in kasta oo ay jirtay xabbad-joojin hore u jirtay. Tehran waxay si wax ku ool ah u xidhay marinka ka dib markii weerarada Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ee ka dhanka ah Iiraan ay bilowdeen dhammaadkii bishii Febraayo. Xidhtaanka marinka muhiimka ah ee shixnadaha saliidda iyo gaaska ayaa sababay kor u kac ku yimid qiimaha saliidda adduunka, waxayna xanibaad ku keentay shixnadaha agabka kale ee muhiimka ah sida bacriminta. Bbc somali

Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka – ama Centcom – ayaa ku sifeeyay duqeymahaas “jawaab xooggan” oo laga bixiyay weerarkii diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. “Gardarrada aan sababta lahayn ee ka dhanka ah maraakiibta ganacsiga ee ay geysteen ciidamada Iiraan waxay si cad u jabisay xabbad-joojinta,” ayaa lagu sheegay bayaan ka soo baxay. “Intaas waxaa sii dheer, hab-dhaqanka khatarta ah ee Iiraan wuxuu dhaawacay xorriyadda marinka badda xilli ganacsigu uu si sii kordhaysa u dhexmarayo marinka muhiimka ah ee ganacsiga caalamiga ah.” Centcom ayaa sheegtay in milatariga Mareykanka ay “sii wadi doonaan bixinta isku-duwidda marinka nabdoon iyo taageerada maraakiibta ganacsiga ee maraya marinka.” IRGC ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay dambeeyay Jimcihii ku sheegtay: “Nidaamka Mareykanka ee heshiis-jebiyaha ah ayaa sidii caadada u ahaydba ku xad-gudbay ballamihii uu qaaday, wuxuuna duqeyn dhanka cirka ah ku qaaday xeebaha Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan, isagoo qiil ka dhiganaya marmarsiiyo kala duwan oo ku saabsan markab ku xad-gudbay marin aan la oggolayn oo ku yaalla Marinka Hormuz.” Waxay ku dartay: “Haddii gardarrada lagu soo celiyo, jawaabtayadu waxay noqon doontaa mid ka ballaadhan tan.” IRGC waxay sidoo kale ku eedeysay “nidaamka Sahyuuniyadda” – oo loola jeedo Israa’iil – inay jabisay xabbad-joojinta Lubnaan. Tani waxay ku soo aadday xilli Israa’iil iyo Lubnaan ay Washington ku kala saxiixdeen heshiis ku meelgaadh ah oo ku saabsan qorshe nabadeed maalintii Jimcaha. Dagaal xaddidan ayaa dhowaanahan ka sii socday koonfurta Lubnaan oo ay isku horfadhiyeen ciidamada Israa’iil iyo ururka Xisbullah ee ay Iiraan taageerto, in kasta oo ay jirtay xabbad-joojin hore u jirtay. Tehran waxay si wax ku ool ah u xidhay marinka ka dib markii weerarada Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ee ka dhanka ah Iiraan ay bilowdeen dhammaadkii bishii Febraayo. Xidhtaanka marinka muhiimka ah ee shixnadaha saliidda iyo gaaska ayaa sababay kor u kac ku yimid qiimaha saliidda adduunka, waxayna xanibaad ku keentay shixnadaha agabka kale ee muhiimka ah sida bacriminta. items.title: FBI arrests fugitive Abdikerm Eidleh in Somalia over massive Minnesota fraud scheme
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Abdikerm Eidleh, an alleged senior figure in the sprawling $250 million Feeding Our Future fraud scheme in Minnesota, was arrested Thursday in Somalia’s capital Mogadishu during a joint operation conducted by the FBI and Somali intelligence agencies, according to U.S. federal officials. The arrest marks a major development in one of the largest pandemic-era fraud investigations in U.S. history and comes more than four years after Eidleh allegedly fled while federal authorities expanded their probe into the scheme. Eidleh, 42, was indicted in September 2022 as part of the federal Feeding Our Future investigation, a case that prosecutors say involved the fraudulent diversion of millions of dollars intended for child nutrition programs during the COVID-19 pandemic. U.S. Attorney for Minnesota Daniel Rosen described Eidleh as a central figure in the operation. “This is a big fish,” Rosen told CBS News. “Eidleh was a key leader and was responsible for bribing and recruiting business to steal from the American taxpayer.” According to federal prosecutors, Eidleh served as the second-in-command to Aimee Bock, the convicted founder of Feeding Our Future, who was recently sentenced to more than 40 years in prison. Investigators allege that Eidleh personally collected approximately $5 million in bribes and kickbacks after directing restaurants and catering businesses to inflate receipts and reimbursement claims submitted to the Minnesota Department of Education. Federal prosecutors have charged Eidleh with wire fraud, federal programs bribery, money laundering, and conspiracy. Authorities said the operation that led to his capture demonstrated the continued international reach of the investigation and the cooperation between U.S. and Somali law enforcement agencies. “This shows the global reach and outstretched arm of American law enforcement,” said Christopher Dotson, Special Agent in Charge of FBI Minneapolis. “Somalia is not the safe haven you may think it is.” The Feeding Our Future investigation has become one of the most significant fraud prosecutions to emerge from the pandemic era. Federal authorities have charged 79 individuals in connection with the case, the majority of whom are of Somali descent. Prosecutors say 66 defendants have either been convicted or pleaded guilty. The case centers on allegations that funds intended to provide meals to children were fraudulently claimed through a network of businesses and individuals seeking reimbursement for meals that prosecutors allege were never served. Beyond Feeding Our Future, federal authorities have also pursued numerous investigations into alleged fraud involving taxpayer-funded programs across Minnesota, including childcare, housing, and behavioral health services. Rosen previously stated that the total scale of fraud involving Minnesota social service programs could exceed $1 billion, making it one of the most consequential public fraud investigations in the state’s history. “The chapter for Feeding Our Future might be closing, but we’re still in the beginning of making sure we protect the American taxpayer,” Rosen said. The arrest of Abdikerm Eidleh in Mogadishu represents one of the most significant enforcement actions in the Feeding Our Future case since the convictions of several high-profile defendants and signals that authorities remain committed to pursuing individuals accused of participating in the massive fraud scheme regardless of where they are located. items.title: Muxuu Guddiga Xuquuqul Insaanka ka yiri dhacdadii Ari-Caddeeye iyo Jalalaqsi?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Madaxa Bannaan ee Xuquuqul Insaanka Qaranka oo warsaxaafadeed soo saaray ayaa ka hadlay dhacdooyin argagax leh oo ka dhacay deegaanka Ari-Caddeeye ee gobolka Sool iyo degmada Jalalaqsi ee gobolka Hiiraan, oo siyaabo kala duwan loogu dilay dad rayid ah. Guddiga ayaa cambaareeyay dhacdadii deegaanka Ari-Caddeeye, kadib markii maleeshiyaad hubeysan ay laayeen dad shacab ah oo gaaraya illaa 21 qof, isla markaana ay ku jiraan carruur iyo dad waayeel ah, kuwaas oo si aan kala sooc lahayn loogu dilay. Sidoo kale, wuxuu guddigu ka hadlay 10-kii qof ee ku dhintay dagaal beeleedka degmada Jalalaqsi iyo guryihii shacabka ee lagu gubay halkaasi. “Guddigu wuxuu si dhow ula socday xaaladaha labada dhacdo ee Ari Caddeeye iyo Jalalaqsi, isagoo qiimeyn hordhac ah ku sameeyay xogaha la helay. War-saxaafadeedkani wuxuu ku salaysan yahay qiimeyntaas hordhaca ah, iyadoo Guddigu sii wadi doono la socodka xaaladda iyo wadashaqeynta hay’adaha iyo dhinacyada ay khusayso, si waafaqsan waajibaadkiisa” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Hoos ka akhriso warsaxaafadeedka oo dhammaystiram;- Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Xuquuqul Insaanka Qaranka Soomaaliyeed (GMXIQ) wuxuu si adag u cambaareynayaa falkii arxan darrada ahaa ee lagu laayay dadka rayidka ah ee Ari-Caddeeye, Gobolka Sool, halkaas oo ugu yaraan 21 qof oo rayid ah, oo ay ku jiraan carruur iyo dad waayeel ah, si aan kala sooc lahayn loogu dilay. Guddigu wuxuu sidoo kale cambaareynayaa rabshadihii ka dhacay Degmada Jalalaqsi, Gobolka Hiiraan, oo ay ku dhinteen ugu yaraan 10 qof, laguna gubay guryo ay lahaayeen dad rayid ah. Guddigu wuxuu si weyn uga walaacsan yahay beegsiga dadka rayidka ah, burburinta hantidooda, barakaca qoysaska iyo saameynta culus ee bini’aadanimo ee ka dhalatay falalkaasi. Guddigu wuxuu si dhow ula socday xaaladaha labada dhacdo ee Ari Caddeeye iyo Jalalaqsi, isagoo qiimeyn hordhac ah ku sameeyay xogaha la helay. War-saxaafadeedkani wuxuu ku salaysan yahay qiimeyntaas hordhaca ah, iyadoo Guddigu sii wadi doono la socodka xaaladda iyo wadashaqeynta hay’adaha iyo dhinacyada ay khusayso, si waafaqsan waajibaadkiisa. GMXIQ wuxuu ku baaqayaa in si degdeg ah loo joojiyo colaadaha, dhammaan dhinacyaduna muujiyaan isxakameyn, ilaaliyaan dadka rayidka ah iyo hantidooda, isla markaana u hoggaansamaan waajibaadkooda ku cad Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, sharciyada caalamiga ah ee xuquuqul insaanka iyo sharciga caalamiga ah ee bani’aadannimada. Guddigu wuxuu ugu baaqayaa hay’adaha awoodda u leh ee Maamul Gobolleedka Waqooyi Bari inay sameeyaan baaritaanno degdeg ah, madax-bannaan, dhexdhexaad ah oo hufan, si loo xaqiijiyo isla xisaabtan loogana jawaabo baahiyaha bini’aadannimo ee qoysaska ay saameeyeen dhacdooyinkani. GMXIQ wuxuu sidoo kale ugu baaqayaa odayaasha dhaqanka, culimada, haweenka, dhallinyarada iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha bulshada inay laba jibaaraan dadaallada lagu dejinayo xiisadaha, laguna xoojinayo wada hadalka iyo dib-u-heshiisiinta, si loo gaaro xal nabadeed oo waara. Ugu dambeyn, Guddigu wuxuu tacsi tiiraanyo leh u dirayaa ehellada iyo qoysaska ay ka geeriyoodeen dadkii lagu dilay rabshadahaasi, wuxuuna caafimaad degdeg ah u rajeynayaa dhammaan dhaawacyada. Sidoo kale, GMXIQ wuxuu mar kale adkeynayaa sida ay uga go’an tahay horumarinta nabadda, ilaalinta xuquuqda aadanaha iyo ka hortagga colaadaha ka dhaca Soomaaliya. The post Muxuu Guddiga Xuquuqul Insaanka ka yiri dhacdadii Ari-Caddeeye iyo Jalalaqsi? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Sawirro: Xiriirka Kuwait oo si weyn usoo dhoweeyey Cartan
items.description: Kuwait (Caasimada Online) – Garsooraha caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliyeed, Cumar Cartan, ayaa gaaray dalka Kuwait, halkaas oo uu ku dhexdhexaadin doono kulanka adag ee horyaalka Zain Premier League ee dhex mari doona Kuwait SC iyo Al-Qadsiya. Ciyaartan ayaa sidoo kale noqon doonta mid kooxda Kuwait SC loogu caleema saarayo koobka horyaalka dalkaas. Cumar Cartan ayaa dalka Kuwait ku gaaray martiqaad rasmi ah oo uu ka helay Guddoomiyaha Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Kuwait, Sheekh Axmed Al-Yuusuf. Waxaa loo doortay inuu dhexdhexaadiyo ciyaarta u dhexeysa kooxaha Kuwait SC iyo Al-Qadsiya, oo la ciyaari doono 29-ka Juun 2026, taasoo ka mid ah kulamada ugu dambeeya ee horyaalka Zain Premier League. Markii uu gaaray Kuwait, waxaa si rasmi ah u soo dhaweeyay Safiirka Soomaaliya u fadhiya dalkaas, Cabdullaahi Maxamed Sheekh, mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Kuwait, iyo wakiillo ka socday shirkadda Al Shaayic. Hore, Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Yurub ee UEFA ayaa ku dhawaaqay in garsoore Cumar Cartan uu dhexdhexaadin doono ciyaarta weyn ee Super Cup-ka, taasoo dhex mari doonta kooxaha Paris Saint-Germain iyo Aston Villa. Cartan ayaa sidoo kale loo doortay inuu ka mid noqdo garsoorayaasha matalaya qaaradda Afrika ee Koobka Adduunka. Hase yeeshee, waxaa garoonka caalamiga ah ee Miami ku celisay Hay’adda Kastamka iyo Ilaalinta Xuduudaha Mareykanka ee CBP, waxaana dib loogu celiyay dalka Turkiga. Cumar Cartan waxaa si weyn loogu aqoonsan yahay mid ka mid ah garsoorayaasha ugu fiican Afrika. Wuxuu qarka u saarnaa inuu noqdo garsoorihii ugu horreeyay ee Soomaaliyeed ee abid dalkiisa uga qeyb gala Koobka Adduunka. Waxaa sidoo kale loo magacaabay mid ka mid ah garsoorayaasha ugu fiican qaaradda, isagoo hore u soo maamulay laba ciyaarood oo ka tirsan Koobka Qaramada Afrika. items.title: Hawlgalka Gobolka Jubbada Hoose oo si xowle ah ku socda
items.description: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo garabsanaya Daraawiishta Jubbaland ayaa weli dagaal adag kula jira maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, iyadoona hawlgalka Gobolka Jubbada Hoose uu maanta galay toddobaadkiisii saddexaad. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamadu ay dhaqdhaqaaqyo xoogan ka wadaan dhulka hawdka ee ku xeeran deegaanada Harboole, Dhasheeg Waamo iyo Miido. Ciidamada ayaa hawlgal dhul iyo cir ah ku beegsanaya deegaanada hoostaga Degmada Afmadow iyo qaar ka mid ah deegaanada kale ee hoostaga Degmada Jilib ee Gobolka Jubbada Dhexe. Hawlgalka dhulka ayaa waxaa barbar socda duqaymo dhanka cirka ah, oo looga gol leeyahay in Shabaabka looga kiciyo goobaha ay dhufeysyada ku leeyihiin. Hawlgalkan oo si xowli ah ku socda ayaa Shabaabka lagaga sifeynayaa dhulka hawdka, waxaana lagu burburiyay saldhigyo iyo godad ay ku dhuumaaleysanayeen. Dhanka kale Ciidamada Militariga iyo Daraawiishta Jubbaland oo ay horkacayaan Kumaandooska Danab ayaa ku sii guurguuranaya xuduudda Gobolada Jubbooyinka. Wararka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in ciidamadu ay ku dhow yihiin deegaanka Qalaawilaha, oo ah deegaan istiraatiiji ah, isla-markaana isku xira Afmadow iyo Jilib oo ka kala tirsan Gobolada Jubbada Hoose iyo Jubbada Dhexe. Deegaanka Qalaawilaha oo sidoo kale loo yaqaano (Isgoyska Qalaawilaha) ayaa waxaa mara waddooyinka ka baxa, isla-markaana gala Degmada Jilib, waana marin muhiim u ah isu socodka Labada Jubba. Qalaawilaha ayaa xiriiriya deegaanada u dhaxeeya Jilib iyo deegaanka Janaay Cabdalle oo hoostaga Afmadow, iyadoo Janaay Cabdalle uu kala qaybiyo Afmadow iyo Kismaayo. Wasiirka Amniga Jubbaland, General Yuusuf Xuseen Cismaan (Dhuumaal) iyo Taliyaha Ciidanka Daraawiishta Jubbaland, General Ismaaciil Saxardiid Keydsane ayaa ciidamada siiyay amar ah inay hore u socdaan mooyee aanay dib u soo laaban karin. Saraakiisha hoggaamineysa hawlgalkan ayaa sheegaya in uu hadafkoodu yahay inay xoreeyaan Magaalada Bu’aale ee Xarunta Gobolka Jubbada Dhexe. Gobolkan ayaa ah kan keliya ee dalka ee ay Shabaabku gacanta ku wada hayaan. Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Jubbaland, Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe) ayaa hawlgalkan kala socda Magaalada Kismaayo, waxaana si joogta ah warbixin looga siiyaa halka uu marayo. Ciidamo cusub oo 14-kii bishan tababar loogu soo xiray Kismaayo ayaa dhiig cusub ku shubay hawlgalkan.
