items.title: Puntland bans Somalia government officials from entering region
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s Puntland authorities on Wednesday announced sweeping security measures targeting federal government activities inside the region, barring federal officials from entry, restricting the movement of militias allied with politicians aligned with Mogadishu and warning against the transport of weapons into the region, in the latest escalation of an increasingly bitter dispute with the Somali federal government. In a statement issued by Puntland’s Ministry of Security, regional authorities prohibited the federal government from recruiting troops and militias from Puntland, warning that anyone found engaging in such activities would face accountability. The ministry also ordered that technical vehicles operated by militias allied with the federal government be prevented from moving within the region, underscoring Puntland’s efforts to tighten security controls across its territory. Regional authorities further declared that “individuals holding security ranks or official positions within the federal government who seek to create instability or unrest in Puntland will not be allowed to enter any part of the region through its borders or airports.” The measures also included a directive targeting piracy. Puntland said anyone involved in piracy activities would face legal action, while security forces were instructed to apprehend suspects and seize the weapons used in such operations. Authorities additionally prohibited political meetings deemed aimed at undermining Puntland, warning that organizers and participants would be held accountable under the law. In a separate warning, Puntland cautioned the federal government against airlifting what it described as “illegal weapons” into Puntland through airports located in the region. The administration also warned aircraft operators against transporting such weapons, stating that any aircraft harmed while carrying them would bear sole responsibility. The announcement comes after Somaliguardian recently reported that Puntland had deployed large numbers of fresh troops across major cities and security checkpoints in an effort to prevent federal government-allied forces from moving between key urban centers in the region. The latest measures signal a further deterioration in relations between Puntland and Somalia’s federal government, with analysts warning that the growing military deployments, movement restrictions and increasingly confrontational rhetoric are bringing both sides closer to a potential armed conflict. The developments mark one of the most significant security escalations in recent months between Puntland and authorities in Mogadishu, highlighting the widening divide between the regional administration and Somalia’s federal government as tensions continue to intensify. items.title: Somali Prime Minister Arrives in Dhusamareb as Push for One-Person, One-Vote Elections Intensifies
items.description: Dhusamareb (WDN) – Somali Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre arrived in Dhusamareb as part of Villa Somalia’s broader strategy to consolidate its influence across the Federal Member States by installing loyal allies within regional leadership structures. Following the installation of Adan Mohamed Nur (Adan Madobe) as the new leader of South West State, attention now appears to be shifting toward Galmudug, where Hassan Sheikh is expected to play an active and key role in shaping the political landscape and influencing the selection of the state’s next leadership. The Prime Minister landed at Ugaas Noor Airport, where he was received by senior federal and regional officials, military commanders, and representatives from various sectors of Galmudug society. Hamze’s visit comes at a politically sensitive moment, as negotiations continue over the future of elections in Galmudug and the broader implementation of Somalia’s proposed one-person, one-vote electoral model. During his stay, Prime Minister Hamza is expected to hold a series of meetings with Galmudug President Ahmed Abdi Kariye “Qoor Qoor,” regional leaders, traditional elders, civil society representatives, and other influential stakeholders. The discussions are expected to focus on political reconciliation and electoral preparations. The visit follows weeks of intense political consultations in Dhusamareb involving senior federal officials, including National Intelligence and Security Agency (NISA) Director Mahad Salad, who has reportedly been engaged in efforts to bridge differences over the region’s electoral roadmap. Security across Dhusamareb has been significantly reinforced ahead of the Prime Minister’s arrival. Additional security personnel have been deployed throughout the city, while key government facilities and public locations remain under heightened protection. The Federal Government has been investing considerable political capital in its campaign to introduce direct elections across the country. Following electoral exercises previously conducted in Mogadishu and South West State, federal authorities are now seeking to expand the model to Galmudug, viewing the regional state as a critical component of the broader electoral reform agenda. Supporters of the initiative argue that one-person, one-vote elections would represent a major step toward democratization and greater public participation in governance. Critics, however, remain concerned about political consensus, implementation challenges, and the potential impact on regional stability if disputes over the process remain unresolved. As discussions continue behind closed doors, many residents of Galmudug are closely watching developments, aware that the decisions reached during the Prime Minister’s visit could have far-reaching implications for the region’s political future. For now, Dhusamareb has become the focal point of Somalia’s latest political negotiations, with federal and regional leaders seeking common ground on a process that could shape the next chapter of governance and elections in Galmudug. items.title: Libya’s eastern government bans entry for citizens of Sudan, Eritrea, Ethiopia and Somalia
items.description: CAIRO (AP) — Authorities based in the eastern part of divided Libya have banned entry for people from four nearby African countries, a move likely meant to stem the influx of migrants seeking to set off for Europe from the country’s northern coast. Libya’s coast is a key departure points for migrants from North Africa trying to reach European shores for a better life there. They are typically packed by smugglers into small and unsafe boats, with thousands dying during the perilous sea journey. The ban, announced late Tuesday, says citizens of Sudan, Eritrea, Ethiopia and Somalia are “prohibited from entering Libyan territory through all land, sea, and air ports.” The government statement said exemptions will be made for diplomats and workers in health and education sectors. Separately, tensions have risen in the last few months in both eastern and western Libya against the resettlement of refugees from other countries. There have been mass crackdowns on refugees with thousands arrested, according to Amnesty International. https://f8bb785a753ed701a033152b162ef56d.safeframe.googlesyndication.com/safeframe/1-0-45/html/container.html According to the United Nations, there are more than 900,000 migrants and refugees in Libya, with Sudanese being the biggest group. Many of these migrants are vying for Europe but boats are regularly intercepted and sent back to Libya. The migrants end up held in government-run detention centers known for abuses, including forced labor, beatings, rapes and torture — practices that amount to crimes against humanity, according to U.N.-commissioned investigators. Libya plunged into chaos after the NATO-backed toppling of its autocratic leader Moammar Gadhafi in 2011. The country is now run by two governments, one based in the west, the other in the east. items.title: Maamulka Waqooyi Bari oo qaaday tallaabo muhiim ah kadib dagaalkii Ari-Caddeeye
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Dowlad-goboleedka Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in xaaladda deegaanka Ari-Caddeeye ee gobolka Sool ay haatan deggan tahay kadib dagaal beeleed khasaare xooggan geystay oo sababay dhimashada in ka badan 20 qof iyo dhaawaca tiro kale oo badan. Maamulka ayaa sheegay in dadaallo lagu xasilinayo xaaladda ay si rasmi ah u socdaan, iyadoo ciidamada ammaanka iyo mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda loo diray deegaanka si loo sugo amniga loogana hortago in dagaalladu dib u qarxaan. Wasiir Ku-xigeenka Arrimaha Gudaha Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya, Cali Axmed Cali, ayaa sheegay in maamulka uu si dhow ula socdo xaaladda deegaanka, isla markaana uu wado dadaallo lagu kala dhexgelinayo beelaha ay dirirtu dhex martay. Wuxuu xusay in khilaaf hore oo ka jiray deegaanka la xalliyay, balse ay mar kale soo cusboonaatay xiisad kale. “Waxaan u ballansaneyn inaan tii hore xallinno, laakiin qaddar ayaa dhacday,” ayuu yiri wasiir ku-xigeenka, isaga oo tilmaamay in dowladda ay sii wadi doonto dadaallada lagu soo afjarayo colaadda. Dagaalka Ari-Caddeeye ayaa la sheegay inuu salka ku hayo aanooyin qabiil oo muddo dheer soo jiitamayay. Xiisaddan ayaa dib u soo cusboonaatay kadib dhacdo lagu beegsaday laba nin oo safar ahaa, taas oo horseedday iska horimaadkii ugu dambeeyay ee deegaanka ka dhacay. Dadaallo hore oo ay hormuud ka ahaayeen odayaasha dhaqanka, culimada iyo waxgaradka deegaanka ayaa lagu doonayay in lagu xalliyo khilaafka. Hase yeeshee, isku dayadaas ayaa guul buuxda laga gaari waayay, iyadoo colaaddu mar kale dib u qaraxday. Suldaan Mustafe Maxamuud Aw-Seed oo ka mid ah salaadiinta dhaqanka ee beesha Fiqishini ayaa sheegay in dadka ku dhintay dagaalka ay ku jiraan haween, carruur iyo waayeel, isaga oo ku tilmaamay dhacdada musiibo naxdin leh. “Sida aan warku ku hayo, 24 qof ayaa ku dhintay,” ayuu yiri suldaanka. Dhankiisa, Garaad Mukhtaar Garaad Cali Buraale oo ka mid ah madax-dhaqameedka beesha Dhulbahante ayaa sheegay in odayaasha dhaqanku ay ka argagaxeen tirada dadka lagu aasay deegaanka, isaga oo ku baaqay in si degdeg ah loo joojiyo colaadda lana qaado tallaabooyin dib loogu soo celinayo nabadda iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada deegaanka. The post Maamulka Waqooyi Bari oo qaaday tallaabo muhiim ah kadib dagaalkii Ari-Caddeeye appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay dagaalka Gobolka Jubbada Hoose
items.description: Militariga Somaliya iyo Xoogaga Daraawiishta Jubbaland ayaa sii wada gulufka dagaal ee ay dhulka cusub kaga qabsanayaan maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ee ka socdo galbeedka Gobolka Jubbada Hoose. Ciidamada ayaa haatan isku fidinaya dhulka hawdka ee deegaanada Harboole iyo Dhasheeg Waamo oo hoostaga Degmada Afmadow, iyagoo taageero ka helaya diyaaradaha dagaalka ee saaxiibada caalamiga ah. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in toddobaadkii labaad ay dhinacyadu si xiriir ah ugu dagaalamayaan gobolka, isla-markaana ay isku adeegsanayaan hubka noocyadiisa kala duwan. Shabaabka ayaa isku dayaya in ay iska caabiyaan weerarka lagu hayo, si aan goobo hor leh looga qabsan, balse sii socoshada cadaadiska kaga imanaya ciidamada uu ku khasbayo in ay difaacyadooda qaar isaga baxaan. Ciidamada ayaa isku ballaarinaya dhufeysyada iyo godadka ay difaac ahaanta Shabaabku uga sameysteen dhulka hawdka ee ay dhowr iyo tobankii sano ee u dambeeyay ay ku sugnaayeen. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in Ciidanka Gaarka ee Kumaandooska Danab ay Talaadadii waddo ka furteen deegaanka Horboole, isla-markaana ay cagta saareen waddada laamiga ee aadda deegaanka Mareerey, halkaas oo uu ka soo gudbayo gurmadka ugu badan ee Shabaabka, iyagoo ka soo tallaabaya Webiga Jubba ee mara deegaankaasi. Ciidamada ayaa waxa uu ujeedkoodu uu u muuqdaa in ay kala jaraan Shabaabka lagu la dagaalamayo aagagga Harboole iyo Dhasheeg Waamo iyo gurmadkooda ka soo gudbaya Mareerey ee ka imanaya dhinaca Degmada Jilib ee Gobolka Jubbada Dhexe. Ciidamada oo toddobaadkii hore gudaha u galay deegaanada Miido iyo Harboole ayaa xilligaasi ku guuleystay inay go’doomiyaan maleeshiyaad ka tirsan kuwa Al Shabaab oo lagu ciriiriyay hawdka deegaanada Miido iyo Harboole, taasna ay keentay in culeysku uu u wareego dhinaca Dhasheeg Waamo oo xudunta dagaalka ah, Shabaabkuna ay gurmad u soo diraan jiidaha hore. Cadaadiskan militari ee lagu hayo maleeshiyada ayaa Shabaabka ku riixay inay gurmad ka keenaan dhinaca Degmada Jilib, si ay ciidamada dagaal cusub uga furaan aagaggaasi, isla-markaana ay u fashiliyaan hawlgalka Dhasheeg Waamo, laakiin aanu gurmadkoodu waxba ka bedelin istiraatiijiyadda ay ciidamadu ku hawlgelayaan. Shabaabka oo gacanta ku haya min Mareerey illaa Jilib ayaa weli ku foogan, sidii ay uga hortagi lahaayeen in laga qabsado Dhasheeg Waamo oo deegaan istiraatiiji ah, kana mid ah meelaha ay ka ilaaliyaan amniga Jilib. Dhasheeg Waamo ayaa ahmiyad dhanka istiraatiijiyadda iyo maamulka u leh Al Shabaab, waana deegaan leh dhul kaymo iyo harooyin biyo, waana deegaan isku xira Afmadow oo Gobolka Jubbada Hoose ah iyo Jilib oo Gobolka Jubbada Dhexe ah.

items.title: Puntland oo ku dhawaaqday go’aan uga sii daraya xiisadda kala dhexeysa DF Soomaaliya
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Amniga Puntland oo warsaxaafadeed kasoo saartay shir ku saabsan amniga deegaannada maamulkaas ayaa ku dhawaaqday go’aanno xasaasi ah oo uga sii dari kara xiisadda siyaasadeed ee haatan kala dhexeysa Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Ugu horreyn Puntland ayaa deegaanadeeda ka mamnuucday siyaasiyiinta iyo saraakiisha Federaalka, waxayna sababta ku sheegtay inay ka hortegayso in la qalqal-geliyo amniga deegaannada maamulkaasi. “Dadka magacaaban ee darajooyinka iyo xilalka ka haya Dowladda Federaalka oo raba inay qas iyo dhibaato ka abuuraan Puntland kama soo geli karaan dhammaan xuduudaha iyo garoomada Puntland,” ayaa lagu yiri go’aanka. Puntland ayaa si toos ah Dowladda Soomaaliya ugu eedeysay inay hub ku daabuleyso deegaanno kamid ah maamulkaas, iyada oo sheegtay inay ka dajineyso garoomada, waxayna digniin u dirtay diyaaraha tega deegaannadeeda. “Waxaan Dowladda Federaalka uga digeynaa hubka sharci darrada ah oo ay kusoo daabuleyso gudaha deegaanada Puntland , kana soo dajineyso garoomada. Sidoo kale waxaan uga digeynaa in aysan diyaaradaha soo qaadin hub sharci darro ah, diyaaraddii soo qaadda wixii soo gaara ayadaa mas’uul ka ah,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka kasoo baxay Puntland. Sidoo kale, Puntland ayaa deegaannadeeda ka mamnuucday in dhaq-dhaqaaq ay ka sameeyaan maleeshiyaadka hubeysan, sidoo kalena ciidamo laga qorto. “Waxaa la mamnuucay in ciidamo maleeshiyaad ah Puntland laga dhex qorto ciddii qorta iyo maleeshiyaadkaas waxaa laga qaadayaa tallaabo sharci ah,” ayaa la sii raaciyay bayaanka kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Amniga Puntland. Si kastaba, go’aankan ayaa u muuqda mid uu maamulka Puntland oo xiisad siyaasadeed kala dhaxeyso hoggaanka Dowladda Federaalka uga hortagayo dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan oo ay dowladda ka sameyso deegaanno ka tirsan Puntland, xilli ay maalmihii u dambeeyay waday qorshe lagu doonayay in dib loogu hawlgeliyo cutubyo ka tirsan ciidanka xoogga oo hore ugu sugnaa deegaannadaas.   The post Puntland oo ku dhawaaqday go’aan uga sii daraya xiisadda kala dhexeysa DF Soomaaliya appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Qiimaha Dahabka dunida oo si weyn Hoos ugu Dhacay
items.description: Suuqyada caalamiga ah ayaa maanta laga diiwaangeliyay hoos u dhac weyn oo ku yimid qiimaha dahabka, iyadoo wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters ay sheegtay in dahabku uu galay khasaarihii ugu weynaa tan iyo bishii Nofeembar 2025. Warbixinta ayaa tilmaamaysa in qiimaha dahabka ee hal oonsi uu dib uga soo laabtay heerarkii sare ee uu gaaray toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay, isagoo hadda ka hooseeya $4,000. Hoos u dhacan ayaa lala xiriirinayaa isbeddellada ka socda suuqyada maaliyadda, kororka kalsoonida maalgashadayaasha iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ku yimid sarifka lacagaha caalamiga ah. Dahabka ayaa inta badan loo arkaa hab maaliyadeed ammaan ah oo ay maalgashadayaashu lacagahooda dhigtaan marka ay jiraan hubanti la’aan dhaqaale ama xiisado siyaasadeed. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, khubarada dhaqaalaha ayaa sheegaya in isbeddellada cusub ee suuqa ay sababeen in dalabka dahabka uu yaraado, taas oo horseeday hoos u dhaca qiimihiisa.

items.title: Muxuu daarranyahay Safarka Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre ee Dhuusamareeb ?
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa maanta safar shaqo ku gaaray magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee caasimadda Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug, halkaas oo la filayo inuu maalmaha soo socda ku sugnaan doono. Safarka Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa la xiriira dadaallada lagu xoojinayo dowlad-dhiska, amniga iyo wada-shaqeynta u dhaxeysa Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug. Inta uu ku sugan yahay Dhuusamareeb, Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa kulammo la qaadan doona madaxda Galmudug iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada, si loo dardargeliyo arrimaha horumarinta iyo xasilloonida deegaanka. Sidoo kale, safarkan ayaa imanaya xilli ay jireen madmadow siyaasadeed oo dhowaan soo kala dhexgalay hoggaanka Galmudug iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Wararka siyaasadeed ayaa tilmaamaya in kulammada la filayo inay diiradda saaraan xoojinta wada-shaqeynta iyo xal u helidda arrimaha taagan. Dhinaca kale, waxaa jira saadaal ah in Galmudug ay noqon karto maamulka labaad ee lagu sameeyo isbeddel siyaasadeed, kaddib doorashadii dhowaan ka dhacday Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, inkastoo aan weli si rasmi ah loo shaacin qorshe arrintaas la xiriira.

items.title: The Digital Sovereignty Trap
items.description: The Digital Sovereignty Trap The U.N. wants every nation to build its own AI stack. It is the surest way to stay a generation behind. Author: U.S. Under Secretary of State for Economic Affairs Jacob Helberg These days, few words flatter a government like “digital sovereignty.” It carries the music of independence, the dignity of self-rule, the promise that a nation holds its own destiny in its hands. So it is no surprise that the expression has been pressed into the service of a fashionable, fast-spreading policy debate. Thanks for reading U.S. Department of State! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work. Many countries have looked to the United Nations to be the great evangelist of that idea. Through its Global Digital Compact and the funds and machinery that some are trying to assemble around it, the organization presses toward a world in which every country commands what the Secretary-General’s own reports call an “irreducible minimum” of artificial intelligence—its own computers, its own data, its own models, raised at home and owned at home. A secretariat-proposed multibillion-dollar fund would help pay for the building. And a growing number of governments, persuaded that independence requires duplication, are drafting national AI strategies to match—each resolved to rebuild, inside its own borders, a stack that already exists somewhere else. It is a seductive vision. It is also backward and counterproductive. Silicon Valley leaders have built fortunes on a heresy that traditional industry leaders still resist: that competition for existing products and methods, far from being the engine of prosperity, is more often the graveyard of growth and the path to stagnation. The company that copies an existing product and follows traditional methods walks into a crowded market and watches its margins bleed toward zero because a hundred rivals are selling the same thing. The company that builds something genuinely new—something that did not exist the day before—faces no competition at all and keeps the profits to show for it. The second company sees its profits go from zero to one, as it is has created a new market. The first reduces both the profits of the first and its own. Only the innovators create new wealth for societies. Now apply the heresy to nations. Picture the conference—there is always a conference—where forty governments rise in turn to pledge a sovereign cloud, a sovereign model, a national champion of their very own. They will applaud one another’s independence. Then they will go home and pour billions into companies built to do precisely what thirty-nine others are doing, in markets too small to sustain even one of them, chasing margins that thin asymptotically toward nothing the moment the next champion is announced. They will have achieved not so-called “digital sovereignty” but a kind of synchronized mediocrity—a planet of subscale clones, each heroically reconstructing last year’s breakthrough while the breakthrough itself moves on without them. While others rebuild the present, American firms will be inventing the future. They will not be defending yesterday’s platform; they will be shipping tomorrow’s—the products that do not yet exist, that no committee in Geneva has thought to subsidize, that will define the coming decade before the clones have finished cloning the last one. And because they will stand alone at the frontier, they will keep what the frontier pays: the fat margins, the soaring valuations, the commanding heights of the global economy. That is not an accident of American luck. It is the iron arithmetic of zero to one. This is the distinction the sovereignty evangelists miss, and it is the whole game. A nation is not digitally sovereign because it can reproduce yesterday’s breakthroughs—half the world can do that. It is digitally sovereign because it can contribute to tomorrow’s. Call it innovation sovereignty: the power not to copy what exists, but to create what does not. The autarkist measures his strength by how much he can wall off and rebuild. The innovator measures his by how much he can invent that which no one else can. One ends the decade with a museum. The other ends it owning the future. America learned the lesson the easy way. When the world moved to 5G, the United States had no national champion to build the radios and base stations at the network’s core. It could have declared a digital sovereignty emergency and burned a fortune standing up a domestic equipment maker from scratch. It did nothing of the kind. Instead, American companies bought the gear from trusted allies and turned their genius loose on the layer above: the cloud, the software, the artificial intelligence that now runs the world. America did not win the future by manufacturing the antenna. It won by building everything that travels through it. This is the logic behind Pax Silica. We did not build it as a fortress. We built it as a coalition of capabilities—a way for nations that trust one another to find the best technology wherever it lives among them and to braid those strengths together. The premise is simple and old: trusted partners trading on their advantages accomplish what no walled-off nation can manage alone. One partner’s compute meets another’s minerals, a third’s talent, a fourth’s capital, and the result is not a sum but a multiplication. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has lately pressed a point the digital sovereignty evangelists would do well to absorb: the prize was never a frontier model but a frontier ecosystem—one built so that value flows outward, to every company and industry and country it touches, instead of pooling in the hands of whoever happens to own the silicon. The great platforms have always given away more than they kept; they create more wealth above them than they capture within. And what each nation keeps for itself, atop that shared foundation, is the one asset no rival can copy and no committee can subsidize into being: its own learning loop—the accumulated knowledge of its firms and its institutions, compounding with every problem it solves, its human capital and its machine capital gaining on each other turn by turn. A country does not become digitally sovereign by hoarding a model that will be obsolete within the year. It becomes digitally sovereign by owning the loop that turns its own experience into advantage. Ecosystems, in the end, do not merely add; they empower the builders—the people who will actually invent what comes next, and who need partners and markets and momentum, not borders drawn around a problem already solved. The champions of digital sovereignty believe they are arming their nations for the future. In truth they are marching them, in perfect and well-funded formation, into the past. Digital sovereignty was never a wall, and it was never a copy. It was always a frontier—and the only nations that will be digitally sovereign in the age of intelligence are the ones bold enough to keep pushing it outward, into the territory no one has built yet. Jacob Helberg is U.S. Under Secretary of State for Economic Affairs and the architect of the Pax Silica initiative. Thanks for reading U.S. Department of State! items.title: Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Somaliland oo maanta qaabilay
items.description: Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, ahna ku-simaha Madaxweynaha, Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi ayaa maanta Qasriga Madaxtooyada JSL kulan kula yeeshay Safiir Ku-xigeenka Dawladda Federaalka Jarmalka Marwo Katrin Josten, oo booqasho rasmi ah ku timid Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Kulanka waxa Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka ku wehelinayey Wasiirka Madaxtooyada, Safiirka Idman ee u fadhiya Israa’iil, Afhayeenka Madaxweynaha JSL, Agaasimaha Guud ee Arrimaha Dibedda iyo Xoghayaha Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka. Kulanka ayaa lagaga wada hadlay xoojinta xidhiidhka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Somaliland iyo Dawladda Jarmalka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada horumarinta kaabeyaasha nolosha bulshada, oo ay ka mid yihiin biyaha, waxbarashada, beeraha iyo waddooyinka. items.title: Somaliland oo war kasoo saartay shacabkii lagu laayay Ari-Caddeeye
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Golaha Somaliland Mudane Yaasiin Xaaji Maxamuud Xiir (Faratoon) iyo qaar kamid ah xubnaha Guurtida iyo Wakiilada ee laga soo doorto gobolka Sool ayaa ka hadlay dagaalkii ka dhacay deegaanka Ari-Caddeeye ee dadka badan lagu laayay, kadib markii la beegsaday dad shacab ah oo ay ku jiraan carruur, haween iyo dad da’ah. Guddoomiye Faratoon oo ka hadlay shirka jaraa’id ayaa xusay in Somaliland ay ka xun taay dhacdadaasi, maadaama la laayay dad gaaraya illaa 21 qof. “Annaga oo ah xubnihii goleyaasha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliand Guurtida iyo Golaha Wakiilada ee laga soo doortay gobolka waxaynu aad iyo aad uga xunahay oo aan halkan ka direynaa tacsi murugo leh oo aan ku tacsiyeyneyno dadkii walaalaha ahaa ee halkaa wada daganaa mashaqada ka dhex dhacday iyo geerida faraha badan leh ee halkaa ka dhacday,” ayuu yiri Faratoon. Guddoomiyaha oo hadalkiisa sii wata ayaa sidoo kale baaq u diray beelaha labada dhinac, wuxuuna ka dalbaday inay is xakameeyaan, isla markaana wada-hadal iyo deganaan ay ku dhameeyaan falka dhacay. “Waxaan ugu baaqeynaa dadkaas walaalaha ee aan kala maaranmeyn mashaqooyinka waa iska dhacaan in halkaa arrinta lagu hakiyo oo lagu joojiyo, sababtoo ah wax aan laga heshiin kareyn ma jiro,” ayuu markale yiri. Sidoo kale, wuxuu kusii daray “Haddii ay sii socdaan nolol dambe jiri meyso wax isku ahaansho ma jirto, halkaas ayay kasii bilaabaneysaa dhibaato kale”. Xaaladda deegaanka Ari-Caddeeye ee gobolka Sool ayaa hadda deggan, waxaana la wareegay ciidamada ammaanka ee Maamulka Waqooyi Bari, kadib markii gudaha magaalada laga saaray maleeshiyaadka labada beelood, waxaana haatan socdo baaritaano iyo dadaallo ay wadaan waxgaradka deegaanka. Dagaalkan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli gobolka Sool ay marar kala duwan ka dhacayeen xiisado iyo dilal la xiriira aanooyin hore iyo khilaafaad deegaan, iyadoo shacabka deegaanku ay ka cabsi qabaan in xaaladdu mar kale faraha ka baxdo haddii aan xal degdeg ah laga gaarin. The post Somaliland oo war kasoo saartay shacabkii lagu laayay Ari-Caddeeye appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Puntland Bans Unauthorised Armed Forces Amid Rising Tensions with Mogadishu
items.description: GAROWE— Puntland authorities have raised concerns over what they described as an alleged plan to undermine security and stability in the region, accusing Somalia’s Federal Government of facilitating the movement of weapons into Puntland. In a statement, the Puntland administration claimed that the weapons could be used to fuel armed confrontations, provoke clan tensions, and create broader security instability across areas under its control. The administration also announced a ban on the presence of any armed groups or forces not operating under Puntland’s official security institutions. It said security agencies had been instructed to strengthen border monitoring and closely track movements that could pose a threat to public safety. Puntland officials further alleged that the Federal Government, with the support of unnamed foreign actors, was pursuing efforts aimed at creating political divisions and triggering clan-based conflict in the region. They said similar attempts had been made in the past but had failed. The administration said it remains committed to safeguarding peace, stability, and public order, warning that it would not tolerate any activity that threatens the security of Puntland. The accusations come amid worsening political tensions between Puntland and the Federal Government, with analysts noting that the current dispute reflects long-standing disagreements over governance, federalism, security coordination, and political authority. The Federal Government has not yet publicly responded to Puntland’s latest allegations. items.title: Raysal Wasaaraha Xukuumadda oo gaaray Magaalada Dhuusamareeb (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Raysal Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka, Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa maanta gaaray Magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee Xarunta Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug, ka dib dhowr jeer oo dib-u-dhac ah. Raysal Wasaaraha Somaliya ayaa si diiran loogu soo dhaweeyay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Ugaas Nuur, iyadoona ay halkaasi ku soo dhaweeyeen Madaxweynaha Galmudug, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoorqoor), Agaasimaha Hay’adda Nabad Sugidda & Sirdoonka Qaranka (NISA), Mahad Maxamed Salaad, xubno ka tirsan Golaha Wasiirada & Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka Galmudug, Saraakiisha Ciidamada Qalabka Sida iyo bulshada qaybaheeda kala duwan. Raysal Wasaaraha ayaa intaasi ka dib loo gelbiyay Xarunta Madaxtooyada Galmudug, isagoona maalmaha soo socda sii joogi doona Dhuusamareeb, sida lagu sheegay war ka soo baxay xafiiskiisa. “Safarka Raysal Wasaare Xamse ayaa daaran xoojinta dowlad-dhiska , isaga oo inta uu joogo Magaalada Dhuusamareeb kulamo la qaadan doona Hoggaanka Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Safarka Raysal Wasaare Barre ee Dhuusamareeb ayaa imanaya, iyadoo uu weli taagan yahay khilaafka Dowladda Federaalka iyo Galmudug ee la xiriira hannaanka Maamulka iyo Doorashooyinka Galmudug.

items.title: Puntland oo ka Mamnuucday Mas’uuliyiinta iyo Ciidamada Federaalka ah Deegaannadeeda
items.description: Maamulka Puntland ayaa soo saaray war-saxaafadeed cusub oo ay ku shaacisay tallaabooyin amni iyo siyaasadeed oo adag, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan mamnuucid lagu soo rogay mas’uuliyiinta ciidamada iyo siyaasiyiinta Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee lagu eedeeyay inay qalalaase ka abuuri karaan deegaannada Puntland. War-saxaafadeedka ayaa lagu sheegay in aan Puntland gudaheeda lagu qaban karin shirar ama dhaqdhaqaaqyo ay wadaan maleeshiyaad sharci-darro ah, isla markaana cid kasta oo ku lug yeelata arrimahaas lala tiigsan doono sharciga. Sidoo kale, Puntland ayaa sheegtay in aan deegaannadeeda lagu oggolaan doonin joogitaanka ciidan aan hoos imanayn maamulka Puntland, iyadoo dowladda Federaalka looga digay in aysan soo daabulin ciidamo ama hub aan sharci ahayn gudaha Puntland. Go’aannadan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay magaalada Garoowe ku kulmayaan siyaasiyiin mucaarad ah, isla markaana ay soo baxayeen warar la xiriira dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan oo la sheegay inay xiriir la leeyihiin Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Puntland waxay sidoo kale ku baaqday in la ixtiraamo nidaamka amniga iyo maamulka ka jira deegaannadeeda, iyadoo sheegtay in cid kasta oo ku xadgudubta amniga ama xasilloonida Puntland laga qaadi doono tallaabooyin sharci ah. Go’aannadan cusub ayaa la filayaa inay saameyn ku yeeshaan xiriirka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, xilli ay jiraan khilaafaad siyaasadeed oo labada dhinac u dhexeeya.

items.title: Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza oo gaaray Dhuusamareeb + Sawirro
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa maanta gaaray magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee caasimada Galmudug, halkaas oo ay kusoo dhaweeyeen Madaxweyne Qoor Qoor, Mahad Salaad iyo mas’uuliyiin kale oo isugu jiro heer federaal iyo heer dowlad goboleed intaba. Ujeedka safarka Ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa la xiriira sidii loo dhammeyn lahaa khilaafka ka taagan doorashooyinka, wuxuuna la kulmi doonaa Madaxweyne Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoor Qoor), si loo soo afjaro xiisadda labada dhinac. Safarkana ayaa horay loo sii qorsheeyay, iyada oo Galmudug ay si weyn ugu diyaar garowday soo dhaweynta Ra’iisul wasaaraha iyo wafdigiisa. Sidoo kale ammaanka ayaa aad loo adkeeyay, iyada oo ciidamo dheeraad ah la dhigay meelaha muhiimka ah ee Dhuusamareeb, si ay u sugaan amniga guud. Waxaa sidoo kale, magaalada horay ugu sugnaa Agaasimaha Hay’adda NISA, Mahad Maxamed Salaad oo wada-hadallo dhowr wareeg ah la galay Madaxweynaha Galmudug, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoor Qoor), kuwaas oo looga hadlay xiisadda siyaasadeed ee haatan taagan, gaar ahaan arrimaha doorashooyinka. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in dadaallada socda uu sidoo kale ka qayb-geli doono Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza, si loo qanciyo Qoor Qoor, kadibna doorasho qof iyo cod ah looga qabto deegaannada Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug. Wada-hadalladan ayaa lagu soo warramayaa in is-faham hordhac ah laga gaaray, isla markaana dhamaystirkooda uu goobjoog ahaan doono Xamza, iyada oo kadib qorshuhu yahay in doorasho toos ah laga qabto Galmudug. Villa Somalia ayaa dooneysa in isbeddel siyaasadeed laga sameeyo Galmudug, isla markaana doorashada madaxtinimada Galmudug ee la qabanayo bisha July lagu doorto musharrax ka imaan doona urur-siyaasadeedka JSP. Waxaa aad loo hadal hayaa in musharraxaasi noqon karo ganacsade Liibaan Axmed Xasan, haddii uusan isbeddelin mowqifka taageerada madaxtooyada ee ku aaddan ninkaas. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, d adka reer Galmudug ayaa isha ku haya xiisadda taagan, oo ay garowsan yihiin inay khatar dhab ah ku tahay jiritaanka Galmudug, isla markaana ay sii kala fogeyn karto bulshada maamulkaasi. Safarkana ayaa horay loo sii qorsheeyay, iyada oo Galmudug ay si weyn ugu diyaar garowday soo dhaweynta Ra’iisul wasaaraha iyo wafdigiisa. Sidoo kale ammaanka ayaa aad loo adkeeyay, iyada oo ciidamo dheeraad ah la dhigay meelaha muhiimka ah ee Dhuusamareeb, si ay u sugaan amniga guud. items.title: Houthis threaten strikes on Somaliland over Israeli military foothold
items.description: HARGEISA (Somaliguardian) – Yemen’s Houthi movement has issued a strong warning against any Israeli military presence in Somaliland, days after reports emerged alleging that Tel Aviv deployed 50 special unit troops to the breakaway region in northern Somalia. Mohammed Al-Farah, a member of the group’s Political Bureau, said on Monday that Israeli activities in Somaliland are a source of grave concern, highlighting the strategic importance of the Red Sea and the Bab al-Mandab Strait, one of the world’s most vital maritime corridors. “Any movement by the Zionist enemy there will be viewed as an attempt to control this vital maritime passage and undermine the security of the entire region, including the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia,” Al-Farah said. The Houthi official added that the presence of Israeli forces in Somali waters constitutes a threat to Yemen’s national security. He further stated that Houthi leader Abdul-Malik Badr al-Din al-Houthi had previously declared that any Israeli or U.S. military presence in Somaliland would be regarded as a direct threat and would be met with a firm response. According to Al-Farah, any such deployment would represent a “red line” that cannot be crossed and would be considered a legitimate target. Al-Farah also argued that protecting the security of the Red Sea does not require foreign military bases or an external military presence, maintaining that responsibility for securing the strategic waterway belongs to regional countries and the states bordering the Red Sea. Growing Focus on Somaliland The warning comes amid increased scrutiny of Israel’s reported activities in Somaliland, a self-declared state that Somalia considers part of its sovereign territory. In December 2025, Israel recognized Somaliland, prompting strong opposition from the Somali Federal Government, which described the move as illegal and reaffirmed that Somaliland remains an integral part of the territory of the Federal Republic of Somalia. The latest remarks also follow reports claiming that Israel established an intelligence base in Somaliland and is planning to establish a naval base in the region to counter Houthi threats against Israeli shipping in the Red Sea. Israeli and Somaliland Authorities Deny Troop Deployment Reports However, both Israel and Somaliland authorities have denied recent reports alleging that Tel Aviv deployed 50 special unit personnel to Somaliland. The reports claimed that the troops were all of African descent, with most reportedly being Ethiopians, allowing them to blend in with the local population and avoid attracting attention so that their operations could remain secret. The denials come as developments involving Somaliland, Somalia, Israel and the Houthis continue to attract attention across the Red Sea region, where security, shipping routes and geopolitical competition remain closely watched by regional actors. items.title: Soomaalida iyo muwaadiniin dalal kale oo laga mamnuucay in ay galaan Liibiya
items.description: Liibiya ( Raxanreeb Online) Dawladda saldhiggeedu yahay bariga dalka Liibiya ayaa soo saartay amar cusub oo mamnuucaya muwaadiniinta Soomaaliya, Suudaan, Eritrea, iyo Itoobiya inay galaan dalkaas, sida ay sheegtay wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters. Warbixin ay Reuters ka soo xigatay ilo dowladeed ayaa lagu sheegay in go’aankan looga gol leeyahay “in lagu xakameeyo gelitaanka ajaanibta ee Libya. Amarka ay soo saartay dowladda Libya ee fadhigeedu yahay magaalada Benghazi, oo ah magaalada labaad ee ugu weyn dalka, ayaa sheegay in “muwaadiniinta Soomaaliya, Suudaan, Eritrea, iyo Itoobiya laga mamnuucay inay soo galaan dhulka Libya iyagoo adeegsanaya dhammaan marinnada berriga, badda iyo hawada.” Si kastaba ha ahaatee, amarku wuxuu ka reebayaa xubnaha safaaradaha iyo qunsuliyadaha iyo qoysaskooda, sidoo kale shaqaalaha ka shaqeeya waxbarashada iyo caafimaadka, haddii ay soo bandhigaan heshiis shaqo iyo rukhsad sharci ah oo ay bixiyeen hay’adaha ay khusayso. Afarta dal ee Geeska Afrika ee lagu xusay amarkan mamnuucidda ayaa ah meelaha ay ka soo jeedaan boqollaal kun oo qof oo ka qaxaya dalalkooda sababo la xiriira xasillooni-darro siyaasadeed iyo amni, dagaallo, cadaadis iyo saboolnimo dhaqaale. items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo go’aan culus soo saaray kadib askartii ay Israa’iil gaysay Somaliland
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Mas’uul sare oo ka tirsan dhaqdhaqaaqa Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa si adag uga digay in ciidamo Israel ama Mareykan ah ay saldhig ama joogitaan militari ku yeeshaan biyaha Soomaaliya, isaga oo sheegay in tallaabo noocaas ah loo arki doono “bartilmaameed sharci ah”. Mohammed al-Farah, oo ka tirsan xafiiska siyaasadda ee Ansarullah, ayaa sheegay in kooxdu si dhow ula socoto dhaqdhaqaaqyada ka socda Badda Cas, marin-biyoodka Baab al-Mandab iyo xeebaha ku dhow Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan kadib warbixinno muran dhaliyay oo sheegayay in Israel ay ciidamo geysay Somaliland. “Waxaan Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Baab al-Mandab u aragnaa meel istiraatiiji ah oo aad muhiim u ah,” ayuu yiri Farah. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in dhaqdhaqaaq kasta oo ay sameeyaan “cadowga Sahyuuniyadda iyoMareykanka” loo fasiran doono isku day lagu doonayo in saameyn colaadeed lagu yeesho gobolka, lagu maamulo marin-biyood muhiim ah, isla markaana lagu khatar geliyo amniga dalalka gobolka, oo ay ku jirto Sacuudiga. Hadalkan ayaa imanaya xilli xiisadda Badda Cas ay weli sareyso, kadib markii Xuutiyiintu ay tan iyo bilowgii dagaalka Gaza weerarro ku qaadeen maraakiib ay ku sheegeen inay xiriir la leeyihiin Israel. Tallaabooyinkaas ayaa Baab al-Mandab ka dhigay mid ka mid ah marinnada badeed ee ugu halista badan caalamka. Baab al-Mandab waa marin dhuuban oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, wuxuuna u dhexeeyaa Yemen, Jabuuti iyo Eritrea. Khalkhal kasta oo ka dhaca halkaas wuxuu saameyn karaa ganacsiga caalamiga ah, maraakiibta shidaalka iyo howlgalada ciidamada badda ee dalal shisheeye. Al-Farah ayaa sheegay in joogitaan militari oo Israel ku yeelato biyaha Soomaaliya uu noqon doono halis toos ah oo ku wajahan Yemen. “Annaga Yemen ahaan, dhaqdhaqaaqyada noocaas ah waxaan u aragnaa khatar toos ah oo ku wajahan amniga qaranka Yemen iyo madax-bannaanideeda,” ayuu yiri. Wuxuu sheegay in hoggaamiyaha Xuutiyiinta, Abdul-Malik al-Houthi, uu hore u bixiyay “digniin cad oo adag”, taas oo ku saabsan in joogitaan kasta oo Israel ama Mareykanku ku yeeshaan gobolka Somaliland “si xoog leh loola macaamili doono”. Al-Farah ayaa ku adkeystay in Xuutiyiintu ay tallaabadaas u arki doonaan “khad cas” iyo “bartilmaameed sharci ah”. Sidoo kale wuxuu meesha ka saaray doodda ah in saldhigyo shisheeye ama ciidamo ka socda dalal dibadeed loo baahan yahay si loo sugo amniga Badda Cas. Wuxuu sheegay in mas’uuliyaddaas ay saaran tahay dalalka gobolka, gaar ahaan kuwa ku teedsan marin-biyoodka. “Badda Cas ma aha meel u furan quwadaha shisheeye,” ayuu yiri, isaga oo Israel iyo Mareykanka ku eedeeyay inay doonayaan inay marin-biyoodka u adeegsadaan “ajendeyaal Sahyuuni ah, gardarro iyo qorshayaal Mareykan ah”. Digniintan ayaa daba socota warbixin uu baahiyay Middle East Eye , oo ay xigtay Somalia Today, taas oo sheegtay in Israel ay ku dhowaad 50 askari u dirtay Somaliland kadib markii ay aqoonsatay maamulkaas bishii December. Warbixinta, oo soo xiganeysay sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan dowladda Soomaaliya, ayaa sheegtay in sirdoonka Soomaaliya uu rumeysan yahay in askartaasi ay yimaadeen kadib markii uu dib u billowday dagaalka Israel iyo Iran dabayaaqadii Febraayo. Sarkaalku wuxuu sheegay in Israel ay si gaar ah u dooratay askar asal ahaan ka soo jeeda Afrika, “gaar ahaan Itoobiyaan”, si aan loo dareemin dhaqdhaqaaqooda. Militariga Israel ayaa ka gaabsaday inuu si toos ah uga jawaabo eedeynta, isaga oo sheegay in arrintani ay “khuseyso dhinaca siyaasadda”, sida ay qortay warbixintu. Hase yeeshee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Israel ayaa markii dambe si kooban u beenisay warbixinta, iyadoo dhowr akoon oo rasmi ah ku qortay: “FAKE NEWS”. Maamulka Somaliland wali si cad uma uusan xaqiijin eedeynta la xiriirta in ciidamo Israel ah la geeyay dhulkiisa. Dhinaca kale, wasiirka gaashaandhigga Somaliland, Maxamed Yuusuf Cali, ayaa hore u beeniyay in Israel ay saldhig militari ka sameysatay Somaliland, balse wuxuu xaqiijiyay in ay jirto taageero dhanka amniga ah. “Ma jiro joogitaan militari ama saldhigyo militari oo Israel ku leedahay Somaliland,” ayuu yiri. “Laakiin Israel way caawineysaa Somaliland… waxay naga taageereysaa tababar loo sameynayo qaar ka mid ah booliska iyo militariga.” Hadalkaas ma uusan joojin shakiga ku saabsan nooca xiriirka amni ee cusub ee ka dhex sameysmay Israel iyo Somaliland. Wasiirka gaashaandhigga Israel, Israel Katz, ayaa intii uu la kulmayey hoggaamiyaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi Cirro, sheegay in labada dhinac ay muddo dheer lahaayeen xiriir amni oo qarsoodi ahaa. “Sanado badan ayaan si qarsoodi ah isaga kaashanay howlgallo kala duwan oo weli qarsoodi ahaan doona,” ayuu yiri Katz. Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa isna shir ganacsi oo ka dhacay Tel Aviv ku sheegay in Somaliland ay diyaar u tahay maalgashi iyo iskaashi cusub oo ay la yeelato Israel. “Somaliland waxay u furan tahay ganacsi, Somaliland-na waxay diyaar u tahay maalgashiga Israel,” ayuu yiri. Aqoonsiga ay Israel siisay Somaliland 26-kii December ayaa soo dhoweeyn ka helay Hargeysa, balse si adag uga careysiiyay Muqdisho. Dekedda Berbera, oo ah dekedda ugu weyn gobolka Somaliland, waxay ku taallaa Gacanka Cadmeed, meel aan ka fogeyn marinnada laga galo Baab al-Mandab. Taas ayaa ka dhigeysa goob istiraatiiji ah oo ay daneyn karaan quwadaha doonaya inay saameyn ku yeeshaan marinada Badda Cas. Xuutiyiinta ayaa bishan ku dhawaaqay xayiraad ay sheegeen inay saarayaan maraakiibta Israel ee mara Badda Cas, taas oo sii kordhisay cabsi laga qabo in joogitaan Israel ay ku yeelato meel u dhow Yemen uu Somaliland iyo biyaha Soomaaliya u beddeli karo goob cusub oo xiisad goboleed ka qaraxdo. Wuxuu sheegay in hoggaamiyaha Xuutiyiinta, Abdul-Malik al-Houthi, uu hore u bixiyay “digniin cad oo adag”, taas oo ku saabsan in joogitaan kasta oo Israel ama Mareykanku ku yeeshaan gobolka Somaliland “si xoog leh loola macaamili doono”. Al-Farah ayaa ku adkeystay in Xuutiyiintu ay tallaabadaas u arki doonaan “khad cas” iyo “bartilmaameed sharci ah”. Sidoo kale wuxuu meesha ka saaray doodda ah in saldhigyo shisheeye ama ciidamo ka socda dalal dibadeed loo baahan yahay si loo sugo amniga Badda Cas. Wuxuu sheegay in mas’uuliyaddaas ay saaran tahay dalalka gobolka, gaar ahaan kuwa ku teedsan marin-biyoodka. “Badda Cas ma aha meel u furan quwadaha shisheeye,” ayuu yiri, isaga oo Israel iyo Mareykanka ku eedeeyay inay doonayaan inay marin-biyoodka u adeegsadaan “ajendeyaal Sahyuuni ah, gardarro iyo qorshayaal Mareykan ah”. Digniintan ayaa daba socota warbixin uu baahiyay Middle East Eye , oo ay xigtay Somalia Today, taas oo sheegtay in Israel ay ku dhowaad 50 askari u dirtay Somaliland kadib markii ay aqoonsatay maamulkaas bishii December. Warbixinta, oo soo xiganeysay sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan dowladda Soomaaliya, ayaa sheegtay in sirdoonka Soomaaliya uu rumeysan yahay in askartaasi ay yimaadeen kadib markii uu dib u billowday dagaalka Israel iyo Iran dabayaaqadii Febraayo. Sarkaalku wuxuu sheegay in Israel ay si gaar ah u dooratay askar asal ahaan ka soo jeeda Afrika, “gaar ahaan Itoobiyaan”, si aan loo dareemin dhaqdhaqaaqooda. Militariga Israel ayaa ka gaabsaday inuu si toos ah uga jawaabo eedeynta, isaga oo sheegay in arrintani ay “khuseyso dhinaca siyaasadda”, sida ay qortay warbixintu. Hase yeeshee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Israel ayaa markii dambe si kooban u beenisay warbixinta, iyadoo dhowr akoon oo rasmi ah ku qortay: “FAKE NEWS”. Maamulka Somaliland wali si cad uma uusan xaqiijin eedeynta la xiriirta in ciidamo Israel ah la geeyay dhulkiisa. Dhinaca kale, wasiirka gaashaandhigga Somaliland, Maxamed Yuusuf Cali, ayaa hore u beeniyay in Israel ay saldhig militari ka sameysatay Somaliland, balse wuxuu xaqiijiyay in ay jirto taageero dhanka amniga ah. “Ma jiro joogitaan militari ama saldhigyo militari oo Israel ku leedahay Somaliland,” ayuu yiri. “Laakiin Israel way caawineysaa Somaliland… waxay naga taageereysaa tababar loo sameynayo qaar ka mid ah booliska iyo militariga.” Hadalkaas ma uusan joojin shakiga ku saabsan nooca xiriirka amni ee cusub ee ka dhex sameysmay Israel iyo Somaliland. Wasiirka gaashaandhigga Israel, Israel Katz, ayaa intii uu la kulmayey hoggaamiyaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi Cirro, sheegay in labada dhinac ay muddo dheer lahaayeen xiriir amni oo qarsoodi ahaa. “Sanado badan ayaan si qarsoodi ah isaga kaashanay howlgallo kala duwan oo weli qarsoodi ahaan doona,” ayuu yiri Katz. Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa isna shir ganacsi oo ka dhacay Tel Aviv ku sheegay in Somaliland ay diyaar u tahay maalgashi iyo iskaashi cusub oo ay la yeelato Israel. “Somaliland waxay u furan tahay ganacsi, Somaliland-na waxay diyaar u tahay maalgashiga Israel,” ayuu yiri. Aqoonsiga ay Israel siisay Somaliland 26-kii December ayaa soo dhoweeyn ka helay Hargeysa, balse si adag uga careysiiyay Muqdisho. Dekedda Berbera, oo ah dekedda ugu weyn gobolka Somaliland, waxay ku taallaa Gacanka Cadmeed, meel aan ka fogeyn marinnada laga galo Baab al-Mandab. Taas ayaa ka dhigeysa goob istiraatiiji ah oo ay daneyn karaan quwadaha doonaya inay saameyn ku yeeshaan marinada Badda Cas. Xuutiyiinta ayaa bishan ku dhawaaqay xayiraad ay sheegeen inay saarayaan maraakiibta Israel ee mara Badda Cas, taas oo sii kordhisay cabsi laga qabo in joogitaan Israel ay ku yeelato meel u dhow Yemen uu Somaliland iyo biyaha Soomaaliya u beddeli karo goob cusub oo xiisad goboleed ka qaraxdo. items.title: Maraykanka oo qorsheynaya in uu cunaqabteynta ka qaado Eritrea
items.description: Washington ( Raxanreeb Online) Mareykanka ayaa doonaya in cunaqabateynta laga qaado Eritrea, isla markaana dib loo soo celiyo xiriirkii diblomaasiyadeed ee kala dhexeeyay Asmara, sida uu qoray wargeyska Wall Street Journal. Eritrea waxaa cunaqabateyn ku soo rogay Qaramada Midoobay sanadkii 2009-kii, kaddib markii ay taageertay maleeshiyada Al-Shabaab ee Soomaaliya. Eritrea ayaa si adag u beenisay eedeymahaasi. Kaddib sanado badan oo cilmi baaris ah oo ay ka sameeyeen Soomaaliya iyo Eritrea, kooxda baarista Qaramada Midoobay ma helin cadeymo lagu qanci karo cunaqabateynta Eritrea ee 2009 ee taageerada maleeshiyada al-Shabaab. Waxay ku eedaysay Maraykanka oo markaa u madax ka ahaa Obama inuu wado olole dublamaasiyadeed oo uu ku doonayo “in Eritrea loogu ciqaabo siyaasad madax-bannaan oo dibadda ah.” Sidoo kale, bishii February 2017, Maraykanku wuxuu cunaqabatayn u gaar ah ku soo rogay ciidamada badda ee Eritrea, taasoo ka careysiisay dowladda Eritrea. “Waa tallaabo dheeraad ah oo aan la fahmi karin oo aan macquul ahayn… waa ciyaar duug ah oo aan sharci ahayn,” ayay yiri Eritra. Bishii Maarso 2021, Maraykanku wuxuu ku dhawaaqay cunaqabatayn fiisaha ah oo ka dhan ah saraakiisha hadda joogta iyo kuwii hore ee dawladda, xubnaha ciidamada ammaanka iyo shakhsiyaad uu ku sheegay inay xiriir la leeyihiin ciidamada gobolka Tigray ee Itoobiya. The post Maraykanka oo qorsheynaya in uu cunaqabteynta ka qaado Eritrea appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: High Court Clears Duale After Ebola Facility Apology
items.description: Kenya’s High Court has pardoned Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale of contempt charges after he issued an unconditional apology for the continued construction of a U.S.-backed Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base. Justice Patricia Nyaundi accepted the Cabinet Secretary’s formal expression of regret on Tuesday, effectively halting the immediate threat of sentencing while ordering a complete cessation of all activities at the site. The ruling marks a significant cooling of tensions between the executive branch and the judiciary following weeks of public unrest. The project, which aimed to establish a 50-bed isolation center for international personnel exposed to Ebola, faced intense scrutiny from civil society groups and legal watchdogs. Petitioners, including the Katiba Institute and the Law Society of Kenya, argued that the government bypassed mandatory environmental and social impact assessments, raising concerns about the potential risk to local communities near the Nanyuki-based facility. “I have directed the immediate and complete cessation of any intended construction, site preparation, or related activities concerning the Laikipia Air Base facility pending the hearing and determination of the substantive petition,” Duale told the court during his appearance. While the government has maintained that the partnership is essential for regional health preparedness, the initiative has become a lightning rod for broader debates over national sovereignty. The controversy intensified following reports that construction continued even after initial court orders were issued in late May, a move that sparked widespread protests that reportedly resulted in three deaths. Justice Nyaundi, in granting the pardon, emphasized that the court expects strict adherence to its directives moving forward. The government’s pivot to a full suspension of works represents a significant concession, though the legal battle over the facility’s constitutionality remains active. The court noted that it accepted the apology primarily because this was the first instance in which the minister had formally addressed the defiance of the orders. The U.S. government, which pledged over $13 million toward the project, has remained largely diplomatic, stating previously that it was working with Kenyan authorities to resolve public and legal objections. With the contempt proceedings now closed, the focus shifts to the substantive case, which will ultimately determine whether the project proceeds or is permanently shuttered. The post High Court Clears Duale After Ebola Facility Apology first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Trump oo Amar ku Bixiyey in Baaritaan Degdeg ah lagu Sameeyo Shirkadaha Shidaalka
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa amar ku bixiyey in baaritaan rasmi ah oo degdeg ah lagu sameeyo shirkadaha waaweyn ee shidaalka, isagoo ku eedeeyey inay diideen inay hoos u dhigaan qiimaha batroolka ee laga iibsado kaalimaha, xilli uu hoos u dhac weyn ku yimid qiimaha shidaalka cayriin ee caalamka. Trump ayaa sheegay in shirkadahani ay macaash xad-dhaaf ah ka helayaan dadweynaha, maadaama qiimaha ay hadda shidaalka ku gadanayaan uusan la mid ahayn qiimaha jaban ee ay iyagu ku soo iibsadaan. “Waxaan faray Wasaaradda Caddaaladda (DOJ) inay si degdeg ah u bilowdo baaritaanka arrintan,” ayuu Trump ku yiri qoraal xanaaq sanka ka muuqdo oo uu soo dhigay bartiisa Truth Social. Wuxuu sidoo kale digniin adag u diray shirkadahaas isagoo yiri: “Qiimaha batroolku waa inuu ku bilowdaa hoos u dhac aad uga dhakhso badan waxa aan hadda arkayo!” Go’aankan uu Trump ku amaray baaritaanka shirkadaha shidaalka ayaa yimid ka dib markii heshiis laga gaaray khilaafkii kala dhexeeyey dalka Iiraan, dibna loo furay Marinka Hormuz, taas oo hoos u dhigtay qiimaha shidaalka ee suuqyada caalamka, laakiin Trump uu aaminsan yahay in shirkaduhu ay weli lacag kor u dhaaf ah ka miiranayaan shacabka Mareykanka.

items.title: Maxaa kasoo baxay wada-hadalladii DF iyo Qoor Qoor?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wararka naga soo gaaraya Dhuusamareeb ayaa sheegaya in meel wanaagsan ay marayaan wada-hadallada u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo hogaamiyaha maamulkaasi, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoor Qoor), kuwaas oo ku aadan arrimaha doorashooyinka qof iyo codka ah. Wada-hadalladan oo galay dhowr wareeg ayaa waxaa ay u dhexeeyeen ergo ka socota dowladda dhexe oo uu hoggaaminayo Taliyaha NISA Mahad Salaad, kuwaas oo la fariistay Axmed Qoor Qoor, iyada oo ugu dambeyn laga gaaray is-fahan hordhac ah, sida ay innoo xaqiijiyeen ilo wareedyo xilkas ah. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Ra’iisul waaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre oo isna saacadaha soo socda ku wajahan Dhuusamareeb uu ka qayb-geli doono dhammaystirka is-afgaradka labada dhinac, si loo soo afjaro xiisadda siyaasadeed ee Galmudug, kadibna loo guda galo doorashooyinka maamulka. Qaban qaabada soo dhaweynta Ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale hadda laga dareemayaa magaalada Dhuusamareeb, oo uu ka bilaabi doono kulamo, sida ay soo sheegayaan Wariyeyaal ku sugan deegaannada Galmudug. Ammaanka ayaa dhanka kale aad loo adkeeyay, iyada oo ciidamo dheeraad ah la dhigay meelaha muhiimka ah ee caasimada, si ay ula socdaan dhaq-dhaqaaqa gud, una sugaan amniga Ra’iisul wasaaraha iyo wafdigiisa. Villa Somalia ayaa dooneysa in isbeddel siyaasadeed laga sameeyo Galmudug, isla markaana doorashada madaxtinimada Galmudug ee la qabanayo bisha July lagu doorto musharrax ka imaan doona urur-siyaasadeedka JSP. Waxaa aad loo hadal hayaa in musharraxaasi noqon karo ganacsade Liibaan Axmed Xasan, haddii uusan isbeddelin mowqifka taageerada madaxtooyada ee ku aaddan ninkaas. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, d adka reer Galmudug ayaa isha ku haya xiisadda taagan, oo ay garowsan yihiin inay khatar dhab ah ku tahay jiritaanka Galmudug, isla markaana ay sii kala fogeyn karto bulshada maamulkaasi. Dhawaan Villa Soomaaliya ayaa doorasho ka qabatay Koonfur Galbeed, halkaas oo uu isbeddal ka dhacay, kadib markii uu doorashada kusoo baxay Guddoomiyihii hore ee Baarlamaanka Sheekh Aadan Madoobe oo ahaa musharrixii matelayay Xisbiga JSP ee Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. The post Maxaa kasoo baxay wada-hadalladii DF iyo Qoor Qoor? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Liibiya oo Soo Rogtay Xayiraado Cusub oo Saameynaya Muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed
items.description: Xukuumadda dalka Liibiya ayaa shaacisay go’aanno cusub oo si weyn u adkeynaya xeerarka gelitaanka dalkaas, kuwaas oo si toos ah u saameynaya muwaadiniinta ka soo jeeda dalalka Soomaaliya, Suudaan, Eratariya iyo Itoobiya. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha dowladda Liibiya ayaa soo saaray amar lagu joojinayo in muwaadiniinta afartaas dal ay ka soo galaan dhammaan marinada xuduudaha dalkaas, ha ahaato dhanka badda, dhulka ama cirka. Tallaabadan ayaa lagu fasiray mid looga golleeyahay xakameynta qulqulka muhaajiriinta iyo la dagaallanka socdaalka sharci darrada ah ee sii kordhaya. Sida ku cad go’aanka rasmiga ah ee ka soo baxay xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha, waxaa xayiraaddan laga reebay oo kaliya dadka haysta oggolaansho shaqo (Work Permit) oo ansax ah, kuwaas oo si gaar ah uga shaqeeya waaxyaha caafimaadka iyo waxbarashada ee dalka Liibiya. Dhanka kale, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha ee Liibiya ayaa la faray inay qaaddo tallaabooyin degdeg ah oo lagu ururinayo, laguna masaafurinayo dhammaan ajaanibta aan haysan deggenaansho sharci ah ee ku sugan gudaha dalkaas. Mas’uuliyiinta Liibiya waxay sheegeen in go’aankani uu qeyb ka yahay qorshaha lagu sugayo amniga qaranka, laguna xallinayo caqabadaha amni iyo kuwa dhaqaale ee ka dhashay socdaalka aan sharciga ahayn. Dalka Liibiya ayaa muddo Sanado ah ahaa marinka ugu weyn ee ay adeegsadaan muhaajiriinta ka timaada Geeska Afrika iyo dalalka kale ee qaaradda, kuwaas oo doonaya inay si sharci darro ah uga gudbaan badda Mediterranean-ka si ay u gaaraan qaaradda Yurub, iyadoo inta badan dadka safarkaas u gala ay la kulmaan qataro naftooda halis geliya.

Mas’uuliyiinta Liibiya waxay sheegeen in go’aankani uu qeyb ka yahay qorshaha lagu sugayo amniga qaranka, laguna xallinayo caqabadaha amni iyo kuwa dhaqaale ee ka dhashay socdaalka aan sharciga ahayn. Dalka Liibiya ayaa muddo Sanado ah ahaa marinka ugu weyn ee ay adeegsadaan muhaajiriinta ka timaada Geeska Afrika iyo dalalka kale ee qaaradda, kuwaas oo doonaya inay si sharci darro ah uga gudbaan badda Mediterranean-ka si ay u gaaraan qaaradda Yurub, iyadoo inta badan dadka safarkaas u gala ay la kulmaan qataro naftooda halis geliya.

items.title: Maamulka Khalifa Haftar oo mamnuucay Soomaalida iyo muwaadiniinta 3 dal oo kale
items.description: Benghazi (Caasimada Online) — Maamulka ka dhisan bariga Libya ayaa Talaadadii mamnuucay in muwaadiniinta Soomaaliya, Sudan, Eritrea iyo Itoobiya ay galaan dhulka Libya, tallaabo uu sarkaal ka tirsan maamulkaasi ku sheegay mid “dib loogu habeynayo” nidaamka soo gelitaanka ajaaniibta dalkaas. Wareegto kasoo baxday maamulka fadhigiisu yahay magaalada Benghazi ayaa lagu sheegay in “muwaadiniinta Sudan, Eritrea, Itoobiya iyo Soomaaliya laga mamnuucay inay soo galaan dhulka Libya, iyaga oo adeegsanaya dhammaan dekedaha dhulka, badda iyo hawada.” Maamulka Benghazi ee uu hoggaamiyo Osama Hamad ayaa xulufo la ah taliyaha militariga bariga Libya Khalifa Haftar, kaas oo gacanta ku haya bariga dalkaas iyo qeybo ballaaran oo ka mid ah koonfurta Libya. Libya ayaa weli u kala qeybsan labo maamul oo iska soo horjeeda, iyadoo dowladda caalamku aqoonsan yahay ee uu hoggaamiyo Abdulhamid Dbeibah ay fadhigeedu yahay magaalada Tripoli. Dbeibah ayaa xukunka ku yimid hannaan ay Qaramada Midoobay taageertay sanadkii 2021. Sarkaal ka tirsan maamulka bariga Libya ayaa wakaaladda Reuters u sheegay in go’aankan uu qeyb ka yahay dadaal lagu “habeynayo soo gelitaanka ajaaniibta ee Libya,” balse faahfaahin dheeraad ah kama bixin sababta si gaar ah loogu bartilmaameedsaday afartan dal ee Afrikaan ah. Go’aanka ayaa ka reebaya xubnaha safaaradaha iyo qunsuliyadaha rasmiga ah ee dalalkaas, iyo sidoo kale xubnaha qoysaskooda. Waxaa sidoo kale laga reebay shaqaalaha ka howlgala waxbarashada, caafimaadka iyo adeegyada la xiriira, haddii ay haystaan oggolaanshaha lagama maarmaanka ah iyo qandaraasyo shaqo oo sharci ah oo ay ka heleen hay’adaha ku shaqada leh. Libya ayaa muddo sanado ah ahayd waddo muhiim ah oo ay isticmaalaan muhaajiriinta ka imanaya dalal ay ka jiraan dagaallo, saboolnimo iyo xasillooni-darro, kuwaas oo doonaya inay Yurub uga gudbaan badda Mediterranean-ka. Tan iyo markii la riday hoggaamiyihii Libya Muammar Gaddafi sanadkii 2011, kaddib kacdoon ay taageereen dalalka NATO, dalkaas ayaa galay qalalaase siyaasadeed iyo mid amni. Khilaafka kooxaha hubeysan iyo maamullada iska soo horjeeda ayaa sii xoogaystay sanadkii 2014, taas oo dalka u kala qeybisay bariga iyo galbeedka. Xog ay Qaramada Midoobay uruurisay horaantii sanadkan ayaa muujineysa in Libya ay ku sugan yihiin in ka badan 900,000 oo muhaajiriin ah, kuwaas oo badankood ka yimid dalal Afrikaan ah. The post Maamulka Khalifa Haftar oo mamnuucay Soomaalida iyo muwaadiniinta 3 dal oo kale appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Cumaan oo war cusub kasoo saartay marinka Hormus kadib saaraakiishii Iiraan ee booqday dalkaas
items.description: Cummaan ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay la shaqeysay Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Badaha (IMO) si loo sameeyo marin badeed ku meel gaar ah, taas oo sahleysa in maraakiibtu ka gudbaan Marinka Hormuz. Wakaaladda wararka dowladda Cummaan ayaa sheegtay in maraakiibta doonaysa inay maraan Marinka Hormuz ay tahay inay sameeyaan qabanqaabada lagama maarmaanka ah iyagoo la xidhiidhaya Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Badaha iyo mas’uuliyiinta Cummaan. Warkan ayaa yimid saacado kadib markii Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, oo hoggaaminayay wafdiga diblomaasiyadeed ee Iiraan, uu booqday dalkaas. Waxa kale oo uu yimid kadib markii Iiraan iyo Cummaan ay Talaadadii bayaan wadajir ah ku sheegeen inay ka go’an tahay ilaalinta Marinka Hormuz si uu u ahaado marin-biyood ammaan ah oo u furan maraakiibta caalamiga ah, iyagoo isla markaasna adkeeyay madaxbannaanidooda iyo xuquuqdooda qaran ee ku saabsan biyaha Marinka Hormuz. Waxay sidoo kale ku dhawaaqeen inay baari doonaan sida mustaqbalka loo maamuli doono Marinka Hormuz iyo kharashaadka adeegyada laga bixiyo marin-biyoodkan, iyagoo sameynaya guddi wadajir ah. Bayaankan ayaa la soo saaray kadib kulan dhexmaray saraakiil sare oo ka kala socday labada dal oo ka dhacay caasimadda Muscat. Kadib markii ay ka soo baxeen Switzerland, Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, madaxa kooxda wada-xaajoodka Iiraan, iyo Abbas Araqchi, Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Iiraan, waxay aadeen Cummaan, halkaas oo ay kula kulmeen Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Badr Busaidi iyo Suldaanka Cummaan Haitham bin Tariq. Talaadadii, Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Badaha, oo ah hay’ad hoos tagta Qaramada Midoobay, ayaa ku dhawaaqay bilowga geeddi-socodka dib loogu celinayo in ka badan 11,000 oo badmaaxiin ah oo ku xayirnaa Marinka Hormuz; badmaaxiinta ayaa ku go’doonsanaa gobolka tan iyo dagaalkii Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ay la galeen Iiraan iyo xaddidaaddii lagu soo rogay isu socodka Marinka Hormuz. Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Badaha ayaa sheegay in hawlgalka samatabixinta badmaaxiintan loo fulin doono si dhow oo iskaashi ah, iyadoo lala kaashanayo dhammaan dalalka gobolka iyo Mareykanka. Bbc somali

items.title: Maxay DF ka tiri go’aanka ay QM kasoo saartay Ahlu Sunna Waljamaaca?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa soo dhaweysay go’aanka kasoo baxay Qaramada Midoobay ee Ururka Ahlu Sunna Waljamaaca looga saaray liiska xadgudubyada loo gaysto carruurta, xilliyada colaadaha. Warbixin sanadle ah oo kasoo baxday QM oo ku saabsan carruurta iyo colaadaha hubeysan, ayaa si rasmi ah loogu xaqiijiyay in Ahlu Sunna looga saaray liiska dhinacyada ku lugta leh xadgudubyada carruurta ee xilliyada dagaallada. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya oo iyadu ka qayb-qaadatay dadaallada la sameeyay ayaa soo dhaweysay go’aanka Qaramada Midoobay, waxayna sheegtay in arrintan lagu gaaray geeddi-socod, qiimeyn iyo wada-tashiyo ay ka qeyb qaateen hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Ahlu Sunna ayaa muddo ku jirtay lifaaqyada warbixinnada Qaramada Midoobay ee carruurta iyo colaadaha hubeysan, basle waxaa hadda la xaqiijiyay in ururkaasi aanu hubeysneyn, isla markaana xubnihiisii ay ku milmeen hay’adaha amniga Qaranka Soomaaliyeed. Hoos ka akhriso warsaxaafadeedka;- Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay soo dhoweynaysaa warbixinta sannadlaha ah ee Qaramada Midoobay (A/80/723-S/2026/357) ee ku saabsan Carruurta iyo Colaadaha Hubeysan, taas oo si rasmi ah u xaqiijisay in ururkii Ahlu Sunna Waljamaaca (ASWJ) laga saaray liiska dhinacyada ku lugta leh xadgudubyada carruurta xilliyada colaadaha hubeysan. ASWJ, oo muddo ku jirtay lifaaqyada warbixinnada Qaramada Midoobay ee Carruurta iyo Colaadaha Hubeysan, ayaa laga saaray liiska kadib markii la xaqiijiyay in ururkaasi aanu mar dambe u jirin koox hubeysan oo madaxbannaan, isla markaana xubnihiisii ay ku milmeen hay’adaha amniga Qaranka Soomaaliyeed. Go’aankan muhiimka ah wuxuu ka tarjumayaa horumarka ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ka gaartay dib-u-habeynta hay’adaha amniga, xoojinta dowladnimada iyo hirgelinta waajibaadka la xiriira ilaalinta carruurta. Sidoo kale, wuxuu caddeyn u yahay dadaallada wadajirka ah ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibbadeeda caalamiga ah ee ku aaddan xaqiijinta ilaalinta carruurta xilliyada colaadaha hubeysan. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa hormuud ka ahayd dadaalladii iyo wada-hadalladii farsamo ee horseeday dib-u-eegista xaaladda Ahlu Sunna Waljamaaca, iyadoo soo gudbisay codsi rasmi ah oo lagu waafajinayo qiimeynta Qaramada Midoobay iyo xaqiiqooyinka ka jira Soomaaliya. Xaqiijintan waxaa lagu gaaray geeddi-socod qiimeyn, daraasayn, xog-ururin, xaqiijin iyo wada-tashiyo ay ka qeyb qaateen hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Dowlad-goboleedyada xubnaha ka ah Dowladda Federaalka, Qaramada Midoobay iyo saaxiibbada kale ee caalamiga ah. Wasaaraddu waxay uga mahadcelinaysaa Qaramada Midoobay, UNICEF, hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Dowlad-goboleedyada xubnaha ka ah Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug, iyo dhammaan saaxiibbada caalamiga ah taageerada iyo wada-shaqeynta ay ka geysteen guushan muhiimka ah. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay mar kale xaqiijinaysaa sida ay uga go’an tahay ilaalinta carruurta, dhowrista xuquuqda aadanaha, hirgelinta Siyaasadda Qaranka ee llaalinta Rayidka, iyo dhismaha hay’ado amni oo masuul ah, isla markaana waafaqsan heerarka iyo waajibaadka caalamiga ah. The post Maxay DF ka tiri go’aanka ay QM kasoo saartay Ahlu Sunna Waljamaaca? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Qaramada Midoobay oo Bilowday Daabulidda 11,000 Badmaax oo Ku Xanibnaa Marin-biyoodka Hormuz
items.description: Qaramada Midoobay ayaa bilowday hawlgal lagu daadgureynayo in ka badan 11,000 badmaax oo muddo bilo ah ku xanibnaa marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Hormuz, kaddib heshiiskii dhexmaray Mareykanka iyo Iiraan ee lagu soo afjaray dagaalkii u dhexeeyay Mareykanka, Israa’iil iyo Iiraan. Xoghayaha Guud ee Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Maraakiibta (IMO), Arsenio Dominguez, ayaa sheegay in hawlgalkan lagu fulinayo iskaashi dhow oo lala yeelanayo Iiraan, Cumaan, dowladaha kale ee xeebaha gobolka, Mareykanka iyo shirkadaha maraakiibta. Marin-biyoodka Hormuz ayaa si weyn u xirmay tan iyo markii dagaalku billowday 28-kii Febraayo 2026, taas oo sababtay in boqolaal maraakiib ah ay ku xayirmaan halkaasi. Si kastaba, dhaq-dhaqaaqa maraakiibta ayaa sare u kacay toddobaadkii la soo dhaafay kaddib saxiixa heshiiska nabadeed, iyadoo ugu yaraan 36 markab oo ganacsi ay hal maalin gudaheed ka gudbeen marinkaasi. Wasaaradda Difaaca Cumaan ayaa sheegtay in daadgureynta loo fulin doono si tartiib ah si looga fogaado isku-dhacyo iyo khataraha amni ee weli ka jira deegaanka. Dhanka kale, Denmark ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay ku biireyso howlgal badeed caalami ah oo ay hoggaaminayaan Faransiiska iyo Britain, kaas oo lagu taageerayo dib u furista marin-biyoodka Hormuz oo muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamka. items.title: Trump oo ka Jawaabay tallaabada Aqalka Senate-ka ee dagaalka Iiraan
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump, oo qoraal xasaasi ah soo saaray ayaa si deg-deg ah uga jawaabay ansixinta qaraarka lagu xadidayo awoodihiisa ee dagaalka Iiraan, kaas oo ay soo saareen odayaasha Aqalka Senate-ka Mareykanka, fiidnimadii Talaadada. Trump oo qoraal soo geliyay bartiisa bulshada ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in go’aanka Aqalka Senate-ka uu kusoo aaday xilli xun, isla markaana qaraarkooda uu yahay mid aan macno badan lahayn. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in uusan ku faraxsaneyn go’aanka soo baxay, isaga oo dhanka kale farriin cad u diray dowladda Iiraan. Farriinta uu Trump ku baahiyay bartiisa bulshada ayaa u qornayd sidan:- “Waxaan Iiraan geliyay meel ay si buuxda cadaadis ugu jirtay, diyaar u ahayd inay dib u laabato, oo ay ku dhowaad wax walba na siiso. Markii ugu horreysay muddo tobanaan sano ah, Iiraan waxay ixtiraam badan u haysay dowladda Mareykanka iyo madaxweynaheeda, oo ah aniga. Laakiin Aqalka Senate-ka Mareykanka ayaa go’aansaday waqtigii ugu xumaa, iyadoo cod aan macno lahayn lagu qaaday Xeerka Awoodaha Dagaalka, inay farriin u diraan dowladda ugu weyn adduunka ee maalgelisa argagixisada in Mareykanku uusan ku faraxsanayn tallaabooyinka aan ka qaadayo oo aan joojiyo. Waxay taageero u fidinayaan cadowga. Afar ka mid ah Jamhuuriyiinta laga badiyay ayaa codkooda ku biiriytay Dimuqraadiyiinta, ‘Maxay codkani ka dhigan tahay?’ Senetaradani waxay shaqadayda ka dhigeen mid adag, laakiin shaqada waan qaban doonaa, wax kasta haa igu qaadato, sababtoo ah taasi waa waxa aan had iyo jeer sameey”! Sida aan horey u sheegnay, Aqalka Senate-ka Mareykanka oo ay Jamhuuriyiintu ku leeyihin aqlabiyadda, ayaa Talaadadii taageeray hindise sharciyeed lagu joojinayo tallaabada milatari ee Mareykanka uu ka qaadayo Iiraan, laakiin weli ma cadda saameynta uu sharcigan ku yeelan doono dagaalka, gaar ahaan iyadoo maamulka Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump uu ka gorgortamayo heshiis nabadeed oo uu la galayo Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan. Aqalka Senate-ka ayaa u codeeyay 50-48 si ay u taageeraan qaraarka wadajirka ah, kaas oo horey u ansixiyay Aqalka Wakiilada horraantii bishan. Ra’yi ururinta ayaa muujinaysa walaac sii kordhaya oo ku saabsan dagaalka Iiraan, walaacyadaas oo xitaa dareemayaan qaar ka mid ah xubnaha Jamhuuriyiinta taageersan Mr. Trump. Dagaalkan, oo bilaabmay Febraayo 28, isla markaana aanay taageersaneyn inta badan dadweynaha Mareykanka, ayaa weli waxaa socda heshiiskiisa rasmiga ah. items.title: U.S. Resumes Air Strikes in Somalia After Brief Pause, AFRICOM Says
items.description: Mogadishu, Somalia — 24 June: The United States has resumed air strikes in Somalia following a brief pause in operations, carrying out a series of attacks against Al-Shabaab militants in coordination with Somali government forces, according to U.S. military officials.

items.title: Somali government calls for immediate end to fighting in Sool region
items.description: The Federal Government of Somalia has issued its first public statement on the ongoing conflict in the Adhi-Adeeye area of the Sool region, where clashes between two local clans have resulted in casualties and injuries.

items.title: Qoysas markii labaad barakacay sanadkan oo Jubbada hoose ku wajaha xaalad nolol xumo
items.description: (ERGO) – Markii labaad ayay sanadkan wajahayaan xaalad barakac in ka badan 400 qoys, kuwaas oo dhibaato cunno xumo iyo hoy la’aan ay ku haysto duleedka deegaan Baar-sanguuni ee gobolka Jubbada hoose. Fatahaada oo  burburisay xero ay daganaayeen 28 bishii May ee sanadkan ayaa sababtay in ay bannaanka ku soo dhacaan, noloshoodan aya maarayn waayaan, kaddib fatahaadda wabiga Jubba. Caasho Cali Aadan iyo qoyskeeda oo 12 ah waxay maciin-bideen baadiyaha deegaanka, gaar ahaan meel u dhow wadada dhinaceeda. Waxay ku doorteen si ay cunno iyo maryo u waydiistaan dadka ku safraya. Waxay sheegtay in ka daashay xaaladdaas oo ay ku jirto muddo ku dhow bil, maaddama cuno joogto ah aysan helin, sidoo kalana ay u suurto galiwaysay dhisidda aqal cooshad ka samaysan oo gabaad u noqda. Toddobaadkii u danbeeyay ayay xustay in labo maalin oo ka mid ah ay cunno bisil, mid ciiriin ah iyo lacag ay u heshay qoyskeeda, halka inta kale aysan dabka shidan. “Maanta dhan hadaad Joogto $0.5 ayaad ka soo helli. Hadii kale ilmahaaga ha baahdan oo ha jiiftaan ayey noqoni, qabowga ayaana u dheer yahay. Nus dollar maxay ii gooyni. Waa nus kiilo baasto ah. Intaas ayaa lagu nool yahay. Waad imaan kartiin waad arki kartaan.” Caasho iyo carruurteeda waxay maalintii waqtigooda oo dhan ku qaataan waddada dhinaceeda iyagoo halkaas ku suga gaadiidka isticmaala waddada. Xaaladdan ayay tilmaamtay in duruuftu ay ku qasabtay. Xeradeedii ay ka soo barakacday ayay sheegtay in fatahaaddu ay ka saramartay, halka inta badan jidadka gala deegaan Baar-sanguuni ay biyuhu xireen, taas oo ku kaliftay in ay u soo baxsato duleedka tuulada. Dadka ugu badan ee caawiya ayaa ah ciidamada dowladda ee ku safra waddada oo isku xirta Kismaayo iyo Muqdisho, kuwaas oo raashin bisil ku taageera marmar. Waxay ka dayrisay xaaladda ay ku jiraan. “Waxaan cunno askarta ayaa noo keenta. Raashinka ay karsadaan ayey wax nooga keenaan. Wax kale oo aan hayno malaha. Shaqo ma jirto. Meel walba biyo ayaa soo xidhay.” Fatahaadda ka hor qoyskeeda wuxuu ku tiirsanaa cunno ay ku beddelan jirtay shaqo ay ka qaban jirtay beer ku taalla deegaanka Baar-sanguuni, taas oo ay fali jirtay, sidoo kalana ilaalin jirtay maalintii. Waxaa la siin jiray raashin iyo khudaar maalinle ah oo qoyskeeda ay ku noolaayeen. Xaaladdaas waxay ku jireen bilihii Febraayo, Maarso iyo Abriil, balse fatahaadda ayaa saamaysay beerta iyo xeradeeda. Waxay sheegtay in biyaha fatahaadda ay qaadeen guri ka samaysan baco iyo alwaax la isku dhisay oo ay ka caawisay mid ka mid ah hay’adaha maxaliga ah. Waxay rajo xuntahay sidii ay uga soo kaban lahayd. “Meeshii la daganaa biyaha ayaa soo galay. Meel tag ah ayaa nala geeyey. Waxaa nageeyey ciidanka Dowlada. Bac ma haysano roob ayaa habeen iyo maalinba da’aya. Wax la’aanta iyo gaajada ayaa u sii dheer. Sidaas ayaan ku suganahay.” Waxay tilmaamtay in saygeeda uusan xaaladda ay wajahayaan carruurtiisu uusan kala dabaalan karin. Wuxuu ka mid yahay dadka qaba baahiyaha gaarka ah, gaar ahaan indho la’aan muddo 10 sano ah. Musiibooyinka dabiiciga ah iyo kuwa dadku sameeyaan ayaa isku biirsaday haweenaydan iyo qoyskeeda. Billowgii sanadkan ayay ka soo barakceen Jamaame, halkaas oo ay ku leeyihiin beer 12 hiktar ah. Waxaa soo salkiciyay dagaal u dhaxeeya ciidamada dowladda iyo kooxda Alshabaab, kaas oo ka galaaftay dalag iskugu jiray gallay, digir iyo sisin, kaas oo u saarnaa beerta iyo guri labo qol ah. Waxaa la mid ah duruuf ahaan Abuukar Nuur Sabriye iyo qoyskiisa oo 13 ah, kuwaas oo galay lixdii bil ee u danbeeyay barakac iyo nolol xumo u raacday. Waxay cuuryaamiyeen horumar kasta oo uu naawilayay. Tan bishii Febraayo wuxuu ku foogganaa sidii uu u la qabsan lahaa xero barakac oo uu ku biiray, taas oo ku taalla Baar-sanguuni, halkaas oo guri labo qol ah uu ka samaystay, balse nasiib daro ma sii waarin. Waxaa ciidda ku daray fatahaad uu sameeyay webiga Jubba bishii May. Wuxuu sheegay in fatahaadda ay ku noqotay lama-filaan aysan ka sii tabaabushaysan. Wuxuu sharraxaya sida ay u saamaysay. “Ismaynaan lahayn meesha ayey soo gaadhayaan biyaha. Waxaan Aragnay xili habeen ah biyaha webiga oo dhinac walba naga maray. Wixii alaab iyo Maacuun ah biyaha ayaa naga qaadday. Waxba biyaha nooma dhaafin. Laakiin carruurta waan ka soo badbaadsanay.” Wuxuu sheegay in 48 saacba hal mar ay helaan wax ay cunaan. Waxaa si aan joogto ahayn ugu caawiya dadka beeraley iyo xoolo-dhaqato, kuwaas oo laftoodu la tacaalaya dhibaatada ay fatahaaddu sababtay. Wuxuu tilmaamay in qoyskiisa uu ku nool yahay xaalad adag. Waxay bannaan-yaal u yihiin qobowga iyo dhibicda roobka. Waxay ku heleen dhul taag ah, halkaas oo tageen markii webigu ku fatahay. “Meel bannaan bay taagan yihiin dadka. Wax hooy ah oo ay haystaan malaha. Meel ay uga gabanayaan malahan. Kaneecada dadka waa na dhamaysay oo marakaneeco maleh. Habeenkii marka roobka uu imaado waxaa lagu soo cararaa gidaarada guryaha tuulada oo jiingadaha hoostoda la iska fariistaa.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray in dhibaatada ay fatahaaddu u horseedday ay qayb ka tahay shaqo la’aan. Biyaha fatahaadda ayaa meel walba xiray. Waxay ka hor istaageen shaqo beero falis ah oo uu qaban jiray. Howshan ka istaagtay oo ahayd shaqo-cunno-ku beddelasho wuxuu ku helayay khudaar iyo raashin maalinle ah, balse biyo baxada oo hakad ku keentay tacabka beeraha ayaa saamayn ku yeelatay. “Meel aan ka shaqayno malahan. Meel loo xoogsi tago ma jirto. Mar mar waxaa na caawiya ciidamada oo garaamkooda wax nooga keena si aan ilmaha u siisano. Waxaa wax noo keenaan hal waqti oo kaliya. Dadka deegaanka wax walba waa nala Jeclaanlahayeen. Laakiin waxba mahaystaan.” Wuxuu ka soo barakacay tuulada Buulo-aji oo hoostagta dagmada Jamaame. Wuxuu halkaas ku lahaa beer 12 hiktar ah. Waxaa u saarnaa labo matoor oo uu ku waraabin jiray. Wuxuu sheegay in dalag u saarnaa iyo agabka beerta lagu waraabiyo uu ka soo cararay, markii dagaal uu ka qarxay, kaas oo u dhaxeeya ciidmada dowladda iyo Alshabaab. Saamaynta fatahaadda ayaa si guud u saamaysay dadka deegaanka Baar-sanguuni, kuwaas oo u badan beeraley ay fatahaaddu baabi’isay dalagyadooda sida uu sheegay guddoomiyaha deegaankan Maslax Saalim Cali. Wuxuu xusay in dadka ugu nugul ay yihiin kuwa barakac ku ah, kuwaas oo ka soo kaban waayay hoy la’aanta iyo nolol xumada ay sababtay fatahaadda. Maamulka, ciidamada iyo dadka tuulada ayuu tilmaamay in ay wajir u caawiyaan, balse aysan ku filnaan taageeradaas. “Dadkii waan soo rarnay oo waxaan dejinay meel bannaan oo ku dhow tuulada oo iskuulka banaankiisa ah. Caqabada ugu wayn  ee haysata dadka waa hooy la’aan. Ma haystaan Marakaneeco iyo meel ay ka galaan dhaxanta iyo dhibicda roobka. Dadka deegaanka tabar malahan ay walaalahood ku caawiyaan.” Dhibaatooyinka fatahaadda, colaadaha qabiilaysan iyo kuwa kooxaysan ay ku hayaan dadka nugul ayaa sare u sii kacaya, waxaana gobollada dhaca koonfurta dalka ay yihiin kuwa ugu badan ee wajahaya musiibooyinkan isbiirsaday.
