Waxaa soo salkiciyay dagaal u dhaxeeya ciidamada dowladda iyo kooxda Alshabaab, kaas oo ka galaaftay dalag iskugu jiray gallay, digir iyo sisin, kaas oo u saarnaa beerta iyo guri labo qol ah. Waxaa la mid ah duruuf ahaan Abuukar Nuur Sabriye iyo qoyskiisa oo 13 ah, kuwaas oo galay lixdii bil ee u danbeeyay barakac iyo nolol xumo u raacday. Waxay cuuryaamiyeen horumar kasta oo uu naawilayay. Tan bishii Febraayo wuxuu ku foogganaa sidii uu u la qabsan lahaa xero barakac oo uu ku biiray, taas oo ku taalla Baar-sanguuni, halkaas oo guri labo qol ah uu ka samaystay, balse nasiib daro ma sii waarin. Waxaa ciidda ku daray fatahaad uu sameeyay webiga Jubba bishii May. Wuxuu sheegay in fatahaadda ay ku noqotay lama-filaan aysan ka sii tabaabushaysan. Wuxuu sharraxaya sida ay u saamaysay. “Ismaynaan lahayn meesha ayey soo gaadhayaan biyaha. Waxaan Aragnay xili habeen ah biyaha webiga oo dhinac walba naga maray. Wixii alaab iyo Maacuun ah biyaha ayaa naga qaadday. Waxba biyaha nooma dhaafin. Laakiin carruurta waan ka soo badbaadsanay.” Wuxuu sheegay in 48 saacba hal mar ay helaan wax ay cunaan. Waxaa si aan joogto ahayn ugu caawiya dadka beeraley iyo xoolo-dhaqato, kuwaas oo laftoodu la tacaalaya dhibaatada ay fatahaaddu sababtay. Wuxuu tilmaamay in qoyskiisa uu ku nool yahay xaalad adag. Waxay bannaan-yaal u yihiin qobowga iyo dhibicda roobka. Waxay ku heleen dhul taag ah, halkaas oo tageen markii webigu ku fatahay. “Meel bannaan bay taagan yihiin dadka. Wax hooy ah oo ay haystaan malaha. Meel ay uga gabanayaan malahan. Kaneecada dadka waa na dhamaysay oo marakaneeco maleh. Habeenkii marka roobka uu imaado waxaa lagu soo cararaa gidaarada guryaha tuulada oo jiingadaha hoostoda la iska fariistaa.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray in dhibaatada ay fatahaaddu u horseedday ay qayb ka tahay shaqo la’aan. Biyaha fatahaadda ayaa meel walba xiray. Waxay ka hor istaageen shaqo beero falis ah oo uu qaban jiray. Howshan ka istaagtay oo ahayd shaqo-cunno-ku beddelasho wuxuu ku helayay khudaar iyo raashin maalinle ah, balse biyo baxada oo hakad ku keentay tacabka beeraha ayaa saamayn ku yeelatay. “Meel aan ka shaqayno malahan. Dadka deegaanka wax walba waa nala Jeclaanlahayeen. Laakiin waxba mahaystaan.” Wuxuu ka soo barakacay tuulada Buulo-aji oo hoostagta dagmada Jamaame. Wuxuu halkaas ku lahaa beer 12 hiktar ah. Waxaa u saarnaa labo matoor oo uu ku waraabin jiray. Wuxuu sheegay in dalag u saarnaa iyo agabka beerta lagu waraabiyo uu ka soo cararay, markii dagaal uu ka qarxay, kaas oo u dhaxeeya ciidmada dowladda iyo Alshabaab. Saamaynta fatahaadda ayaa si guud u saamaysay dadka deegaanka Baar-sanguuni, kuwaas oo u badan beeraley ay fatahaaddu baabi’isay dalagyadooda sida uu sheegay guddoomiyaha deegaankan Maslax Saalim Cali. Wuxuu xusay in dadka ugu nugul ay yihiin kuwa barakac ku ah, kuwaas oo ka soo kaban waayay hoy la’aanta iyo nolol xumada ay sababtay fatahaadda. Maamulka, ciidamada iyo dadka tuulada ayuu tilmaamay in ay wajir u caawiyaan, balse aysan ku filnaan taageeradaas. “Dadkii waan soo rarnay oo waxaan dejinay meel bannaan oo ku dhow tuulada oo iskuulka banaankiisa ah. Caqabada ugu wayn  ee haysata dadka waa hooy la’aan. Ma haystaan Marakaneeco iyo meel ay ka galaan dhaxanta iyo dhibicda roobka. Dadka deegaanka tabar malahan ay walaalahood ku caawiyaan.” Dhibaatooyinka fatahaadda, colaadaha qabiilaysan iyo kuwa kooxaysan ay ku hayaan dadka nugul ayaa sare u sii kacaya, waxaana gobollada dhaca koonfurta dalka ay yihiin kuwa ugu badan ee wajahaya musiibooyinkan isbiirsaday. items.title: Ghost Embassies: The Decay of Somalia’s Foreign Ministry
items.description: By Dayib Sh Ahmed The damage inflicted on Somalia’s fragile state-building project by entrenched political networks is so enormous and wide-ranging that it is hard to fully grasp. It runs the gamut from the hollowing out of public institutions to the erosion of core diplomatic customs, transforming sovereign statecraft into a vehicle for private extraction. In their recent book How States Think , political scientists John Mearsheimer and Sebastian Rosato argue that states generally act rationally and strategically, basing their foreign policy decisions on a careful assessment of threats, opportunities, and balances of power. Somalia’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA), however, increasingly operates in a reality that defies this traditional rational calculus. Rather than projecting national security interests abroad, the central apparatus in Mogadishu has allowed its global diplomatic outposts to become unaccountable, personalized fiefdoms where the sovereign assets of the Somali people are bartered away like private commodities. Plato wisely noted when he said that one of the penalties for refusing to participate in politics is that you end up being governed by your inferiors. As I have argued in earlier columns, including “ Somalia’s Foreign Policy: A Spectacle of Incompetence, ” the destructive consequences of mismanagement within Somalia’s foreign affairs institutions have been evident for some time. Yet, rather than improving, the situation appears to be deteriorating, with new controversies and governance failures emerging on an almost daily basis. The latest allegations surrounding embassy properties in Nigeria serve as another troubling example of a broader institutional crisis. One way to bring home the depth of this institutional decay is to look at a specific case. The recently unsealed investigative report by the High Advisory Committee of the MFA dated May 4, 2026 detailing the illicit liquidation of Somali state property in Abuja, Nigeria, is more than just an indictment of a rogue diplomat. It is a devastating exposure of structural collapse at the absolute highest echelons of the Ministry. The committee’s findings read like a corporate raider’s manual rather than a diplomatic briefing. According to the investigation, former Ambassador Jamal Mohamed Barrow unilaterally orchestrated an illicit “swap agreement.” He allegedly exchanged a prime, 3,202.67-square-meter piece of sovereign state property (Plot No. 1191 in Abuja’s prestigious Katampe Extension) for a residential building owned by a private Nigerian citizen located entirely outside the secure diplomatic zone. Worse still, the former ambassador actively denied the existence of a second, highly valuable tract of state property a 3,027.80-square-meter plot (Plot No. 39 in Guzape II) until the committee confronted him with irrefutable land registration documents. Perhaps most alarming is the revelation that the original sovereign titles to these state lands were handed over to unvetted foreign “facilitators” under the flimsy guise of administrative assistance. This represents an unprecedented, reckless abandonment of sovereign immunity and asset protection. To understand the political mechanics shielding such an audacious heist, one must look beyond the individual and examine the political networks that insulate him. One diplomat replied to my inquiry about the case by email, writing “Jamaal Barrow, a prominent member of Damujadiid and former Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs (2013), who also previously served as Somalia’s Ambassador to Nigeria, has been accused of unlawfully appropriating land belonging to the Somali Embassy. According to reports produced by committees within the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and judicial institutions, evidence was reportedly identified indicating that a criminal offense may have occurred. A panel of experts that reviewed the matter allegedly recommended that legal proceedings be initiated.” This is where the true crisis of governance reveals itself. A diplomat does not wake up one morning and decide to liquidate, swap, and conceal thousands of square meters of sovereign national soil unless they are entirely confident that nobody is watching or, more accurately, that their political faction will protect them from consequence. The profound betrayal engineered in Abuja is the direct byproduct of a culture of impunity nurtured by the incompetency of the current State Minister Ali Omer (AKA) Balcad, For years, the political leadership of the MFA has treated foreign postings as political rewards rather than strategic, highly scrutinized extensions of state authority. By failing to implement basic institutional guardrails, the state Ministry’s leadership has abdicated its foundational constitutional duties. However, despite the existence of official findings and explicit recommendations from internal experts, no visible legal action has been taken to date. This paralysis raises severe concerns and suspicions that political connections or special interests namely, the enduring influence of factions like Damujadiid may be actively hindering the fair and impartial implementation of justice. As constitutional scholars and political scientists frequently warn, the longest shadow cast by institutional corruption is the destruction of norms. Norms take decades to develop because they rest on habits of restraint and the expectation that violations will be punished. But they can disappear virtually overnight once it becomes clear that punishment is not coming. When a federal appointee openly defies a high-level investigative committee and faces no judicial reckoning, it teaches every other sitting ambassador a dangerous lesson: state property is yours to plunder, provided you have the right political cover in Mogadishu. The foundation of good governance is the rule of law, and no individual should be above it. If credible evidence and official determinations establish that national property was unlawfully misappropriated, it is essential that the relevant legal measures be carried out transparently. The current State Minister cannot absolve himself of responsibility by pointing to the complexities of foreign jurisdictions. The Ministry’s leadership bears responsibility for the systemic negligence that made this heist possible. True accountability requires an immediate and comprehensive overhaul of how the Ministry of Foreign Affairs manages its global assets. Until the Ministry’s leadership accepts responsibility for these failures and strips heads of mission of unilateral asset-management authority, the sovereign assets of the Somali people will remain dangerously exposed to the predatory actions of unaccountable officials. The Architecture of a Bad System To understand how a scandal of this magnitude unfolds and why it is so rarely punished we must look at the psychology of the individuals the system elevates. In his incisive book Corruptible: Who Gets Power and How It Changes Us , political scientist Brian Klaas observes a grim reality about modern leadership: “Often wrong, never uncertain remains a winning strategy in too much of our world.” This perfectly encapsulates the sheer audacity of Ambassador Barrow’s defense. When confronted by a six-member panel of senior diplomats, he lacked any written authorization, cabinet memos, or ministerial directives to justify the alienation of state property. He was legally and ethically wrong. Yet, he operated with the unwavering certainty of a man who knew his political faction, Damujadiid, would shield him. He confidently defied the National Auditor General’s federal decree nullifying the illegal property swap, projecting a resolute arrogance that dared Mogadishu to stop him. In a fragile state where institutional authority is weak, this type of weaponized certainty often triumphs over the rule of law. But the blame does not rest solely on the shoulders of one brazen diplomat. As Klaas further explains: “Corruptible people are drawn to power. They’re often better at getting it. We, as humans, are drawn to following the wrong leaders for irrational reasons linked to our Stone Age brains. Bad systems make everything worse.” Somalia’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs is the textbook definition of a bad system. By treating diplomatic postings as the spoils of political patronage rather than rigorous extensions of statecraft, the Ministry actively attracts the corruptible. When there are no proactive auditing safeguards, no centralized property tracking, and no immediate consequences for defiance, the environment practically begs to be exploited. The administrative vacuum maintained by the State-Minister does not just accidentally allow for the liquidation of state assets; it structurally incentivizes it. The Abuja embassy scandal is not a localized anomaly; it is the inevitable byproduct of a foreign service that has lost its way. When asked to evaluate the state Ministry’s proposed emergency remedies, one former Somali diplomat characterized the situation to me bluntly. “These represent a desperate exercise in damage control. It is a fire brigade response to a house that has already burned to the ground. Sending a high-level ministerial delegation across the continent to recover stolen land deeds from foreign brokers is a deeply embarrassing spectacle. It serves as a direct challenge to the top leadership.” Indeed, dispatching a multi-agency delegation to West Africa fails to address the root cause of the rot. If the State Minister claim they are in control of the nation’s foreign footprint, they must prove it by looking inward rather than flying outward. Until the top leadership accepts structural responsibility and entirely dismantles the bad system they oversee stripping individual ambassadors of unilateral property-signing authority and centralizing asset management under an independent Board of Trustees accountability will remain a convenient illusion. If the government in Mogadishu refuses to implement an urgent systemic reforms, the ghost embassies of Somalia will continue to be quietly sold off, brick by brick, by those drawn to power solely for what they can extract from it. Dayib Sh. Ahmed Email: Dayib0658@gmail.com —— Dayib is a political analyst, WardheerNews contributor . and co-author of forthcoming book- Searching for Meaning, Somalia’s Quest for Good Governance. items.title: Reckless Convoy Sparks Gun Battle in Garowe, Raising Fears of Wider Conflict in Puntland
items.description: Garowe (WDN)- What began as the movement of a heavily armed convoy toward Garowe on Tuesday night quickly escalated into one of the most alarming security incidents Puntland has witnessed in recent months, exposing the dangerous consequences of increasingly militarized politics and the growing risk posed by unauthorized armed groups operating under political banners. The confrontation erupted at an eastern security checkpoint outside Garowe when Puntland security forces intercepted a heavily armed convoy linked to the protection detail of politician known as “Mashruuc,” a figure aligned with political circles in Mogadishu. According to multiple sources, the politician himself was not present. Mr. Mashruuc is currently in Mogadishu. The convoy involved in the clash consisted of members of his security escort and armed supporters attempting to enter Garowe. What happened next sent shockwaves through the Puntland capital. Witnesses reported sustained gunfire as Puntland forces confronted the convoy. Initial reports indicate that several individuals were killed or wounded, with most casualties believed to have occurred among the convoy’s armed escort. Officials have not yet released verified casualty figures. The incident immediately raised troubling questions about why such a large and heavily armed force was attempting to enter the city despite heightened security measures and ongoing political tensions. Residents described scenes of panic as heavy weapons fire echoed across eastern Garowe. One witness said the sound of gunfire continued for several minutes, far exceeding what would normally be expected from a routine checkpoint dispute. More alarming were reports that heavy weapons were used during the confrontation. A local resident told reporters that a DShK heavy-machine-gun round struck his family home during the fighting. “The projectile entered a room where children sleep,” he said, describing a terrifying near-miss that could easily have resulted in civilian deaths. The incident served as a stark reminder of how quickly political disputes involving armed actors can transform residential areas into battle zones, placing innocent civilians at immediate risk. Warnings Ignored Sources familiar with the events told WardheerNews that elders from the Carmo area had reportedly advised representatives of the convoy to limit the size of their armed escort before proceeding toward Garowe. According to those accounts, community leaders recommended that only a single vehicle and a small number of security personnel accompany the group in order to avoid misunderstandings with Puntland security forces. Those recommendations were allegedly rejected. Instead, a much larger armed convoy continued toward the city, creating precisely the type of confrontation local elders had hoped to prevent. Security analysts say the decision demonstrated a remarkable lack of judgment given the prevailing political climate and the known sensitivities surrounding armed movements inside Puntland. Following the clash, a statement issued in the name of Mr. Mashruuc blamed Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni for the violence. Critics, however, questioned the basis of the accusation, noting that the convoy itself arrived carrying heavy weapons mounted on pickup trucks and attempted to move through a controlled security checkpoint. The statement was released while the politician remained in Mogadishu, far from the scene of the confrontation. Several observers noted the irony that such a convoy would be unlikely to move freely through many areas of Mogadishu without attracting an immediate security response from government forces. The incident has further deepened concerns about the increasingly confrontational tone adopted by some opposition figures and their supporters. Beyond the immediate clash, the Garowe incident has reignited debate over the growing presence of armed groups operating outside Puntland’s established security command structures. Puntland authorities have repeatedly expressed concern about the emergence of clan-based militias and armed formations allegedly receiving support from political actors aligned with the Federal Government in Mogadishu. Officials argue that allowing parallel armed structures to operate inside Puntland threatens the state’s security architecture and risks creating competing chains of command. Security experts warn that such developments could have severe consequences if left unchecked. What occurred outside Garowe was not merely a checkpoint dispute. It was a confrontation that could easily have spiraled into a broader armed conflict between rival forces, drawing communities into a crisis that neither side may have intended. Had the exchange of fire lasted longer, had reinforcements arrived from either side, or had civilian casualties been higher, Puntland could have found itself facing a far more serious security emergency. A Test for Puntland’s Stability The timing of the clash is particularly sensitive as opposition politicians have been gathering in Garowe for political consultations. One opposition figure, Hassan Shire Abgaalow, arrived peacefully in Garowe a day earlier without incident, demonstrating that political participation itself is not the issue. The controversy instead centers on the use of heavily armed escorts and the growing tendency to blur the line between political activity and military mobilization. For many Puntland residents, the events of Tuesday night were a sobering warning. The exchange of gunfire exposed how fragile stability can become when political competition is accompanied by armed convoys, competing loyalties, and increasingly inflammatory rhetoric. As investigations continue and tensions remain high, one conclusion is becoming difficult to ignore: Puntland’s greatest challenge may no longer be political disagreement itself, but the dangerous normalization of armed politics that threatens to turn political disputes into military confrontations. For a region that has spent decades building one of Somalia’s most stable security environments, the stakes could hardly be higher. Had the exchange of fire lasted longer, had reinforcements arrived from either side, or had civilian casualties been higher, Puntland could have found itself facing a far more serious security emergency. A Test for Puntland’s Stability The timing of the clash is particularly sensitive as opposition politicians have been gathering in Garowe for political consultations. One opposition figure, Hassan Shire Abgaalow, arrived peacefully in Garowe a day earlier without incident, demonstrating that political participation itself is not the issue. The controversy instead centers on the use of heavily armed escorts and the growing tendency to blur the line between political activity and military mobilization. For many Puntland residents, the events of Tuesday night were a sobering warning. The exchange of gunfire exposed how fragile stability can become when political competition is accompanied by armed convoys, competing loyalties, and increasingly inflammatory rhetoric. As investigations continue and tensions remain high, one conclusion is becoming difficult to ignore: Puntland’s greatest challenge may no longer be political disagreement itself, but the dangerous normalization of armed politics that threatens to turn political disputes into military confrontations. For a region that has spent decades building one of Somalia’s most stable security environments, the stakes could hardly be higher. items.title: Daaawo: Gabadhii lagu dhibaateeyay Muqdisho ‘oo la waayay’
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimad Online) – Guddoomiyaha Ururka Haweenka Gobolka Banaadir, Jawaahir Baarqab oo maanta shir jaraa’id ku qabatay magaalada Muqdisho ayaa ka hadashay arrimo ku aadan falkii lagu dhibaateeyay gabar ku sugneyd goob fagaare ah oo ku taalla Muqdisho, laguna soo dhaweynayay mid kamid gabdhaha isticmaala baraha bulshada oo kusoo laabatay caasimada. Muuqaalka gabadha yar oo ku baahay baraha bulshada ayaa muujinayo wiilal dhalinyaro ah oo ku xadgudbayo gabadha, waxaana ka dhashay caro xoogan. Marwo Jawaahir Baarqab ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in ay raadiyeen gabadha la dhibaateeyay balse ay waayeen, iyada oo su’aal ka keentay sida ay wax u dheceen. Guddoomiyaha Haweenka Gobolka Banaadir ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in dhacdadan ay u eeg-tahay mid lasoo abaabulay oo laga leeyahay dano gaar ah. “Gabadhii dhibka ku dhacay waxaan ka raadinay gobolka Banaadir meel walba ka raadinay waan la’nahay marka ma iyaga ayaa gabadha soo abaabulay oo qorshe ay wadeen ayay ahayd? waayo falka dhacay iyo hadalkooda ayaa isku xigsaday,” ayay tiri guddoomiyaha haweenka ee gobolka Banadir. Sidoo kale waxay jawaab adag siisay gadhihii mudaharaadka dhigay u dacwooday beesha caalamka. “Gabdhahaas tacaddiga, dulmiga iyo beenta sheeganaayo iyo Xalane ayaan u dirsaneynaa beesha caalamka la hadleynaa waddankan beel caalam kama talisee waxay caawisaa bulshada Soomaaliyeed”. Dhinaca kale, waxay farriin u dirtay laamaha amniga Soomaaliya oo ay ugu baaqday inay tallaabo deg-deg ah ka qaadaan gabdhaha siyaasadeynaya kiiskan ee baraha bulshada ka wada ololaha xooggan. “Waxaan rabnaa laamaha amniga in tallaabo sharciga waafaqsan ay ka qaadaan gabdhahaas, gabar rabta iyadoo qaawan inay Liido isku soo duubto oo xeebaha ay tagto oo Jasiiro tagto, haddana rabto inay xijaab soo qaadato oo boor kale Feminist keento qof ka yeelaayo ma jirto,” ayay markale tiri. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo haatan ciidamada Booliska Soomaaliya ay weli baadi goob ugu jiraan raggii ka dambeeyay falkaasi, si cadaaladda loo horkeeno dambiileyaasha. Xeer Ilaalinta Qaranka ayaa dhankeeda baaris ku haysa dhacdada, waxayna sheegtay in tallaabo laga qaadi doono cid kasta oo lagu helO inay ku lug lahayd falka lagu dhibaateeyay gabadha yar. items.title: Ansarullah Official Issues Stark Warning Over Alleged Israeli Naval Presence Near Somalia
items.description: Sana (WDN)- A senior leader of Yemen’s Ansarullah movement has issued a sharp warning over the reported presence of Israeli forces in Somalia’s territorial waters, declaring that any such deployment would be treated as a legitimate military target. Mohammed al-Farah, a member of Ansarullah’s political bureau, said on Monday that any Israeli activity in Somali waters represents a serious regional escalation, stressing the strategic importance of the Red Sea and the Bab al-Mandab strait as one of the world’s most critical maritime corridors. “Any movement by the Zionist enemy in those waters will be seen as an attempt to control a vital shipping route and undermine the security of the entire region, including Saudi Arabia,” al-Farah said. He further argued that an Israeli military presence in Somali maritime space poses a direct threat to Yemen’s national security. Al-Farah added that Ansarullah leader Abdul-Malik Badr al-Din al-Houthi has previously warned that any Israeli or U.S. military presence in Somaliland would be considered a direct threat and met with a firm response. According to him, such deployments cross a “red line” and would be treated as legitimate military targets. The Ansarullah official also emphasized that security in the Red Sea, in his view, should not depend on foreign military bases or external forces, but rather on regional states and coastal countries taking responsibility for safeguarding their own waters. The warning comes against the backdrop of heightened geopolitical sensitivity in the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea corridor, following reports in December 2025 that Israel had recognized Somaliland. The Federal Government of Somalia strongly rejected the move, describing it as illegal and reiterating that Somaliland remains an integral part of Somalia’s sovereign territory. Several other countries and international organizations also dismissed the recognition, warning that it could further destabilize an already fragile regional security environment. items.title: Turkish Military Aircraft Land in Mogadishu as Defense Cooperation Deepens
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Two Turkish Air Force A400M Atlas transport aircraft have landed in Mogadishu in the past several hours, marking yet another visible sign of deepening military cooperation between Türkiye and Somalia. The aircraft, bearing tail numbers 18-0094 (TUAF753) and 18-0093 (TUAF752), departed from Kayseri, Türkiye, before arriving in the Somali capital on what security officials describe as a coordinated military movement linked to ongoing bilateral defense cooperation. According to a senior security official, the aircraft were carrying Somali troops who completed training programs in Türkiye. These units are expected to take part in Somalia’s upcoming Independence Week commemorations, underscoring the growing role of foreign-trained formations within national ceremonial and operational frameworks. Since 2014, Türkiye has steadily expanded its security footprint in Somalia through a layered partnership that began with training anti-riot police units and has since evolved into broader military cooperation. Over the years, the relationship has grown to include the training of pilots, naval personnel, and specialized units across multiple branches of the Somali security forces. Beyond military training, the two countries have signed a series of strategic agreements covering defense cooperation, maritime security, and joint exploration in the oil and gas sector—cementing one of the most comprehensive bilateral partnerships in the Horn of Africa. Reports further indicate that the same aircraft also facilitated the return of another contingent of Somali personnel to Türkiye for advanced training programs, focused on modern military technologies and specialized operational skills. The synchronized arrival and departure of these aircraft highlight not only logistical coordination but also the increasingly institutionalized nature of Somalia–Türkiye defense ties, now spanning training, deployment, and long-term capacity building. items.title: DFS OO SAXIIXDAY QANDARAASKA DARAASADDA IYO NAQSHADAYNTA WADDADA GALKAAYO–ELGUULA (100KM)
items.description: Muqdisho, 23 Juun 2026 – Wasaaradda Hawlaha Guud, Dib-u-dhiska iyo Guriyeynta ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta martigelisay munaasabad lagu saxiixayay qandaraaska adeegyada daraasadaynta, naqshadaynta, qiimeynta saameynta deegaanka iyo bulshada, iyo diyaarinta dukumentiyada qandaraas-bixinta ee qaybta Galkaayo–Elguula oo dhererkeedu yahay 100 kiiloomitir. Munaasabadda ayaa waxaa shir-guddoominayay Wasiirka Hawlaha Guud, Dib-u-dhiska iyo Guriyeynta, Mudane Ayub Ismaaciil Yuusuf, waxaana ka qeyb galay Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi, Wasiirka Hawlaha Guud ee Galmudug, Mudane Axmed Dhiblaawe Kaasir, masuuliyiin ka socday IBS Bank, GOB Community Organisation iyo shirkadda KKATT Consult Limited. Waddada Galkaayo–Hobyo ayaa loo arkaa mid ka mid ah kaabeyaasha ugu muhiimsan ee bartamaha Soomaaliya, maadaama ay isku xirto deegaannada gudaha iyo xeebaha Badweynta Hindiya. Mashruucan ayaa la filayaa inuu door weyn ka qaato kobcinta ganacsiga, fududeynta isu-socodka, kor u qaadista amniga iyo xoojinta isdhexgalka dhaqaalaha dalka. Bilowga daraasadaynta iyo naqshadaynta qaybta Galkaayo–Elguula ayaa ah tallaabo muhiim u ah hirgelinta guud ahaan waddada Galkaayo–Hobyo oo dhererkeedu dhan yahay 260 kiiloomitir. Wasiir Ayub Ismaaciil Yuusuf ayaa sheegay in mashruucani muhiimad gaar ah u leeyahay horumarinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha dalka, isagoo xusay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ka go’an tahay dardargelinta maalgashiga kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo xoojinta iskaashiga ay la leedahay Dowladda Galmudug iyo bah-wadaagta horumarinta. Sidoo kale, Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa bogaadiyay dadaallada lagu hirgelinayo mashruucan, isaga oo tilmaamay muhiimadda uu u leeyahay horumarka iyo isku xirnaanta dalka. Qandaraaska la saxiixay ayaa shirkadda KKATT Consult Limited u xilsaaraya fulinta daraasaadka farsamo, naqshadaynta hordhaca ah iyo tan faahfaahsan, qiimeynta saameynta deegaanka iyo bulshada, iyo diyaarinta dukumentiyada qandaraas-bixinta ee qaybta Galkaayo–Elguula (100KM). Mashruucan ayaa qayb ka ah Barnaamijka Horumarinta Kaabeyaasha Waddooyinka Soomaaliya (RIPSOM), oo ay maalgelinayaan Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika (AfDB) iyo Midowga Yurub (EU), isla markaana ay fulinayso Wasaaradda Hawlaha Guud, Dib-u-dhiska iyo Guriyeynta ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya

items.title: DFS oo ku dhawaaqay in Ururka Ahlu Sunna waljameeca laga saaray liiska kooxaha lagu tuhunsanyahay colaadaha iyo ku xadgudubka carruurta
items.description: Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqday in ururka Ahlu Sunna Waljamaaca (ASWJ) laga saaray liiska hay’adaha lagu tuhunsanaa xiriirka carruurta iyo colaadaha hubeysan, kadib markii la xaqiijiyay in ururku uu buuxiyay shuruudihii looga baahnaa ilaalinta xuquuqda carruurta. Qoraal rasmi ah oo kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa lagu sheegay in go’aankan uu ku yimid qiimeyn dheer iyo wada-shaqeyn dhexmartay ASWJ, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Qaramada Midoobay iyo hay’adaha kale ee bahwadaagta la ah arrimaha ilaalinta carruurta. Wasaaraddu waxay xustay in ASWJ muddooyinkii la soo dhaafay ay fulinaysay tallaabooyin lagu xaqiijinayo in aan carruurta loo adeegsan colaadaha hubeysan, isla markaana xubnaha ururka ay si buuxda ula shaqeeyeen hay’adaha amniga iyo kuwa caalamiga ah ee arrintan ku howlan. Sidoo kale, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in go’aankani uu qayb ka yahay dadaallada lagu xoojinayo dowladnimada, dib-u-habeynta hay’adaha amniga iyo hirgelinta waajibaadka caalamiga ah ee la xiriira ilaalinta carruurta xilliyada colaadaha. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa uga mahadcelisay Qaramada Midoobay, UNICEF, Dowladda Galmudug iyo dhammaan hay’adihii ka qayb qaatay geeddi-socodkan, kuwaas oo door muhiim ah ka qaatay xaqiijinta iyo dabagalka tallaabooyinka lagu ilaalinayo carruurta. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa mar kale ku celisay sida ay uga go’an tahay dhowrista xuquuqda carruurta, hirgelinta siyaasadaha qaran ee ilaalinta rayidka, iyo dhismaha hay’ado amni oo waafaqsan heerarka iyo shuruucda caalamiga ah.

items.title: Deadly Clan Violence in Sool as Civilians Buried in Mass Funeral
items.description: Laascaanood/Adhicadeeye, (WDN) – A devastating outbreak of clan violence in the Adhicadeeye area of Somalia’s Northeast- Sool region has left more than 20 people dead and dozens wounded, according to local sources, in one of the deadliest inter-clan confrontations witnessed in the region this year. The fighting, which erupted between two clans (Dhulbahante/Jaamac Siyaad and Fiqishini), involved the extensive use of heavy and light weapons and reportedly drew in armed vehicles dispatched from positions near the Sarinta front line in Guumeys. What began as a localized dispute quickly escalated into a large-scale armed confrontation, transforming rural communities into battlefields and leaving a trail of death and destruction in its wake. Local residents described scenes of chaos as gunfire echoed across the area for hours, forcing families to flee their homes while others found themselves trapped between the opposing forces. According to local reports from the ground, the latest bloodshed was triggered by the killing of a khat trader from the Jaamac Siyaad clan in Adhicadeeye on the previous day. What might otherwise have remained an isolated criminal incident rapidly evolved into a retaliatory cycle of violence that engulfed entire communities. The casualty toll continued to rise throughout the day as wounded victims were transported to nearby settlements and medical facilities. Sources familiar with the situation told WardheerNews that more than 20 people lost their lives, while many others sustained injuries of varying severity. The exact number of casualties remains difficult to verify independently due to the volatile security situation and limited access to the area. Particularly shocking are reports that many of those killed were civilians who had no direct involvement in the fighting. items.title: Daawo: DF oo war kasoo saartay shacabkii lagu laayay Ari-Caddeeye
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Soomaaliya,Cali Yuusuf Cali (Xoosh) oo wareysi kooban siiyay Telefishinka Soomaali Cable ayaa ka hadlay dagaalka ka dhacay deegaanka Ari-Caddeeye ee gobolka Sool, kaas oo lagu xasuuqay dad badan oo shacab ah ayna ku jiraan dad Birmageydo ah. Wasiir Cali Xoosh ayaa falka ka dhacay ku tilmaamay wax aan la aqbali karin, isla markaana aan u fiicneen Waqooyi Bari iyo guud ahaan Soomaali. “Deegaanka Ari-Caddeeye fidno ayaa ka dhacday oo aan u fiicneyn deegaanka iyo Soomaali aad iyo aad ayaan uga xunahay wixii dhacay waana wax aan u fiicneen qalbiga daahirka ah” ayuu yiri Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tacsi u diray ehellada dadka lagu dilay Ari-Caddeeye oo maanta aas wadareed loo sameeyay, isaga oo kuwa dhaawaca ah u rajeeyay caafimaad buuxa. “Waxaan Alle uga baryeynaa in intii ku dhimatay uu Eebbe u naxariisto intii ku dhaawacantana uu u booga dhayo,” ayuu mar kale Wasiir Cali Xoosh. Dhinaca kale, bayaan goor sii horreysay kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha oo lagu cambaareeyay dhacdadan ayaa baaq loogu diray beelaha labada dhinac oo loogu baaqay inay joojiyaan dagaallada dhexdooda ah iyo in lasii huriyo colaadda ka taagan duleedka magaalada Laascaanood. “Wasaaraddu waxay ku baaqaysaa in si degdeg ah oo shuruud la’aan ah loo joojiyo khilaafaadka iyo dhammaan falalka hurin kara colaadda, iyadoo dhinacyada ay khusayso loogu baaqayo inay ka hormariyaan nabadda, wada noolaanshaha iyo ilaalinta Xasiloonida shacabka,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Xaaladda deegaanka ayaa haatan deggan, kadib dagaal shalay halkaas ka dhacay oo sababay dhimashada in ka badan 20 ruux iyo dhaawaca tobannaan kale, sida ay xaqiijiyeen ilo deegaanka ah oo lagu kalsoonaan karo. Dagaalka ayaa galaaftay nolosha dad rayid ah, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah dadkii ku dhintay maanta la aasay, halka dhaawacyada qaar loo qaaday goobo caafimaad oo ku yaalla deegaannada u dhow, gaar ahaan Laascaanood. Wararka haatan laga helayo Ari-Caddeeye ayaa sheegaya in dadka ku dhintay dagaalka ay ku jireen haween, carruur iyo dad da’ ah, taas oo sare u qaadday walaaca laga qabo saameynta uu dagaalku ku yeeshay shacabka rayidka ah ee ku nool degmada. Dhanka kale, waxgaradka iyo odayaasha dhaqanka ee degmada Ari-Caddeeye ayaa wada dadaallo lagu qaboojinayo xaaladda, iyagoo ku baaqaya in la joojiyo colaadda iyo falalka aargoosiga ah ee keeni kara dagaallo hor leh. Dagaalka ka dhacay degmada Ari-Caddeeye ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli gobolka Sool ay marar kala duwan ka dhacayeen xiisado iyo dilal la xiriira aanooyin hore iyo khilaafaad deegaan, iyadoo shacabka deegaanku ay ka cabsi qabaan in xaaladdu mar kale faraha ka baxdo haddii aan xal degdeg ah laga gaarin. The post Daawo: DF oo war kasoo saartay shacabkii lagu laayay Ari-Caddeeye appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Agaasimaha Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadda oo kulan la yeeshay wefdi uu hoggaaminayay dhiggiisa dalka Austria
items.description: Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadda Soomaaliyeed (HSJ), Mudane Xuseen Qaasim Yuusuf, ayaa maanta Muqdisho ku soo dhaweeyay,  isla markaana kulan kula qaatay Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Socdaalka dalka Austria, Mudane Gernot Maier, iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayay. Agaasimaha Guud ee HSJ, Xuseen Qaasim Yuusuf, ayaa muujiyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo xiriirka iyo wada-shaqeynta labada hay’adoood. Sidoo kale Agaasimaha ayaa xusay in Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadda Soomaaliya ay ku jirto geeddi-socod dib-u-habeyn iyo casriyeyn ballaaran, oo muhiim u ah in la helo iskaashi caalami ah oo taageera dadaallada lagu horumarinayo adeegyada socdaalka iyo maamulka xuduudaha dalka. Dhankiisa, Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Socdaalka Austria, Gernot, ayaa uga mahadceliyay HSJ soo dhoweynta iyo fursadda ay u heleen wadashaqeynta labada hay’adood.

items.title: Wafdi iyo ciidamo ay dirtay DF oo gaaray Dhuusamareeb + Ujeedka
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Wafdi ka socda Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo galabta ka ambabaxay Muqdisho ayaa gaaray magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee caasimada Galmudug, halkaas oo lagu soo dhaweeyay. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, wafdigan ayaa hordhac u ah Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre oo lagu wado inuu berri gaaro magaalada Dhuusamareeb. Sidoo kale xubnaha wafdiga ee lagu soo dhaweeyay halkaas waxaa kamid ah ilaalada gaarka ah ee Ra’iisul wasaaraha. Qaban qaabada soo dhaweynta Ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale hadda laga dareemayaa magaalada Dhuusamareeb, oo uu ka bilaabi doono kulamo, sida ay soo sheegayaan Wariyeyaal ku sugan deegaannada Galmudug. Dhanka kale, ammaanka ayaa aad loo adkeeyay, iyada oo ciidamo dheeraad ah la dhigay meelaha muhiimka ah ee caasimada, si ay ula socdaan dhaq-dhaqaaqa gud, una sugaan amniga Ra’iisul wasaaraha iyo wafdigiisa. Waxaa sidoo kale, magaalada haatan ku sugan Agaasimaha Hay’adda NISA, Mahad Salaad oo wada-hadallo dhowr wareeg ah la galay Madaxweynaha Galmudug, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoor Qoor), kuwaas oo looga hadlay xiisadda siyaasadeed ee taagan, gaar ahaan arrimaha doorashooyinka. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in dadaallada socda uu sidoo kale ka qayb-geli doono Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza, si loo qanciyo Qoor Qoor, kadibna doorasho qof iyo cod ah looga qabto deegaannada Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug. Wada-hadalladan ayaa lagu soo warramayaa in is-faham hordhac ah laga gaaray, isla markaana dhamaystirkooda uu goobjoog noqon doono Xamza, iyada oo kadib qorshuhu yahay in doorasho toos ah laga qabto Galmudug. Villa Somalia ayaa dooneysa in isbeddel siyaasadeed laga sameeyo Galmudug, isla markaana doorashada madaxtinimada Galmudug ee la qabanayo bisha July lagu doorto musharrax ka imaan doona urur-siyaasadeedka JSP. Waxaa aad loo hadal hayaa in musharraxaasi noqon karo ganacsade Liibaan Axmed Xasan, haddii uusan isbeddelin mowqifka taageerada madaxtooyada ee ku aaddan ninkaas. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, d adka reer Galmudug ayaa isha ku haya xiisadda taagan, oo ay garowsan yihiin inay khatar dhab ah ku tahay jiritaanka Galmudug, isla markaana ay sii kala fogeyn karto bulshada maamulkaasi. items.title: Geerida aynu ka ordaynaa way inala kulmaysaa!!!
items.description: GEERIDA AYNU KA ORDAYNAA WAY INNALA KULMAYSAA. Binu aadmigu geerida ma jecla, hadday meel yari ku xanuunto dhaqtar iyo dawaad doonanaysaa, hindiya iyo itoobiya ama yurub ayaad nafta kula cararaysaa haddaad karayso, kumaankun lacaga ayaad caafimaadkaaga u hurayasaa haddaad haysato, haddaba walaalayaal waxa habboon inaanaad adigu is qaadsiin xanuun ciqaab ilaahay kuugu imanaya. Waxaynu nahay dad muslim ah oo uu ilaahay maamulo oo uu u soo rogay laba waddo shar iyo khayr, haddaad waddada khayrka aad raacdid caafimaadkaagu inta badan wuu fiicnaanaya. Haddaad waddada sharka aad raacdid oo aad xalaashato wuxuu ilaahay xarrimay adigoo ummadana fasahaad ku dhex qaybinaya guulaysanmaysid. Ilaahay wuxuu kuu soo dirayaa digniino dhiigaaga oo uu subaggu ku bato macaanku ku bato dhiigkar IWM. Waxyaalahaasi markay kugu soo socdaan waxaad is weydiisaa waxaad cuntay maxay yihiin xaaraan iyo xalaal oo is daba qabo intaanay masiibadu ubadkaaga iyo qoyskiinaba aanay silcin intaanay caarkiinu kuu guurseegin oo aan looga cararin fasahaadka aad qaybinayso, waxaad tahay addoon diciifa ee is hubso dib ugu noqo camalkaaga xun ummaddana xishmee. MAHADSANID. CABDI BACAW. GUUL ALLE.

items.title: Dadkii lagu xasuuqay Adhicadeeye oo maanta meydkoodii si jamac ah loogu tukaday
items.description: Dadkii shicibka ahaa ee shalay lagu xasuuqay deegaanka Adhicadeeye ee bariga Sool oo maanta jinaasad wadeer loogu tukaday isla markaasina loo sameeyay xabaal wadareed. Shalay ayaa ciidamo hubaysan oo ka soo kicitimay magaaladda Laascaanood ay weerar ku soo qaadeen Tuulada Adhicadeeyo oo galbeed kaga beegan magaaladda Laascanood halkaasi oo ay xasuuq ka geysteen isla markaasina ay guryo badan dab qabadsiiyeen iyaga oo sidoo kale xasuuqay dad tiro badan gaystayna dhaawac faro badan. Ma aha markii ugi horaysay ee xasuuq noocani ah uu ka dheco deegaankaasi lagu xasuuqaayo dadka Fuqashini ee dega halkaasi sanadkan gudihiisa waa markii labaad ee uu xasuuqani oo kale dhaco iyada oo xiligaasi au dhimashadu kor u dhaaftay 30 qof. Hubkani ay dadkani isku xasuuqayaan waxa isugu dhiibay oo keenay xukuumadda Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud gaar ahaan wasiirkiisa gashaan dhiga Fiqi, iyaga oo ay u jeedadoodu ahayd in ay ku weeraraan dawlada Somaliland iyo maamul goboleedka Puntland oo ay xukuumadda Xasan Sheekh damacsanyd in ay dhulkaasi nabdoon ay colaad ka abuurto. Dhanka kalana waxa ay dadka shicibka ee reer Laascaanood ay aad uga qaylinayaan dilalka qorshaysan iyo kuwa badheedhka ah oo ku soo badanaaya magaaladaasi taasi oo maamulka halkaasi ka jiraa uu waxba ka qab kari laayahay sidoo kale waxa ay dadku aad uga qaylinayaan kufsiga oo ah waxa ay haweenka reer Laascaanood ayna hore u arki jirin se hada ah dhibta ugu weyn ee ay haweenku xiligani ka cabsadaan

items.title: Court Closes Sacdiya Bajaaj Case Hearings as Ruling Awaited
items.description: The Banadir Regional Court on Tuesday concluded hearings in the case against Sacdiya Bajaaj, who is facing charges related to alleged public incitement, with the court’s verdict now pending. The nearly three-hour session included submissions from the prosecution, questioning of the defendant, and arguments presented by Sacdiya Bajaaj’s defence lawyers. Banadir Regional Court Chairman Salah Dabaan declared the hearings formally closed, saying the court would announce at a later date when its final ruling will be delivered. Speaking after the hearing, Sacdiya Bajaaj’s defence lawyer, Advocate Khalane, said all stages of the trial had been completed and that the defence is now awaiting the court’s decision. He maintained that the prosecution had failed to present evidence or witnesses to substantiate the charges. “There is no evidence or witness testimony supporting the allegations against Sacdiya Bajaaj,” Advocate Khalane said. The court had recently returned the case file to the prosecution, instructing it to complete or strengthen the charges and supporting evidence. Sacdiya Bajaaj, who has been detained by the Federal Government of Somalia for 74 days, appeared once again before the Banadir Regional Court as the hearing phase of the case came to an end. items.title: Trump oo sheegay in Iran ay ogaalatay in la baaro goobaha nukleerka
items.description: Washington ( Raxanreeb Online) Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in “Iran ay si buuxda oo shuruud la’aan ah u ogolaatay in baaritaano heerkoodu sareeyo lagu sameeyo Nukliyeerkeeda, kuwaa oo soconaya muddo aad u dheer mustaqbalka (weligood!!!)’. “Haddii Iran aysan aqbali lahayn arrintan, ma jiri lahayn wax wada xaajood ah oo dheeraad ah.” Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa yiri. Saacado ka hor, afhayeenka wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda ee Iran, Esmail Baghaei ayaa sheegay in Iran aysan qorsheyneynin inay IAEA u ogolaato inay booqdaan xarumaha nukliyeerka ee ku waxyeeloobay dagaalka. Hadalkan ayaa u muuqday mid jawaab u ah hadalkii shalay kasoo yeeray madaxweyne ku xigeenka Mareykanka J.D. Vance ee ahaa in Iran ay ogolaatay soo celinta kormeerayaasha IAEA. items.title: Soomaaliya oo garab istaag wayn u muujisay Qatar kadib..
items.description: Doha (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo warsaxaafadeed soo saartay ayaa ka hadashay qaraxii xoogganaa ee ka dhacay xarunta ugu weyn ee dalka Qatar ee lagu sifeeyo gaaska dabiiciga ah ee dareeraha ah (LNG), taas oo ku taalla Aagga Warshadaha ee Ras Laffan. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa marka hore u tacsiyeeysay dowladda iyo shacabka Qatar, maadaama waxyeelo uu gaystay qaraxaasi oo sababay dhimasho iyo dhaawac intaba. “Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay tacsida iyo murugada la wadaagaysaa Dowladda iyo shacabka Qatar, sidoo kale qoysaska ay dhibaatadu saameysay, waxayna dhaawacyada u rajaynaysaa caafimaad degdeg ah,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Sidoo kale, Soomaaliya ayaa garab istaag wayn u muujisay dowladda Qatar, waxayna sheegtay inay la qaybsaneyso murugada dhacdadaasi. “Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay garab istaag iyo taageero buuxda u muujineysaa Dowladda walaalaha ah ee Qatar, kaddib dhacdadii ka dhacday xarun gaas oo ku taalla Aagga Warshadaha ee Ras Laffan,” ayaa mar kale yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Ugu yaraan 13 qof ayaa ku geeriyooday, dhowr iyo toban kalena way dhaawacmeen, kaddib qarax ka dhacay xarun gaas oo ku taalla Aagga Warshadaha ee Ras Laffan, sida ay xaqiijiyeen mas’uuliyiinta dalkaasi. Wasiirka Tamarta ee Qatar, Sacad Al-Kaabi, oo ka hadlay masiibadan, ayaa sheegay in qaraxa ka dhacay xarunta weyn ee Ras Laffan uu ka dhashay “cilad farsamo”, wuxuuna meesha ka saaray inuu ahaa weerar ka yimid dhinac cadow ah. Wasiirku wuxuu intaas ku daray in dhoofinta gaaska LNG ee Qatar aysan wax saameyn ah ku yeelan doonin dhacdadan. Sidan dalalka kale ee ku yaalla Khaliijka, Qatar ayaa horay ula kulamay weerarro gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn (drones) oo uga yimid dhinaca Iiraan, intii uu socday dagaalka u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil oo dhinac ah iyo Iiraan. Qaraxan ayaa yimid xilli shaqaaluhu ay dib u bilaabayeen hawlgallada xarunta gaaska, taas oo hawlaheeda la hakiyay kadib weerarkii Iiraan ay qaaday bishii Maarso ee sannadkan.   The post Soomaaliya oo garab istaag wayn u muujisay Qatar kadib.. appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dowladda oo si kulul uga hadashay dagaalka dadka badan ay ku dhintay ee ka dhacay deegaanka Ari-caddeeye
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Waxaa maanta deegaanka Ari-caddeeye ee gobolka Sool, aas loogu sameeyey in ka badan 20 ruux oo ku dhintay dagaalkii ka dhacay deegaankaas. Dadka dhintay ayaa la sheegay in ay isugu jireen Haween, carruur iyo dad da’ ah, oo aan qeyb ka ahayen dagaalka. Sidoo kale dadkii kale ee dagaalka ku dhaawacmeen, ayaa la sheegay in hadda xaaladooda caafimaad lagula tacaalayo isbitaalo ku yaalla gobolka Geesta kale Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha Soomaaliya, ayaa sheegtay in ay ka xun tahay colaadda ka socota deegaanka Ari-caddeeye, taas oo dhex martay laba beelood oo walaalo ah, sababtayna khasaare nafeed. Wasaaraddu ayaa sheegtay in ay cambaaraynayso falalka gacan ka hadalka ah ee sababay dhimasho iyo dhaawaca dadka rayidka ah. Sidoo kale Wasaaraddu ayaa ku baaqday in si degdeg ah oo shuruud la’aan ah loo joojiyo khilaafaadka iyo dhammaan falalka hurin kara colaadda, iyadoo dhinacyada ay khusayso loogu baaqayo inay ka hormariyaan nabadda, wada noolaanshaha iyo ilaalinta Xasiloonida shacabka. “Wasaaraddu waxay ugu baaqaysaa Odayaasha Dhaqanka, Culimada, Haweenka, Dhallinyarada, Waxgaradka deegaanka iyo dhammaan masuuliyiinta Dowlad Goboleedka Waqooyi Bari inay door muuqda ka qaataan dejinta xiisadda colaadeed, xoojinta wada hadalka iyo raadinta xal nabadeed oo waara si looga hortago in colaaddani sii fiddo” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka kasoo baxay wasaaradda. Wararkii ugu dambeeyey waxa ay tilmaamayaan in xaalada ay degan tahay, balse la filan karo xili kasta in uu dagaalka labada maleeshiyo uu dib u qarxo. items.title: United States Targets ISIS Financial Networks Across Three Continents
items.description: United States Targets ISIS Financial Networks Across Three Continents Press Statement Thomas “Tommy” Pigott, Spokesperson Under the leadership of President Trump, the United States is dismantling ISIS’s ability to finance terrorism around the world. We are cutting off the financial lifelines from around the world that enable ISIS to fund attacks, support its regional affiliates, and threaten civilians, including religious minorities. Today’s designations target three individuals and six entities operating across Europe, the Middle East, and West Africa who have enabled ISIS to move money across borders – exposing a network that spans from France and Syria to Türkiye and Nigeria. These actions reflect the United States’ unrelenting pressure on ISIS, which continues to decentralize its operations and rely on financial intermediaries to connect its global network. Among those designated is a France-based facilitator who provided information concerning the use of explosives to ISIS supporters, a Syria-based operator who used cryptocurrency to transfer funds on behalf of ISIS associates in multiple countries including the United States, and a Nigeria-based facilitator whose money exchange businesses served as conduits for ISIS financing. The United States also reaffirms its strong partnership with Nigeria, which joined the United States in the May 16, 2026, operation that resulted in the killing of Abu-Bilal al-Minuki, the number two official in ISIS. We will continue to use every diplomatic and legal tool available to hold ISIS and its supporters accountable – wherever they operate and however they move money. We remain fully committed to protecting American lives, defending religious minorities, and working with international partners to eliminate the threat that ISIS poses to global peace and security. Today’s action is being taken pursuant to the counterterrorism authority, Executive Order (E.O.) 13224, as amended. The U.S. Department of State designated ISIS, then known by its former name of al-Qa’ida in Iraq, as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist (SDGT) pursuant to E.O. 13224 on October 15, 2004, and as a Foreign Terrorist Organization pursuant to section 219 of the Immigration and Nationality Act on December 17, 2004. More information on today’s designations can be found in Treasury’s Press Releases .

items.title: Iran  iyo Cumaan oo soo saaray hadal wadajir ah oo ku saansam marinka Hormuz
items.description: Iran iyo Cumaan oo soo saaray hadal wadajir ah oo ku saansam marinka Hormuz Iran iyo Cumaan ayaa bayaan ay si wadajir ah u soo saareen waxa ay ku sheegeen in ay ka go’an tahay ilaalinta marin biyoodka Hormuz oo ah marin biyood nabdoon oo furan oo ay maraan maraakiibta caalamiga ah, isla markaana waxa ay carabka ku adkeeyeen madax banaanida iyo xuquuqdooda ku aadan dhul badeedka gacanka Hormuz. Waxa ay sidoo kale shaaca ka qaadeen in ay baari doonaan mustaqbalka maamulka marin biyoodka Hormuz iyo qarashka ku baxaya adeegyada laga bixiyo marin biyoodkan iyaga oo sameynaya guddi isku dhaf ah. War-murtiyeedka ayaa laga soo saaray shir ay mas’uuliyiin sarsare oo ka tirsan labada dal ku yeesheen magaalada Masqad. Markii ay ka soo ambabaxeen Switzerland, Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf oo ah madaxa kooxda wada xaajoodka Iran iyo Cabbaas Araqchi, wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Iran, waxay tageen Cumaan, waxayna la kulmeen wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Badar Busaidi iyo Sultan Haitham bin Tariq, boqorka Cumaan.

items.title: Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka oo maanta ka qayb galay Xafladda Furitaanka Mashruuca Biyo-ballaadhinta magaalada Hargeisa
items.description: Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ahna ku-simaha Madaxweynaha, Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi, ayaa maanta ka qayb galay Xafladda Furitaanka Mashruuca Biyo-ballaadhinta Magaalada Hargeisa ee Wajiga 2-aad. Mashruucan oo muhiimmad weyn u leh horumarinta adeegyada biyaha ee caasimadda, ayaa lagu talo galay in lagu kordhiyo helitaanka biyaha nadiifta ah, laguna daboolo baahida sii kordhaysa ee bulshada ku nool Hargeysa. Mashruucan waxa maalgeliyey Baanka Horumarinta Jarmalka ee Jamhuuriyada Federalka ee dalka Jarmalka, waxana fulisay Wakaalada Biyaha Hargaysa. Munaasibadda furitaanka waxa ka soo qayb-galay Masuuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan Xukuumadda, Wasiiro, Maamulka Gobolka Maroodijeex iyo ka degmada Hargeysa, Hay’adaha Caalamiga ah ee wada shaqaynta la leh Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada. Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka JSL ayaa hadal uu ka jeediyey munaasibadda waxa uu bogaadiyey dhammaan dhinacyadii ka qayb qaatay hirgelinta mashruucan, isaga oo xusay in Xukuumaddu ay mudnaan gaar ah siinayso horumarinta adeegyada biyaha, korontada iyo kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha ee muhiimka u ah nolosha shacabka. Waxa uu sheegay in Mashruuca Biyo-ballaadhinta Hargeysa Wajigiisa 2-aad uu wax weyn ka tari doono biyo-yaraanta ka jirta Caasimadda, isla markaana uu sare u qaadi doono tayada adeegyada biyaha ee ay u baahan yihiin muwaadiniintu. Waxa kale oo uu adkeeyey in Xukuumaddu ay sii wadi doonto dedaallada lagu horumarinayo adeegyada nolosha bulshada JSL sida tooska ah u taabanaya.

items.title: Wasiir Aadan Barre oo kasoo muuqday maxkamad ku taal Kenya
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Caafimaadka Kenya, Aadan Barre Ducaale ayaa maanta soo gaaray Maxkamadda Kilimani ee magaalada Nairobi, halkaas oo lagu dhageysanayo xukun la xiriira dacwad maxkamadeed oo ka dhalatay mashruuca dhismaha xarun karantiil oo loogu talagalay cudurka Ebola. Ducaale ayaa lagu helay dembi maxkamadeed kaddib markii maxkamaddu ay ku eedeysay inuu iska indho tiray amar hore oo lagu joojiyay dhismaha xarun go’doon oo leh 50 sariirood, taas oo laga dhisayo saldhig ciidan oo ku yaalla magaalada Nanyuki, qiyaastii 140 kiiloomitir waqooyi kaga beegan Nairobi. Bishii hore, Maxkamadda Sare ee Kenya ayaa amar ku bixisay in la hakiyo mashruuca ilaa laga dhageysanayo dacwad ay gudbisay hay’adda xuquuqda aadanaha ee Katiba Institute, oo ka digtay in xaruntu ay keeni karto “khatar weyn oo degdeg ah” oo ku wajahan caafimaadka dadweynaha. Si kastaba, garsoore Patricia Nyaundi ayaa Isniintii sheegtay in wasiirka caafimaadku uu ogaa amarka maxkamadda, isla markaana uu oggolaaday in shaqada mashruucu sii socoto. Garsooruhu waxay sheegtay in dowladda aysan ka baxsan karin fulinta amarka maxkamadda iyadoo dib u magacaabaysa ama dib u qeexaysa mashruuca socda. “Amarka maxkamaddu ma ahayn martiqaad hal-abuur leh, balse wuxuu ahaa amar waajib ah oo la fuliyo,” ayay tiri garsoore Nyaundi, iyadoo intaas ku dartay in Ducaale uu si buuxda u fahmay in dhismaha xarunta Nanyuki la joojiyay. Xarunta karantiilka ayaa loogu talagalay muwaadiniinta Mareykanka ee looga shakiyo inay qaadeen cudurka Ebola ee ka dillaacay Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo, waxaana mashruuca maalgelinaya dowladda Mareykanka. Qorshahan ayaa dhaliyay mudaaharaadyo xooggan oo ka dhacay magaalada Nanyuki, halkaas oo ugu yaraan saddex qof ay ku dhinteen kaddib markii boolisku isku dayeen inay kala eryaan dadkii dibadbaxa dhigayay. Dadka dhintay waxaa ku jiray Sylvester Muigai Ndung’u oo ahaa arday 17 jir ah oo dugsiga sare dhigta, kaas oo markhaatiyaal ay sheegeen in madaxa laga toogtay, inkastoo boolisku ay sheegeen inay sugayaan natiijada baaritaanka meydka. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Kenya ayaa ku dooday inaysan jebin amarkii maxkamadda, iyadoo sheegtay in shaqada socota ay tahay mashruuc ay dowladda Kenya si madax-bannaan u fulinayso si looga hortago halista Ebola. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto ayaa si cad u difaacay mashruuca xarunta karantiilka, isagoo sheegay in dowladda Mareykanka ay codsi rasmi ah u gudbisay Kenya, isla markaana diidmada codsigaasi ay noqon lahayd “mid aan bani’aadamnimo ahayn.” Ruto ayaa sidoo kale ugu baaqay siyaasiyiinta iyo shacabka inay ka fogaadaan siyaasadeynta arrimaha la xiriira cudurka Ebola, isagoo ku tilmaamay arrintaasi mid aad u xasaasi ah. items.title: FoZ founder pledges to force Somaliland recognition on Trump’s desk
items.description: HARGEISA (Somaliguardian) – Friends of Zion (FoZ) founder Dr. Mike Evans said he intends to speak with U.S. President Donald Trump about the importance of formally recognizing Somaliland, citing the territory’s friendship with Israel during a special award ceremony held Thursday in Jerusalem, The Jerusalem Post reported on Sunday. “It’s time to bless all states that bless Israel,” Evans said. “Somaliland has shown genuine friendship toward the Jewish state, and I intend to speak with U.S. President Donald Trump about the importance of formal American recognition of Somaliland.” Evans made the remarks during a ceremony at the Friends of Zion Heritage Center in Jerusalem, where Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi received the Friends of Zion Award in honor of the opening of Somaliland’s embassy in Jerusalem and the country’s friendship with Israel. The ceremony brought together diplomats, business leaders, Christian leaders, and other distinguished guests from around the world. Accepting the award, Abdullahi expressed appreciation for the recognition and highlighted the growing relationship between Somaliland and Israel. “It is a great honor for me to receive the Friends of Zion Award,” Abdullahi said. “I am deeply moved and grateful for this recognition.” “This award symbolizes the growing friendship and strengthening ties between Somaliland and Israel. We are committed to further deepening the relationship between our peoples and building a future based on cooperation, mutual respect, and friendship,” he added. Abdullahi concluded by thanking Evans and the Friends of Zion organization for presenting him with the award. Evans said the recognition comes at a time when Israel faces significant security and diplomatic challenges, making genuine partnerships especially meaningful. “At a time when Israel faces complex security and diplomatic challenges, true friendship carries special significance,” Evans said. He praised Abdullahi’s role in advancing relations with Israel, saying the Somaliland leader had demonstrated “leadership, courage, and vision” in strengthening ties between the two peoples. “The decision to open an embassy in Jerusalem sends a clear message of friendship, mutual respect, and cooperation,” Evans said. “On behalf of millions of Friends of Zion supporters around the world, we are proud to present President Abdullahi with the Friends of Zion Award and recognize his commitment to the historic and enduring relationship between the Jewish people and the State of Israel.” Established by Shimon Peres, the Friends of Zion Award has been presented to approximately 26 world leaders. Previous recipients include U.S. President Donald Trump, former U.S. President George W. Bush, and former U.S. Vice President Mike Pence. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Magaalada Aricaddeeye oo aas wadareed loogu sameeyay in ka badan 20 qof oo halkaas shalay lagu diley
items.description: In ka badan 20 qof ayaa maanta aas wadareed loogu sameeyay deegaanka Aricadeeye ee gobolka Sool, kaddib markii shalay halkaas aano qabiil loogu laayay. Muuqaallo ay aragtay Warbaahinta Goobjoog ayaa muujinaya dadweyne ku howlan aas wadareed loo sameynayo dhibbanayaashii dagaalka, kuwaas oo la sheegay inay ku jiraan carruur, waayeel, culimo iyo dhallinyaro. Ilo deegaanka ah ayaa sheegay in dadkaasi lagu laayay hal goob, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah meydadka la sheegay in xitaa la dulmariyey gaadiidka dagaalka. Sidoo kale, ilo wareedyo deegaanka ah ayaa Goobjoog u sheegay in weli lala tacaalayo dhaawacyada ku dhawaad 13 qof oo ku dhaawacmay iska horimaadka, kuwaas oo qaarkood qaba dhaawacyo halis ah. Dagaalka sababay khasaarahan baaxadda leh ayaa la sheegay inuu ka dhashay dil loo geystay nin qaad-wale ahaa oo ka howlgalayay deegaanka, taas oo si degdeg ah u kicisay dagaal hubeysan oo dhexmaray maleeshiyaad ka kala tirsan laba beelood oo wada dega aagga Aricadeeye. Dhanka kale, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-Heshiisiinta Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa soo saartay baaq nabadeed ay ku cambaareyneyso colaadda, iyadoo dhinacyada ku lugta leh ugu baaqday inay si degdeg ah oo shuruud la’aan ah u joojiyaan dagaalka. Wasaaraddu waxay sidoo kale ugu baaqday odayaasha dhaqanka, culimada, waxgaradka iyo mas’uuliyiinta heerarka kala duwan inay ka qeyb qaataan dadaallada lagu dejinayo xiisadda iyo raadinta xal waara oo looga hortago in colaaddu sii faafto. Colaaddan ayaa noqotay mid ka mid ah dagaalladii ugu khasaaraha badnaa ee muddooyinkii dambe ka dhaca gobolka, iyadoo bulshada deegaanka ay wajahayaan murugo iyo barakac ka dhashay rabshadaha.

items.title: Waa sidee xaaladda Ari-Caddeeye kadib dagaalkii cuslaa ee ka dhacay?
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Waxaa saaka deggan xaaladda degmada Ari-Caddeeye ee gobolka Sool ee dowlad-goboleedka Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya kadib dagaal shalay halkaas ka dhacay oo sababay dhimashada in ka badan 20 ruux iyo dhaawaca tobannaan kale, sida ay xaqiijiyeen ilo deegaanka ah. Dagaalka ayaa galaaftay nolosha dad rayid ah, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah dadkii ku dhintay ayaa la aasay, halka dhaawacyada qaar loo qaaday goobo caafimaad oo ku yaalla deegaannada u dhow. Wararka laga helayo Ari-Caddeeye ayaa sheegaya in dadka ku dhintay dagaalka ay ku jireen haween, carruur iyo dad da’ ah, taas oo sare u qaadday walaaca laga qabo saameynta uu dagaalku ku yeeshay shacabka rayidka ah ee ku nool degmada. Ilo kala duwan oo deegaanka ah ayaa Caasimada Online u sheegay in weerarka ka dhacay Ari-Caddeeye uu daba socday dilal hore uga dhacay qaybo ka mid ah gobolka Sool, inkasta oo aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin sababta rasmiga ah ee horseeday iska horimaadka. Saraakiisha hay’adaha ammaanka ee maamulka Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya ayaa la sheegay inay yeesheen kulamo la xiriira xaaladda amni ee degmada iyo sidii loo xakameyn lahaa xiisadda. Hase yeeshee, ilaa hadda wax war ah kama aysan soo saarin go’aannada laga gaaray ama tallaabooyinka la qorsheynayo. Dhanka kale, waxgaradka iyo odayaasha dhaqanka ee degmada Ari-Caddeeye ayaa wada dadaallo lagu qaboojinayo xaaladda, iyagoo ku baaqaya in la joojiyo colaadda iyo falalka aargoosiga ah ee keeni kara dagaallo hor leh. Dagaalka ka dhacay degmada Ari-Caddeeye ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli gobolka Sool ay marar kala duwan ka dhacayeen xiisado iyo dilal la xiriira aanooyin hore iyo khilaafaad deegaan, iyadoo shacabka deegaanku ay ka cabsi qabaan in xaaladdu mar kale faraha ka baxdo haddii aan xal degdeg ah laga gaarin. items.title: DF Soomaaliya oo war kasoo saartay isfahamka laga gaaray…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa soo dhaweysay isfahamka iyo is-afgaradka (memorandum of understanding) u dhexeeya dowladaha Mareykanka iyo Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay is-afgaradkan u aragto tallaabo wanaagsan oo lagu yareynayo xiisadaha, laguna xoojinayo wada-hadallada, laguna adkeynayo xasilloonida gobolka. “Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay ku bogaadinaysaa labada dhinac inay doorteen diblomaasiyad iyo wada-xaajood si loo dhimo xiisadaha loona horumariyo nabadda,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaan kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya. Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay sidoo kale bogaadisay dadaallada wax-ku-oolka ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Pakistan, dowladda Qatar, Jamhuuriyadda Carabta ee Masar, Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Jamhuuriyadda Türkiye, kuwaas oo taageeray horumarkan diblomaasiyadeed. Sidoo kale, dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay aqoonsan tahay doorka muhiimka ah iyo dadaallada Madaxweyne Donald Trump ee lagu hormarinayo nabadda. Soomaaliya waxay rajaynaysaa in isfahamkan lagu dhaqan-geliyo niyad wanaagsan, islamarkaana uu gacan ka geysto ilaalinta nolosha dadka rayidka ah, sugidda xorriyadda maraakiibta iyo isu-socodka badda, iyo ka hortagga sii kordhaya ee xiisadaha. Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay mar kale xaqiijinaysaa taageeradeeda ku aaddan diblomaasiyadda, ixtiraamka sharciga caalamiga ah, iyo xallinta khilaafaadka si nabad ah. Soomaaliya waxay soo dhaweynaysaa dhammaan dadaallada lagu horumarinayo nabadda, amniga iyo xasilloonida Bariga Dhexe, Geeska Afrika iyo gobolka Badda Cas. The post DF Soomaaliya oo war kasoo saartay isfahamka laga gaaray… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Sacadiyo Bajaaj oo mar kale la soo taagey maxkamadda Gobolka iyo Qareenkeeda oo faahfaahin ka bixiyay kiiska
items.description: Sacdiyo Bajaaj oo wajahaysa eedeymo la xiriira kicin dadweyne ayaa maanta mar kale la hor geeyay Maxkamadda Gobolka Banaadir, iyadoo la la soo gabagabeeyay dhageysiga dacwadda islamarkaana la sugayo go’aanka kama dambaysta ah ee maxkamadda. Qareenka u doodaya Sacdiyo Bajaaj, Abuukaate Xalane, ayaa sheegay in dhammaan marxaladihii dhageysiga kiiska la soo afjaray, isla markaana hadda la sugayo xukunka ama go’aanka ay maxkamaddu ka gaari doonto dacwadda. Abuukaate Xalane ayaa sheegay in aysan jirin caddeymo ama marqaatiyo taageeraya eedeymaha loo jeediyay macmiilkiisa oo muddo bilo ah xabsiga ku jirtay, asagoo yiri “Majiro wax cadeymo ah ama marqaati ah oo loo hayo eedeymaha Sacdiyo Bajaaj,” ayuu yiri Abuukaate Xalane. Dhowaan ayay maxkamaddu dib ugu celisay xeer-ilaalinta dacwadda loo haysto gabadhan, iyadoo ka dalbatay in la dhamaystiro ama la xoojiyo qodobbada iyo caddeymaha la xiriira kiiskan.

items.title: South Sudan Sets Historic Election Date But Peace Hangs in the Balance
items.description: South Sudan has set December 22, 2026, as the date for its first-ever general election, but with an armed opposition threatening to jail registration workers and gaping funding shortfalls unresolved, the announcement raises as many questions as it answers. South Sudan’s National Elections Commission formally announced Monday that the nation’s first ever post-independence general election will be held on December 22, 2026, a landmark declaration shadowed by funding crises, unresolved legal gaps, and an armed opposition warning that voter registration workers will be treated as prisoners of war. The announcement marks the fifth postponement of a vote originally envisioned shortly after the nation gained independence from Sudan in 2011 and arrives at a moment when the world’s youngest country is arguably less stable than at any point since its 2018 peace agreement. With six months until election day, the stakes and the obstacles could not be higher. NEC Chairman Prof. Abednego Akok Kacuol, speaking to reporters at the commission’s headquarters in Juba, confirmed that the date complies with Article 16 of the National Election Act, which mandates that a notice of election timing be published at least six months before the vote. “The election will be conducted on December 22, 2026,” Prof. Akok told reporters. Yet in the same breath, he acknowledged the commission’s precarious position. “There are many challenges facing the Commission and we strongly request the Government to speed up amending the existing legal gaps and to provide all basic needs within a short period to enable us to proceed with our duties,” he said. The commission’s candour about its own constraints is telling. Voter registration has yet to begin, constituency boundaries have not been finalized, and the permanent constitution remains under negotiation. Without a permanent constitution, legal analysts warn, the National Election Act itself may be rendered void for the purposes of a December poll. The political environment complicates matters further. Relations between the ruling Sudan People’s Liberation Movement and the rival SPLM-IO have deteriorated sharply since the March 2025 house arrest of First Vice President Riek Machar, who was subsequently suspended, indicted, and put on trial on treason charges. The SPLM-IO has since suspended cooperation in election-related committees. The opposition’s posture has turned openly threatening. Acting SPLM-IO chairperson Nathaniel Pierino declared that any individual entering opposition-controlled territory to register voters or campaign would be considered a prisoner of war, adding bluntly, “Be reminded, the country is at war.” By January 2026, South Sudan’s ceasefire monitoring mechanism had recorded a 14% increase in ceasefire violations and a 43% rise in hostilities involving peace agreement signatories. The United Nations has not minced words. Nicholas Haysom, head of the UN Mission in South Sudan, warned that mismanaged elections could reignite violence and upset the country’s fragile stability, emphasizing that properly prepared elections preceded by trust-building exercises can transform a divisive process into a nation-building one. President Salva Kiir has publicly vowed the government will provide the necessary resources and logistical support for a December vote, but observers note that presidential commitments have been made and broken before. Prof. Akok closed his announcement with an appeal to South Sudanese citizens: “The public is to be informed that sovereignty is to vote during the election as the only way of getting into power.” Whether that sovereignty can be exercised safely and on time remains the defining question of South Sudan’s most consequential political test yet. The post South Sudan Sets Historic Election Date But Peace Hangs in the Balance first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Deadly Explosion Strikes Qatar’s Ras Laffan Gas Facility
items.description: Thirteen workers were killed and 66 others injured in a technical explosion at the Barzan gas supply facility in Qatar’s Ras Laffan Industrial City on Sunday, June 21, 2026. The incident occurred as crews attempted to restart operations that had been suspended for months following regional conflict. The tragedy comes at a critical juncture for Qatar, which is attempting to restore energy output amid the ongoing volatility of the Iran war. As one of the world’s leading liquefied natural gas (LNG) exporters, Qatar has faced significant infrastructure challenges since March, when Iranian missile strikes damaged parts of the same industrial complex. While officials have categorized the latest blast as a “technical accident” rather than sabotage, the event underscores the complex and high-stakes nature of reviving industrial operations in a conflict-prone region. “This was an accident and not a sabotage or hostile in nature,” said Qatar’s Energy Minister, Saad al-Kaabi, during a press conference on June 22. He confirmed that the fire had been brought under control and that the facility’s export capabilities remained unaffected. Meanwhile, the international community has expressed its support for the Gulf state. The Federal Republic of Somalia issued an official statement pledging its solidarity with Qatar following the disaster. Other nations have also extended their condolences, particularly as the casualties were confirmed to include foreign nationals. According to the Indian Embassy in Doha, 12 of the 13 victims were Indian citizens. While the plant’s export capacity for global markets is reportedly stable, authorities remain focused on the ongoing investigation into the specific technical malfunction that triggered the blast. The incident has drawn renewed attention to the broader dangers of rapid industrial restarts in the Gulf, where infrastructure is under immense pressure to meet global energy demands following long-term production disruptions.   The post Deadly Explosion Strikes Qatar’s Ras Laffan Gas Facility first appeared on Radio Dalsan .
