items.title: Former Somali minister claims Israel infiltrated Somalia’s institutions
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Former Somali Information Minister Zakaria Mahmoud Hajji has alleged that Israel has deeply infiltrated Somalia’s federal institutions and political decision-making structures, weeks after Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud described Tel Aviv as an enemy of both Somalia and the Muslim world over its recognition of Somaliland, its acceptance of a Somaliland embassy in Jerusalem, and plans to establish a military base in the Red Sea port city of Berbera. Hajji Alleges Israeli Influence in Somalia “Israel has deeply infiltrated Somalia’s institutions and penetrated Somali political decision-making. We must recognize the danger of its presence in Berbera, as well as the risks posed by delays in achieving national unity and saving what remains of the Somali state,” Hajji told in an interview with Egypt Independent newspaper. “The primary responsibility lies with the Somalis themselves, and this is what allowed the fragmentation to occur. However, Arab states and countries of the Horn of Africa also bear responsibility.” The former Somali minister argued that responsibility for Somalia’s fragmentation rests primarily with Somalis themselves, while also pointing to the role of regional actors. Israel, Ethiopia and Somalia Hajji added that “Israel penetrates Somalia through Ethiopia, as the two countries share relations and mutual interests.” Speaking about his history of being part of the insurgent groups that fought Ethiopian forces after they entered Somalia and seized the capital, Mogadishu, in 2006, Hajji explained how he believed Israel used Ethiopia in pursuing its interests in Somalia. “I was part of the Somali Re-Liberation Alliance when Ethiopia attempted to occupy parts of Somalia in 2007. The war with Ethiopia continued between 2007 and 2011. After Ethiopia was repelled and its forces pushed out of parts of Somali territory, Western powers stepped in and helped install non-national forces into positions of authority, which later contributed to the deterioration of the situation,” Hajji said. “When Ethiopia occupied parts of Somalia, it was effectively a proxy war. Israel had an interest in fragmenting Somalia, while Ethiopia had a direct interest in fighting Somalia and occupying parts of it. Thus, Ethiopian and Israeli objectives converged. Even today, Ethiopia continues to occupy part of western Somalia,” Hajji added. The former Somali minister and member of parliament said Israel benefited from Somalia’s collapse and instability and argued that a broader project aimed at reshaping the Horn of Africa region is underway. Israel’s Recognition of Somaliland The remarks come after Israel recognized Somaliland last year, becoming the first United Nations member state to recognize the breakaway northern region. Following the recognition, Israel appointed an ambassador to Somaliland while accepting Somaliland’s appointment of an ambassador to Israel and plans to establish an embassy in Jerusalem . Somaliland also announced that it would soon open its embassy in Jerusalem, prompting condemnation from 19 Muslim countries that regard Jerusalem as an occupied Palestinian city. The developments have placed renewed attention on relations between Israel and Somaliland, the strategic importance of Berbera on the Red Sea, and continuing political tensions between Somalia and Somaliland over international recognition and sovereignty. items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo qaaday tallaabo lagu ilaalinayo hufnaanta Doorashada Hoggaanka Koonfur Galbeed
items.description: Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka oo ka jawaabaya cabashada laba ka mid ah saddexda xubnood ee ku tartamaya Doorashada Hoggaanka Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa qaaday tallaabo lagu ilaalinayo hufnaanta doorashadaasi oo Arbacada ka dhaceysa Magaalada Baydhabo. Doorashadan oo ay wax dooranayaan Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa waxaa ku tartamaya Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo metelaya Ururka JSP, Shariif Xasan Sheekh Aadan oo ka socda Ururka Horumar & Midnimo Qaran iyo Cabdicasiis Maxamed Cismaan oo isna ah Musharaxa Ururka Karaama. Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa warsaxaafadeed uu maanta soo saaray ku sheegay in guddigu uu marka hore ka masuul yahay goobta doorashada, isla-markaana uu u diyaariyay ciidamo ka madaxbannaan dhammaan musharaxiinta, taas oo musharax kasta uu imaan karo. Guddiga ayaa sidoo kale Xildhibaanada ku wargeliyay inay reeban tahay in moobeelada iyo wixii la mid ah lala galo goobta doorashada, iyadoo la ilaalinayo qaabka qarsoodiga ah ee wax lagu dooranayo. Warsaxaafadeedka ayaa u qornaa:- Jawaab celinta cabashada musharaxiinta 1. Amniga Doorashada Amniga goobta doorashada waxaa masuul ka ah Guddiga Madaxabannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha (GMDQS), waxa uuna u diyaariyay ciidamo gaar ah oo ka madaxbannaan dhammaan musharaxiinta u tartamaya xilka Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, si waafaqsan Qodobka 79aad ee Sharciga Doorashooyinka. 2. Dhexdhexaadnimada Goobta Doorashada GMDQS waxa uu diyaariyay goob dhexdhexaad ah oo ka madaxbannaan dhammaan musharaxiinta, ayna u wada siman yihiin imaanshaheeda, si waafaqsan Qodobka 74aad, farqadiisa 2aad ee Sharciga Doorashooyinka. 3. Ilaalinta Anshaxa Codbixinta Guddiga Madaxabannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha, waxa uu ku wargelinayaa Xildhibaanada in ay reeban tahay in ilo xirka codbixinta (voting booth) lala galo mobile iyo wixii la mid ah, si loo ilaaliyo qarsoodiga codka, si waafaqsan Qodobada 3aad iyo 56aad ee Sharciga Doorashooyinka ee Sharci Lr. 28- 2024. Sidaa darteed, waxaa lagu wargelinayaa Xildhibaanada codkooda dhiibanaya inay u hoggaansamaan sharciga, codkoodana u dhiibtaan si qarsoodi ah, kana fogaadaan wax kasta oo wax u dhimi kara qarsoodi ahaanshaha codka.

items.title: Villa Somalia oo markii ugu horeysay ka hadashay dagaalladii ka dhacay Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya ayaa ka hadlay dagaalkii dhawaan magaalada Muqdisho ku dhexmaray ciidamada dowladda iyo ciidamo taabacsanaa qaar ka mid ah hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka, oo ay ku jiraan Madaxweynihii 7-aad ee Soomaaliya, Shariif Sheekh Axmed iyo Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee dalka, Xasan Cali Khayre. Afhayeenka Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Cabdiraxmaan Aadan Cali Xadaana ayaa sheegay in Villa Soomaaliya ay ka xun tahay rabshadihii dhacay, isaga oo xusay in dowladda ay hore u oggolaatay in mucaaradku qabtaan dibadbaxyo nabadeed oo lagu asteeyay goobo cayiman, si loo ilaaliyo amniga shacabka iyo ka-qaybgalayaasha isu-soo-baxyada. Afhayeenka ayaa ku eedeeyay mucaaradka inay ka baxeen qorshihii lagu heshiiyay, isla markaana ay goobaha dibadbaxyada la yimaadeen hub culus, arrintaas oo uu sheegay inay sababtay faragelinta hay’adaha amniga. Sidoo kale wuxuu difaacay tallaabada ay qaadday dowladda, isaga oo sheegay in lagu dhaqmay xeerka xakamaynta hubka ee ay hore u ansixiyeen Golaha Wasiirradu. Sida uu sheegay, dowladda waxaa waajib ku ahaa inay ka hortagto hub lagu dhex wato magaalada Muqdisho. “Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay u fasaxday inay dibadbaxyo ku qabtaan goobo loo cayimay, balse arrintaas waxay u rogeen in hub waaweyn loola soo baxo. Dowladdu gacmaha kama laabanayso arrintaas, waxaana la dhaqangelinayay xeerka xakamaynta hubka oo ay xukuumaddu ansixisay,” ayuu yiri Xadaana oo wareysi siiyay BBC-da. Dhanka kale, Villa Soomaaliya ayaa si cad u diidday eedeymaha uga yimid mucaaradka, kuwaas oo dowladda ku eedeeyay inay mas’uul ka ahayd iska horimaadyadii dhacay. Dowladda ayaa ku adkaysatay in tallaabooyinkii la qaaday ay ahaayeen kuwo lagu sugayay amniga caasimadda. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli hay’adaha amniga ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay toddobaadkan soo bandhigeen hub ay sheegeen inay ku qabteen howl-gallo hub uruurin ah oo laga fuliyay degmooyinka Cabdicasiis iyo Howl-wadaag, kuwaas oo ka mid ahaa goobihii ay ka dhaceen iska hor-imaadyada u dhexeeyay ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa mucaaradka. items.title: Sarkaal Sare oo ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab oo lagu Dilay Hawlgal ka dhacay Shabeellaha Hoose
items.description: Muqdisho, Juun 9, 2026 – Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabad-sugidda Qaranka (NISA) ayaa sheegtay in sarkaal sare oo ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab lagu dilay hawlgal wadajir ah oo ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibada caalamiga ah ay ka fuliyeen gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. War-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay NISA ayaa lagu sheegay in ninkan la dilay uu hore uga badbaaday saddex hawlgal oo kala duwan, balse ugu dambeyn lagu bartilmaameedsaday hawlgalkii ugu dambeeyay. Hay’addu ma shaacin magaca sarkaalka la dilay iyo waddamada ama hay’adaha caalamiga ah ee ka qeyb qaatay hawlgalka. NISA ayaa sheegtay in hawlgalkani uu qeyb ka yahay dadaallada lagu burburinayo hoggaanka iyo shabakadaha Al-Shabaab, si loo yareeyo awoodda kooxda ee qorsheynta iyo fulinta weerarrada ay ka geystaan koonfurta Soomaaliya. Gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose ayaa ka mid ah meelaha ugu muhiimsan ee ay ka socdaan howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, maadaama uu gobolkaasi ku dhow yahay Muqdisho isla markaana muddo dheer uu ahaa meel ay kooxdaasi ku xoogganeyd. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sannadihii u dambeeyay kordhisay howlgallada militari iyo kuwa sirdoon ee lagu bartilmaameedsanayo hoggaanka, dhaqaalaha iyo sahayda Al-Shabaab. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale ballanqaadday inay sii wadi doonto dagaalka lagula jiro kooxda si loo xoojiyo amniga iyo awoodda dowladda ee dalka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ilo madax-bannaan ayaan weli xaqiijin karin faahfaahinta hawlgalkan, maadaama ay adag tahay helitaanka xog sugan oo laga helo goobaha colaadaha ka socdaan.

items.title: Xi Jinping iyo Kim Jong Un oo Ballan-qaaday Xoojinta Xiriirka Shiinaha iyo
items.description: Madaxweynaha Shiinaha Xi Jinping iyo hoggaamiyaha Kuuriyada Waqooyi Kim Jong Un ayaa kulan muhiim ah ku yeeshay magaalada Pyongyang, iyagoo ku heshiiyey in la sii xoojiyo xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah iyo iskaashiga labada dal. Xi Jinping oo booqasho rasmi ah oo laba maalmood ah ku tagay Kuuriyada Waqooyi ayaa sheegay in Beijing iyo Pyongyang ay tahay inay adkeeyaan kalsoonida siyaasadeed ee ka dhaxaysa labada dhinac isla markaana kor u qaadaan iskaashiga dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga, beeraha, caafimaadka iyo tiknoolajiyadda. Booqashadan ayaa noqotay tii ugu horreysay ee Xi ku tago Pyongyang muddo toddobo sano ah, iyadoo labada hoggaamiye ay ku tilmaameen xiriirka labada waddan mid ku dhisan saaxiibtinimo taariikhi ah, dano wadaag iyo taageero siyaasadeed oo soo jireen ah. Xi ayaa sheegay in saaxiibtinimada u dhaxaysa Shiinaha iyo Kuuriyada Waqooyi aysan saameyn doonin isbeddellada ka dhacaya caalamka, isagoo xusay in dowladdiisu ay sii wadi doonto taageerada ay siiso Pyongyang iyo ilaalinta danaha wadajirka ah ee labada dal. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo qaaday sidii loo ballaarin lahaa isu socodka shacabka, iyadoo dib loo furay xuduudaha iyo duulimaadyadii rayidka ee labada waddan. Xi ayaa ku baaqay in la kordhiyo iskaashiga dhinacyada waxbarashada, dhaqanka, dalxiiska, ciyaaraha iyo warbaahinta si loo xoojiyo xiriirka bulshada ee labada dal. Dhankiisa, Kim Jong Un ayaa ku tilmaamay Xi “marti aad loo qadariyo” oo shacabka Kuuriyada Waqooyi ay si diirran u soo dhaweeyeen. Wuxuu sheegay in booqashadan ay caddeyn u tahay sida uu u adag yahay xiriirka labada waddan, isla markaana ay muujinayso muhiimadda ay Beijing siiso Pyongyang. Kim ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijiyey in dalkiisu si buuxda u taageersan yahay mabda’a “Hal Shiinaha” isla markaana uu garab taagan yahay siyaasadaha Shiinaha ee la xiriira ilaalinta danihiisa muhiimka ah. Labada hoggaamiye ayaa ku heshiiyey in la kordhiyo kulamada heerka sare ah, la xoojiyo wada-xaajoodyada istiraatiijiga ah, lana ballaariyo iskaashiga dhaqaale iyo dhaqameed, iyagoo sheegay in tallaabooyinkaas ay gacan ka geysan doonaan nabadda iyo horumarka gobolka Bariga Aasiya. Booqashada Xi Jinping ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli Shiinaha iyo Kuuriyada Waqooyi ay xusayaan sannad-guuradii 65-aad ee ka soo wareegtay heshiiska saaxiibtinimada, iskaashiga iyo is-difaaca wadajirka ah ee u dhexeeya labada dal, kaas oo saldhig u ahaa xiriirkooda dhow ee tobannaan sano socday.

items.title: Sheekada Ninkii Ugu Horreeyay Ee Lacag Ku Qanciya Gabar
items.description: Sheekada Ninkii Ugu Horreeyay Ee Lacag Ku Qanciya Gabar Waxaa la sheegaa in waqti hore oo aad u fog uu jiray nin aad looga yaqaanay magaalada uu ku noolaa. Ninkaas wuxuu ahaa qof shaqeeya, lacagtiisana si adag ku hela. Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah ayuu arkay gabar qurux badan oo suuqa mareysa, qalbigiisana markiiba way soo jiidatay. Wuxuu isku dayay inuu la hadlo, laakiin gabadhii si fudud uma aysan siin dareen badan. Ninkii markaas wuu wareeray, wuxuuna saaxiibkiis waydiiyay sida uu qalbigeeda ku heli karo. Saaxiibkii ayaa qoslay kadibna ku yiri: “War dumarka hadal kaliya kuma qancaan mararka qaar… wax yar gacanta geli.” Ninkii markii hore wuu ka yaabay arrintaas, laakiin ugu dambeyn wuu aqbalay. Jeebkiisa ayuu gacanta geliyay wuxuuna gabadhii siiyay lacag yar. Isla markiiba jawigii ayaa is beddelay, gabadhiina way dhoolla-caddeysay. Dadkii meesha joogay arrintaas aad ayay ula yaabeen. Qaar baa yiri ninkaan waa nin caqli badan, qaar kalena waxay ku doodeen inuu albaab cusub furay. Maalmo kadib sheekadii magaalada oo dhan ayay gaartay. Rag badan ayaa bilaabay inay qaabkii ninkaas ku daydaan. Waxaa xitaa la sheegay in qaar badan jeebabkoodu maalmo gudahood khafiifeen. Sanado badan kadib, sheekada ninkaas wali dadka way ka sheekeeyaan. Qaar waxay ku tilmaamaan halyeey, qaarna waxay yiraahdaan isaga ayaa bilaabay dhibka ragga maanta haysta. Laakiin hal su’aal ayaa weli taagan: Haddii uusan maalintaas jeebka furin… maanta xaaladdu sidee bay ahaan lahayd? items.title: The World Cup Begins in a Few Days. Africa’s Best Referee Is Stranded in Istanbul.
items.description: The Rejection of Omar Artan Is Not Just an Entry Denial — It Is a Declaration That African Excellence Does Not Belong at Its Own World Cup By  Abdiweli Waberi  | June 8, 2026 “Omar Artan is among Africa’s most respected referees and deserves the support of the entire football community. Denying him entry to the United States and preventing him from officiating scheduled matches harms not only him personally but also undermines football’s commitment to fairness, merit, and the spirit of fair play.”  — Ciise Aden Abshir, Senior Advisor, Somalia’s Ministry of Youth and Sports.  On the morning of June 8, 2026 — few days before the most-watched sporting event on the planet is due to open its curtain — Omar Abdulkadir Artan, CAF’s Best Male Referee of the Year 2025, one of only 52 match officials in the world selected by FIFA to officiate the 2026 FIFA World Cup, sat in Istanbul, Turkey. Not on a training pitch with his fellow referees, not preparing to make history as the first Somali referee ever to step onto a World Cup pitch. He was in Istanbul because the United States of America had turned him away. He had a valid visa. He had a diplomatic passport, obtained with the extraordinary help of the Somali Embassy in Nairobi precisely because he had anticipated the obstacles a Somali passport would face. He had been approved by FIFA, after years of verified excellence. He had done everything right.And still, at Miami International Airport, US immigration authorities sent him back. This piece of writing is not merely about a bureaucratic inconvenience. It is about what that moment at Miami airport represents: a systematic, politically motivated rejection of African excellence at the very tournament Africa helped make possible. It is about a pattern that the African football community — all nine African nations competing at this World Cup, all 54 member states of the African Union, and every institution that claims to stand for fairness in global sport — can no longer afford to treat as someone else’s problem. Who Is Omar Artan? A Story Africa Should Know by Heart Born in Mogadishu in 1992, Omar Artan came of age in a country where football itself was a complicated act of faith. Somalia’s footballing landscape had been devastated by decades of conflict and instability. Infrastructure was broken. Opportunities were scarce. Yet Artan found his passion in refereeing, working his way through local Somali leagues before earning his FIFA listing in 2018 — a feat that, in the context of his country, was extraordinary in its own right. It is perhaps fitting that Somalia’s greatest football contribution to the world has come not from a striker, but from the person the game entrusts to be fair. In January 2024, he became the first Somali referee ever to officiate at the Africa Cup of Nations, presiding over Tunisia vs. Namibia and Algeria vs. Mauritania during the AFCON in Côte d’Ivoire — two matches that produced famous results for the underdogs. His composure under pressure was unmistakable. The refereeing community took notice. By June 2025, Artan was standing at the summit of continental football, officiating the CAF Champions League final in Cairo between Egypt’s Pyramids FC and South Africa’s Mamelodi Sundowns — becoming the first Somali referee to take charge of an African continental final. Later that year, CAF made it official: Omar Abdulkadir Artan was Africa’s best referee of 2025. In April 2026, FIFA announced its 52 referees for the 2026 World Cup. Omar Artan was among them — one of only seven African referees chosen, and the sole representative from Sub-Saharan Africa’s Horn region. He would have been the first Somali, in any capacity, to officiate a FIFA World Cup final tournament. That was Africa’s story. A story of struggle, perseverance, excellence, and arrival on the world’s biggest stage. Then America intervened. The Chronology of a Rejection — How Every Door Was Slammed Shut The path to Miami Airport was not a simple one. It was a journey that required extraordinary effort at every stage — and that is itself part of the indictment. As the World Cup approached, Omar Artan began encountering obstacles obtaining the standard US entry visa. Other referees from around the world — Europe, South America, Asia — faced no such barriers. Artan’s Africanidentity, however, placed him in a category requiring additional scrutiny, additional paperwork, and additional uncertainty that his counterparts did not have to confront. Recognising that Artan’s standard Somali passport would likely be insufficient to navigate US immigration’s treatment of Somali nationals, the Somali Embassy in Nairobi took the extraordinary step of facilitating a diplomatic passport for him. This was not a routine measure — diplomatic passports are reserved for officials whose travel carries official state weight. The fact that Somalia elevated a football referee to this status reflects how seriously the country took both his achievement and the obstacles in his path. He travelled to Nairobi, transited through Istanbul, Turkey — and on June 8, 2026, he arrived at Miami International Airport, the gateway to one of the World Cup’s host cities. US immigration authorities denied him entry. No specific reason was communicated. He was not held pending for further review. He was not given an opportunity to present additional documentation or appeal to FIFA liaison officers. He was simply turned around and sent back to Istanbul. With a diplomatic passport, a valid US visa in hand and FIFA accreditation as one of 52 referees selected worldwide, Artan believed the hardest part was behind him. But unfortunately, the door of Miami International Airport still slams.  FIFA’s Silence Is the Loudest Sound in the Room The same federation that spent years championing inclusion, diversity, and the growth of football in emerging nations — the same federation that invested in training programs for African referees and footballers precisely to build pathways like the one Artan walked — has offered no public intervention, no visible advocacy, and no loud declaration that one of their own selected officials must be present at their tournament. FIFA’s silence here is not neutral. When an institution of its size and influence watches its appointed referee face a visa barrier and does not use every tool at its disposal to resolve it, that silence becomes complicity. The organization has diplomatic relationships, host country agreements, and the weight of an event that generates billions of dollars in revenue. The idea that it cannot secure the entry of its own carefully selected match officials — or that it would not try loudly and urgently — is impossible to accept without serious questions. Artan’s case sits at the intersection of a broader, deliberate pattern of exclusion that the Trump administration has applied to the 2026 World Cup, in defiance of the spirit — and arguably the letter — of the hosting agreement FIFA signed with the United States. Fans from Senegal and Ivory Coast — two of Africa’s finest football nations, both qualified for the World Cup — found their ability to travel to the United States effectively suspended after those countries were added to the travel ban list in December 2025. Supporters who had been planning for years to attend a World Cup on the same continent were suddenly barred. “I don’t know why the American president would want teams from certain countries not to take part. If that’s the case, they shouldn’t agree to host the World Cup,” said one Senegal supporter at the Africa Cup of Nations in Morocco. And now, a referee. Not a fan. Not an official. Not a delegation member. But a FIFA-appointed, CAF-certified, diplomatically-documented match official, selected through the most rigorous independent merit process that world football operates. The Call for Solidarity — What African Nations Must Do Now? This is the moment that tests whether African solidarity exists beyond rhetoric. And the response must be collective, coordinated, and immediate.   Morocco, Senegal, Egypt, Nigeria, Côte d’Ivoire, Cameroon, South Africa, Mali, and Algeria — every African nation competing at this World Cup — must formally raise the case of Omar Artan through their respective Football Federations, their governments’ diplomatic channels, and at the tournament itself. A joint statement from all nine African football federations, presented to FIFA, to the US State Department, and to the international media, would carry weight that any individual federation’s voice cannot. These nations did not travel to this World Cup as guests. They earned their places. They are participants, not spectators. And what happens to Omar Artan is a signal directed at all of them. The Confederation of African Football awarded Omar Artan its highest refereeing honour. He carries CAF’s certification and CAF’s name into that World Cup. His exclusion is therefore not Somalia’s problem alone — it is CAF’s problem. CAF President Patrice Motsepe must issue an official, unambiguous statement demanding that the United States government provide an immediate and transparent explanation, and that FIFA facilitate Artan’s entry as a matter of urgency. Finally, if the football world — FIFA, CAF, the African nations competing, the global football community — watches this happen in silence, then the next whistle blown at the 2026 FIFA World Cup will carry the weight of a question no one has answered: whose tournament is this, really? items.title: Puntland oo xabsiga dhigtay askar ka cabaneysay mushaar la’aan
items.description: Garoowe ( Raxanreeb Online) Wararka inaga soo gaaraya magaalada Garoowe ee Caasimada maamulka Puntland, ayaa ku waramaya in Puntland ay xirtay in ka badan 20 askari oo maalmo ka hor sameeyey gadood ay uga cabanayaan mushaar la’aan. Qoraal kazoo baxay laamaha amniga ee gobolka Nugaal, ayaa lagu sheegay in sababta loo xiray 20-ka askari ay tahay in ay qalqal amni darro geliyeen magaalada Garoowe, isla markaana ay ku kaceen falal wax u dhimanaya amniga guud ee caasimada Puntland. Sidoo kale maamulka Puntland ayaa sheegay in Askartan dhawaan Maxkamad la horeyn doono, isla markaana tallaabo sharciga waafaqsan laga qaadi doono. Waa markii u horreysey oo xukuumadda Puntland ay ka tallaabo qaaddo ciidamada oo badanaa la arko in marka ay mushahar waayaan jidadka xiraan. The post Puntland oo xabsiga dhigtay askar ka cabaneysay mushaar la’aan appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo UNESCO oo Bilaabay Qorshe Lagu Dhowrayo Keydka Taariikhiga ah ee Dalka
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Waxbarashada, Sayniska iyo Dhaqanka (UNESCO) ayaa bilaabay dadaal cusub oo lagu ilaalinayo laguna keydinayo dhaxalka taariikhiga ah ee dalka, gaar ahaan dukumiintiyada iyo kaydka muhiimka ah ee xambaarsan taariikhda Soomaaliya. Barnaamijkan oo ay taageerayso dowladda Japan, kana socda sanduuqa Japan Funds-in-Trust (JFIT), ayaa lagu qabtay Muqdisho muddo laba maalmood ah. Aqoon-is-weydaarsiga waxaa ka qeyb galay mas’uuliyiin dowladeed, khubaro dhanka hidaha iyo dhaqanka ah, keyd-yaqaanno iyo daneeyayaal kale oo ka shaqeeya ilaalinta dhaxalka qaranka. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray sidii Soomaaliya uga faa’iideysan lahayd barnaamijka UNESCO ee Memory of the World Programme, kaas oo ujeeddadiisu tahay ilaalinta dukumiintiyada iyo diiwaannada taariikhiga ah ee qiimaha weyn u leh bulshada caalamka. Khubaro ka qeyb gashay shirka ayaa soo bandhigtay qiimeyn lagu sameeyay kaydka taariikhiga ah ee Radio Mogadishu, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan codad, warar iyo xog muhiim ah oo ka tarjumaya dhacdooyinkii ugu waaweynaa ee taariikhda casriga ah ee Soomaaliya tan iyo sanadkii 1951-kii. Doodaha ayaa sidoo kale xoogga lagu saaray horumarinta hababka lagu ilaalinayo, lagu dijitaaleynayo isla markaana shacabka loogu fududeynayo helitaanka dukumiintiyada taariikhiga ah. Khubaradu waxay xuseen in arrintani muhiim u tahay ilaalinta xusuusta qaranka, gaar ahaan kadib tobannaan sano oo ay dalka saameeyeen colaado, barakac iyo burbur hay’adeed. Ka qeybgalayaashu waxay dib u eegeen habraacyada lagu diiwaangeliyo dhaxalka dukumiintiyada ee UNESCO, iyagoo isla markaana falanqeeyay fursadaha ay Soomaaliya u leedahay in ay soo gudbiso kaydyo qaran oo mudan in heer caalami ah lagu aqoonsado. Agaasimaha Istaraatiijiyadda Warbaahinta ee Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska, Cabdishakuur Cali Axmed, ayaa sheegay in aqoon-is-weydaarsigani uu yahay tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu ballaarinayo fahamka Soomaaliya ee barnaamijka Memory of the World, isla markaana uu furi doono waddooyin cusub oo lagu badbaadin karo keydka taariikhiga ah ee dalka. Waxa uu uga mahadceliyay UNESCO, khubarada iyo dhammaan daneeyayaasha ka qeyb qaatay dadaalkan, isagoo muujiyay rajada ah in mashruucani uu gacan ka geysan doono ilaalinta dhaxalka dukumiintiyada Soomaaliyeed si ay uga faa’iideystaan jiilasha mustaqbalka. ka qeybgalayaashu waxay isku raaceen in la dhiso guddi qaran oo isku dubbaridi doona aqoonsiga, ilaalinta iyo horumarinta dukumiintiyada taariikhiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyadoo la adeegsanayo hannaanada UNESCO. Khubarada dhaqanka ayaa aaminsan in ilaalinta kaydadka muhiimka ah, gaar ahaan kuwa Radio Muqdisho, ay door weyn ka qaadan doonto xoojinta aqoonsiga qaranka, kobcinta cilmi-baarista iyo hubinta in jiilalka dambe ay helaan xog dhab ah oo ku saabsan taariikhda dalkooda.

items.title: DF oo shaacisay inay fashilmeen dadaallo xal loogu raadinayay arrinta Garsoore Cartan
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo markii ugu horeysay ka hadashay caqabadihii uu la kulmay garsoore Cumar Cartan, oo qorshuhu ahaa inuu ka qeyb-galo garsoorka ciyaaraha koobka adduunka ayaa sheegtay inay fashilmeen dadaallo xal loogu raadinayay arrintan. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Isboortiska ee Soomaaliya ayaa lagu sheegay inay si weyn uga xun tahay duruufihii sababay in garsooraha Soomaaliyeed ee caalamiga ah, Cumar Cartan uu ka baaqdo ka qeyb-galka tartanka kubadda cagta ee caalamiga ah ee hadda ka socda dalalka Mareykanka, Canada iyo Mexico. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in dadaallo ay sameysay wasaaradda oo kaashaneysa wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda iyo madaxtooyadda ay suurta-gelin in xal laga gaaro arrinta Garsooraha. “Nasiib darro, inkastoo dadaalladaas xooggan la sameeyay, ma suuragelin in xal laga gaaro. Garsoore Cumar Cartan wuxuu tusaale muuqda u yahay kartida, adkeysiga, iyo dadaalka dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Wasaaradda ayaa xaqiijisay taageeradeeda buuxda ee Garsoore Cumar Cartan, waxayna sii wadi doontaa taageerada horumarintiisa xirfadeed iyo ka qeyb-galka fursadaha caalamiga ah ee mustaqbalka. Hoos ka aqriso war-saxaafadeedka oo dhameystiran: Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Isboortiska ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay si weyn uga xun tahay duruufihii sababay in garsooraha Soomaaliyeed ee caalamiga ah, Cumar Cartan, uu ka baaqdo ka qeybgalka tartanka kubadda cagta ee caalamiga ah ee hadda ka socda Dalalka Mareykanka, Canada, iyo Mexico. Kadib markii la ogaaday in Garsoore Cumar Cartan uu la kulmay caqabado la xiriira ogolaanshaha gelida dalka Mareykanka (Entry Denied), Wasaaraddu iyadoo kaashaneysa Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah iyo Madaxtooyada Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, waxay sameysay dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed iyo wada-xaajood ballaaran oo lala yeeshay Dowladda Mareykanka iyo hay’adda FIFA si xal degdeg ah loogu helo arrintan. Nasiib darro, inkastoo dadaalladaas xooggan la sameeyay, ma suuragelin in xal laga gaaro. Garsoore Cumar Cartan wuxuu tusaale muuqda u yahay kartida, adkeysiga, iyo dadaalka dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed. Guulihiisa caalamiga ahaa waxay sharaf iyo sumcad u yihiin shacabka Soomaaliyeed, waxayna caddeynaysaa in caqabadaha iyo duruufaha adag ee dalka ka jira aysan hor istaagin in dhalinyarada Soomaaliyeed ay gaaraan heerar sare oo caalami ah. Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Isboortiska waxay mar kale xaqiijineysaa taageeradeeda buuxda ee Garsoore Cumar Cartan, waxayna sii wadi doontaa taageerada horumarintiisa xirfadeed iyo ka qeybgalka fursadaha caalamiga ah ee mustaqbalka. Sidoo kale, Wasaaraddu waxay u mahadcelineysaa shacabka Soomaaliyeed, bahda ciyaaraha iyo dhammaan dadka muujiyay garab istaagga, dhiirrigelinta iyo taageerada ay u muujiyeen Garsoore Cumar Cartan. items.title: Mareykanka oo ku dhegay garsoorihii ugu mudnaa ee Afrika, marka loo eego garsooreyaasha kale
items.description: Garsoore Cumar Cartan oo ka mid ah garsooreyaasha ugu sarreya ee Qaaradda Afrika ayaa ka mid noqday 7 Garsoore oo Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Afrika ee CAF uu u diray inay wax ka dhexdhexaadiyaan Ciyaaraha Koobka Adduunka ee FIFA 2026 ee lagu qabanayo Mexico, Mareykanka iyo Canada. Garsooreyaasha Afrika ayaa wadarta guud ee garsooreyaasha ay FIFA u qorsheysay inay dhexdhexaadiyaan tartankaasi ka dhigeysa 52 Garsoore, waana sida uu ahaa qorshaha asalka ah ee FIFA ay dhawaan ku dhawaaqday inay garsoori doonaan kulamada la ciyaarayo, inkastoo FIFA ay Talaadadan liiskaasi ka saartay Garsooraha Soomaaliyeed ee lagu magacaabo Cumar Cartan, sababo ku aaddan diidmada Mareykanka ee inuu garsooruhu galo dalkaasi. Maamulka Socdaalka Federaalka Mareykanka ayaa Garsoore Cumar Cartan ka horjoogsaday inuu gudaha u galo dalkaasi, iyadoo la turxaan bixinaayo walaaca amniga. Garsooraha oo wata fiisaha saxda ah ee dal ku galka Mareykanka ayaa Sabtidii ka degay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Miami ee Gobolka Florida, laakiin saraakiisha ayaa u sheegay inaanan la ogoleyn inuu gudaha u galo dalka, taas oo keentay in dib loogu celiyo Magaalada Istanbul. Hay’adda Kastamka iyo Ilaalinta Xuduudaha Mareykanka ayaa laga soo xigtay in Garsooraha Sare ee Somaliya ay saameynayso xayiraadda fiisaha ee dalalka muwaadiniintooda laga mamnuucay dalkaasi. Somaliya ayaa waxay ka mid tahay 39-ka dal ee ku qoran amarka fulinta ee laga mamnuucay inaysan dadkoodu imaan karin dalkaasi Mareykanka. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sanadkii hore saxiixay amar muwaadiniinta dalalkaasi looga mamnuucayo in la siiyo fiisaha dal ku galka Mareykanka.. Dhammaan garsooreyaasha kale ee Afrika iyo kuwa ee ka socda dunida inteeda kale ayaa loo ogolaaday inay galaan dalkaasi, marka laga soo tago Garsooraha Qaran ee Somaliya. Wasiirka Dhallinyarada & Ciyaaraha Somaliya, Maxamed Cabdiqaadir Cali ayaa warsaxaafadeed ku sheegay in Dowladda Soomaaliyeed ay sameysay dadaalo diblomaasiyadeed iyo wada-xaajood ballaaran oo lala yeeshay Mareykanka iyo FIFA, si xal degdeg ah loogu helo arrintan, balse nasiib darro aysan dadaaladaasi guuleysan. FIFA ayaa sheegtay in Garsoore Cumar Cabdiqaadir Cartan uu ka maqnaan doono Koobka Adduunka, iyadoona u sababeysay “FIFA kuma lug laha hababka socdaalka ee dalka martida loo yahay, oo ay ku jiraan go’aan ka gaarista fiisaha, waxaana ay ku soo wargeliyeen masuuliyiinta in Mr. Cartan xaaladiisa aan waxba laga bedeli doonin hadda.” Si kastaba ha-ahaatee 6-da Garsoore ee kale ee hadda ka socda Afrika iyo dalalka ay u kala dhasheen ayaa kala ah Pierre Atcho (Gabon), Dahane Beida (Mauritania), Mustapha Ghorbal (Algeria), Jalal Jayed (Morocco), Amin Mohamed Omar (Egypt) iyo Abongile Tom (South Africa). Cartan waa garsoorihii ugu mudnaa ee garsooreyaasha ay Afrika u dirtay Koobka Qaramada Adduunka ee FIFA 2026, marka loo eego in Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Afrika uu sanadkii hore u tixgeliyay inuu yahay garsooraha ugu wanaagsan ee 2025. Tallaabada uu Maamulka Donald Trump isku hortaagay inuu galo dalkaasi ayaa dood adag ka dhalisay barraha bulshada, sidoo kalena wuxuu noqday qodobka koowaad ee Warbaahnta caalamiga ah ay ka warameyso.

items.title: Israel oo la sheegay in ay ku dhex milantay DF Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirkii hore ee Warfaafinta Soomaaliya Zakaria Maxamuud Xaaji ayaa sheegay in Israa’iil ay “si qoto dheer” u dhexgashay hay’adaha iyo go’aannada siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya, isagoo mas’uuliyadda koowaad dusha ka saaray Soomaalida laftooda iyo hoggaanka siyaasadeed ee dalka. Zakaria, oo wareysi gaar ah siiyay wargeyska Egypt Independent, ayaa sheegay in kala qeybsanaanta gudaha, nidaamka siyaasadeed ee jilicsan iyo maqnaanshaha barnaamij qaran ay Soomaaliya ka dhigeen dal u nugul faragelin shisheeye. “Israa’iil waxay si qoto dheer u dhexgashay hay’adaha Soomaaliya, waxayna saameyn ku yeelatay go’aanka siyaasadeed ee Soomaalida,” ayuu yiri. Wuxuu sheegay in arrintaas aysan ku imaan awood shisheeye oo keliya, balse ay sahleen khilaafaadka Soomaalida, tabar-darrida hay’adaha dowladda iyo hoggaan uu ku tilmaamay mid aan dalka u horseedin heshiis siyaasadeed oo qaran. “Mas’uuliyadda koowaad waxay saaran tahay Soomaalida laftooda, taas ayaana sahashay kala dhantaalidda,” ayuu yiri. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli aqoonsiga Israa’iil ee Somaliland uu noqday mid ka mid ah arrimaha ugu xasaasisan siyaasadda Soomaaliya iyo Geeska Afrika. Israa’iil ayaa 26-kii December 2025 si rasmi ah u aqoonsatay Somaliland, taas oo ka dhigtay dalkii ugu horreeyay ee sidaas sameeya tan iyo markii Somaliland ay sheegatay inay ka go’day Soomaaliya 1991-kii. Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa tallaabadaas ku tilmaantay weerar ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee dalka. Midowga Afrika ayaa sidoo kale ku adkeystay inuusan aqoonsaneyn Somaliland, isagoo sheegay in midnimada, madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya ay yihiin mabda’ aan laga leexan karin. Aqoonsiga Israa’iil ayaa sidoo kale cambaareyn xooggan kala kulmay dalal Carab, Muslim iyo Afrikaan ah, kuwaas oo ka digay in tallaabadaas ay sii hurin karto xiisadaha Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas. Zakaria ayaa sheegay in arrinta Somaliland ay muujineyso sida Soomaaliya ugu baahan tahay dib-u-habeyn siyaasadeed oo qoto dheer, midnimo qaran iyo dowlad dhexe oo awood u leh inay ilaaliso dhulkeeda, baddeeda iyo go’aankeeda siyaasadeed. Wuxuu si adag u dhaliilay nidaamka federaalka Soomaaliya, isagoo ku tilmaamay mid “si musiibo ah u fashilmay.” Sida uu sheegay, Soomaalidu waa dad mideysan dhaqan ahaan, diin ahaan iyo luqad ahaan, balse dhibaatadu waxay ka dhalatay hoggaan xumo iyo nidaam siyaasadeed oo aan lagu dhisin heshiis qaran oo dhab ah. “Nidaamka federaalka si musiibo ah ayuu u fashilmay,” ayuu yiri. “Shacabka Soomaaliyeed waa mideysan yahay dhaqan ahaan, diin ahaan iyo luqad ahaan. Dhibaatadu kuma jirto shacabka, waxay ku jirtaa kuwa hadda talada haya.” Zakaria ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya muddo 36 sano ah aysan yeelan dowlad hay’adeed oo dhab ah, balse weli ay jiraan waxyaabo xooggan oo isku haya dadka Soomaaliyeed. Wuxuu ku baaqay in la sameeyo midnimo qaran oo degdeg ah, doorashooyin caddaalad ah iyo isbeddel siyaasadeed oo ka baxsan hoggaanka hadda jira. “Shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo xoogagga siyaasadeed ee qaranka waa inay qaataan mas’uuliyadda, iyagoo sameynaya midnimo qaran oo degdeg ah, doorashooyin caddaalad ah, kana gudbaya hoggaanka siyaasadeed ee hadda jira,” ayuu yiri. Wuxuu ugu baaqay dalalka Carabta inay si firfircoon uga qeyb qaataan xallinta dhibaatada Soomaaliya, isagoo sheegay in maqnaanshahooda uu fursad siinayo dalal kale oo dano istiraatiiji ah ka leh Badda Cas iyo Geeska Afrika. Zakaria ayaa ka digay in haddii Soomaaliya aysan si degdeg ah u xoojin midnimadeeda gudaha, aqoonsiga Israa’iil ee Somaliland iyo xiriirrada ku xiga ay sii kordhin karaan khatarta kala go’a dalka iyo saameynta shisheeye ee siyaasadda Soomaaliya. Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa tallaabadaas ku tilmaantay weerar ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee dalka. Midowga Afrika ayaa sidoo kale ku adkeystay inuusan aqoonsaneyn Somaliland, isagoo sheegay in midnimada, madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya ay yihiin mabda’ aan laga leexan karin. Aqoonsiga Israa’iil ayaa sidoo kale cambaareyn xooggan kala kulmay dalal Carab, Muslim iyo Afrikaan ah, kuwaas oo ka digay in tallaabadaas ay sii hurin karto xiisadaha Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas. Zakaria ayaa sheegay in arrinta Somaliland ay muujineyso sida Soomaaliya ugu baahan tahay dib-u-habeyn siyaasadeed oo qoto dheer, midnimo qaran iyo dowlad dhexe oo awood u leh inay ilaaliso dhulkeeda, baddeeda iyo go’aankeeda siyaasadeed. Wuxuu si adag u dhaliilay nidaamka federaalka Soomaaliya, isagoo ku tilmaamay mid “si musiibo ah u fashilmay.” Sida uu sheegay, Soomaalidu waa dad mideysan dhaqan ahaan, diin ahaan iyo luqad ahaan, balse dhibaatadu waxay ka dhalatay hoggaan xumo iyo nidaam siyaasadeed oo aan lagu dhisin heshiis qaran oo dhab ah. “Nidaamka federaalka si musiibo ah ayuu u fashilmay,” ayuu yiri. “Shacabka Soomaaliyeed waa mideysan yahay dhaqan ahaan, diin ahaan iyo luqad ahaan. Dhibaatadu kuma jirto shacabka, waxay ku jirtaa kuwa hadda talada haya.” Zakaria ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya muddo 36 sano ah aysan yeelan dowlad hay’adeed oo dhab ah, balse weli ay jiraan waxyaabo xooggan oo isku haya dadka Soomaaliyeed. Wuxuu ku baaqay in la sameeyo midnimo qaran oo degdeg ah, doorashooyin caddaalad ah iyo isbeddel siyaasadeed oo ka baxsan hoggaanka hadda jira. “Shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo xoogagga siyaasadeed ee qaranka waa inay qaataan mas’uuliyadda, iyagoo sameynaya midnimo qaran oo degdeg ah, doorashooyin caddaalad ah, kana gudbaya hoggaanka siyaasadeed ee hadda jira,” ayuu yiri. Wuxuu ugu baaqay dalalka Carabta inay si firfircoon uga qeyb qaataan xallinta dhibaatada Soomaaliya, isagoo sheegay in maqnaanshahooda uu fursad siinayo dalal kale oo dano istiraatiiji ah ka leh Badda Cas iyo Geeska Afrika. Zakaria ayaa ka digay in haddii Soomaaliya aysan si degdeg ah u xoojin midnimadeeda gudaha, aqoonsiga Israa’iil ee Somaliland iyo xiriirrada ku xiga ay sii kordhin karaan khatarta kala go’a dalka iyo saameynta shisheeye ee siyaasadda Soomaaliya. items.title: Tensions Rise Ahead of South West State Presidential Election in Baidoa
items.description: BAIDOA — Political tensions are mounting in Baidoa as the race for the presidency of Somalia’s South West State enters a decisive stage ahead of the scheduled election on the 10th of this month. The contest has narrowed to three key candidates — Aden Madobe, Sharif Hassan Sheikh Aden, and Dr. Abdi Aziz Jawari — who are all intensifying efforts to secure the support of members of the South West State Parliament. Sources in Baidoa say candidates and their supporters have stepped up political consultations, lobbying campaigns, and closed-door meetings in an effort to consolidate votes, while the city continues to witness heightened political activity and increased security attention. However, the electoral process remains overshadowed by growing disputes between Aden Madobe’s rivals and federal authorities over several unresolved issues that opposition candidates insist are essential for ensuring a transparent and credible election. One of the main points of contention is the use of mobile phones inside the voting hall. Opposition candidates are demanding a complete ban on phones to prevent lawmakers from photographing their ballots after voting, arguing that such measures are necessary to safeguard the secrecy and integrity of the vote. Independent candidates have supported the proposal, while Villa Somalia is reportedly opposed to the restriction. Another contentious issue concerns the venue and timing of the election. Rival candidates are calling for the vote to be held at a neutral and secure location protected by African Union forces rather than at a government-controlled facility. They have also insisted that the election be conducted during daylight hours, rejecting any plans for a nighttime vote amid reports that authorities are considering holding the election at the presidential palace. The opposition has also raised objections over Aden Madobe’s continued role as Speaker of Somalia’s Federal Parliament while contesting for another political office. Rival candidates argue that he should step down from the position and participate in the election solely as an ordinary candidate. Aden Madobe has publicly rejected those demands. Meanwhile, sources indicate that the Federal Government is considering alternative certification arrangements aimed at preventing a possible collapse of the electoral process should the leading opposition candidates withdraw from the race. The developments have fueled concerns that the election could face delays or even cancellation if political disagreements remain unresolved before polling day. The South West State presidential election is being closely monitored across Somalia, with analysts warning that its outcome could significantly influence both the future political direction of the regional administration and the broader national political landscape. items.title: Mareykanka oo ka hadlay sababta Gasoore Cumar Cartan loogu diiday inuu galo dalkaasi
items.description: Miami ( Raxanreeb Online) Garsooraha Soomaaliyeed Cumar Cabdulqaadir Cartan ayaa seegaya ka qaybgalka Koobka Adduunka ee sanadkan kadib markii loo diiday gelitaanka Maraykanka, sida ay xaqiijisay FIFA. Cumar Cabdiqaadir Cartan oo sanadkii 2025 loo aqoonsaday garsooraha ugu wanaagsan Afrika ee ragga, ayaa ka mid ahaa garsoorayaasha loo xushay inay dhex dhexaadiyaan ciyaaraha Koobka Adduunka ee ka dhacaya Maraykanka, Canada iyo Mexico. Hase yeeshee markii uu kasoo degay magaalada Miami kadib safar uu kaga yimid Istanbul, ciidamada ilaalada xudduudaha Maraykanka ayaa baadhitaan dheeraad ah ku sameeyay, ugu dambayna u diiday inuu dalka galo. Sarkaal ka tirsan Hay’adda Kastamka iyo Ilaalinta Xuduudaha Maraykanka (CBP) oo u warramay warbaahinta CNN ayaa sheegay in Cumar Cartan loo arkay “inuu uusan u qalmin gelitaanka USA” kadib baadhitaan amni, balse ma aysan faahfaahin sababta rasmiga ah ee go’aankaasi. Soomaaliya ayaa ka mid ah dalalka uu saameeyay xayiraadda socdaalka ee maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump, taas oo keentay in muwaadiniinta dalalkaas lagu sameeyo baaritaanno adag. FIFA ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay ku sheegtay inaanay wax door ah ku lahayn go’aannada socdaalka ee dalalka martigelinaya tartanka, iyadoo xustay in dowladda martida loo yahay ay go’aamiso cidda la siinayo fiisaha iyo cidda loo oggolaanayo inay dalka gasho. Xidhiidhka Kubadda Cagta Soomaaliya ayaa la xidhiidhayay FIFA si loo helo sharraxaad dheeraad ah, halka mas’uuliyiin Soomaali ahi ay sheegeen in Cumar Cartan watay dukumiintiyo sax ah iyo baasaboorka diblomaasiga ah oo loogu talagalay fududeynta safarkiisa. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa iyadoo dalal kale oo ay ka mid tahay Iran ay sidoo kale cabasho ka muujiyeen caqabado dhinaca socdaalka ah oo la xidhiidha Koobka Adduunka. Madaxweynaha xidhiidhka kubadda cagta Iran Mehdi Taj ayaa sheegay in xulka Iran loo oggolaaday inay galaan Maraykanka hal maalin oo shalay ciyaartooda, halka qaar ka mid ah maamulka iyo warbaahinta xulka aan weli loo oggolaan Tegitaanka dalkaas. Cumar Cartan ayaa noqday garsoore FIFA ah sanadkii 2018, wuxuuna hore uga soo shaqeeyay tartamada waaweyn ee Afrika sida Koobka Qaramada Afrika ee AFCON. Dad badan oo Soomaali ah ayaa u arkayay ka qaybgalka Koobka Adduunka guul taariikhi ah oo u soo hoyatay Soomaalida iyo garsoorka Afrikaba, balse dedaalka shakhsiga ayaa u ek in uu caqabad weyn wejahay. items.title: FIFA oo si quus leh uga hadashay soo celinta Garsoore Cartan ee Mareykanka
items.description: Ankara (Caasimada Online) – Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Adduunka (FIFA) oo ka fal-celiyay caqabadihii uu la kulmay garsoore Cumar Cartan, kaas oo qorshuhu ahaa inuu ka qeyb-galo garsoorka ciyaaraha koobka adduunka ayaa sheegay in uusan waxba u qaban karin Cartan. FIFA ayaa si cad u sheegtay in arrinta Cartan aysan awoodin inay wax ka qabato, ama kala hadli karin dowladda Maraykanka, maaddama dowladaha martigelinaya dadka soo galaya dalalkooda ay mas’uul ka yihiin arrimaha socdaalka. Cartan oo ku safrayay baasaboorka diblomaasiga ah ee Soomaaliya ayaa laga soo celiyey garoonka diyaaradaha magaaalada Miami ee dalka Mareykanka. Garsooraha ayaa waxaa shalay dib loogu celiyay magaalada Ankara ee caasimadda dalka Turkiga. Dhacdadan ayaa dhalisay falcelin xooggan iyadoo bulshada Soomaaliyeed si weyn uga caroodeen in garsoore heer caalami ah loo diido gelitaanka Mareykanka, xilli uu u socday howl rasmi ah oo la xiriirta ciyaaraha adduunka. Qaar kamid ah dadka falanqeeya arrimaha isboortiga iyo siyaasadda ayaa sidoo kale dhaliilo u jeediyay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, iyagoo ku eedeeyay inay ka gaabisay taageerada iyo dabagalka arrinta Cartan, maadaama uu ku safrayay baasaboorka diblomaasiga ah. Garsoore Cumar Cabduqaadir Cartan ayaa ku guulaystay garsooraha ugu fiican ee qaarada Afrika sannadkii 2025, waxaana billadaas guddoon siiyay xiriirka kubadda cagta ee Afrika (CAF). Si kastaba, arrintan oo loo arkayay mid astaan u noqon karta horumarka garsoorka Soomaaliyeed ee ka qayb-galka tartamada heerka caalami, ayaa waxaa soo afmeeray qawaaniinta adag ee safarka ee Mareykanka. Dhacdadan ayaa tusaale cad u ah qiimaha iyo halka qofka Soomaaliga ah ee sita baasaboorka Soomaaliya ah uu ka joogo caalamka iyo sida loogu arko in uu yahay qof qiimo, dawlad iyo damaanad midna aan lahayn. items.title: Dowladda Somaliya oo ka hadashay is hortaagga uu Mareykanka ku sameeyay Garsoore Cumar Cartan
items.description: Wasiirka Dhallinyarada & Ciyaaraha Somaliya, Maxamed Cabdiqaadir Cali ayaa saaka war ka soo saaray is hortaagga uu Mareykanka ku sameeyay in Garsoore Cumar Cartan uu galo dalkaasi. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay in wasaaraddu ay aad uga xun tahay duruufihii sababay in Garsooraha Soomaaliyeed uu ka baaqdo ka qaybgalka Koobka Adduunka ee lagu qabanayo Mareykanka, Mexico iyo Canada. Warka uu Wasiirku soo saaray ayaa u qornaa:- Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Isboortiska ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay si weyn uga xun tahay duruufihii sababay in Garsooraha Soomaaliyeed ee caalamiga ah, Cumar Cartan uu ka baaqdo ka qaybgalka tartanka kubadda cagta ee caalamiga ah ee hadda ka socda Dalalka Mareykanka, Canada iyo Mexico. Ka dib markii la ogaaday in Garsoore Cumar Cartan uu la kulmay caqabado la xiriira ogolaanshaha gelidda dalka Mareykanka (Entry Denied), wasaaraddu iyadoo kaashaneysa Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah iyo Madaxtooyada Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, waxay sameysay dadaalo diblomaasiyadeed iyo wada-xaajood ballaaran oo lala yeeshay Dowladda Mareykanka iyo hay’adda FIFA, si xal degdeg ah loogu helo arrintan. Nasiib darro, inkastoo dadaalldaas xooggan la sameeyay, ma suurtaagelin in xal laga gaaro. Garsoore Cumar Cartan wuxuu tusaale muuqda u yahay kartida, adkeysiga iyo dadaalka dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed. Guulihiisa caalamiga ahaa waxay sharaf iyo sumcad u yihiin shacabka Soomaaliyeed, waxayna caddeynaysaa in caqabadaha iyo duruufaha adag ee dalka ka jira aysan hor istaagin in dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed ay gaaraan heerar sare oo caalami ah. Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Isboortiska waxay mar kale xaqiijineysaa taageeradeeda buuxda ee Garsoore Cumar Cartan, waxayna sii wadi doontaa taageerada horumarintiisa xirfadeed iyo ka qaybgalka fursadaha caalamiga ah ee mustaqbalka. Sidoo kale, wasaaraddu waxay u mahadcelineysaa shacabka Soomaaliyeed, bahda ciyaaraha iyo dhammaan dadka muujiyay garab istaagga, dhiirrigelinta iyo taageerada ay u muujiyeen Garsoore Cumar Cartan.

items.title: Somali referee Omar Artan denied U.S. entry for 2026 World Cup
items.description: WASHINGTON (Somaliguardian) – Somali football referee Omar Abdulkadir Artan will miss what was expected to be a historic World Cup debut after being denied entry into the United States, FIFA confirmed on Monday. Artan had been scheduled to participate in training and officiating duties at the tournament, which begins on Thursday. His appointment would have made him the first Somali referee to officiate at a FIFA World Cup. A FIFA spokesperson said the governing body had been informed that Artan would not be permitted to enter the United States and therefore would be unable to take part in the competition. “FIFA is not involved in host country immigration processes, including visa adjudications, and has been informed by authorities that Mr Artan’s status will not be changed at present,” the spokesperson said. In a statement, Artan said he remained optimistic despite the setback and was focused on the future of his refereeing career. “I would like to thank FIFA and CAF for all their support and I promise to keep my refereeing levels up as I concentrate on the future,” he said. “I want to thank the football family for their messages and wish my colleagues all the best success during the World Cup and I look forward to joining them again in future competitions.” The U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) said a Somali national arrived at Miami International Airport from Istanbul on Saturday and was denied entry after officials determined he was inadmissible following additional screening procedures. Although the agency did not identify the individual by name, it said the decision was based on vetting concerns and that the traveler underwent a routine secondary inspection before being refused entry. “Admissibility determinations are made on a case-by-case basis using law enforcement, national security, and immigration information available at the time of inspection,” the CBP said. The agency did not provide further details regarding the concerns that led to the decision. The case has drawn attention amid ongoing scrutiny of U.S. immigration policies ahead of the World Cup. Last year, the Trump administration introduced a broad travel ban affecting citizens from 12 countries, including Somalia. According to media reports, Artan held a valid U.S. visa at the time of travel. Somalia’s embassy in Washington had not issued a public response as of Monday. Artan, who was named the Confederation of African Football’s (CAF) Best Male Referee for 2025, is widely regarded as one of Africa’s leading match officials. His absence means Somalia will miss a landmark moment at the World Cup, where he had been poised to become the first Somali referee to officiate on football’s biggest stage. items.title: Trump: Heshiiska aan Iiraan la geli doonaahi wuxuu ka fiicnaan doonaa kii Obama
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump, ayaa sheegay inuu maalmo gudahood fikrad cad ka heli karo heshiiska suurtagalka ah ee u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iran. Trump wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in haddii heshiis la gaaro, uu ka wanaagsanaan doono heshiiskii nukliyeerka ee ay maamulka Barack Obama la galeen Iran sanadkii 2015. Trump ayaa ku dooday in heshiiska cusub uu si weyn uga duwanaan doono kii hore, isagoo sheegay inuu noqon doono “heshiis wanaagsan oo sax ah” isla markaana aan siin doonin Iiraan faa’iidooyin uu u arko inay ku jireen heshiiskii Obama. Sidoo kale, maamulka Trump ayaa tilmaamay in heshiiska la qorsheynayo uu diiradda saari doono xaddididda awoodda Iran ee kobcinta yuraaniyamka iyo maaraynta kaydka yuraaniyamka la hodmiyey, arrimo uu maamulka Trump ku dhaliilay heshiiskii hore ee Obama. Wada-hadallada u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iran ayaa weli socda, iyadoo Trump marar badan muujiyey rajo ah in heshiis la gaari karo, inkastoo ay jiraan caqabado iyo kala aragti duwanaansho ku saabsan arrimaha nukliyeerka iyo cunaqabateynta saaran Iiraan. Trump wuxuu aaminsan yahay in heshiis kasta oo uu la gaaro Iiraan uu ka adkaan doono kana waxtar badan doono heshiiskii Obama, wuxuuna sheegay in sawirka heshiiskaas laga yaabo inuu caddaado maalmaha soo socda.

items.title: Maamulka Donald Trump oo dhalashada kala laabanaya Soomaaligii ugu horreeyey
items.description: Minneapolis (Caasimada Online) – Nin Soomaali ah oo degan gobolka Minnesota ayaa ka mid noqday 17 qof oo dowladda Mareykanka ee uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Donald Trump ay dooneyso in lagala noqdo dhalashada Mareykanka, taas oo qeyb ka ah olole cusub oo Washington ay ku ballaarineyso kiisaska ka xayuubinta muwaadinimada dadka dhalashada qaatay. Abdikadir Kadiye, oo 54 jir ah, ayaa wajahaya dacwad madani ah oo uu gudbiyay xafiiska xeer ilaaliyaha federaalka ee gobolka Minnesota. Dacwadda ayaa ku eedeyneysa inuu si sharci-darro ah ku helay dhalashada Mareykanka, isla markaana uu qariyay xog muhiim ah markii uu ku jiray hannaanka jinsiyadda. Waaxda Caddaaladda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in Kadiye uu 1997-kii isku dayay inuu dalka ku soo galo aqoonsi kale, isagoo markii hore sheegay in magaciisu yahay Liban M. Degel. Sida ku cad dacwadda, wuxuu markaas sheegay inuu xaas leeyahay balse uusan carruur lahayn. Codsigaas ayaa la sheegay in garsoore socdaal uu diiday. Dacwadda ayaa intaas ku dartay in Kadiye uu sanadkii xigay, 1998-kii, gudbiyay codsi kale oo uu ku isticmaalay magaca Abdikadir Kadiye. Saraakiisha Waaxda Caddaaladda ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Kadiye uu mar u sheegay sarkaal ka tirsan ilaalinta xuduudaha Mareykanka inuu isticmaalay laba aqoonsi intii uu ku jiray hannaanka lagu oggolaanayay inuu dalka galo. Dacwaddan ma aha xukun dembi, Kadiye ayaana xaq u leh inuu maxkamadda iska difaaco. Hase yeeshee, haddii dowladda Mareykanka ay ku guuleysato kiiska, wuxuu waayi karaa dhalashada Mareykanka, taas oo dib ugu celin karta xaaladdii socdaal ee uu lahaa ka hor inta uusan muwaadin noqon. Sharciga Mareykanka ayaa dowladda u oggolaanaya inay maxkamad ka dalbato in dhalashada lagala noqdo qof ku dhashay dal kale oo Mareykan noqday, haddii ay caddeyso inuu muwaadinimada ku helay khiyaano, xog qarin, ama been uu ka sheegay codsigiisa. Kiisaska noocan ah ayaa muddo dheer ahaa kuwo aad u yar, sababtoo ah waxay u baahan yihiin dacwad dheer iyo caddeyn culus. Xog taariikhi ah ayaa muujineysa in intii u dhaxeysay 1990 iyo 2017 ay Waaxda Caddaaladda Mareykanka sanadkii celcelis ahaan gudbin jirtay 11 dacwadood oo keliya oo lagu dalbanayo in qof lagala noqdo dhalashada. Laakiin dowladda Trump ayaa hadda si weyn u ballaarineysa ololahaas, iyadoo sheegtay inay beegsaneyso dadka ay ku eedeyneyso inay khiyaano ku heleen jinsiyadda ama ay qariyeen dembiyo culus. Sii-hayaha xeer-ilaaliyaha qaranka Mareykanka Todd Blanche ayaa sheegay in Waaxda Caddaaladdu aysan u dulqaadan doonin ku xadgudubka hannaanka qaadashada dhalashada. “Dambiilayaal ajaaniib ah ayaa ka been sheegaya dembiyadoodii hore, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa ka ganacsada daroogada, kuwa sameeyey xadgudub galmo iyo khiyaanooleyaal,” ayuu yiri Blanche. Xoghayaha Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka Markwayne Mullin ayaa isna sheegay in dowladda Trump ay adeegsan doonto waddo kasta oo sharci ah oo lagu baabi’in karo jinsiyadda dadka lagu helo inay been ku heleen dhalashada. “Dhalashada Mareykanka waa mudnaan, waana in si daacad ah lagu kasbado,” ayuu yiri Mullin. “Haddii aad halkan timaaddo, sharcigayaga jebiso, kadibna aad been ka sheegto hannaanka socdaalka, waad luminaysaa mudnaantaas.” Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in 16-ka qof ee kale ee lagu daray ololahan lagu eedeynayo falal kala duwan, oo ay ku jiraan xadgudubyo galmo oo ka dhan ah carruur, daroogo, dambiyo maaliyadeed iyo khiyaano socdaal. Kiiska Kadiye ayaa si gaar ah u taabanaya bulshada Soomaaliyeed ee Minnesota, oo ah mid ka mid ah jaaliyadaha Soomaalida ugu waaweyn Mareykanka. Waxaa sidoo kale uu kusoo beegmayaa xilli dowladda Trump ay adkeysay siyaasaddeeda socdaalka, iyadoo ballanqaadday inay si adag ula dagaallameyso dadka ay ku eedeyso inay si khaldan ku heleen sharci ama dhalasho. Haddii maxkamaddu taageerto dacwadda dowladda, Kadiye wuxuu noqon karaa mid ka mid ah kiisaska ugu dambeeyay ee muwaadin Mareykan ah oo dhalashada lagala noqdo, iyadoo Washington ay sare u qaadeyso adeegsiga tallaabo sharci oo muddo dheer loo arkayay mid naadir ah. items.title: Iiraan oo canbaaraysay cuno qabataynta midowga Yurub
items.description: Kazem Gharibabadi, ku-xigeenka wasiirka arrimaha dibadda jamhuuriyada Islaamiga ee Iiraan ayaa cambaareeyay cunaqabateenada cusub ee Midowga Yurub ee ka dhanka ah tiro shakhsiyaad Iiraaniyiin ah iyo hay’ado, isaga oo ku qeexay cadaadisyadan been abuur iyo xoog sheegasho. Waxa uu ku qoray barta shabakada bulshada ee X: ‘’Maanta, golaha Midowga Yurub, talaabo been abuur ah, waxa ay ku meel mariyeen wax loogu yeeray cunaqabateeno ka dhan ah hay’ado iyo shakhsiyaad Iiraaniyiin ah oo lala xiriirinayo marinka Hormuz. Iyaga midowga Yurub ayaa ah kuwa ugu weyn ee ku xadgudbaya xuquuqda shacabka Iiraan, midowguna uu si kas ah uga aamusnaa xiritaanka ciidamada badda Maraykanku ku sameeyeen Iiraan, taasi oo loo tixgalinayo ficil dagaal’’ Waxa uu intaa ku daray Iiraan in ‘’aysan qayb ka ahayn heshiiska Sharciga Badda. Rajiimka sharciga ee Iiraan ee marinka Hormuz waa ‘’gudbid dambi la’aan’’ marka loo eego si guud sharciga caalamiga ah iyo korjoogteynta badbaadada badda iyo tixgalinada ammaanka ee dowlad xeeb leh’’ Waxa uu ugu yeeray talaabo siyaasadeed, isaga oo sheegay in uusan ka arkin ‘’wax qiimo ah’’ oo talaabadan siyaasadeed ay u leedahay Iiraan.

items.title: Iiraan iyo Israa’iil oo sheegay inay joojin doonaan duqeymaha balse ka digay aargoosi
items.description: Iiraan iyo Israa’iil ayaa sheegay inay joojiyeen weerarradii ay isku qaadayeen, ka dib markii labada dal ay is rasaaseeyeen markii ugu horreysay tan iyo markii la gaaray xabad joojintii bishii Abriil. Fariin codeed lagu daabacay wakaaladaha wararka rasmiga ah Isniintii, Mohammed Baqer Qalibaf, afhayeenka baarlamanka Iiraan ayaa ku tilmaamay weerarkii habeenimadii Axada ee duqaymaha ay iyagu gaysteen gabi ahaanba kuwo lagu qiimeeyay inay ahaayeen lagama maarmaa oo ay guulaysteen. Farriinta codka oo qoraal ahaan ay daabacday wakaalada wararka IRNA ayuu ku yiri Qalibaf, ‘’Haddii aynu ku tixgalino diblomaasiayada wadahadalada kali ah ee qolalka xiran iyo diblomaasiyada qosolka, weeynu ku guul daraysan lahayn bilowgiiba, haddii aynu ku tiirsanaan lahayn dagaal iyo howlgalo militari oo kali ah, ma aynaan awoodneen in aynu si buuxda u difaacno xuquuqdeena’’. items.title: Trump oo Netanyahu uga Digay Weerarro Cusub oo ka Dhan ah Iiraan
items.description: Mareykanka ayaa sare u qaaday dadaallada lagu doonayo in lagu dejiyo xiisadda Bariga Dhexe, kaddib markii Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu digniin culus u diray Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu, isaga oo uga digay inuu dib u bilaabo dagaal ka dhan ah Iiraan. Trump ayaa sheegay in Netanyahu uu “kaligiis noqon doono” haddii Israa’iil ay sii waddo weerarrada ka dhanka ah Iiraan, xilli labada dal ay hakiyeen duqeymihii isdhaafsiga ahaa ee dhacay maalmihii lasoo dhaafay. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Trump uu si toos ah ula xiriiray Netanyahu, kuna boorriyey inuu joojiyo weerarrada, si loo sii ambaqaado wada-hadallada nabadeed ee aan tooska ahayn ee u dhexeeya Washington iyo Tehran. Xiisadda cusub ayaa ka dhalatay duqeymo ay Israa’iil ka geysatay magaalada Beirut ee caasimadda Lubnaan, taas oo keentay in Iiraan ay gantaallo ku garaacdo waqooyiga Israa’iil. Inkastoo xabbad-joojin ay dhaqan gashay bishii Abriil, haddana dhacdooyinkan ayaa noqday kuwii ugu cuslaa ee labada dhinac dhex mara tan iyo markaas. Maalintii Isniinta, Israa’iil ayaa weerartay nidaamyada difaaca hawada iyo xarun batrool kiimiko ah oo ku taalla Iran, halka Iiraan ay jawaab ahaan bartilmaameedsatay xarun la mid ah oo ku taal magaalada Haifa iyo laba saldhig oo ciidan oo Israa’iili ah. Dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu dejinayo colaadda ayaa weli socda, iyadoo caalamku si dhow ula socdo haddii labada dhinac ay u hoggaansami doonaan baaqyada nabadeed ama ay dib ugu laaban doonaan dagaal cusub oo gobolka oo dhan saameeya.

items.title: Dawladda Mareykanka oo Xaqiijiyay inay Dalkeeda u Diiday Garsoore Cumar Cartan ah oo ka Qaybgalayay Koobka Adduunka
items.description: Dawladda Mareykanka ayaa si rasmi ah u xaqiijisay inay u diidday inuu dalkeeda galo garsooraha caanka ah ee reer Soomaaliya, Omar Abdulkadir Artan, kaas oo loo xushay inuu qayb ka noqdo garsoorayaasha dhex-xaadin doona kulammada Koobka Adduunka. Go’aankan oo dhabar-jab ku ah isboortiga Soomaaliya ayaa yimid ka dib markii garsooraha laga soo celiyay mid ka mid ah garoomada diyaaradaha ee Mareykanka, taas oo keentay in gabi ahaanba laga saaro liiska garsoorayaasha tartanka maadama uusan u safri karin dalkaas. Hey’adda Kastamka iyo Ilaalinta Xuduudaha Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in go’aankani uu dhashay ka dib baaritaan lagu sameeyay, isla markaana lagu helay arrimo la xiriira amniga iyo baaritaanka qofka. Go’aankan ayaa dib u soo kiciyay doodaha ku saabsan saameynta siyaasadeed iyo caqabadaha hortaagan muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee u safraya tartammada caalamiga ah, iyadoo la xaqiijiyay in Omar Artan uu markii hore sitay baasaboor diblomaasi ah iyo fiiso sharci ah. Hadal-haynta Caalamiga ah ee ka Dhalatay Arrintan Go’aanka uu Mareykanku dalka kaga mamnuucay Omar Artan ayaa durbadiiba noqday mid si weyn looga hadal-hayo fagaarayaasha isboortiga iyo warbaahinta caalamiga ah. Khuburada ciyaaraha iyo falanqeeyayaasha caalamiga ah ayaa muujiyay walaac ku saabsan sida go’aanada siyaasadeed iyo shuruucda socdaalka ee dalalka martigelinaya Koobka Adduunka ay u saameyn karaan caddaaladda iyo sinnaanta isboortiga adduunka. Baraha bulshada iyo baraha ay ku kulmaan taageerayaasha kubbadda cagta ee qaaradda Afrika ayaa lagu falanqeeyay arrintan, iyadoo dad badani ay su’aal ka keeneen sababta garsooraha ugu fiicnaa Afrika ee sannadkii 2025 loogu diiday inuu taariikh ka dhigo Koobka Adduunka. Hadal-hayntan ayaa sidoo kale dib u soo noolaysay doodaha la xiriira xayiraadaha socdaal ee saaran muwaadiniinta u dhashay waddamada qaarkood, iyadoo dadka qaar ay sheegayaan in dhacdadan ay hoos u dhigeyso niyadda dhalinyarada huteysan ee ka soo baxaya waddamada soo koraya ee hiigsanaya fagaarayaasha waaweyn ee caalamka.

items.title: FIFA oo Garsoore Cumar Cartan ka saartay Liiska Garsooreyaasha Koobka Adduunka
items.description: Cumar Cartan oo lagu waday inuu noqdo qofkii ugu horreyay ee Soomaali ah oo garsoore ka noqda ciyaar ka tirsan Koobka Kubadda Cagta Adduunka ee FIFA 2026 ayaa laga saaray Liiska Garsooreyaasha FIFA, ka gadaal markii loo diiday inuu galo dalkaasi Mareykanka. Cumar Cartan oo noqday Garsooraha Afrika ee 2025 ayaa Sabtidii ka degay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Miami ee Gobolka Florida, isagoo wata fiisaha saxda ah ee dal ku galka Mareykanka, waxaase is hortaagay Saraakiisha Waaxda Amniga Gudaha ee DHS, kuwaas oo u sheegay inaanu dalka geli karin, iyagoona dib ugu celiyay Turkiga. FIFA ayaa waxay sheegtay in Garsoore Cumar Cabdiqaadir Cartan uu ka maqnaan doono Koobka Adduunka, sababo ku aaddan diidmada dalka martida loo yahay ee inuu galo dalkaasi. “FIFA kuma lug laha hababka socdaalka ee dalka martida loo yahay, oo ay ku jiraan go’aan ka gaarista fiisaha, waxaana ay ku soo wargeliyeen masuuliyiinta in Mr. Cartan xaaladiisa aan waxba laga bedeli doonin hadda.” Ayay FIFA ku sheegtay warsaxaafadeed ay soo saartay. Somaliya ayaa waxay ku jirtaa liiska dalal uu Maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu dadkooda ka mamnuucay inay yimaadaan Mareykanka. Tallaabada uu Mareykanka ugu diiday Cartan inuu gudaha u galo dalkaasi ayaa sare u qaadday walaaca laga qabo xayiraadaha socdaalka Washington iyo saamaynta ay ku yeelan karaan tartanka. Cartan ayaa lagu waday inuu noqdo garsoorihii ugu horreyay ee Soomaaliyeed ee dhexdhexaadiya Finalka Koobka Adduunka. Ciyaarta finalka ayaa 19-ka bisha July lagu qaban doonnaa Garoonka Kubadda Cagta MetLife ee dalkaasi Mareykanka, waana sababta ay u saameynayso Garsoore Cartan xayiraadda Washington. Cartan ayaa ka mid ahaa 52 Garsoore oo FIFA ay ku dhawaaqday inay dhexdhexaadin doonaan muddada ay ciyaaruhu ka socdaan Canada, Mexico iyo Mareykanka. Tartanka ayaa 11-ka bishan oo Khamiista ku beegan ka furmaya Mexico, waxaana ciyaarta ugu dambeysa lagu soo geba-gabeen doonnaa Mareykanka.

items.title: Warbaahinta oo si weyn u hadal Haysa Ka Reebidda Garsoore Cumar Cartan ee Koobka Adduunka 2026
items.description: Arrinta la xiriirta ka reebidda garsooraha caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliyeed, Cumar Cabdulkadir Cartan ee tartanka Koobka Adduunka 2026 ayaa noqotay mid si weyn loogu hadal hayo warbaahinta caalamka, kaddib markii la xaqiijiyey inuusan ka qayb geli doonin tartanka lagu qabanayo Mareykanka, Kanada iyo Mexico. Warbaahinta ugu waaweyn dunida, gaar ahaan kuwa, Mareykanka,Carabta iyo Afrika, ayaa si qoto dheer u falanqeynaya saameynta go’aankan, iyadoo la tilmaamay in Cumar Cartan uu qarka u saarnaa inuu noqdo garsoorihii ugu horreeyay ee Soomaaliyeed ee ka dhex muuqda Koobka Adduunka. Telefishinka caanka ah ee Al Jazeera ayaa baahiyey warbixin sheegaysa in maamulka Mareykanka uu u diiday garsooraha Soomaaliyeed gelitaanka dalkiisa si uu uga qayb qaato maamulka ciyaaraha Koobka Adduunka 2026. Dhanka kale, Lataliyaha Sare ee Wasaaradda Dhalinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha Soomaaliya, Siciid Aadan Abshir, ayaa si adag u cambaareeyey tallaabadan, isagoo ku tilmaamay mid dhaawacaysa qiyamka caddaaladda iyo sinnaanta ee kubadda cagta caalamka. Siciid Aadan Abshir ayaa sheegay in Cumar Cartan uu ka mid yahay garsoorayaasha ugu sumcadda badan qaaradda Afrika, islamarkaana ka hor istaagista fursaddan taariikhiga ah aysan saameyn ku yeelanayn oo keliya isaga shaqsi ahaan, balse ay dhaawacayso rajada iyo hamiga ciyaartooyda iyo saraakiisha Soomaaliyeed ee doonaya inay gaaraan heerarka ugu sarreeya ee isboortiga caalamka. Arrintan ayaa dhalisay dood ballaaran oo ka dhex socota warbaahinta baraha bulshada, taageerayaasha kubadda cagta iyo bulshada Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo su’aal gelinaya sababaha dhabta ah ee ka dambeeya go’aanka lagu joojiyey ka qaybgalka garsooraha Soomaaliyeed ee tartanka ugu weyn kubadda cagta adduunka, inkastoo arrintu ay la xariirtu u safridda Mareykanka oo Muwaadiniinta dalalka qaar oo Soomaaliya ku jirto laga mamnuucay. items.title: Waaxda Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka oo sheegtay in la celiyay Garsoore Cumar Cartan
items.description: Mareykanka ayaa xaqiijyay in dalkaasi laga celiyay Garsoore Cumar Cartan oo ka mid ahaa Garsooreyaasha Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Adduunka ee FIFA, isla-markaana loo xushay inay dhexdhexaadiyaan tartamada xulalka qaramada, muddada ay ciyaaruhu ka socdaan saddexda dal ee lagu kala qabanayo ee kala ah Mareykanka, Mexico iyo Canada. Ciyaaraha Koobka Adduunka ee 2026 ayaa Khamiista ka furmaya Mexico, iyadoo kulanka ugu horreyana uu dhex mari doono Mexico iyo South Africa. Waaxda Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka ee DHS ayaa Isniintii Al Jazeera u sheegtay in Garsooraha Soomaaliyeed aan la ogolaan inuu gudaha u galo dalka, ka dib markii uu Sabtidii ka degay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Miami ee Gobolka Florida. Afhayeen u hadlay DHS ayaa sheegay in tallaabada lagu horjoogsaday ay ka dhalatay go’aan ah inaanan la aqbali karin inuu gudaha u galo dalka, sababo ku aaddan hubinta welwelka, oo macnaheedu yahay in uu caqabad ku noqon karo amniga Mareykanka. Cumar Cartan ayaa ka mid ah 52-ka Garsoore ee FIFA, waxaana lagu waday inuu ka qaybgalo Ciyaaraha Koobka Adduunka, iyadoo Cartan uu sanadkii 2025 noqday garsooraha ugu wanaagsan ee Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Afrika ee CAF. Cartan ayaa haystay fiisaha dal ku galka Mareykanka, ka hor inta aanu u dhoofin Miami, waxaana dib loogu celiyay Turkiga oo uu ka soo safray. items.title: Somali soccer referee denied US entry, will miss World Cup debut
items.description: (Reuters) – The United States denied entry over the weekend to soccer referee Omar Abdulkadir Artan, who had been expected to be ​the first Somali to officiate at a World Cup match. A FIFA spokesperson ‌said on Monday that Artan will not be able to train and officiate at the World Cup — which kicks off on Thursday — after he was not allowed to enter the United States. “FIFA is ​not involved in host country immigration processes, including visa adjudications, and has ​been informed by authorities that Mr Artan’s status will not be changed ⁠at present,” the spokesperson said. Artan said in a statement that despite the circumstances ​he was in a positive mood and focused on the next challenges of his refereeing ​career. “I would like to thank FIFA and CAF for all their support and I promise to keep my refereeing levels up as I concentrate on the future,” he said. “I want to thank the ​football family for their messages and wish my colleagues all the best success ​during the World Cup and I look forward to joining them again in future competitions.” The U.S. Customs ‌and ⁠Border Protection, without naming him, said in a statement that a Somali national arrived at Miami International Airport from Istanbul on Saturday and was deemed inadmissible due to vetting concerns. The agency did not elaborate on those concerns, but said the referee underwent routine ​additional inspection before ​being denied entry. “Admissibility determinations ⁠are made on a case-by-case basis using law enforcement, national security, and immigration information available at the time of inspection,” the ​CBP said. The Trump administration’s strict immigration policies have been a point ​of concern ahead ⁠of the World Cup. Last year, Washington imposed a sweeping travel ban on citizens of 12 countries, including Somalia. Artan, who was named the Confederation of African Football’s Best Male ⁠Referee for ​2025, had a valid visa, according to media ​reports. Somalia’s embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Source: Reuters The post Somali soccer referee denied US entry, will miss World Cup debut appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Somali Referee Omar Artan Barred From World Cup After US Denies Entry
items.description: By The Daily Somalia | June 9, 2026 Somali referee Omar Abdulkadir Artan has been officially excluded from the 2026 FIFA World Cup after the United States denied him entry, FIFA confirmed Monday, a decision that has drawn swift and widespread condemnation from across the football world. Artan arrived at Miami International Airport on Saturday from Istanbul, holding a valid visa and a diplomatic passport facilitated by the Somali embassy in Nairobi. Despite his FIFA appointment and diplomatic travel documents, US Customs and Border Protection determined he was inadmissible on what it described as “vetting concerns,” without elaborating further. FIFA’s spokesperson confirmed the ruling to AFP, adding that the organisation has no authority over the immigration laws of host nations, a statement that critics say exposes a fundamental failure in the tournament’s hosting arrangement. The World Cup, co-hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico, kicks off on June 11. Artan was not an ordinary traveller. He was one of seven African referees selected by FIFA to officiate at the tournament and the first Somali ever appointed to a World Cup. In 2025, he was named the best referee in Africa at the CAF Awards in Rabat, a recognition that placed him among the continent’s most distinguished football officials. He had previously made history in January 2024 as the first Somali to officiate at the Africa Cup of Nations. Somalia is among multiple African and Muslim majority nations subject to travel restrictions introduced by President Donald Trump’s administration, restrictions that have drawn repeated criticism from human rights groups and international bodies. The case of Artan has brought those restrictions into sharp global focus, with a decorated professional barred not for any wrongdoing but by virtue of his nationality. Ciise Aden Abshir, a senior advisor to Somalia’s Ministry of Youth and Sports, told AFP that Artan held a valid visa and called on the global football community to stand with him. The Federal Government of Somalia has faced separate criticism for not doing enough to secure Artan’s entry in advance, despite being aware of the travel ban complications. For Somalia, a country navigating a deep political and security crisis at home, the exclusion of its most celebrated referee from the world’s biggest sporting stage is a moment of compounded loss. Omar Artan earned his place. The system failed him. The post Somali Referee Omar Artan Barred From World Cup After US Denies Entry appeared first on Daily Somalia .

items.title: US confirms it denied entry to Somali referee set to take part in World Cup
items.description: The United States has denied entry to a top Somali referee who was set to participate in the FIFA World Cup, raising concerns about Washington’s travel restrictions and their impact on the tournament . The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) confirmed to Al Jazeera on Monday that Omar Artan was not allowed into the country after arriving in South Florida on Saturday. Artan, who is listed as one of FIFA’s 52 World Cup referees, was “determined to be inadmissible due to vetting concerns and was denied entry”, a DHS spokesperson said in an email, without providing further details. Artan’s arrival in the US, however, suggests that he had a valid visa prior to travel. Somalia is on President Donald Trump’s travel ban list. The president has often disparaged the African country and its people. Late last year, he sparked outrage when he called Somali immigrants in the US “garbage”. Artan, one of Africa’s top referees, was set to become the first Somali to officiate a World Cup match. The denial of entry is the latest controversy surrounding US travel policies and the World Cup , which is being cohosted by Mexico and Canada. Iran’s national team has to stay in Mexico due to visa issues. The players will be allowed to arrive in the US to play their game, but they must then return to their base south of the border. Still, some of the team’s staff members were denied US visas altogether. There is also growing concern about federal agents harassing foreign nationals or targeting undocumented immigrants in or around stadiums. His city is set to host fans for several matches, including the final, which will take place in nearby New Jersey. “Soccer would not exist without immigrants. Immigrants play and coach the game, work in the stadiums, fill the stands, and make celebrations like the World Cup possible. Six of the players on the US Men’s National Team are immigrants,” Mamdani wrote in a social media post. “We will not allow ICE or anyone else to sow fear in our communities — especially at this moment. As the world comes to our city, we will stand proudly with our immigrant neighbors and reject these attacks for what they are: an attempt to divide us.” On Monday, the Council on American-Islamic Relations (CAIR) decried the travel bans after Artan was denied entry. “Our nation should not ban anyone from our shores simply because of their race or their ethnicity. That’s especially true of a coach or referee or anyone else coming to participate in the World Cup,” Edward Ahmed Mitchell, CAIR’s deputy director, told Al Jazeera. “Somali visitors go through the same vetting process that other visitors go through, and once someone has gone through that thorough vetting process, there is no reason to ban them from our country simply because of their nationality. Doing so is an affront to our values and the law.” FIFA, which awarded Trump its inaugural peace prize last year, did not immediately respond to Al Jazeera’s request for comment. DHS has suggested that participation in the World Cup – including by athletes, coaches, and staff – does not affect inspection and decisions by Customs and Border Protection (CBP) at airports and border crossings. “Admissibility determinations are made on a case-by-case basis using law enforcement, national security, and immigration information available at the time of inspection,” a DHS spokesperson said. “CBP officers have the authority to question travelers, conduct inspections, and determine admissibility consistent with US law.” Earlier this year, in an interview with Al Jazeera in Mogadishu, Artan said it was an “honour” to appear on football’s brightest stage despite the hardships and civil strife in Somalia. The referee added that, at times, he has had to change his route to his local stadium because of explosions in the country. “You cannot give up as a referee. You have to have a target. I had this target, but it was not an easy job,” he said. “You have to continue, and you have to fight if you want to go to a place like the World Cup.” Al Jazeera.
