items.title: Maxaa Lagu Haystaa Cumar Cartan?
items.description: MUQDISHO, GOOBJOOG NEWS – Garsooraha Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliyeed, Cumar Cabdulqaadir Cartan, ayaa wajahaya caqabad weyn oo dhanka safarka ah, kadib markii loo diiday inuu galo dalka Maraykanka, halkaas oo uu u tagi lahaa ka qeyvgalka dhexdhexaadinta ciyaaraha Koobka Adduunka ee FIFA 2026. Cartan oo dhowaan loo doortay Garsooraha Sannadka 2025 ee Qaaradda Afrika, ayaa laga celiyay Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Miami, iyadoo dib loogu celiyay magaalada Istanbul ee dalka Turkiga. Dhacdadan ayaa dhalisay falcelin xooggan iyo hadalhayn weyn oo warbaahinta isboortiga ee caalamka ku dhex martay baraha bulshada, gaar ahaan aaladda X oo hore loogu yaqaanay Twitter. Sida ay xaqiijiyeen dhawr ilood oo caalami ah oo ay ka mid tahay warbaahinta BBC Sport , Cartan ayaa watay dalkugal sharci ah iyo baasaboor diblomaasi ah oo ay u fududaysay dawladda Soomaaliya. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa saameeyay xeerarka adag ee dawladda Maraykanka ay ku baarto muwaadiniinta u dhashay dalka Soomaaliya, taas oo keentay in loo diido oggolaanshaha gudaha dalka. Tallaabadan ayaa timid xilli ay garsoorayaashii kale ee reer Afrika ee la xushay ay durbaba gaareen dalka Maraykanka, halkaas oo uu uga furmay tababarkii ugu danbeeyay ee loogu diyaargaroobayay Koobka Adduunka. Haddii aan xal degdeg ah loo helin arrintan, Cartan ayaa seegi doona fursad taariikhi ah oo uu ku qaban lahaa kulamo muhiim ah, maadaama inta badan ciyaaraha tartanka, ku dhowaad 78 kulan, ay ka dhacayaan gudaha Maraykanka. Falanqaynta Wargaysyada Wargayska caanka ah ee The Guardian iyo Wakaaladda Wararka ee Anadolu Agency ayaa qoray in kiiskani uu weydiin weyn dul dhigayo sinnaanta ciyaaraha adduunka. Doodda ugu weyn ee la lafagurayo ayaa ah in siyaasadda xuduudaha iyo dhalashada qofka ay caqabad ku noqon karaan guulaha iyo hibooyinka ciyaaraha ee uu qofku ku soo tabcay. Wargeysyada ayaa xusay in Cartan uu yahay garsooraha kaliya ee metelayay bariga iyo bartamaha Afrika, maqnaanshihiisana ay dhabarjab ku tahay matalaadda qaaradda ee tartanka ugu weyn kubbadda cagta adduunka. Maxaa Xal ah oo la Filan Karaa? Ilawareedyo xog-ogaal ah waxay sheegayaan in ururka kubadda cagta adduunka ee FIFA uu hadda bilaabay dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo degdeg ah. Waxaa la raadinayaa in Cartan la siiyo oggolaansho gaar ah oo uu dalka ku gali karo ka hor inta aysan ciyaaruhu si rasmi ah u billaban. Haddii dadaalkaas Maraykanka lagu guuldarraysto, FIFA ayaa laga yaabaa inay u weeciso Cartan inuu garsoore ka noqdo kulamada ka dhacaya waddamada deriska ah ee Kanada ama Mexico, kuwaas oo qeyb ka ah qabashada Koobka Adduunka, shuruudahooda dalkugalkana ay ka debecsan yihiin kuwa Maraykanka. Dhacdadan waxay, mar kale, hoosta ka xarriiqday caqabadaha adag ee hortaagan dhallinyarada hiboolayaasha ah ee Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo raba inay fagaarayaasha caalamiga ah geeyaan magacooda iyo magaca dalkooda.

Haddii dadaalkaas Maraykanka lagu guuldarraysto, FIFA ayaa laga yaabaa inay u weeciso Cartan inuu garsoore ka noqdo kulamada ka dhacaya waddamada deriska ah ee Kanada ama Mexico, kuwaas oo qeyb ka ah qabashada Koobka Adduunka, shuruudahooda dalkugalkana ay ka debecsan yihiin kuwa Maraykanka. Dhacdadan waxay, mar kale, hoosta ka xarriiqday caqabadaha adag ee hortaagan dhallinyarada hiboolayaasha ah ee Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo raba inay fagaarayaasha caalamiga ah geeyaan magacooda iyo magaca dalkooda.

items.title: Cabdullaahi Nuur oo go’aan yaab leh ka qaatay inuu sii shaqeeyo hoteelka Elite
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirkii hore ee amniga Soomaaliya, Cabdullaahi Maxamed Nuur oo ah mulkiilaha hoteelka Elite oo caawa shir jaraa’id ku qabtay magaalada Muqdisho ayaa sheegay in uusan furayn hoteelkiisa illaa xukunka ka banneynayo hoggaanka Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Cabdullaahi Nuur ayaa sheegay in uu qaatay go’aanka inuu sii xirnaado hoteelkiisa, isagoo sabab uga dhigay in ciidanka dowladda ay si sharci darro ah u beegsadeen ganacsigiisa, keliya inuu ka aragti duwan yahay hoggaanka xukunka jooga. “Waan ka xumahay, laakiin waan ku qasbanahay, waxaan qaatay go’aan ah inuu sii xirnaado, wuuna xirnaan doonaa. Sababaha uu u xirnaanayo waxaa kamid ah weligay kama dareemin goobtayda ganacsiga dhanka hay’adaha amniga iyo dowladda amni darro, marna ma fileyn dowladdii ayaa inta kusoo duusho goobtan ganacsiga ayaa dumin doonta,” ayuu yiri Cabdullaahi Maxamed Nuur. Waxa uu intaas kusii daray: “Waxay kamid aheyd goobaha ay dhalinyarada Soomaaliyeed jecel yihiin inay tagaan. Dhalinyaro 150 ka badan ayaa ka shaqeynaysay oo mushaar ka qaadaneysay. Nasiib darro, dowladdii la rabay inay ganacsiga amnigiisa ilaaliyaan ayaa kusoo duushay, burburisay oo hantidii taallayna qaadatay.” Wasiirkii hore ee amniga ayaa ku dooday in qof ganacsade ah oo Muqdisho degan uusan dowladda ka difaaci karin goob ganacsi, sidaas darteedna uusan diyaar u ahayn in uu sida cadowga ula dagaallamo dowladda si uu u ilaaliyo ganacsigiisa. “Maadaama aan hubin in ganacsigayga ka amaan helayo dowladda, aniguna aan hadda diyaar u ahayn in dowladda sidii cadowga kale uga ilaalinayay ganacsiga uga ilaaliyo, waxaa ii fududaatay in Elite uu xirnaado, wuuna sii xirnaan doona illaa marxaladda dalka ka jirta isbedelayso, ama nidaamka dalka ka jirana isbeddelayo,” ayuu yiri. Go’aankan mulkiilaha hoteelka Elite ayaa imanaya kadib markii booliska uu galabta hoteelka kusoo bandhigay hub fara badan oo isugu jira kuwa fudud iyo kuwa culus, ayna ka mid yihiin hub casri ah iyo agab kale oo ay ku jiraan diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn (drones). Ciidanka booliska ayaa maalmihii dambe magaalada Muqdisho iyo nawaaxigeeda ka waday howl-gallo hub ka dhigis ah oo lagu beegsanayo mucaaradka, kuwaas oo dhawaan dagaal culus la galay ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliya. Si kastaba, xiisadda siyaasadeed ee dalka ayaa kasii dareysa, iyadoo gaartay heer dowladda iyo mucaaradka ku dagaalamaan gudaha caasimadda, waxaana si dhow isha loogu hayaa waan-waan iyo dhex-dhexaadin ay beesha caalamka ka dhex wado dhinacyada. items.description: Mogadishu (AFP) – Award-winning Somali referee Omar Artan, set to be the first from his country to officiate at the World Cup finals, was denied entry to the United States, a sports ministry official told AFP on Monday.

items.title: Cumar Cartan oo laga soo celiyay Mareykanka xilli uu ku safrayay baasaboorka Soomaaliya
items.description: Ankara (Caasimada Online) – Garsoore Cumar Cartan ayaa loo diiday inuu galo dalka Mareykanka, halkaas oo uu uga qayb-galayay dhex-dhexaadinta ciyaaraha koobka adduunka (World Cup). Cumar Cartan ayaa la sheegay in laga soo celiyay magaalada Miami ee gobolka Florida, kadib markii lagu wargeliyay in uusan geli karin dalka Mareykanka, sida ay sheegayaan wararka la helayo. Intaa kadib, waxaa Garsooraha dib loogu celiyay magaalada Ankara ee caasimadda dalka Turkiga. Garsoorahan ayaa watay baasaboor Soomaali ah oo nooca diblomaasiga ah, waxaana magaalada Nairobi ee dalka Kenya si rasmi ah uga sagootiyay Safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Kenya ka hor safarkiisa. Cumar Cartan ayaa sameyn lahaa taariikh cusub haddii uu si rasmi ah uga mid noqdo garsoorayaasha ka howl-galaya Koobka Adduunka. Arrintan ayaa sidoo kale loo arkayay mid astaan u noqon karta horumarka garsoorka Soomaaliyeed ee ka qayb-galka tartamada heerka caalami, hase yeeshe waxaa muuqata inay soo afmeertay qawaaniinta adag ee safarka ee dowladda Mareykanka. Dhacdadan ayaa tusaale cad u ah qiimaha iyo halka qofka Soomaaliga ah ee sita baasaboorka Soomaaliya ah uu ka joogo caalamka iyo sida loogu arko in uu yahay qof qiimo, dawlad iyo damaanad midna aan lahayn. Si kastaba, arrintan ayaa si weyn looga fal-celiyay baraha bulshada, iyadoo dad badan ay ka muujiyeen walaac iyo niyad-jab. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaan weli si rasmi ah uga hadlin arrinta qabsatay Garsoore Cartan, oo horey uu u maamuusay Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda. items.title: Hay’adaha Dawladda oo la faray Isticmaalka Astaanta iyo Midabada Rasmiga ah ee Calanka Qaranka
items.description: Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Dib-u-eegista iyo Hirgelinta Dastuurka (ICRIC) ayaa faray dhammaan hay’adaha dowladda inay adeegsadaan astaanta iyo midabada rasmiga ah ee Qaranka Soomaaliya, si loo mideeyo loona waafajiyo isticmaalka astaamaha qaranka ee xafiisyada dowladda iyo hay’adaha guud. Qoraal ay guddigu soo saareen ayaa lagu sheegay in go’aankan uu salka ku hayo qodobbada Dastuurka Ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Soomaaliya, kadib markii la arkay kala duwanaansho ku yimid isticmaalka astaamaha qaranka ee hay’ado kala duwan. Guddigu wuxuu faray hay’adaha dowladda federaalka, dowlad-goboleedyada, wakaaladaha dowladda iyo dhammaan muwaadiniinta inay adeegsadaan midabada iyo tilmaamaha rasmiga ah ee ku qeexan dastuurka marka la soo bandhigayo calanka iyo astaanta qaranka. Sida lagu sheegay bayaanka, midabka buluugga ah ee calanka Soomaaliya waa inuu waafaqsanaadaa heerarka dastuuriga ah, halka astaanta qarankana lagu soo bandhigayo naqshadda iyo midabada si rasmi ah loo ansixiyay. ICRIC ayaa sidoo kale ugu baaqday hay’adaha isticmaalaya noocyo aan rasmi ahayn oo astaamaha qaranka ah inay sameeyaan sixitaannada lagama maarmaanka ah si ay ugu hoggaansamaan shuruudaha dastuurka. Amarkan cusub ayaa khuseeya dhammaan xafiisyada dowladda federaalka, hay’adaha dowlad-goboleedyada iyo guud ahaan hay’adaha dadweynaha, kuwaas oo lagu boorriyay inay cusboonaysiiyaan dukumiintiyada rasmiga ah, boorarka iyo aqoonsiyada hay’adahooda marka loo baahdo. Astaamaha qaranka ayaa door muhiim ah ka ciyaara dadaallada dib-u-dhiska dowladnimada Soomaaliya, iyagoo xoojinaya midnimada, wadajirka shacabka iyo aqoonsiga qaran ee dalka. Calanka Soomaaliya oo markii ugu horreysay la ansixiyay sanadkii 1954-kii, ka hor xornimada dalka, ayaa muddo dheer astaan u ahaa midnimada Soomaaliyeed, halka astaanta qarankuna ay tahay astaan muhiim ah oo lagu garto hay’adaha dowladda iyo dukumiintiyada rasmiga ah.

items.title: Garsooraha Soomaaliyeed Omar Artan oo loo diiday gelitaanka Mareykanka
items.description: Garsooraha caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliyeed, Omar Abdulkadir Artan, ayaa la sheegay in loo diiday inuu galo Mareykanka kadib markii uu gaaray garoonka diyaaradaha ee Miami si uu uga qeyb galo tartanka Koobka Adduunka ee 2026. Inkastoo uu watay fiiso sax ah, waxaa dib loogu celiyay dalka Turkiga, iyadoo aan weli si rasmi ah loo shaacin sababta loo celiyay. Omar Artan ayaa ah garsoorihii ugu horreeyay ee Soomaali ah ee loo xusho inuu ka garsooro Koobka Adduunka, waxaana loo aqoonsaday mid ka mid ah garsoorayaasha ugu wanaagsan Afrika. Wuxuu tan iyo 2018 ka tirsanaa liiska garsoorayaasha FIFA, isagoo ka soo shaqeeyay tartamo waaweyn oo ay ku jiraan Koobka Qaramada Afrika (AFCON). Mas’uuliyiin Soomaaliyeed ayaa cambaareeyay dhacdadan, iyagoo sheegay inay dhaawacayso qiyamka caddaaladda iyo sinnaanta ee kubadda cagta. Dhanka kale, FIFA ayaa la filayaa inay arrintan wax ka ogaato, iyadoo warar kala duwan ay sheegayaan in baaritaan lagu hayo sababta keentay in garsooraha loo diido gelitaanka dalka. Dhacdadan ayaa timid xilli ay jireen walaacyo hore oo ku saabsan caqabadaha socdaalka ee saameyn kara qaar ka mid ah ka qeybgalayaasha Koobka Adduunka 2026.

items.title: Travel Ban, Hotel Raid, and Armed Clashes: The Escalating Confrontation Between Villa Somalia and a Former Insider
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) – Somalia’s escalating political tensions appear to have entered a new and potentially dangerous phase after reports emerged that former presidential adviser and prominent businessman Abdullahi Mohamed Nur has been barred from leaving the country amid a widening dispute with the federal government. Sources close to officials at Aden Adde International Airport told WardheerNews that authorities issued an order preventing Abdullahi Mohamed Nur from boarding international flights and restricting him from traveling abroad until further notice. The government has yet to publicly confirm the reported travel ban or provide any legal justification for the measure. The move comes only weeks after Abdullahi Mohamed Nur resigned from his position as an adviser to President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, a departure that fueled speculation of a serious political falling-out between the two men. While neither side has publicly disclosed the reasons behind the split, recent developments suggest that tensions have rapidly intensified. Government security agencies have reportedly accused Abdullahi Mohamed Nur of aligning himself with opposition groups and participating in activities they consider a threat to national security. However, no formal charges have been announced, and no evidence supporting the allegations has been publicly presented. Adding to the controversy are reports that Abdullahi Mohamed Nur’s passport has also been suspended, effectively restricting his freedom of movement and raising questions about whether the actions are based on legal proceedings or political considerations. The latest measures follow a security operation carried out at the Elite Hotel, a prominent beachfront property in Mogadishu owned by Abdullahi. Police forces reportedly entered the hotel and conducted searches while disarming members of its security detail. Authorities have yet to provide a detailed explanation regarding the purpose of the operation or any findings that may have resulted from it. The raid has fueled criticism from government opponents, who argue that state institutions are increasingly being deployed against political rivals rather than focusing exclusively on security threats facing the country. Meanwhile, reports from the Middle Shabelle region indicate that armed clashes may have occurred near the coastal town of Warsheikh. Local sources claim that forces allegedly loyal to Abdullahi Mohamed Nur became involved in a confrontation with government troops after withdrawing from the Gubadley area amid reports that authorities intended to seize their weapons. The circumstances surrounding the reported clash remain unclear. No independent verification has emerged regarding casualties, and the federal government has not issued an official statement addressing the incident. Taken together, the reported travel restrictions, passport suspension, security operations against a business linked to a former government insider, and allegations of military confrontations paint a picture of a political dispute rapidly evolving into a broader confrontation. Political observers warn that the use of security measures against former allies risks deepening Somalia’s already fragile political divisions. They argue that when political disagreements begin to overlap with security operations, public confidence in state institutions can erode, particularly if legal procedures and transparency are perceived to be lacking. The developments come at a time when Somalia is facing mounting political disputes over elections, governance, and the future direction of the federal system. As tensions continue to rise, questions are growing over whether the government’s actions represent legitimate security measures or the latest chapter in an increasingly bitter political power struggle. For now, Abdullahi’s case has become a symbol of the broader uncertainty gripping Somalia’s political landscape—where former allies are turning into adversaries, and where the line between national security and political conflict is becoming increasingly blurred. items.title: Competing Narratives Emerge Over Weapons Cache Displayed in Mogadishu
items.description: Mogadishu(WDN) – Fresh controversy has erupted over the Somali government’s security operations in Mogadishu, with opposition supporters accusing authorities of using weapons displays as part of a broader political campaign aimed at discrediting government critics. Security forces have continued operations that officials describe as efforts to collect illegal weapons following recent clashes in the Banadir districts of Abdiaziz and Heliwaa/Howlwadaag. The confrontations came after opposition-linked groups resisted what they described as attempts by government-aligned forces to target their areas. Speaking to reporters from Elite Hotel, Banadir Regional Police Commander Mahdi Omar Mumin announced the seizure of a significant cache of weapons, including heavy arms and long-range weaponry allegedly recovered during security operations and stored at the hotel. Government officials have presented the weapons as evidence of illegal armed activity. However, opposition figures and their supporters dispute that narrative, arguing that the display is part of a political propaganda effort designed to portray opposition groups as security threats. The government claim that the weapons being showcased were not linked to anti-government actors but were instead military-grade arms intended for security operations against terrorist groups. According to these allegations, the public presentation of the weapons is aimed at tarnishing the image of opposition figures who have challenged the government’s policies. The dispute highlights the growing information war accompanying Somalia’s deepening political tensions, with both sides seeking to shape public perception of recent events. Commander Mahdi rejected allegations of misconduct during the operation, insisting that security forces carried out their duties professionally. He stated that no damage occurred at the hotel and that neither staff nor security personnel were harmed during the operation. “Our forces simply carried out their responsibilities,” he said, dismissing claims of abuses or irregularities. The latest weapons display has also revived memories of previous incidents in which authorities publicly exhibited arms allegedly seized from opposition-linked groups following clashes in Mogadishu’s Abdiaziz and Howlwadaag districts. Those earlier claims were similarly challenged by opposition figures, who accused the government of exploiting security operations for political purposes. As competing narratives continue to emerge, the controversy underscores the widening trust deficit between the government and its opponents. With tensions remaining high, questions surrounding the origin of the seized weapons and the political motivations behind their public display are likely to remain at the center of Somalia’s increasingly polarized political debate. items.title: Police Display Heavy Weapons Allegedly Recovered from Elite Hotel in Mogadishu
items.description: MOGADISHU — Somalia’s Federal Government on Monday publicly displayed a large cache of weapons and ammunition allegedly recovered from the Elite Hotel in Mogadishu, a property said to be owned by former Minister of Internal Security Abdullahi Mohamed Nur. The weapons were presented by the Somali Police Force following a security operation conducted over the past 24 hours in the capital. Authorities stated that the arms were discovered inside a room within the hotel during the operation. Addressing journalists at the hotel premises, Banadir Regional Police Commissioner Moalim Mahdi said the recovered arsenal included both heavy and light weapons, as well as substantial quantities of ammunition. He rejected allegations that security forces had unlawfully forced entry into the room where the weapons were found, insisting that the operation was carried out in accordance with security procedures. “The weapons were recovered from a room inside the hotel, and claims that the room was broken into are unfounded,” the commissioner told reporters. Moalim Mahdi described the alleged storage of weapons inside a commercial hotel as a serious threat to public security and national stability, noting that such facilities are intended to serve civilians and visitors. “It is unacceptable for a hotel located in a densely populated area and intended for public accommodation to be used for storing weapons,” he said. “Such actions directly undermine the security and stability of the capital.” The police commissioner also issued a warning to political actors and individuals accused of keeping unauthorized weapons, stressing that security agencies would respond firmly to any attempts to destabilize the country. “If one weapon is brought forward, we are prepared to seize ten,” he said. “It is unfortunate that a facility built through investment and intended to serve the public is allegedly being used to store weapons aimed at threatening Somalia’s statehood.” The federal government has not yet announced whether arrests have been made in connection with the operation. The incident comes amid heightened political tensions and ongoing security operations in Mogadishu, where authorities have intensified efforts to curb illegal arms possession and reinforce public security. items.title: Milkiilaha hotel Elite oo ku dhawaaqay go’aan ka dhan ah dowladda…
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxamreeb Online) Wasiirkii hore ee amniga Soomaaliya Cabdullaahi Maxamed Nuur, oo ah milkiilaha Elite Hotel, ayaa ka hadlay hubka ay galabta laamaha amniga ku soo bandhigeen hotelkiisa, waxa uuna sharaxaad ka bixiyay in habka ay dowladda ula shaqan tahay in ay tahay mid aad loogu xumaado, laguna sumcad dilayo goobtiisa ganacsi. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in hotel-kiisu sii xirnaan doono, isagoo xusay in uusan haatan jirin jawi uu ku sii wadi karo shaqada ganacsiga. Waxa uu ku eedeeyay dowladda Federaalka in hub aan shaqo ku lahayn hotelka lagu soo bandhigay gudaha xarunta si loo dhaawaco sumcadda goobta. Cabdullaahi ayaa sheegay inuu aad uga xun yahay go’aankan, maadaama uu si toos ah u saameynayo in ka badan 150 shaqaale ah oo ka shaqeynayay hotelka, kuwaas oo isugu jiray xirfadlayaal iyo dad badan oo qoysaskoodu ku tiirsanaayeen dakhliga ay halkaasi ka helaan, kuna jireen Ajaaniib. Sidoo kale Cabdullaahi, ayaa sheegay in wax laga xumaado in ay tahay hay’adihii amniga ee la rabay in ay ilaaliyaan amniga iyo sumcada ganacsiga in ay kusoo duleen ganacsiga ayna burburiyaan, waxa uuna xusay in qof dagan magaalada in dowladda uusan ka difaaci karin haddii ganacsiga lasoo weeraro. Sikastaba, Elite Hotel ayaa ka mid ahaa hoteellada ugu caansan uguna mashquulka badan xeebta Liido ee magaalada Muqdisho, waxaana habeen walba ku caweeyn jiray dhallinyaro Soomaaliyeed. items.title: Wasiir Fiqi oo ku jees-jeesay mucaaradka kadib dhacdadii maanta
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa ka hadlay hubkii uu booliska sheegay in laga soo saaray hoteelka Elite, inkastoo uu arrintaas beeniyay mulkiilaha hoteelka, wasiirkii hore ee amniga, Cabdullaahi Maxamed Nuur. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa dhacdadan ku tilmaamay mid marqaati cad u ah dhagar uu sheegay inay maleegayeen mucaaradka iyo mashruuc ay kasoo qaateen shisheeye, kaas oo uu sheegay in lala damacsanaa dalka, gaar ahaan caasimadda, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Waa nasiib-darro weyn in dad mas’uuliyiin sheeganaya oo dalkan xilal muhiim ah ka soo qabtay ay isku dayaan dhagar intaa le’eg oo loo maleegayo dalkooda in ay qeyb ka noqdaan, waxaase Alle looga mahdinayaa in dawladdu ka hortagtay shirqoolkaas,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Fiqi. Sidoo kale, wuxuu sheegay in cid kasta oo haweysanaysa in ay qandaraas ku soo qaadato dhiig daadinta dadkeeda iyo dibin-daabyaynta dowladnimada ay u dambaynayso in ay ku hor fadeexowdo umadda iyo sharciga hortiisa, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Hadalka Wasiir Fiqi oo u muuqday mid ugu jees-jeesayo mucaaradka ayaa imanaya saacado kadib markii booliska ay sheegeen in hoteelka Elite gudihiisa lagu qabtay hub fara badan oo isugu jira kuwa fudud iyo kuwa culus, ayna ka mid yihiin hub casri ah iyo agab kale oo ay ku jiraan diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn (drones). Sidoo kale, maalmihii dambe ciidanka booliska ayaa magaalada Muqdisho iyo nawaaxigeeda ka waday howl-gallo hub ka dhigis ah oo lagu beegsanayo mucaaradka, kuwaas oo dhawaan dagaal culus la galay ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliya. Si kastaba, hubka uu soo bandhigay booliska waxaa beeniyay Wasiirkii hore ee Amniga Soomaaliya, Cabdullaahi Maxamed Nuur oo ah mulkiilaha hoteelka Elite, kaas oo sheegay in ciidamada dowladda ay xoog uga haystaan hoteelkiisa. Cabdullaahi Nuur ayaa sidoo kale ku tilmaamay been abuur in hoteelka gudihiisa lagu qabtay hubka uu soo bandhigay booliska, wuxuuna sheegay in hub culus lagu daabulay gudaha hoteelka si looga been abuurto, loona sumcad-dilo ganacsigiisa, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. items.title: Somalia police say weapons cache found in Mogadishu’s Elite Hotel
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Mogadishu Police Commander Mahdi Omar Mumin said Monday that Somalia’s security forces recovered illegal weapons from Mogadishu’s seaside luxury Elite Hotel, owned by former Security Minister and senior opposition figure Abdullahi Mohamed Nur, during an operation targeting unauthorized arms in the capital. Speaking at a press conference, Mumin said the weapons were discovered inside what authorities described as a secured room within the hotel. According to police, the cache included drones, sniper equipment, PKM machine guns, and AK-style rifles. Mumin said officers initially believed the room would be difficult to access but were later able to enter after hotel management provided the key. He added that traditional elders were present when the weapons were removed from the premises. The police commander said commercial establishments, including hotels, must not be used to store illegal weapons. The development comes after Somali police and army forces launched a large-scale security operation in Mogadishu’s Abdiasis district, an area traditionally regarded as an opposition stronghold. The district was the scene of clashes last week between federal forces and fighters loyal to former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed. The fighting lasted two days before ending amid pressure from international partners. On Saturday, Nur said security forces had raided his hotel while carrying heavy weapons and explosives. He alleged that the forces intended to place the weapons inside the property and later present them to the media as evidence of illegal arms storage in order to justify looting the hotel. Government forces have since maintained control of the hotel, which has remained closed to the public for a third consecutive day. Speaking at a press conference Monday evening, Nur rejected the police allegations and said the weapons displayed to the media were never inside the hotel. He described the operation as a fabricated attempt to damage both his reputation and his business. Nur said he recognized only two drones shown in images released by authorities and maintained that both belonged to him legally. He said the drones were commercial civilian unmanned aerial vehicles for which he had received government authorization and that they had previously been used to assist security forces with surveillance operations in the Middle Shabelle region during campaigns against Al-Shabaab. Asked why his hotel had been singled out, Nur said the action was politically motivated because of his kinship with opposition leader Sharif Sheikh Ahmed. He alleged that elements within the government were seeking to create instability by targeting him. The controversy comes only days after militias loyal to Nur were involved in a confrontation with Somali army forces on the road connecting Mogadishu and the Middle Shabelle region. The fighters, traveling in eight technical vehicles, had left Mogadishu after receiving information that security forces were preparing an operation to disarm them. During their movement, they were ambushed by government forces, triggering a brief exchange of fire before they continued to an area controlled by militias from Nur’s clan in Middle Shabelle. Although fighting between government and opposition-aligned forces subsided last week and international partners are working to bring Somali leaders together to address the political standoff, tensions remain high, underscoring the fragility of the country’s political and security environment. items.title: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga iyo Safiirka Shiinaha oo Ka Wada Hadlay Xoojinta Iskaashiga Difaaca
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa kulan muhiim ah la yeeshay Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Dadka Shiinaha u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Danjire Wang Yu. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iskaashi ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha, iyadoo si gaar ah looga wada hadlay iskaashiga dhinacyada difaaca, tababarrada ciidamada, iyo taageerada lagu horumarinayo hay’adaha amniga Qaranka Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay ilaalinta midnimada dhuleed, madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka labada dal. Wasiir Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa Dowladda Shiinaha uga mahadceliyey taageerada joogtada ah ee ay siiso Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, horumarinta iyo dib-u-dhiska hay’adaha dowladda. Dhankiisa, Danjire Wang Yu ayaa muujiyey sida ay dowladda Shiinaha uga go’an tahay sii wadidda taageerada iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay Soomaaliya. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada ay dowladda Soomaaliya ku xoojinayso xiriirrada caalamiga ah iyo iskaashiga istaraatiijiga ah ee lagu taageerayo amniga, xasilloonida iyo horumarka dalka.

items.title: Kiisaska cudur faafaya oo kusoo badanaya magaalada Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa maalmihii lasoo dhaafay laga dareemayay koror ku yimid kiisaska dadka la ildaran xanuun sababa shuban iyo fuuqbax, kuwaas oo isugu jira da’ kala duwan, sida ay xaqiijiyeen ilo caafimaad oo la hadlay warbaahinta. Ilo-wareedyada ayaa sheegay in qaar ka mid ah dadka uu haleelay xanuunkan loo qaaday xarumaha caafimaadka iyo isbitaallada ku yaalla caasimadda, kadib markii ay soo wajahday xaalad caafimaad oo u baahatay daryeel degdeg ah. Dhaqaatiirta ka howlgasha isbitaallada Muqdisho ayaa baaritaanno ku sameeyay bukaannada la geeyay xarumaha caafimaadka, xilli ay sii kordhayaan kiisaska la xiriira xanuunkan oo si gaar ah looga dareemayo xaafado kala duwan oo magaalada ka tirsan. Dr. Sahra Isaaq oo ku takhasustay cudurrada carruurta ayaa baraha bulshada ku baahisay muuqaal ay ku sharxeyso tallaabooyinka degdegga ah ee la qaadi karo marka la arko qof la ildaran xaaladdan, ka hor inta aan loo gudbin goob caafimaad. Sida ay sheegayaan shaqaalaha caafimaadka, carruurta ayaa ka mid ah dadka ugu badan ee uu saameeyay xanuunkan, waxaana xarumaha caafimaadka lagu arkayaa carruur badan oo la siinayo faleembooyin iyo daawooyin looga hortagayo fuuqbaxa. Mid ka mid ah dhaqaatiirta ka howlgasha xarun caafimaad oo ku taalla Muqdisho ayaa sheegay in maalmihii dambe ay qabteen tiro badan oo bukaanno ah, kuwaas oo intooda badan xaaladdoodu soo hagaagtay kadib markii ay heleen daryeel caafimaad iyo daaweyn ku habboon. Ilaa hadda ma jiro war rasmi ah oo kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo ku saabsan kororka kiisaskan ama tallaabooyinka ay qorsheyneyso si looga hortago faafitaanka xanuunka iyo saameynta uu ku yeelan karo bulshada. items.title: What Is the Latest on Turkey’s Mediation Between Somalia’s Government and the Opposition?
items.description: MOGADISHU— Turkey has launched an intensive high-level mediation initiative between Somalia’s Federal Government and opposition leaders in an effort to defuse mounting political tensions linked to the country’s electoral process and broader constitutional disagreements. Senior Turkish officials are currently holding a series of discreet consultations with both sides in Mogadishu, according to multiple sources familiar with the discussions. The talks are reportedly taking place at a secured facility within the Aden Adde International Airport compound, where separate engagements are being conducted with government and opposition representatives. The opposition camp is understood to have delegated three senior political figures to formally represent its position during the negotiations, while top officials from the Federal Government are leading the government’s side of the dialogue. Turkey, a longstanding strategic partner of Somalia, has assumed a direct facilitation role in the ongoing discussions, coordinating communication channels and relaying proposals between the parties as part of efforts aimed at reducing political friction and advancing a negotiated understanding. Sources close to the process said the Deputy Chief of Turkey’s National Intelligence Organization (MIT) has, over recent hours, conducted separate meetings with senior Somali government officials and opposition politicians in what diplomats described as “active shuttle diplomacy” designed to bridge divisions between the rival camps. The mediation effort comes at a politically sensitive moment for Somalia, amid intensifying disagreements over the electoral framework, constitutional amendments, and the future direction of the country’s state-building process. Political analysts and diplomatic observers increasingly view the Turkish-led initiative as the most significant mediation track currently underway in Somalia, with its outcome expected to carry major implications for the country’s political stability and institutional trajectory in the months ahead. While no official agreement has yet emerged from the talks, sources indicated that discussions remain ongoing, with regional and international stakeholders closely monitoring developments as both sides explore possible avenues toward political consensus and de-escalation. items.title: Fasuul Cabdalla: 15 Sannadguuradii ka soo Wareegatay Dilka Wakiilkii Al-Qaacidda ee Bariga Afrika
items.description: Maanta oo kale, 08 Juun, waxay ku beegan tahay, 15 sano ka hor, markii duleedka magaalada Muqdisho lagu dilay argaggaxiye Fasuul Cabdalla Maxamed, oo ahaa wakiilkii iyo maskaxdii istiraatiijiyadeed ee al-Qaacidda ee Bariga Afrika, isla markaasna ahaa farsamayahankii ka danbeeyay weerarradii masiibada ahaa ee safaaradaha Maraykanka ee Nairobi iyo Daarusalaam sannadkii 1998dii. Fasuul, oo ahaa madaxa unugga qaabilsan saadka iyo iskuxirka caalamiga ah ee gobolka, wuxuu muddo labaatan sano ah ku jiray liiska argaggaxisada ugu doonista badan caalamka, iyadoo dawladda Maraykanka ay madaxiisa dul dhigtay lacag abaalmarin ah oo gaaraysa 5 milyan oo doollar. Geeridiisa oo timid sannadkii 2011kii, ka dib markii uu ku dhacay barkontorool oo ay ciidanka dawladda Soomaaliyeed leeyihiin, waxay soo afjartay nolosha nin labaatan sano ka shaqaynayay hawlo argaggaxisnimo. Haddaba, maqaalkan wuxuu si qotadheer u falanqaynayaa sooyaalkii nololeed iyo barbaarintii Fasuul ee dalka Comoros. Sidoo kale, maqaalku wuxuu lafagurayaa habmaamulkii shabakadaha saadka ee uu ka dhisay xuduudaha gobolka, aasaasiddii unugga “ Jaysh Ayman ” , iyo khilaafkii ragaadiyay isaga iyo hoggaanka sare ee al-Shabaab. Ugu danbayntii, maqaalku wuxuu iftiiminayaa xaqiiqada rasmiga ah ee ka danbaysay habeenkii uu u gacangalay ciidanka dawladda. Waa Kuma Argaggaxiye Fasuul? Magaaladii lagu dilay oo ahayd caasimadda Soomaaliya ee Muqdisho, magaalo u jirta 2,643km ayuu ku dhashay, taas oo ahayd caasimadda dalka Comoros ee Moroni. Walow uu adeegsan jiray siddeed magac, waxayse labadiisa waalid ugu wanqaleen Cabdalla Maxamed Fasuul. Inkastoo warbixinnada reer Galbeedka ay sheegaan inuu dhashay bishii December sannadkii 1974, balse buuggiisa xusuus-qorka ee The War Against Islam iyo baaritaannada rasmiga ah ee laga dhex helay kombiyuutarkiisa, waxaa ku xusnayd inuu dhashay August 1972. Comoros waa dal jasiirad ah oo ku dhex yaalla marinka Mozambique ee Badweynta Hindiya, una dhexeeya xeebaha bariga Afrika iyo jasiiradda Madagascar. Jasiiradahan silsiladda ah waxay ka kooban yihiin dhul yar oo ay ku nool yihiin dad aad ugu dhagan diinta Islaamka, iyadoo dhaqankooda asalka ah uu yahay midka faca weyn ee bulshada Sawaaxiliga ee xeebaha ku dhow. Markii uu Fasuul dhashay bilowgii toddobaatanaadkii, jasiiraduhu waxay ku jireen marxalad kacdoon gobannimadoon ah oo ay isaga dul qaadayeen gumaysigii Faransiiska, iyadoo ugu danbayntii ku guulaystay inay xorriyadda qaataan bishii July ee sannadkii 1975. Wixii intaas ka danbeeyay, dalku wuxuu galay xasilloonidarro siyaasadeed oo dabo dheeraatay, saboolnimo baahsan, iyo afgenbiyo isdabajoog ah. Haddaba, go’doonka dhinaca juqraafiga iyo qalalaasaha maamul ee ragaadiyay Comoros, waxay keentay inay ku kacaamaan jiil dhan oo indhaha dibadda u taagayay, si ay u helaan nolol iyo fursado ka fiican midka ay jasiiraddu u fidin karto. Degaankaas ay duruufaha qallafsan hareeyeen ayuu ku dhashay kuna barbaaray waxna ku bartay Fasuul. Haddaba, geeddisocodkiisa nololeed ee yaraannimo iyo waxbarasho waxa uu ku qaatay  dalkiisa hooyo ee Comoros, halkaas oo uu siddeedameeyadii ku qaatay waxbarashadiisii aasaasiga ahayd iyo middii sare ee diinta, kuwaas oo qaabeeyay aragtidii danbe ee uu fagaarayaasha caalamiga ah ugu gudbay. Barbaarintaas dhexdeeda wuxuu sidoo kale ku bartay shan luuqadood oo kala ah: afkiisa hooyo, Faransiiska, Carabiga, Ingiriisiga, iyo Sawaaxiliga. Sannadkii 1990 ayuu u kicitimay dalka Pakistan isagoo helay fursad waxbarasho oo jaamaceed, si uu usoo barto cilmiga kumbiyuutarka. Waxaase durbadiiba qaatay mawjaddii jihaadka caalamiga ahayd ee lagaga dhawaaqay dalkii dariska la ahaa midka uu waxbarashada u joogay oo ahaa Afgaanistaan. Wuxuuna iska xaadariyay xeryaha tababbarka al-Qaacidda ee Afgaanistaan, halkaas oo uu ku hantay xeeladaha isgaarsiinta qarsoon iyo farsamada walxaha qarxa. Aqoontaas farsamo waxay u gogol-xaartay inuu sannadkii 1993 soo galo gobolka Gedo ee Soomaaliya, si uu tababarro u siiyo xoogaggii “Al-Ittihad Al-Islami”, isagoo sannadkii xigayna u wareegay magaalada Nairobi, si uu halkaas uga yagleelo ganacsiyo qarsoodi ah oo gabbaad u noqda saadka iyo maaliyadda kooxda al-Qaacidda. Kaartadii saadka ee uu dhisay waxay saldhig u noqotay weerarradii safaaradaha Maraykanka ee Nairobi iyo Daarusalaam ee dhacay sannadkii 1998, isagoo markii danbana agaasimay weerarradii huteelka Paradise iyo iskudaygii diyaaraddii Israa’iil ee Mombasa sannadkii 2002. Weerarradan ayaa sababay masiibo bini’aadantinimo oo baaxad leh, iyadoo wadarta guud ee khasaarihii nafeed ee ka dhashay ay gaartay dhimashada ku dhowaad 240 qof, halka ay ku dhaawacmeen in ka badan 4,160 qof oo u badnaa dad rayid ah oo aan waxba galabsan. Muddadaas oo dhan wuxuu adeegsanayay magacyo been-abuur ah iyo xeelado uu kaga dhuumanayay sirdoonka caalamiga ah. Ugu danbayntii, caddadiskii amniga ee ku qabsaday Kenya wuxuu ku khasbay inuu sannadkii 2007 gabbaad rasmi ah ka dhigto gudaha Soomaaliya, isagoo ku dhex milmay hoggaanka sare ee kooxda argaggaxisada ah ee al-Shabaab (AS), halkaasna ka aasaasay unugga gaarka ah ee Jaysh Ayman. Maaraynta Hawlgallada Sida lagu falanqeeyay buugga Inside Al-Shabaab ee ay qoreen suxufiyiinta Harun Maruf iyo Dan Joseph, soo galitaankii rasmiga ahaa ee Fasuul ee gudaha Soomaaliya sannadkii 2007, wuxuu isbeddel weyn u horseeday habkii ay u hawlgalayeen garabka milateriga ee kooxda AS. Intii uu ku sugnaa degaannada jasiiradda ku dhow iyo xeryaha qarsoon ee kaymaha Jubbada Hoose, wuxuu asaasay garabka la magacbaxay “Jaysh Ayman”. Sababta ugu weyn ee uu unuggan u aasaasay waxay ahayd inuu abuuro cudud gaar ah oo fulisa istiraatiijiyaddii al-Qaacidda ee ballaarinta jihaadka Bariga Afrika, isagoo ka faa’iidaysanaya nuglaanta xuduudaha si uu weerarrada ugu wareejiyo gudaha dalka Kenya, isla markaasna uu u hantiyo dhalinyarada ku hadasha afka Sawaaxiliga ee laga soo qoray xeebaha gobolka. Sida lagu xusay xogaha xarunta CTC West Point, muddadii uu unuggan dhisayay waxaa soo kala dhex galay isaga iyo hoggaanka sare ee kooxda argaggaxisada ah ee AS, gaar ahaan Axmed Cabdi Godane, ismaandhaaf iyo khilaaf hoose. Tani waxay ka dhalatay rabitaankii Godane ee ahaa inuu unko nidaam maamul oo hal meel laga hoggaamiyo, isagoo diiddanaa in Fasuul uu sameeyo unug si uga madaxbannaan hoggaanka kooxda. Ismaandhaafkii ayaa cirka sii galay marka la isku qabtay dhaqaalaha iyo doorka madaxbannaanida ee dagaalyahannada ajaaniibta ah ee Fasuul asaasay. Dhanka kale, habka uu u maareeyay hawlgallada waxay tusaale u tahay heerka ugu sarreeya ee hirgelinta xeeladaha loo yaqaanno xeeladaha dhawrista iyo qarinta sirta hawlgallada. Sida lagu xusay baaritaannada hay’adaha sirdoonka caalamiga ah, wuxuu ku dhowaad labaatan sano ka badbaadayay daba-galkii iyo ugaarsigii ugu weynaa ee dunida ka dhaca, isagoo adeegsanaya farsamooyinkii qotada dheeraa ee uu buuraha Afgaanistaan ka soo bartay. Fasuul wuxuu si joogto ah u beddeli jiray wajigiisa, qaabnololeedka qoyskiisa, iyo magacyadiisa, isagoo adeegsan jiray magacyo been abuur ah oo ay kamid ahaayeen Abdul Karim iyo Abuu Cabdi. Sidoo kale, buuggiisa xusuusqorka ah waxaa laga fahmayaa in marnaba uusan ka tegi jirin wax raad elektaroonig ah marka uu farriimaha u gudbinayo unugyada hoostaga, taas oo ka dhigtay mid kamid ah shakhsiyaadka ugu dhuumashada ee taariikhda al-Qaacidda. Sida lagu falanqeeyay xarunta CTC West Point, Fasuul wuxuu ahaa maskaxdii ka danbaysay naqshadaynta shabakadaha saadka ee isaga gudbi jiray xuduudaha Bariga Afrika, isagoo isku xiri jiray Soomaaliya, Kenya, Tansaaniya, iyo jasiiradaha Comoros. Sida ay xaqiijiyeen baarayaasha amniga, maamulkiisa dhanka saadku ma ahayn mid ku kooban dhaqdhaqaaqa ciidanka oo kaliya, balse wuxuu salka ku hayay aasaasidda ganacsiyo dhawr iyo hanti maguurto ah oo ku yaalla magaalada Nairobi, kuwaas oo loo adeegsan jiray gabbaad maaliyadeed iyo marin qarsoodi ah oo loo mariyo saadka iyo agabka qaraxyada. Haddaba, sida uu Fasuul u qaabeeyay marinnada saadka, waxay awood u siisay unugyada al-Qaacidda inay si dhib yar hubka iyo lacagaha uga tallaabiyaan xuduudaha gobolka, taasi oo suurtagelisay fulinta weerarradii masiibada ahaa ee dhacay sannaddadii 1998 iyo 2002 iyo kuwii ka danbeeyay. Dhimashadii Fasuul Sida lagu xusay falanqaynta xarunta CTC West Point iyo warbixinnada sirdoonka gobolka, 08 Juun, sannadkii 2011, isaga iyo kuxigeenkiisii dhanka iskuxirka ee Cali Dhere, waxay ku jireen safar qarsoodi ah oo ay uga soo guurayeen fariisimaha gobolka Shabeellada Hoose. Jidka oo ay ka habaabeen ayaa sababay inay ka weecdaan halkii ay u socdeen, iyagoo si lama filaan ah u abbaaray barta kontoroolka ee Sarkuusta ee duleedka caasimadda Muqdisho, halkaas oo ay fadhiyeen ciidamada xoogga dalka Soomaaliya oo xilligaas ku jiray diyaargarow sare, sababo la xiriira dagaalladii ka socday. Sida ay xaqiijiyeen hay’adaha amniga dawladdii kumeelgaarka ahayd iyo khubaro sirdoon oo caalami ah, markii Fasuul la dilayay ee ay askarta rasaas ku furayeen inaysan aqoon u lahayn qofka ay dilayaan inuu ahaa ninkii loogu doonista badnaa labaatankii sano ee la soo dhaafay. Inaan markiiba la aqoonsan waxaa qayb ka ahayd wajigiisa oo isbeddelay iyo baasaboorka uu watay, balse baaritaanno qotodheer oo dhanka hiddasidayaasha iyo agabkiisa, waxay keentay in la aqoonsado. Dilka Fasuul ma ahayn mid ku yimid hawlgal sirdoon oo qorshaysan ama shil iska dhacay. Waxayse ahayd shirqool laga soo maleegay gudaha kooxda AS. Taas oo keentay in dhaawac weyn uu soo gaaro istiraatiijiyaddii ugu weynayd ee ku dhacda silsiladda al-Qaacidda ee Bariga Afrika, marka loo eego miisaanka hawlihii uu gacanta ku hayay. Sida laga helay xogaha laga soo saaray kombiyuutarkiisii gacanta iyo baasaboorkii been-abuurka ahaa ee dalka Koonfur Afrika, Fasuul wuxuu xilligaas ahaa ninka rasmiga ah ee isku xira hoggaanka sare ee al-Qaacidda iyo kooxda al-Shabaab, ahaana maskaxdii unugtay garabka “Jaysh Ayman”. Geeridiisu waxay si rasmi ah u joojisay qorshayaal casri ah oo saadka iyo maaliyadda lagu maamulayay iyo weerarradii uu ka maleegayay gudaha dalka Kenya. Inkastoo dilkiisu uu si muuqata uga dhacay bar kontorool, haddana baaritaannada danbe iyo xogaha sirdoonka ayaa muujiyay in geerida Fasuul aysan ahayn dhacdo kedis ah oo kaliya, balse ay salka ku haysay shirqool gudaha ah oo si weyn loogu tuhunsan yahay hoggaamiyihii kooxda al-Shabaab ee xilligaas, Axmed Cabdi Godane. Sida lagu xusay warbixinnada falanqaynta ee xarunta CTC West Point iyo qoraallada hay’adaha cilmibaarista amniga ee Foreign Policy Research Institute (FPRI), waxaa jiray tuhun xooggan oo sirdoonka caalamiga ah laga helay oo tilmaamayay in Godane uu si dadban uga danbeeyay in Fasuul ka lumo jidka oo uu habaabo, isagoo adeegsaday unuggiisa gaarka ah ee Amniyaadka, si uu meesha uga saaro garabka jilbaculusta ajaanibta ee al-Qaacidda ee loolanka baaxadda leh kula jiray hoggaankiisa. Tuhunkan shirqoolka ah waxaa si cad u xaqiijiyay eedaymo rasmi ah oo markii danbe ka yimid xubnihii ugu sarreeyey kooxda, sida dagaalyahankii u dhashay Maraykanka ee Cumar Xamaami (Abu Mansoor Al-Amriki) iyo Ibraahim afgaani. Labadan sarkaál ayaa ka hor inta aan la qaarijin si cad u shaaciyay in Godane uu ugaarsi iyo shirqoollo ah ku laayay hoggaamiyayaasha ajnabiga ah, si uu awoodda kooxda ugu koobo gacantiisa. Sidaas darteed, inkastoo ay rasaastu ka dhacday qoryaha ciidanka dawladda, balse habaabitaanka Fasuul waxay si toos ah u fulisay rabitaankii Godane ee ahaa inuu xididdada u siibo cid kasta oo caqabad ku ah xukunkiisa.

Magaaladii lagu dilay oo ahayd caasimadda Soomaaliya ee Muqdisho, magaalo u jirta 2,643km ayuu ku dhashay, taas oo ahayd caasimadda dalka Comoros ee Moroni. Walow uu adeegsan jiray siddeed magac, waxayse labadiisa waalid ugu wanqaleen Cabdalla Maxamed Fasuul. Inkastoo warbixinnada reer Galbeedka ay sheegaan inuu dhashay bishii December sannadkii 1974, balse buuggiisa xusuus-qorka ee The War Against Islam iyo baaritaannada rasmiga ah ee laga dhex helay kombiyuutarkiisa, waxaa ku xusnayd inuu dhashay August 1972. Comoros waa dal jasiirad ah oo ku dhex yaalla marinka Mozambique ee Badweynta Hindiya, una dhexeeya xeebaha bariga Afrika iyo jasiiradda Madagascar. Jasiiradahan silsiladda ah waxay ka kooban yihiin dhul yar oo ay ku nool yihiin dad aad ugu dhagan diinta Islaamka, iyadoo dhaqankooda asalka ah uu yahay midka faca weyn ee bulshada Sawaaxiliga ee xeebaha ku dhow. Markii uu Fasuul dhashay bilowgii toddobaatanaadkii, jasiiraduhu waxay ku jireen marxalad kacdoon gobannimadoon ah oo ay isaga dul qaadayeen gumaysigii Faransiiska, iyadoo ugu danbayntii ku guulaystay inay xorriyadda qaataan bishii July ee sannadkii 1975. Wixii intaas ka danbeeyay, dalku wuxuu galay xasilloonidarro siyaasadeed oo dabo dheeraatay, saboolnimo baahsan, iyo afgenbiyo isdabajoog ah. Haddaba, go’doonka dhinaca juqraafiga iyo qalalaasaha maamul ee ragaadiyay Comoros, waxay keentay inay ku kacaamaan jiil dhan oo indhaha dibadda u taagayay, si ay u helaan nolol iyo fursado ka fiican midka ay jasiiraddu u fidin karto. Degaankaas ay duruufaha qallafsan hareeyeen ayuu ku dhashay kuna barbaaray waxna ku bartay Fasuul. Haddaba, geeddisocodkiisa nololeed ee yaraannimo iyo waxbarasho waxa uu ku qaatay  dalkiisa hooyo ee Comoros, halkaas oo uu siddeedameeyadii ku qaatay waxbarashadiisii aasaasiga ahayd iyo middii sare ee diinta, kuwaas oo qaabeeyay aragtidii danbe ee uu fagaarayaasha caalamiga ah ugu gudbay. Barbaarintaas dhexdeeda wuxuu sidoo kale ku bartay shan luuqadood oo kala ah: afkiisa hooyo, Faransiiska, Carabiga, Ingiriisiga, iyo Sawaaxiliga. Sannadkii 1990 ayuu u kicitimay dalka Pakistan isagoo helay fursad waxbarasho oo jaamaceed, si uu usoo barto cilmiga kumbiyuutarka. Waxaase durbadiiba qaatay mawjaddii jihaadka caalamiga ahayd ee lagaga dhawaaqay dalkii dariska la ahaa midka uu waxbarashada u joogay oo ahaa Afgaanistaan. Wuxuuna iska xaadariyay xeryaha tababbarka al-Qaacidda ee Afgaanistaan, halkaas oo uu ku hantay xeeladaha isgaarsiinta qarsoon iyo farsamada walxaha qarxa. Aqoontaas farsamo waxay u gogol-xaartay inuu sannadkii 1993 soo galo gobolka Gedo ee Soomaaliya, si uu tababarro u siiyo xoogaggii “Al-Ittihad Al-Islami”, isagoo sannadkii xigayna u wareegay magaalada Nairobi, si uu halkaas uga yagleelo ganacsiyo qarsoodi ah oo gabbaad u noqda saadka iyo maaliyadda kooxda al-Qaacidda. Kaartadii saadka ee uu dhisay waxay saldhig u noqotay weerarradii safaaradaha Maraykanka ee Nairobi iyo Daarusalaam ee dhacay sannadkii 1998, isagoo markii danbana agaasimay weerarradii huteelka Paradise iyo iskudaygii diyaaraddii Israa’iil ee Mombasa sannadkii 2002. Weerarradan ayaa sababay masiibo bini’aadantinimo oo baaxad leh, iyadoo wadarta guud ee khasaarihii nafeed ee ka dhashay ay gaartay dhimashada ku dhowaad 240 qof, halka ay ku dhaawacmeen in ka badan 4,160 qof oo u badnaa dad rayid ah oo aan waxba galabsan. Muddadaas oo dhan wuxuu adeegsanayay magacyo been-abuur ah iyo xeelado uu kaga dhuumanayay sirdoonka caalamiga ah. Ugu danbayntii, caddadiskii amniga ee ku qabsaday Kenya wuxuu ku khasbay inuu sannadkii 2007 gabbaad rasmi ah ka dhigto gudaha Soomaaliya, isagoo ku dhex milmay hoggaanka sare ee kooxda argaggaxisada ah ee al-Shabaab (AS), halkaasna ka aasaasay unugga gaarka ah ee Jaysh Ayman. Maaraynta Hawlgallada Sida lagu falanqeeyay buugga Inside Al-Shabaab ee ay qoreen suxufiyiinta Harun Maruf iyo Dan Joseph, soo galitaankii rasmiga ahaa ee Fasuul ee gudaha Soomaaliya sannadkii 2007, wuxuu isbeddel weyn u horseeday habkii ay u hawlgalayeen garabka milateriga ee kooxda AS. Intii uu ku sugnaa degaannada jasiiradda ku dhow iyo xeryaha qarsoon ee kaymaha Jubbada Hoose, wuxuu asaasay garabka la magacbaxay “Jaysh Ayman”. Sababta ugu weyn ee uu unuggan u aasaasay waxay ahayd inuu abuuro cudud gaar ah oo fulisa istiraatiijiyaddii al-Qaacidda ee ballaarinta jihaadka Bariga Afrika, isagoo ka faa’iidaysanaya nuglaanta xuduudaha si uu weerarrada ugu wareejiyo gudaha dalka Kenya, isla markaasna uu u hantiyo dhalinyarada ku hadasha afka Sawaaxiliga ee laga soo qoray xeebaha gobolka. Sida lagu xusay xogaha xarunta CTC West Point, muddadii uu unuggan dhisayay waxaa soo kala dhex galay isaga iyo hoggaanka sare ee kooxda argaggaxisada ah ee AS, gaar ahaan Axmed Cabdi Godane, ismaandhaaf iyo khilaaf hoose. Tani waxay ka dhalatay rabitaankii Godane ee ahaa inuu unko nidaam maamul oo hal meel laga hoggaamiyo, isagoo diiddanaa in Fasuul uu sameeyo unug si uga madaxbannaan hoggaanka kooxda. Ismaandhaafkii ayaa cirka sii galay marka la isku qabtay dhaqaalaha iyo doorka madaxbannaanida ee dagaalyahannada ajaaniibta ah ee Fasuul asaasay. Dhanka kale, habka uu u maareeyay hawlgallada waxay tusaale u tahay heerka ugu sarreeya ee hirgelinta xeeladaha loo yaqaanno xeeladaha dhawrista iyo qarinta sirta hawlgallada. Sida lagu xusay baaritaannada hay’adaha sirdoonka caalamiga ah, wuxuu ku dhowaad labaatan sano ka badbaadayay daba-galkii iyo ugaarsigii ugu weynaa ee dunida ka dhaca, isagoo adeegsanaya farsamooyinkii qotada dheeraa ee uu buuraha Afgaanistaan ka soo bartay. Fasuul wuxuu si joogto ah u beddeli jiray wajigiisa, qaabnololeedka qoyskiisa, iyo magacyadiisa, isagoo adeegsan jiray magacyo been abuur ah oo ay kamid ahaayeen Abdul Karim iyo Abuu Cabdi. Sidoo kale, buuggiisa xusuusqorka ah waxaa laga fahmayaa in marnaba uusan ka tegi jirin wax raad elektaroonig ah marka uu farriimaha u gudbinayo unugyada hoostaga, taas oo ka dhigtay mid kamid ah shakhsiyaadka ugu dhuumashada ee taariikhda al-Qaacidda. Sida lagu falanqeeyay xarunta CTC West Point, Fasuul wuxuu ahaa maskaxdii ka danbaysay naqshadaynta shabakadaha saadka ee isaga gudbi jiray xuduudaha Bariga Afrika, isagoo isku xiri jiray Soomaaliya, Kenya, Tansaaniya, iyo jasiiradaha Comoros. Sida ay xaqiijiyeen baarayaasha amniga, maamulkiisa dhanka saadku ma ahayn mid ku kooban dhaqdhaqaaqa ciidanka oo kaliya, balse wuxuu salka ku hayay aasaasidda ganacsiyo dhawr iyo hanti maguurto ah oo ku yaalla magaalada Nairobi, kuwaas oo loo adeegsan jiray gabbaad maaliyadeed iyo marin qarsoodi ah oo loo mariyo saadka iyo agabka qaraxyada. Haddaba, sida uu Fasuul u qaabeeyay marinnada saadka, waxay awood u siisay unugyada al-Qaacidda inay si dhib yar hubka iyo lacagaha uga tallaabiyaan xuduudaha gobolka, taasi oo suurtagelisay fulinta weerarradii masiibada ahaa ee dhacay sannaddadii 1998 iyo 2002 iyo kuwii ka danbeeyay. Dhimashadii Fasuul Sida lagu xusay falanqaynta xarunta CTC West Point iyo warbixinnada sirdoonka gobolka, 08 Juun, sannadkii 2011, isaga iyo kuxigeenkiisii dhanka iskuxirka ee Cali Dhere, waxay ku jireen safar qarsoodi ah oo ay uga soo guurayeen fariisimaha gobolka Shabeellada Hoose. Jidka oo ay ka habaabeen ayaa sababay inay ka weecdaan halkii ay u socdeen, iyagoo si lama filaan ah u abbaaray barta kontoroolka ee Sarkuusta ee duleedka caasimadda Muqdisho, halkaas oo ay fadhiyeen ciidamada xoogga dalka Soomaaliya oo xilligaas ku jiray diyaargarow sare, sababo la xiriira dagaalladii ka socday. Sida ay xaqiijiyeen hay’adaha amniga dawladdii kumeelgaarka ahayd iyo khubaro sirdoon oo caalami ah, markii Fasuul la dilayay ee ay askarta rasaas ku furayeen inaysan aqoon u lahayn qofka ay dilayaan inuu ahaa ninkii loogu doonista badnaa labaatankii sano ee la soo dhaafay. Inaan markiiba la aqoonsan waxaa qayb ka ahayd wajigiisa oo isbeddelay iyo baasaboorka uu watay, balse baaritaanno qotodheer oo dhanka hiddasidayaasha iyo agabkiisa, waxay keentay in la aqoonsado. Dilka Fasuul ma ahayn mid ku yimid hawlgal sirdoon oo qorshaysan ama shil iska dhacay. Waxayse ahayd shirqool laga soo maleegay gudaha kooxda AS. Taas oo keentay in dhaawac weyn uu soo gaaro istiraatiijiyaddii ugu weynayd ee ku dhacda silsiladda al-Qaacidda ee Bariga Afrika, marka loo eego miisaanka hawlihii uu gacanta ku hayay. Sida laga helay xogaha laga soo saaray kombiyuutarkiisii gacanta iyo baasaboorkii been-abuurka ahaa ee dalka Koonfur Afrika, Fasuul wuxuu xilligaas ahaa ninka rasmiga ah ee isku xira hoggaanka sare ee al-Qaacidda iyo kooxda al-Shabaab, ahaana maskaxdii unugtay garabka “Jaysh Ayman”. Geeridiisu waxay si rasmi ah u joojisay qorshayaal casri ah oo saadka iyo maaliyadda lagu maamulayay iyo weerarradii uu ka maleegayay gudaha dalka Kenya. Inkastoo dilkiisu uu si muuqata uga dhacay bar kontorool, haddana baaritaannada danbe iyo xogaha sirdoonka ayaa muujiyay in geerida Fasuul aysan ahayn dhacdo kedis ah oo kaliya, balse ay salka ku haysay shirqool gudaha ah oo si weyn loogu tuhunsan yahay hoggaamiyihii kooxda al-Shabaab ee xilligaas, Axmed Cabdi Godane. Sida lagu xusay warbixinnada falanqaynta ee xarunta CTC West Point iyo qoraallada hay’adaha cilmibaarista amniga ee Foreign Policy Research Institute (FPRI), waxaa jiray tuhun xooggan oo sirdoonka caalamiga ah laga helay oo tilmaamayay in Godane uu si dadban uga danbeeyay in Fasuul ka lumo jidka oo uu habaabo, isagoo adeegsaday unuggiisa gaarka ah ee Amniyaadka, si uu meesha uga saaro garabka jilbaculusta ajaanibta ee al-Qaacidda ee loolanka baaxadda leh kula jiray hoggaankiisa. Tuhunkan shirqoolka ah waxaa si cad u xaqiijiyay eedaymo rasmi ah oo markii danbe ka yimid xubnihii ugu sarreeyey kooxda, sida dagaalyahankii u dhashay Maraykanka ee Cumar Xamaami (Abu Mansoor Al-Amriki) iyo Ibraahim afgaani. Labadan sarkaál ayaa ka hor inta aan la qaarijin si cad u shaaciyay in Godane uu ugaarsi iyo shirqoollo ah ku laayay hoggaamiyayaasha ajnabiga ah, si uu awoodda kooxda ugu koobo gacantiisa. Sidaas darteed, inkastoo ay rasaastu ka dhacday qoryaha ciidanka dawladda, balse habaabitaanka Fasuul waxay si toos ah u fulisay rabitaankii Godane ee ahaa inuu xididdada u siibo cid kasta oo caqabad ku ah xukunkiisa.

items.title: Xogtii u dambeysay ee dhex-dhexaadinta Turkiga ka dhex wado DF iyo mucaaradka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xogo dheeraad ah ayaa kasoo baxaya dadaallada dhex-dhexaadin ee dowladda Turkiga ka waddo khilaafka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka. Mas’uuliyiin ka socota dowladda Turkiga ayaa kulamo gaar-gaar ah la yeeshay labada dhinac, kuwaas oo diiradda lagu saaray arrimaha doorashooyinka iyo sidii loo heli lahaa is-afgarad siyaasadeed. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, dowladda iyo mucaaradku ayaa ku qancay in la dhiso guddi farsamo oo ka shaqeeya isu-soo dhoweynta aragtiyada kala duwan ee ku saabsan hannaanka doorashooyinka dalka. Guddigan ayaa la filayaa inuu soo diyaariyo talooyin iyo qodobbo ay labada dhinac ka wada shaqeyn karaan, ka hor inta aan la qaban kulan toos ah oo ay yeeshaan madaxda Dowladda Federaalka iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka. Sidoo kale, xogta la helayo ayaa muujineysa in Dowladda Federaalka ay muujisay dabacsanaan ku aaddan doodda la xiriirta doorashada heer federaal, iyadoo la sheegay inay oggolaatay in arrintaas la guda galo kadib marka la qabto doorashooyinka tooska ah ee dowlad-goboleedyada. Dhanka kale, qaar ka mid ah mucaaradka ayaa weli ku adkeysanaya in doorashooyinka heer federaal iyo kuwa dowlad-goboleedyada ay noqdaan kuwo isku xiran, isla markaana dhammaantood lagu qabto hannaan dadban oo ay ka qeyb-galayaan qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada. Dadaalladan dhex-dhexaadinta ah ayaa weli socda, iyadoo falanqeeyayaasha siyaasadda ay aaminsan yihiin in kulamada iyo doorka beesha caalamka ay siinayaan waqti dheeraad ah Villa Soomaaliya, xilli ay taagan yihiin doodaha ku saabsan jadwalka doorashooyinka iyo muddada hay’adaha dowladda. The post Xogtii u dambeysay ee dhex-dhexaadinta Turkiga ka dhex wado DF iyo mucaaradka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Cabdullaahi Nuur oo sheegay in hub lagu daabulay hoteelkiisa, kuna eedeeyay DF bililiqo
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirkii hore ee Amniga Soomaaliya, Cabdullaahi Maxamed Nuur, oo sidoo kalena ah mulkiilaha hoteelka Elite ayaa sheegay in ciidamada dowladda ay xoog uga haystaan hoteelkiisa. Cabdullaahi Nuur ayaa marka hore beeniyay in hoteelka gudahiisa lagu qabtay hubka uu soo bandhigay booliska, isagoo sheegay in hub culus lagu daabulay gudaha hoteelka, si looga been abuurto, loona sumcad dilo ganacsigiisa. “Waxaan la wadaagayaa bulshada Soomaaliyeed in maalintii saddexaad ay ciidamo hubeysan si sharci-darro ah ugu sugan yihiin gudaha Hoteelka Elite,” ayuu yiri Wasiirka hore ee amniga. Sidoo kale waxa uu sheegaay in la burburiyay qaybo kamid ah hoteelka, isla markaana la bililiqeystay hanti taallay gudaha hoteelka, isagoo sheegay in hantida maqan uu dhawaan la wadaagi doono bulshada. “Waxaan la soconaa in gudaha hoteelka lagu daabulay hub culus, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in gudaha Hotelka si been abuur ah la is kugu sawirro hubka ay soo geliyeen Hotel ka si loo sumcad xumeeyo goobtaas ganacsi,” ayuu yiri mulkiilaha hoteelka Elite. Waxa uu intaas kusii daray “Waxaan rabaa inaan bulshada u caddeeyo in hubka yaalla hoteelka uu yahay mid fudud oo keliya, laguna ilaaliyo amniga Hotel ka iyo badqabka shacabka soo booqda hoteelka.” Hadalka mulkiilaha hoteelka Elite ayaa imanaya kadib markii galabta ay ciidanka booliska Soomaaliya kusoo bandhigeen gudaha hoteelka hub culus oo ay sheegeen inay ku qabteen gudaha hoteelka. Hubka uu soo bandhigay booliska ayaa isugu jiray hub fudud iyo kuwa culus, waxaana ka mid ahaa hub casri ah iyo agab kale oo ay ku jiraan diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn (drones). “Hubkan waxaa laga soo qaaday hoteelka, wuxuuna ka mid yahay hubka sida sharci-darrada ah loo haystay. Ma jirto wax nagu kalifaya inaan ammaanka been ka sheegno. Hubkan waxaa lagu qabtay gudaha hoteelka,” ayuu yiri Taliyaha booliska gobolka Banaadir, Macallin Mahdi oo shir jaraa’id ku qabtay gudaha hoteelka Elite. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa weli sii wada howl-galka hub ka dhigista ee lagu beegsanayo mucaaradka, kuwaas oo dhawaan dagaal culus la galay ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliya. The post Cabdullaahi Nuur oo sheegay in hub lagu daabulay hoteelkiisa, kuna eedeeyay DF bililiqo appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dowladda iyo WFP oo Soo Bandhigay Daraasad Ku Saabsan Nafaqo-darrada Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Hay’adda Cuntada Adduunka (WFP) ayaa maanta magaalada Muqdisho ku soo bandhigay daraasad lagu magacaabo “Daboolidda Farqiga Nafaqada ee Soomaaliya”, taas oo lagu qiimeeyay heerarka nafaqo-darrada, xaaladda suuqyada cuntada iyo noocyada cuntooyinka ay heli karaan qoysaska Soomaaliyeed. Daraasaddan oo ay iska kaashadeen Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha iyo WFP ayaa soo bandhigtay xog ku saabsan caqabadaha hortaagan helitaanka cunto nafaqo leh, iyadoo sidoo kale lagu soo jeediyay talooyin wax ku ool ah oo lagu xoojinayo dheelli-tirka baahiyaha nafaqo ee bulshada. Wasiiru Dowlaha Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha, Xirsi Jaamac Gaani, ayaa sheegay in bulshada Soomaaliyeed ay si weyn ugu baahan tahay wacyigelin iyo daryeel ku saabsan cunnooyinka caafimaadka leh, si loo yareeyo saameynta nafaqo-darrada gaar ahaan haweenka iyo carruurta. Munaasabadda ayaa sidoo kale waxaa ka hadlay Madaxa Qaybta Cunnada iyo Nafaqada ee Wasaaradda Caafimaadka, Osaama Cabdi Cali, Agaasimaha Waaxda Wax-soo-saarka iyo Sugnaanta Cuntada ee Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Waraabka, Maxamed Muuse Aadan, iyo Lataliyaha Sare ee Arrimaha Cunnada, Nafaqada iyo Cimilada ee Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha, Dr. Maxamed Cabdi Faarax. Mas’uuliyiintan ayaa faahfaahin ka bixiyay qodobada ay daraasaddu xoogga saartay iyo dadaallada dowladda ay ku doonayso in bulshada Soomaaliyeed ay u helaan cunnooyin nafaqo leh oo kor u qaada caafimaadka iyo tayada nolosha. Warbixintan waxaad u isticmaali kartaa cod warbaahineed ama qoraal war oo la baahiyo.

items.title: Booliska Soomaaliya oo Faahfaahin Ka Bixiyey Hub Lagu Qabtay Hoteelka Elite ee Muqdisho
items.description: Taliska Booliska Soomaaliya ayaa faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka bixiyay howlgal lagu soo qabtay hub lagu keydiyay gudaha Hoteelka Elite ee magaalada Muqdisho. Taliyaha qeybta guud ee Booliska Gobolka Banaadir, Macallin Mahdi ayaa sheegay in hubka lagu hayay qol si gaar ah loo adkeeyay oo ku yaalla hoteelka, isagoo xusay in furaha qolkaasi loo soo dhiibay odayaal deegaanka ah. “Qol buruuf ah ayuu ku xiray hubkaani, furaha ayuu usoo dhiibay odayaal. Waa la jabin waayay, mana la qarxin, dalkaan xoog iyo mooryaanimo kuma sii jiri karto,” ayuu yiri Macallin Mahdi. Taliyaha ayaa tilmaamay in Hoteelka Elite uu kamid yahay dhismayaasha muhiimka ah ee bilicda caasimadda Muqdisho, balse loo adeegsaday meel lagu keydiyo hub aan sharciyeysneyn. Macallin Mahdi ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in aan la aqbali doonin in hub sharci darro ah lagu dhex haysto magaalada Muqdisho, isagoo sheegay in goob ganacsi, hoteel ama guri deegaan midna aan loo oggolaan doonin in lagu kaydiyo hub aan fasax haysan. Hubka lagu qabtay howlgalka ayaa lagu soo bandhigay gudaha Hoteelka Elite, halkaas oo saraakiisha amniga ay ku muujiyeen noocyada kala duwan ee hubka la sheegay in laga helay goobta.

items.title: Dowladda oo hub fara badan ku soo bandhigtay hotel Elite
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Dowladda Faderaalka Soomaaliya ayaa Goordhaweyd Hotel Elite ee Muqdisho, ku soo bandhigtay hub fara badan oo ay sheegtay inuu lee yahay wasiirkii hore ee amniga Cabdullaahi Maxamed Nuur oo ah mikiilaha hotelka. Hubkan ayaa waxaa soo bandhigay taliska booliska Soomaaliya, oo waday howlgal 24 saac ee lasoo dhaafay, kuwaasi oo sheegay in waqti badan ay hubka soo heleen gudaha Hotelka. Taliyaha Booliska gobolka Banaadir Macalin Mahdi, oo warbaahinta kula hadlay gudaha hotelka, ayaa sheegay in hubka ay soo bandhigeen ay kasoo sareen qol ku yaalla hotelka, isla markaana aysan waxba ka jirin in la jibiyay qolka, si hubka loo soo saaro. Taliye Macalin Mahdi, ayaa carabka ku dhuftay in hubka isugu jiraan kuwa culus iyo fudud iyo rasaas fara badan oo dhammaantood hotelka yaalay sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Asiga oo sii hadlay taliye Macalin Mahdi, ayaa hoosta ka xariiqay in hotel loogu tala-galay in dadka ay ku nastaan in hub intaas la eg uu dhex-yaallo, isla markaana amni darrada caasimada loogu shaqeeynayo. Sidoo kale Macalin Mahdi, ayaa siyaasiyiinta ugu goodiyay in haddii ay hub soo qataan ay la kulmi doonaan cawaaqib xun sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Waa laidin jeybeynaya haddii aad hal qori soo qataan 10 qori ayaan soo qaadayneynaa, maxaa yeelay adinka ayaa qoray soo qaatay. Waa ayaan darro meel hotel ah oo dadka ka dhaxeeysa oo qurux iyo hanti la geliyay, haddana in hub la doonayo in lagu dumiyo dowladnimada Soomaaliya lagu keediyo” ayuu yiri Taliyaha Booliska Gobolka Banaadir. The post Dowladda oo hub fara badan ku soo bandhigtay hotel Elite appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Sanctions to Strangle Iran’s Energy Smuggling and Illicit Financial Networks
items.description: Sanctions to Strangle Iran’s Energy Smuggling and Illicit Financial Networks Press Statement Thomas “Tommy” Pigott, Spokesperson Today, the United States is disrupting Iran’s efforts to evade our sanctions and fund its destabilizing activities. The United States is targeting a sophisticated network that has smuggled hundreds of millions of dollars’ worth of Iranian liquified petroleum gas (LPG) to markets in South and East Asia. This network used front companies in the United Arab Emirates and China, along with Iran’s shadow fleet of vessels, to disguise Iranian-origin fuel and circumvent U.S. sanctions. We are also sanctioning an Iranian currency exchange house and its operators who work with other actors to help Iran facilitate billions of dollars in illicit financial transactions. These dealings enable the regime to move funds derived from oil sales while evading the international financial system. These sanctions are part of the Administration’s Economic Fury campaign, which maintains maximum pressure on the Iranian regime and disrupts its ability to generate revenue for weapons development, support for terrorist proxies, and regional aggression. The United States will continue to take steps to hold accountable anyone who facilitates Iran’s sanctions evasion, including foreign companies and financial institutions. We call on the international community to join us in enforcing these measures and preventing Iran from accessing resources that fuel terrorism, weapons proliferation, and instability across the region. Today’s action is being taken pursuant to E.O. 13902, which targets persons operating in Iran’s financial and petroleum sectors. These designations will advance the Administration’s Economic Fury and build on a series of OFAC actions targeting Iran’s shadow banking and petroleum sales networks . For more information on today’s action, please see the Department of the Treasury’s press releases .

items.title: DF oo hub culus kusoo bandhigtay gudaha hoteelka Elite + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliska Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed ayaa maanta hoteelka Elite ee magaalada Muqdisho ku soo bandhigay hub culus, kaas oo uu sheegay in lagu qabtay gudaha hoteelka. Hubka uu soo bandhigay booliska ayaa isugu jiray hub fudud iyo kuwa culus, waxaana ka mid ahaa hub casri ah iyo agab kale oo ay ku jiraan diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn (drones). Taliyaha qaybta guud ee booliska gobolka Banaadir, Macallin Mahdi oo warbaahinta kula hadlay gudaha hoteelka Elite ayaa sheegay in aan marnaba la aqbali doonin in shaqsi madax hore ahaa uu haysto hub culus oo waxyeello u geysan kara amniga caasimadda. “Hubkan waxaa laga soo qaaday hoteelka, wuxuuna ka mid yahay hubka sida sharci-darrada ah loo haystay. Ma jirto wax nagu kalifaya inaan ammaanka been ka sheegno. Hubkan waxaa lagu qabtay gudaha hoteelka,” ayuu yiri Taliye Macallin Mahdi. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa weli sii wada howl-galka hub ka dhigista ee lagu beegsanayo mucaaradka, kuwaas oo dhawaan dagaal culus la galay ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliya. Horey ciidamada ayaa howl-gallo lagu soo qabtay hub uga sameeyay degmooyinka Howl-wadaag iyo Cabdicasiis, oo ka mid ahaa meelihii ay joogeen mucaaradka. Kadibna howl-galka wuxuu u wareegay dhinaca degmada Gubadley, halkaas oo la sheegay inay tageen ciidamo Macawiisley ah oo daacad u ah Wasiirkii hore ee Amniga, Cabdullaahi Maxamed Nuur. Ciidamadaas ayaa ugu dambeyn aaday dhinaca gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, oo markii horeba kasoo kicitameen. Si kastaba, tallaabooyinkan ayaa imanaya xilli ay socdaan shirar siyaasadeed iyo dadaallo lagu dhex-dhexaadinayo dowladda iyo mucaaradka, kuwaas oo ay qayb ka tahay dowladda Turkiga, si la isugu soo dhaweeyo labada dhinac. Lama oga sida ay wax noqon doonaan, hase yeeshee waxaa laga war sugayaa natiijada ka soo baxda dadaallada haatan socda, kuwaas oo diiradda lagu saarayo sidii xal looga gaari lahaa khilaafka siyaasadeed ee ka taagan dalka, kana dhashay hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka ku-meel-gaarka ah. The post DF oo hub culus kusoo bandhigtay gudaha hoteelka Elite + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Maalinta Badaha Adduunka: Ilaalinta Badaha & Dibudhiska Awoodda Ciidanka Badeed ee Soomaaliya
items.description: 8da Juun sannad kasta dunidu waxay u dabbaaldegtaa Maalinta Badaha Adduunka (World Ocean Day), oo ah maalin caalami ah oo lagu xusuusto qiimaha weyn ee baduhu u leeyihiin nolosha aadanaha iyo degaanka dunida. Baduhu keliya kuma koobna in ay yihiin marin ay isaga gooshaan maraakiibta iyo doonyuhu; waase il dhaqaale oo si joogto ah looga helo khayraad badan oo jaadad kala duwan leh. Waa lafdhabarta nolosha aadanaha. Waxay baduhu soosaaraan qeyb weyn oo oksijiinta aan qaadanno ah; uumibaxooda roobabka ayaa ka dhasha, taasoo gacan ka geysata isu dheellitirnaanta cimilada. Aragtida Maalinta Badaha Adduunka markii ugu horraysay waxaa lagu soo bandhigay Shirkii Qaramada Midoobay ee Degaanka iyo Horumarka ee lagu qabtay magaalada Rio de Janeiro ee dalka Brazil sannadkii 1992. Ujeeddadu waxay ahayd in bulshada caalamka lagu baraarujiyo muhiimadda badaha iyo khataraha ku soo wajahan. Ugu danbayn, sannadkii 2008 ayay Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay si rasmi ah ugu asteeyeen 8da Juun inay noqoto Maalinta Badaha Adduunka, waxaana xuska rasmiga ah la bilaabay 2009kii. Maalintan waxay dunidu ku mideysan tahay hal fariin oo cad: in badaha la ilaaliyo, laga hortago wasakheynta, lana xaqiijiyo in jiilasha mustaqbalka ay ka faa’iidaystaan khayraadka badda sida ay maanta uga faa’iidaystaan dadka nool. Muhiimadda Badaha ee Nolosha Aadanaha Baduhu waxay daboolaan in ka badan 70% oogada dhulka, waxaana lagu qiyaasaa inay soo saaraan in ka badan kala bar oksijiinta dunida. Sidoo kale waxay nuugaan qeyb weyn oo ka mid ah kaarboonka hawada ku sii badanaya, taasoo kaalin weyn ka qaadata yaraynta isbeddelka cimilada. Malaayiin qof oo dunida ku nool ayaa nolol maalmeedkooda ku tiirsan tahay khayraadka badda. Kalluumeysiga, gaadiidka badda, tamarta, dalxiiska iyo warshadaha la xiriira baduhu waxay ka mid yihiin ilaha ugu waaweyn ee dhaqaalaha caalamka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, badaha adduunka waxaa maanta halis ku haya wasakheyn sii kordhaysa, kalluumeysi xaddhaaf ah, qashin caag ah, shidaal ku daata xeebaha iyo isbeddelka cimilada. Khatarahan ayaa keenay in dalal badan iyo hay’ado caalami ahi xoogga saaraan ilaalinta badaha. Soomaaliya iyo Khayraadka Baddeeda Marka laga hadlayo badaha, Soomaaliya waxay ka mid tahay dalalka ugu nasiibka badan dunida. Waxay leedahay xeebta ugu dheer qaaradda Afrika, oo dhererkeedu gaarayo ka badan ,300 km, kuna fidsan Badweynta Hindiya iyo Gacanka Berbera. Xeebahan dheer waxay hoy u yihiin khayraad dabiici ah oo aad u badan, gaar ahaan kalluunka, macdanta badda, tamarta iyo fursadaha ganacsi ee la xiriira gaadiidka badda. Intaas waxaa dheer, Soomaaliya waxay ku taallaa goob istiraatiiji ah oo ay maraan qaar ka mid ah marinbiyoodka ugu mashquulka badan dunida. Hasayeeshee, inkastoo khayraadkaasi aad u badan yahay, faa’iidada ay shacabka Soomaaliyeed ka helaan weli waa mid kooban. Sababaha ugu waaweyn waxaa ka mid ah awood la’aanta ilaalinta xeebaha, kalluumaysi sharcidarro ah, maamulxumo, wasakhow iyo maalgelin-la’aan. Waxaa marar badan xeebaha Soomaaliya ka hawlgalay maraakiib shisheeye oo kalluumaysi sharcidarro ah ka sameeyay, kuwaas oo jillaabta kalluun aad uga badan xaddigii loo oggolaaday ama mararka qaar aan wax ruqsad ah u haysan. Arrintani waxay dhaawac ku tahay dhaqaalaha dalka iyo nolosha kalluumaysatada Soomaaliyeed. Khatarta Wasakhaynta Badaha Soomaaliya Sida dalal badan oo dunida ah, Soomaaliya sidoo kale waxaa soo wajahaya khatarta wasakheynta badda. Magaalooyinka xeebaha leh waxaa mararka qaar laga arkaa qashin lagu daadinayo badda ama xeebaha ku dhow. Qashinka caagga ah ayaa ka mid ah khataraha ugu waaweyn. Marka uu badda gaaro wuxuu waxyeelleeyaa kalluunka, noolayaasha quuta badda, shimbiraha iyo cid kasta oo ku tiirsan khayraadka badda. Ugu danbayn, walxahaas ayaa dib ugu soo laabta fayaqabka cuntada ee aadanaha. Waxaa, sidoo kale, jira cabashooyin la xiriira qashin warshadeed iyo walxo sun ah oo lagu daadiyo xeebaha Soomaaliya. Haddii aan si degdeg ah loo xakamayn, arrimahan waxay halis gelin karaan caafimaadka bulshada iyo jiritaanka khayraadka badda. Dibudhiska Ciidanka Badda iyo Ilaalinta Badaha Soomaaliyeed Ka dib dadaalladii dib loogu dhisay ciidamada dhulka iyo cirka, Soomaaliya waxay si isa soo taraysa u xoojinaysay dibudhiska Ciidanka Badda Soomaaliyeed. Tani waa tallaabo muhiim ah, maadaama dal leh xeebta ugu dheer Afrika uusan awood u yeelan karin ilaalinta khayraadkiisa baddeed iyadoo aan jirin ciidan badeed awood leh. Sidaas darteed, Ciidanka Badda Soomaaliyeed waxaa horyaalla masuuliyado badan oo muhiim u ah amniga iyo horumarka dalka. Waxaana ka mid ah: 1. Ilaalinta Khayraadka Buluugga ah Ciidanka badda ayaa door muhiim ah ka ciyaari kara ladagaallanka jilaabashada sharcidarrada ah. Iyagoo adeegsanaya maraakiib kormeer, tiknoolajiyad casri ah iyo iskaashi caalami ah, waxay awood u yeelan karaan inay ilaaliyaan khayraadka badda ee Soomaaliyeed. 2. Ka Hortagga Wasakhaynta Badaha Dalka Ciidanka badda waxay ka qeyb qaadan karaan dabagalka maraakiibta ku xadgudbaya sharciyada degaanka, gaar ahaan kuwa qashinka ama walxaha sunta ah ku daadinaya badda Soomaaliya. 3. items.fullContent: 8da Juun sannad kasta dunidu waxay u dabbaaldegtaa Maalinta Badaha Adduunka (World Ocean Day), oo ah maalin caalami ah oo lagu xusuusto qiimaha weyn ee baduhu u leeyihiin nolosha aadanaha iyo degaanka dunida. Baduhu keliya kuma koobna in ay yihiin marin ay isaga gooshaan maraakiibta iyo doonyuhu; waase il dhaqaale oo si joogto ah looga helo khayraad badan oo jaadad kala duwan leh. Waa lafdhabarta nolosha aadanaha. Waxay baduhu soosaaraan qeyb weyn oo oksijiinta aan qaadanno ah; uumibaxooda roobabka ayaa ka dhasha, taasoo gacan ka geysata isu dheellitirnaanta cimilada. Aragtida Maalinta Badaha Adduunka markii ugu horraysay waxaa lagu soo bandhigay Shirkii Qaramada Midoobay ee Degaanka iyo Horumarka ee lagu qabtay magaalada Rio de Janeiro ee dalka Brazil sannadkii 1992. Ujeeddadu waxay ahayd in bulshada caalamka lagu baraarujiyo muhiimadda badaha iyo khataraha ku soo wajahan. Ugu danbayn, sannadkii 2008 ayay Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay si rasmi ah ugu asteeyeen 8da Juun inay noqoto Maalinta Badaha Adduunka, waxaana xuska rasmiga ah la bilaabay 2009kii. Maalintan waxay dunidu ku mideysan tahay hal fariin oo cad: in badaha la ilaaliyo, laga hortago wasakheynta, lana xaqiijiyo in jiilasha mustaqbalka ay ka faa’iidaystaan khayraadka badda sida ay maanta uga faa’iidaystaan dadka nool. Muhiimadda Badaha ee Nolosha Aadanaha Baduhu waxay daboolaan in ka badan 70% oogada dhulka, waxaana lagu qiyaasaa inay soo saaraan in ka badan kala bar oksijiinta dunida. items.title: Shirka seddaxaad ee guddoomiyaasha magaalooyinka Soomaaliya oo ka furmaya magaalada Muqdisho
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta Soomaaliya, Cali Yuusuf Cali (Xoosh), ayaa maanta magaalada Muqdisho ka furay Madasha Saddexaad ee guddoomiyaasha magaalooyinka Soomaaliya, kaas oo ay ka qeyb galayaan duqeyda degmooyinka dalku. Madashan ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa horumarinta dowladaha hoose, tayeynta adeegyada bulshada iyo xoojinta wada-shaqeynta u dhaxeysa dowladda federaalka, dowlad-goboleedyada iyo maamulka degmooyinka. Isagoo ka hadlayay furitaanka shirka, Wasiir Xoosh ayaa sheegay in maamullada degmooyinku ay safka hore kaga jiraan wax ka qabashada caqabadaha saameeya bulshada, sida amniga, abaaraha, barakaca, isbeddelka cimilada, khilaafaadka deegaanka iyo murannada la xiriira kheyraadka. “Xoojinta dowladaha hoose ma aha oo keliya siyaasad la qaato, balse waa tiirka adeeg bixinta, horumarka iyo ka qeybgalka dimuqraadiyadeed ee bulshada,” ayuu yiri wasiirku. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijiyay sida ay dowladda federaalku uga go’an tahay hirgelinta nidaamka maamul-daadejinta iyo dhismaha hay’adaha dowladaha hoose, isagoo ku boorriyay ka qeybgalayaasha inay is dhaafsadaan khibradaha iyo xalalka wax ku oolka ah ee lagu horumarin karo adeegyada bulshada iyo adkeysiga bulshooyinka. Shirkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli Soomaaliya ay sii waddo dadaallada lagu ballaarinayo dowladaha hoose iyo dhismaha hay’adaha dowladeed, kadib sanado badan oo ay dalka saameeyeen colaado iyo xasillooni darro siyaasadeed. Hay’adaha caalamiga ah ayaa muddo dheer ku adkeysanayay in maamullo deegaan oo awood leh ay muhiim u yihiin horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, kor u qaadista ka qeybgalka shacabka iyo gaarsiinta awoodda dowladda meelaha ka baxsan magaalooyinka waaweyn. Madasha ayaa sidoo kale lagu falanqeyn doonaa dib-u-habeynta maamulka, horumarinta magaalooyinka, kobcinta dakhliga degmooyinka, la qabsiga isbeddelka cimilada iyo xoojinta iskaashiga u dhexeeya degmooyinka dalka. Xoojinta maamullada degmooyinka ayaa loo arkaa tiir muhiim u ah dadaallada Soomaaliya ee lagu xaqiijinayo xasillooni waarta, horumar dhaqaale iyo dowladnimo dimuqraadi ah.

items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay xafiiska Xoghayaha guud ee QM ayaa looga hadlay xaaladda guud ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan rabshadihii ugu dambeeyay ee dhawaan ka dhacay magaalada Muqdisho. António Guterres oo walaac ka muujiyay dagaalkii ka dhacay caasimada ayaa si deg-deg ah farriin ugu diray dowladda iyo mucaaradka, isaga oo xasuusiyay baahida loo qabo in deg-deg dib loogu bilaabo wada-hadalladii labada dhinac. “Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay waxa uu walaac xooggan ka muujiyey wararka ku saabsan rabshadaha ka dhacay Muqdisho. Waxa uu hoosta ka xariiqay baahida degdegga ah ee loo qabo in dhammaan dhinacyada ay khuseyso ay dib u bilaabaan wadahaddalka si loo helo dariiq loo maro ka fogaanshaha in dib u dhac ku yimaado horumarkii ilaa hadda laga gaaray Soomaaliya, iyo sidoo kale in la xaqiijiyo badbaadada dadka rayidka ah iyo kaabayaasha bulshada,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Sidoo kale, wuxuu dhinacyada is haya ugu baaqay inay is-xakameeyaan, kana fogaadaan wax kasta oo keeni kara isku dhinacyo horleh oo ka dhaca dalka.
